description:
Job Title: Senior Director – Software Product Management, LillyDirect International

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


LillyDirect is an innovative, industry-first direct-to-patient e-commerce experience designed to improve access to care, reduce healthcare costs, and provide integrated support to people managing chronic disease. As we scale rapidly, delivering exceptional consumer experiences is central to our mission.


We are seeking a Senior Director, Software Product Management, LillyDirect International to lead the international expansion of our digital product portfolio. This is a rare opportunity to take a proven direct-to-consumer healthcare platform and bring it to new markets, shaping how patients and healthcare professionals around the world access care, medicines, and support through LillyDirect.

As a senior product leader, you will define and own the international product strategy and roadmap, build and lead a team of market-focused product leaders, and decide what we build once, what we localize, and where a market earns dedicated investment. You will partner closely with Design, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Pharmacy, and Operations to launch products that feel native to each market, reduce friction, and build lasting consumer trust and loyalty, all on a scalable, modular platform that gets faster to launch with every new market.


What You Will Do


Team First Mentality

Install and embody a no-ego, team-first mindset in all interactions across your teams. Foster a collaborative culture that prioritizes shared success over individual recognition. Represent the product team with humility and integrity when engaging with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors.


International Product Strategy and Roadmap
Define and lead a bold international product strategy across multiple regions and markets, translating enterprise goals into market-specific roadmaps, timelines, and requirements. Prioritize investments based on local patient and consumer expectations, market maturity, and business impact, and ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across a portfolio of interconnected products and market teams.


Global Platform and Local Market Balance

Decide what to standardize, what to localize, and what to build once and reuse. Establish clear principles for when a market earns dedicated product investment versus being served from shared platform capabilities, and manage competing demands across markets with transparency and sound judgment.


Build and Lead Market Product Teams

Structure, hire, and develop a team of market-focused product leaders, each accountable for the roadmap and outcomes of their country or region. Set clear decision rights between market teams and global platform teams, and create the rhythms (planning, prioritization, shared learning) that keep the whole organization aligned without slowing local teams down.


Partnership Champion

Act as a strategic product partner across the organization, turning goals into a compelling product vision and actionable strategy for each market. Work closely with Design and Engineering to ensure solutions are grounded in local consumer needs, technically scalable, and aligned with the broader LillyDirect experience. Stay current on new technology and third-party solutions that could accelerate market launches. Champion the voice of the consumer in every product decision, using data, satisfaction trends, and qualitative research from each market to inform priorities.


User Experience and Design

Partner with UX and research leadership to understand end-to-end consumer journeys in each market across web, mobile, chat, email, and phone, ensuring what we bring to market reflects local language, culture, and expectations rather than a translated version of the U.S. experience. Advocate for design quality and accessibility throughout the product lifecycle and use data-driven insights to continuously reduce friction and anticipate needs before customers do.


Regulatory, Compliance, and Local Partnerships

Partner closely with Legal, Regulatory, Privacy, Pharmacy, and Operations leaders to design products that meet market-specific requirements for healthcare, data protection, payments, and operations. Build and manage relationships with local partners and vendors and bring regulatory considerations into roadmap planning early so they inform product decisions rather than slow them down.


Technical Collaboration and Standards

Lead your teams alongside engineering leadership to assess architectural trade-offs for platform components that must work across markets. Establish technical standards and ensure scalable, modular solutions that flex with volume, new languages, and new market requirements.


Stakeholder Engagement and Thought Leadership

Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, regional leaders, and local market teams. Serve as the internal subject matter expert on international product strategy, grounded in best practices for e-commerce and direct-to-consumer models. Represent LillyDirect’s product vision in industry forums and contribute to thought leadership.


Operational Excellence and Resource Planning

Lead portfolio-level resource allocation and prioritization across multiple countries, balancing engineering capacity, operational readiness, regulatory timelines, and cross-functional dependencies. Define how success is measured in each market and hold teams accountable to clear outcomes.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 10+ years leading product teams, including 5+ years in leadership roles
  • E-commerce or direct-to-consumer experience
  • US Candidates: Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

What You Should Bring

  • Direct experience leading market-specific product teams, where a team (and its leader) owned the product roadmap, localization, and outcomes for a single country or region
  • Proven experience leading across multiple markets simultaneously, with several market- or region-focused product teams reporting into you (leaders of leaders), not just serving as a single-market owner
  • Demonstrated track record launching and scaling consumer products in new international markets at a high-growth e-commerce or direct-to-consumer company
  • Experience balancing global platform consistency with local market needs, including deciding what to standardize, what to localize, and how to prioritize across competing market demands
  • Experience navigating market-specific regulatory, payment, language, and operational requirements in partnership with Legal, Ops, and local partners
  • Proven record of driving measurable improvements in consumer experience and business outcomes across markets
  • Deep understanding of user experience principles and human-centered design, including how user needs differ across cultures and regions
  • Experience structuring and evolving a multi-market product organization, including when to stand up a dedicated market team versus serve a market from shared platform teams
  • Background building modular platform and shared services architecture that lets new markets launch faster without rebuilding from scratch
  • Experience building and managing market-entry playbooks, launch sequencing, and go/no-go frameworks
  • Experience operating in regulated or complex environments (healthcare, pharmacy, financial services, or similar)
  • Excellent communication and influence skills, including engagement with C-level executives, regional GMs, and local market leaders
  • Resilience and persistence in navigating ambiguity, overcoming obstacles, and driving progress in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Exceptional leadership and strategic thinking, with strong business acumen and consumer empathy

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form () for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.


Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).


Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is

$163,500 - $275,000

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

About the Opportunity

Are you highly organized, detail-oriented, and someone who enjoys bringing people, processes, and projects together? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can make an impact, solve problems, and continue learning?

BayWa r.e. Solar Systems LLC is looking for a Project Management Specialist to join our Project Management Office (PMO).

In this role, you'll help keep important business initiatives moving forward by coordinating project activities, tracking progress, supporting cross-functional teams, and ensuring key deliverables stay on schedule. You'll work closely with project managers and business leaders across the organization, gaining exposure to a variety of initiatives while building your project management skills.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong organizational and communication skills who is interested in developing a career in project management.

What You'll Do

Keep Projects Moving

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of projects across the organization.
  • Help develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Track deadlines, action items, and project progress to keep teams aligned and accountable.
  • Coordinate meetings, document key decisions, and follow up on next steps.
  • Take ownership of smaller projects or assigned workstreams as your experience grows.

Support Communication & Collaboration

  • Work with cross-functional teams to coordinate priorities, activities, and deadlines.
  • Provide project updates and help ensure stakeholders have the information they need.
  • Identify potential roadblocks and work with team members to keep projects on track.
  • Build strong working relationships across departments.

Drive Organization & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain project trackers, dashboards, reports, and documentation.
  • Help prepare project updates and presentations for leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, streamline processes, and strengthen project execution.
  • Support the development and implementation of PMO tools, templates, and best practices.

What We're Looking For: We're looking for someone who is proactive, collaborative, and enjoys turning plans into action.

You'll be successful in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and can juggle multiple priorities without losing sight of the details.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with colleagues at all levels.
  • Take initiative, follow through on commitments, and enjoy solving problems.
  • Are comfortable tracking deadlines, coordinating activities, and keeping others informed.
  • Enjoy learning new tools, processes, and ways of working.
  • Have strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Bring a positive, flexible, and solutions-oriented mindset.

Experience & Education

  • 1–2 years of experience in project coordination, business operations, administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Operations, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Familiarity with project management tools or methodologies is a plus.

Don't have formal project management experience? We still encourage you to apply if you have strong organizational skills, enjoy coordinating people and activities, and are excited to grow into project management.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting meaningful, cross-functional business initiatives.
  • Collaborate with teams and leaders across the organization.
  • Build valuable project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Contribute ideas and improvements that make a real difference.
  • Develop professionally within a dynamic and evolving business.

Ready to help turn great ideas into results? We'd love to hear from you.

Salary: $60,000 - $70,000

title: Senior/Principal Technical Product Manager
excerpt: About Nava Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective.
description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

This role is open for multiple levels and titles. Final title/compensation will be determined by how your interview weighs against our core competencies during your interview cycle. This position is contingent pending contract award.

Position summary

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager (Cloud) to lead product strategy and delivery for our work with the U.S. Department of Education's Office of Federal Student Aid (FSA), which delivers federal student aid to millions of students and families every year. Our team builds automated testing suites, test data tooling, and CI/CD pipelines in AWS that help multiple vendor teams ship safer releases, faster.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, cloud engineering, and quality. You'll work with engineers, FSA product owners, and third-party vendor teams to define the roadmap, prioritize the backlog, and make sure every release moves the program forward. The best fit for this role started out technical. Maybe you were a software engineer, or you worked in infrastructure, test automation, QA engineering, or DevOps before moving into product. You can follow an architecture discussion, push back on an estimate, and still translate it all into plain language for agency leadership.

What you'll do

  • Define and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned to FSA's mission, milestones, and contract objectives using the Focus Delivery Framework Apply structured prioritization frameworks to balance user needs, compliance requirements, and technical feasibility
  • Turn vendor team pain points, release data, and stakeholder goals into epics, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria
  • Define success measures for test coverage, release velocity, defect escape rate, and pipeline reliability
  • Partner with engineering leads on AWS architecture, CI/CD pipelines, test automation strategy, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code, and make informed tradeoffs without prescribing implementation
  • Own the backlog for developer self-service tools (test data generation, pipeline status, environment readiness) used by vendor teams and government stakeholders
  • Collaborate with the Technical Lead on DevSecOps and ATO readiness activities so security and compliance are planned in from the start
  • Coordinate technical dependencies across engineering, external vendors, and FSA platform owners
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to keep cross-functional teams aligned and unblocked
  • Partner with FSA product owners to balance competing priorities across a multi-vendor federal ecosystem
  • Build alignment across program, policy, and technology partners without formal authority
  • Run demos and sprint reviews that keep stakeholders informed and promote continuous learning
  • Establish a metrics strategy including leading indicators, counterweight metrics, and performance dashboards
  • Create a single source of truth linking technical specifications, user requirements, and decisions
  • Prepare Monthly Project Status Reports and represent delivery health to FSA leadership

Required skills

  • 4-year degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience in technical product management, software engineering, or a closely related technical role
  • Prior experience working as an engineer, or working on infrastructure or cloud environments and projects (for example, test automation, QA engineering, or DevOps)
  • Experience on government modernization projects
  • Hands-on cloud experience, AWS preferred (Azure also welcome)
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code, enough to clarify edge cases and challenge estimates
  • Strong skills in MVP definition, roadmap creation, and cross-functional delivery using agile methodologies
  • Exceptional executive communication, with the ability to synthesize technical details into clear, scannable updates for leadership
  • Data-driven decision-making; comfortable establishing metrics strategies and analytics framework

Desired skills

  • Experience with the Department of Education / FSA or other high-volume public services
  • Familiarity with government security requirements (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, ATO processes, Section 508) and Public Trust environments
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Terraform, Playwright or similar test frameworks, and observability tooling such as DataDog
  • Experience managing dependencies across multiple vendor teams
  • Comfort with SQL or Python for your own analysis
Compensation
$153,000—$173,700 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus

Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools

Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin

The Site Reliability Specialist II contributes to the operational stability and performance of Intelerad’s healthcare imaging platforms with growing independence. This role takes ownership of defined monitoring, database maintenance, and cloud operations tasks, responds to incidents with increasing autonomy, and begins to drive improvements in systems and processes. As this individual deepens their expertise across system administration, SQL performance, and cloud infrastructure, they play an active role in helping the team maintain the high availability standards that healthcare providers depend on.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain system reliability across production environments by monitoring infrastructure health, independently investigating and resolving performance issues, and ensuring consistent uptime for Intelerad’s healthcare imaging platforms with escalation to senior specialists for complex scenarios.
  • Execute and optimize SQL database maintenance by performing routine and non-routine maintenance tasks, analyzing basic query performance issues, supporting backup and recovery operations, and escalating advanced tuning requirements to senior team members.
  • Support cloud infrastructure operations by administering and maintaining cloud-based deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), implementing infrastructure changes using established patterns, and contributing to the migration of on-premises systems to cloud environments.
  • Respond to incidents with increasing ownership by independently diagnosing system and database issues of moderate complexity, executing resolution steps, contributing to root cause analysis, and recommending preventive measures to reduce recurrence.
  • Advance continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to automate recurring manual tasks, improving monitoring coverage and alerting accuracy, updating runbooks and documentation, and contributing to team projects that enhance platform reliability.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in system administration, site reliability engineering, technical operations, or a related role supporting production environments.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server administration, including query execution, index concepts, backup and recovery, and database maintenance tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including compute, storage, and networking fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration, including scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).
  • Experience using monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, DataDog, or similar) to identify and investigate system issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Cloud certification (AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator, or equivalent).
  • Experience with healthcare IT systems, particularly PACS, RIS, or medical imaging platforms.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data standards and compliance requirements (HIPAA, DICOM, HL7).
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with SQL Server high availability concepts (Always On, clustering, replication).
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotation.
  • Flexibility to respond to critical incidents outside standard business hours.

Travel Requirements

Occasional travel may be required for client escalations or team collaboration (up to 10%).

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

The base pay for this position ranges from $82,500 - $110,000 USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.

Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. title: Web Developer (PHP & JavaScript)
excerpt: The Eclipse Foundation is a globally recognised not-for-profit organisation that supports a vibrant community of open source projects and contributors.
description:
The Eclipse Foundation is a globally recognised not-for-profit organisation that supports a
vibrant community of open source projects and contributors. With a commitment to vendor neutrality and transparency, we provide a collaborative environment for innovation across industries, including cloud, edge, AI, and developer tooling. Our team is remote first, inclusive, and passionate about open source.


Position Summary

The Eclipse Foundation is seeking a skilled Web Developer to join our Software Development team. This is a new role where you will help build, maintain, and modernise the web platforms that support our global open source community and internal operations.

Your primary focus will be developing and maintaining Drupal websites, modernising legacy PHP applications, and building new applications using Symfony. You will also work with JavaScript, APIs, and other web technologies, contributing to front-end development and supporting applications built with frameworks such as React, Nuxt.js, and Hugo when needed.

We are looking for someone with strong PHP, Symfony, Drupal, and JavaScript skills who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and work across different applications and frameworks.

Reporting to the Web Development Team Lead, you will take ownership of your work, contribute to technical decisions, and collaborate with colleagues to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, accessible, and maintainable solutions.

This is an opportunity to work with a range of technologies, engage directly with open source communities, and deliver solutions that have a global impact.

Salary Range: $75,000–$95,000 in Canada and €45,000–€60,000 in Europe.

Location: This is a remote position. The selected candidate will work from their home office.All qualified candidates will be considered, with preference for candidates based in
Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Belgium.


Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain Drupal websites, including custom modules, themes, and integrations.
  • Build new web applications and internal tools using Symfony and modern PHP
  • development practices.
  • Maintain and modernise legacy PHP applications, improving code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Twig.
  • Support applications using other web technologies and frameworks, including Bootstrap,
  • React, Nuxt.js, and Hugo, as needed.
  • Design, develop, and integrate REST APIs and third-party services, following security and reliability best practices.
  • Work with relational databases, primarily MariaDB, including schema design, query optimisation, and performance improvements.
  • Maintain and improve search and caching integrations using technologies such as Solr and Redis.
  • Investigate and resolve application errors, performance issues, and reported bugs.Maintain dependencies, support framework upgrades, and address security vulnerabilities.
  • Use Docker-based development environments and CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and deploy applications reliably.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, participate in code reviews, improve automated test coverage, and maintain technical documentation.
  • Apply secure coding practices, support the Foundation's privacy and compliance requirements, and develop responsive, accessible web interfaces.
  • Collaborate with developers and internal stakeholders to clarify requirements, communicate progress, and identify blockers.
  • Balance planned development with maintenance and support requests.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in our applications, development processes, and technical practices.

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Desired Skills and Experience
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, object-oriented programming, and Composer.
  • Experience developing and maintaining applications using Symfony and Drupal 11.

  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience using templating engines such as Twig.

  • Working knowledge of web accessibility and performance principles.

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, including pull requests and code reviews.

  • Familiarity with Drupal caching, configuration management, queues, and Drush.
  • Experience migrating legacy PHP applications to Symfony.
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Keycloak.
  • Familiarity with NGINX configuration, including reverse proxying, caching, and HTTP headers.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes/OKD and Jenkins for containerised deployments.
  • Experience with profiling, debugging, and performance analysis tools.

title: Senior Digital Donor Specialist
excerpt: The Senior Digital Donor Specialist will lead Earthworks’ efforts to develop an independent funding base and, internally, strengthen the connections between digital engagement and individual giving.
description:
The Senior Digital Donor Specialist will lead Earthworks’ efforts to develop an independent funding base and, internally, strengthen the connections between digital engagement and individual giving. The position’s core responsibility is to develop, manage, and measure strategies that move supporters from initial engagement through action, giving, and long-term support. This position is 32 hours per week.

About Earthworks

Earthworks is a nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting communities and the environment from the adverse impacts of mineral and energy development while promoting sustainable solutions. Earthworks stands for clean air, water, and land, healthy communities, and corporate accountability. We work for solutions that protect both the Earth’s resources and our communities. Earthworks has a primarily remote staff of approximately 50 employees in over 20 states and DC.

Earthworks is committed to challenging and dismantling systemic oppression. Earthworks’ board and staff understand that promoting diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) both within and beyond Earthworks is critical to carrying out our mission to protect communities and the environment from the adverse impacts of resource extraction. We understand that our commitment to DEI means a dedication to constant learning and improvement.

Earthworks welcomes applications from diverse candidates and is an equal-opportunity employer. Earthworks evaluates employees and applicants for employment on merit, competence, and qualifications and does not tolerate discrimination.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Earthworks, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Core responsibilities:

  • Own and manage Earthworks’ digital supporter and donor journey, developing clear pathways that move people from initial engagement to action, first-time giving, repeat and recurring giving, and long-term support.

  • Own Earthworks’ email and digital donor strategy, including audience segmentation, campaign architecture and sequencing, engagement and fundraising cadence, nurture and welcome series, post-action follow-up, stewardship, re-engagement, and performance optimization; work collaboratively with Communications and Program staff responsible for content production, digital acquisition, and channel execution.

  • Lead digital individual-giving campaigns in close partnership with the Philanthropy team, with responsibility for growing digital revenue, increasing donor conversion, strengthening recurring giving, and improving donor retention and upgrade pathways.

  • Develop systems to connect Communications, Philanthropy, and Program priorities into an integrated supporter strategy, establishing clear campaign goals, audiences, supporter pathways, handoffs, and measures of success while coordinating with staff responsible for content creation, advocacy, social media, paid acquisition, and donor stewardship.

  • Develop and manage a robust testing and optimization program across email and digital fundraising, testing messaging, content, audiences, asks, campaign structure, cadence, donation pathways, and other variables to continuously improve performance.

  • Establish and track shared performance metrics for the digital supporter program, including audience growth, engagement, action-taking, donor conversion, revenue, retention, recurring giving, and movement between stages of the supporter journey; regularly translate results into actionable recommendations.

  • Manage and coordinate external digital fundraising vendors and partners, ensuring outside support aligns with Earthworks’ strategy, audience goals, brand and messaging, and is accountable to clear performance objectives.

  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of Earthworks’ email and digital donor program, coordinating staff and external partners, managing necessary input and approvals, and consulting with the position’s manager and other relevant staff as needed.

Required Experience and Qualifications

The successful candidate should bring 8+ years of demonstrated experience independently developing and managing digital fundraising and email strategy, with strong execution skills, excellent writing and project management, and demonstrated success developing and executing digital fundraising campaigns that generate individual donations.

  • 8+ years of direct experience in digital fundraising, online marketing, and/or email marketing.

  • Experience using email marketing platforms, CRM systems, and online donation tools to manage campaigns and track performance.

  • Strong copywriting and editing skills tailored to engaging and motivating supporters and translating complex missions into accessible and compelling content and stories.

  • Proven ability to pull performance analytics, interpret engagement and fundraising data, and use insights to optimize future campaigns.

  • Demonstrated experience with audience segmentation, donor conversion, stewardship, and email campaign strategy.

  • Strong project-management and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to coordinate competing priorities and move projects forward.

  • Experience developing and executing meaningful tests and applying results to improve fundraising performance.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience working in a nonprofit, advocacy organization, political campaign, or similar mission-driven environment.

  • Experience with Engaging Networks and Salesforce, including audience segmentation, reporting, and donor data management.

  • Experience developing or growing recurring giving programs, donor retention strategies, or automated cultivation series.

  • Experience managing external fundraising agencies, consultants, or digital vendors.

  • Familiarity with digital acquisition strategies and evaluating the longer-term value of acquired supporters.

Location and Travel

This position is remote in the United States, and applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Some travel may be required for certain positions. Employees who are unable to travel/attend in-person meetings for health or disability reasons may request accommodations.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a 32-hour-per-week position. The salary range for this position is $80,000-$85,000 annually, depending on experience. This is the true hiring range, thoughtfully created in consideration of budget and pay equity, and it’s not negotiable. Earthworks provides staff working 30+ hours with a competitive benefits package, including employer-paid medical, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance. Additionally, Earthworks offers unlimited paid leave, paid parental leave, and a 403(b) retirement plan (with a 5% match after one year of employment). After five years of employment, staff is eligible for a fully paid sabbatical.

Bargaining Unit Status

Earthworks is a union workplace; our employees are represented by Earthworkers Unite/ Industrial Workers of the World (IWW). This position is included in the bargaining unit.

How to Apply

We strongly encourage and seek applications from people of color, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, people with disabilities, and bilingual individuals. Reasonable accommodations will be made so that applicants with disabilities may participate in the application and interview process. Please advise in writing of special needs at the time of application.

Apply online at , including a cover letter, resume, and one example of a fundraising email or digital fundraising campaign you developed or managed. No emails or phone calls, please. Application Deadline: December 5th, 2026.

Qualified applicants can expect to complete three interview stages: an initial phone interview, a virtual panel interview, and a virtual final interview. We’ll also request a list of three professional references after the second stage of the interview process.

description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Role Summary:

The Senior Network & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving highly available and secure network infrastructure supporting Visa's critical platforms and services.


This role requires deep hands-on expertise across cloud and enterprise networking, with responsibility for connectivity, routing, network security, troubleshooting, automation, and production operations. The engineer will work closely with SRE, Cloud, Security, Architecture, and application teams to deliver resilient network solutions and resolve complex production issues.

The ideal candidate combines strong traditional networking fundamentals with modern cloud networking and automation skills and is comfortable operating business-critical infrastructure in a 24x7 environment.


All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools to support everyday work.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and operate highly available network infrastructure across cloud and enterprise environments.
  • Design and support AWS networking, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPNs, routing, load balancing, DNS, and connectivity across multiple environments and regions.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols, network segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, NAT, DNS, and load-balancing solutions.
  • Support hybrid connectivity between cloud environments, data centers, partners, service providers, and external networks.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex network incidents, troubleshooting connectivity, routing, latency, packet loss, and performance issues.
  • Design network solutions with resilience, redundancy, scalability, security, and disaster recovery requirements in mind.
  • Implement network infrastructure and configuration through automation and Infrastructure as Code, reducing manual operational activities.
  • Build and improve network monitoring, observability, alerting, and capacity management.
  • Collaborate with Security, Cloud, SRE, Architecture, application teams, vendors, and telecommunications providers on network designs and implementations.
  • Support network changes, maintenance activities, incident response, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, network diagrams, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production environments.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting large-scale enterprise and cloud networks.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, routing, switching, DNS, NAT, VPN, network segmentation, and load balancing.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS networking services such as VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, and site-to-site VPN.
  • Experience with enterprise firewall platforms and network security concepts.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and data center connectivity.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex network issues using tools such as packet captures, flow logs, network telemetry, and traffic analysis.
  • Experience with network monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Experience automating network infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and scripting, such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience operating highly available, business-critical production environments.
  • Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, change management, and production support.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working across infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, and application teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced experience with AWS networking in large-scale, multi-account, and multi-region environments.
  • Experience with Fortinet, Cisco, or similar enterprise networking and security platforms.
  • Experience with Direct Connect, carrier circuits, colocation/data-center networking, and connectivity with external partners.
  • Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code at scale.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container networking.
  • Experience designing resilient network architectures for high-volume distributed systems.
  • Experience with network capacity planning, performance engineering, and observability.

Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.

title: Senior, Systems Engineer - Functional Safety & Safety Architecture (Unstructured
excerpt: About The Company: At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
description:
About The Company:
At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler Truck family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet The Team:
Torc is hiring a Senior Systems Engineer to own the safety concept, safety architecture, and safety case for autonomous vehicles that operate in unstructured, off-highway environments. Our team adapts Torc’s L4 autonomy stack to specialty vehicle platforms and delivers them to customers for hands-on evaluation. We are a small, dedicated group that owns the system end to end, from hazard analysis through on-vehicle verification, and we work directly with vehicle manufacturers, suppliers, and Torc’s corporate safety organization.

What You’ll Do:
This role is focused on the safety of autonomous ground vehicles in unstructured environments: defining what “safe” means for each platform and use case, designing the safety architecture that achieves it, and producing the evidence that it has been achieved. In a secondary capacity you will contribute to the system architecture of the autonomy kit itself, so that the safety concept holds across multiple vehicle platforms and generations of compute. You will work closely with systems, software, controls, perception, hardware, and test engineers, and you will be the second independent safety voice on a lean team.

  • Safety Engineering
    • Lead hazard analyses for new platforms and use cases, and derive safety goals and functional safety requirements from them.
    • Perform single-point-failure and fault-tree analyses of the autonomy system, including compute, sensing, communications, and drive-by-wire paths, and define fault detection, degraded modes, and minimum-risk maneuver behavior.
    • Define the safety requirements and acceptance criteria for partner-supplied drive-by-wire and emergency-stop systems, and lead their integration assessment.
    • Build and maintain structured safety cases (for example, GSN) for successive operating phases: closed-course testing with a safety driver, remote operation, and customer-operated evaluation.
    • Prepare and present safety assessments to internal safety governance boards and to customer and partner reviews, and act as an independent safety reviewer in the software and hardware release process.
  • Safety and Systems Architecture
    • Define the safety-relevant interfaces of the autonomy kit that stay fixed as the vehicle changes: vehicle gateway and emergency-stop paths, operating-mode and takeover management, diagnostics, and fault management; and specify the mode-arbitration and fault-response behavior (operating modes, takeover, pause, emergency stop) as formal state behavior with timing, backed by message-level interface contracts.
    • Contribute safety and reliability analysis to system-level architecture decisions, including compute platform selection, redundancy strategy, and the path from prototype hardware to productized hardware.
    • Co-author architecture decision records, interface control documents, and system requirements with the principal systems engineer and software architects.
    • Establish requirements traceability from safety goals through system and component requirements to tests and safety-case evidence, in the team’s model-based systems engineering environment and text-based requirement tooling, so that each requirement carries its safety classification, verification method, and evidence.
  • Verification, Validation, and Field Readiness
    • Define system-level safety metrics and key performance indicators used to judge readiness before vehicles are handed to customers, and the verification plan that produces them.
    • Specify fault-injection interfaces and acceptance criteria for software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and vehicle-in-the-loop testing, and review test plans and results for safety coverage.
    • Support on-vehicle testing, incident and anomaly investigation, and the safety content of operating procedures, training, maintenance, and recovery documentation delivered with the vehicles.

We are seeking an engineer who is energized by making a real autonomous system demonstrably safe in the field, and who can move between a hazard analysis, an architecture review, and a vehicle bay in the same week.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years of experience OR Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field with 3+ years of industry experience
  • Hands-on experience applying a functional safety standard to a real product, such as ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), MIL-STD-882, UL 4600, or IEC 61508, including authoring hazard analyses, safety goals, and safety requirements.
  • Experience building and defending a safety case or safety assessment for an autonomous or robotic system in front of an internal safety board, a customer, or a regulator.
  • Experience with system safety analysis methods such as FMEA, FTA, STPA, or single-point-failure analysis, applied to systems that combine software, compute, sensing, and actuation.
  • Working knowledge of vehicle actuation and drive-by-wire systems, emergency-stop architectures, and fault-tolerant design patterns such as redundancy, watchdogs, and minimum-risk maneuvers.
  • Experience as a systems engineer on a complex real-time system: requirements definition, interface control, traceability, and verification planning.
  • Ability to read and review production software (C++ or Python) and to reason about timing, failure modes, and diagnostics at the code and message level.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to perform both real-time diagnostics and in-depth post-analysis.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional engineering teams, including the ability to translate safety findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for leadership and partners.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a highly collaborative environment.

Bonus Points!

  • Experience with off-highway, defense, agricultural, mining, or other unstructured-environment ground vehicles.
  • Experience with model-based systems engineering (SysML, Cameo or similar) and requirements tools (Jama, DOORS, or text-based requirement languages).
  • Experience specifying or operating hardware-in-the-loop and fault-injection test environments.
  • Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS 2 and with safety-relevant aspects of automotive compute platforms (for example, NVIDIA DRIVE).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity engineering for vehicles (ISO/SAE 21434) and its interaction with functional safety.
  • Experience working with vehicle manufacturers and suppliers on joint safety responsibilities and interface agreements.
  • Experience supporting on-vehicle testing, debugging, and deployment activities.
  • Passion for autonomous vehicles, robotics, and solving complex real-world engineering challenges.

Work Location: For this position, we are open to hiring in our Blacksburg, VA office work location in a hybrid capacity. We are also open to hiring Remote in the United States & Canada with semi-monthly travel to Blacksburg, VA. Some travel to Europe may be required.

U.S. Citizenship Requirement:
This position requires access to information and systems that are restricted under U.S. law. Accordingly, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role. This requirement is based on applicable government regulations and is not related to immigration status discrimination.

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • Company-wide holiday office closures

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.

excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description:

The Senior Recovery and Restoration Engineer is a key member of the Incident Management & Recovery team, responsible for rebuilding and securing infrastructure environments following ransomware or other destructive cyber incidents. This role blends deep on-premises infrastructure expertise (Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, storage, backups, etc.) with advanced Microsoft 365 and Azure tenant recovery experience. This Engineer will lead hands-on rebuild efforts across identity, compute, storage, and cloud layers, working directly with clients, the GuidePoint Security Incident Response team, and internal engineers to restore business operations quickly, securely, and safely.

About the Recovery & Restoration Team:

The Recovery & Restoration (R&R) Team is responsible for responding to large-scale cybersecurity incidents and supporting the technical remediation efforts required to restore client environments to a secure, operational state. We operate within GuidePoint Security's Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) and Incident & Advisory (IA) practice, serving as the hands-on rebuild arm that brings clients back online after ransomware and other destructive cyber events.

Our team of Recovery & Restoration Engineers focuses on infrastructure rebuild, identity recovery, and environment hardening across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments — including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, VMware, Hyper-V, and enterprise backup platforms. We partner with DFIR forensic investigators, Threat Actor Communications, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and client IT teams to deliver rapid, secure, and defensible recovery outcomes.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Lead IT recovery projects involving on-premises endpoint and network infrastructure, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365.
  • Develop and manage technical remediation and restoration plans tailored to the impact of a client’s environment.
  • Knowledge of common firewall platforms and ability to implement network containment in preparation for recovery efforts.
  • Rebuild Active Directory domains, DNS/DHCP, and GPO structures to a clean baseline.
  • Restore and validate virtualized workloads (VMware, Hyper-V) and critical file/application servers.
  • Recover and secure Entra ID identities, Conditional Access, and synchronization with on-prem AD.
  • Rebuild Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams configurations.
  • Validate and restore data from backups (Veeam, Rubrik, Datto, etc.) ensuring integrity and cleanliness.
  • Knowledge of common remote management tools used to assist impacted clients remotely.
  • Knowledge of industry standard Microsoft hardening guidelines.
  • Ability to implement common compliance controls, such as MFA, Defender for Office 365, Purview, etc.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (PowerShell/Python) for recurring recovery workflows.
  • Document rebuilt configurations and assist client recommendations for hardening and post-incident validation.
  • Participate in after-hours response rotations.
  • Travel to client sites as required to perform critical recovery activities and on-site validation. Up to 50% travel.

Required Experience and Education:

Technical Expertise

  • 7+ years of technical experience OR a BS/BA Degree with 3+ years of technical experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Strong experience with VMware or Hyper-V virtualization platforms.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell. Prefer experience with Entra ID, Exchange Online, and Graph API modules.
  • Familiarity with backup restoration workflows and immutable storage systems.
  • Solid understanding of identity security, Conditional Access, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Exchange Online Protection.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Recovery & Security Mindset

  • Demonstrated success in recovery or rebuild scenarios post-incident, including ransomware or other destructive attacks.
  • Ability to identify persistence mechanisms and rebuild clean environments under tight timelines.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, CIS benchmarks, and insurance-driven recovery requirements.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work alongside IR firms, legal counsel, and insurers during live recovery engagements.
  • Capable of mentoring junior engineers and improving structured rebuild approaches.

Professional Attributes

  • Calm and decisive under pressure and able to prioritize critical-path recovery items.
  • Highly organized with a disciplined approach to communicating recovery milestones, task tracking, and reporting.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% to client environments as needed for hands-on rebuilds and validation.

Preferred Experience & Technical Knowledge:

  • 5–8 years of experience in infrastructure engineering roles, preferably within consulting, MSP, or IR/recovery efforts.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., AZ-104, MS-100, MS-500, SC-300) or equivalent enterprise experience.
  • Experience with one or more EDR or security platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender).
  • Strong scripting or automation experience, demonstrating process acceleration in rebuilds.

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 50% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Lead SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and functional validation.

  • Manage stakeholder communication, functional documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Review junior consultants' deliverables and provide functional guidance.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on SAP Fieldglass Functional Consulting experience.
  • End-to-end SAP Fieldglass implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support experience.
  • Contingent Workforce Management.
  • Services Procurement and Statement of Work (SOW) processes.
  • SAP Fieldglass configuration and business rule management.
  • Requirements gathering and functional solution design.
  • SAP Fieldglass integration requirements and functional specifications.
  • SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and go-live support.
  • Functional and integration troubleshooting.
  • Stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with global and distributed delivery teams.
  • Ability to mentor junior consultants.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

  • Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA.
  • Understanding of APIs, middleware, interfaces, and enterprise integration concepts.
  • Experience with large-scale global SAP Fieldglass implementations and rollouts.
  • Experience working with implementation partners, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
  • SAP Fieldglass training or relevant SAP certification.

Mandatory Skills

  • SAP Business AI for eProcurement
  • SAP Joule for Consultants (J4C)

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 7–11 years of overall experience with strong hands-on SAP Fieldglass functional consulting expertise. They should be capable of independently leading functional delivery, managing complex stakeholder requirements, coordinating integration and testing activities, and mentoring junior team members.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients.

description:
Summary: The Enterprise Clinical Insights Senior Advisor is a senior individual contributor who independently leads high-priority business insights, measurement, and solution design work for the Enterprise Clinical organization. The role serves as a trusted consultant to clinical and business leaders, helping them clarify complex problems, identify the right analytical approach, and translate evidence into decisions that improve affordability, quality, health outcomes, customer experience, and operational performance.

This role owns relationships with designated business partners and stewards a portfolio of insights products and capabilities. The Senior Advisor sets direction for complex analyses, KPI and measurement frameworks, executive scorecards, dashboards, decision-support tools, and self-service solutions. The role leads work from problem framing and prioritization through design, delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement, while coordinating Data & Analytics, Technology, Clinical, Finance, Network, and other matrix partners.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior Advisor is expected to apply sound judgment in ambiguous situations, influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and provide clear recommendations to senior leaders. The role also raises the effectiveness of the broader team by establishing standards, coaching colleagues, and building reusable approaches that scale business insights across the enterprise.


Responsibilities:

  • Own relationships with assigned Enterprise Clinical business partners and serve as a trusted consultant on priorities, performance challenges, and decision needs.
  • Consult with leaders to clarify ambiguous business problems, distinguish root causes from symptoms, and determine the appropriate analytical, measurement, product, or process solution.
  • Triage and prioritize business questions based on strategic value, urgency, feasibility, dependencies, and expected impact; communicate recommendations and trade-offs.
  • Independently lead complex, cross-functional analyses that evaluate clinical, operational, and financial performance and identify actionable opportunities.
  • Translate strategic questions into hypotheses, analytical approaches, measurement methodologies, technical requirements, and decision-oriented recommendations.
  • Lead the design of executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, dashboards, decision-support tools, and other scalable business insights capabilities.
  • Act as business owner and steward for assigned insights products, including product vision, roadmap, requirements, metric integrity, governance, adoption, and lifecycle management.
  • Design standardized measures and evaluation frameworks that connect clinical outcomes, operational performance, and financial value.
  • Lead matrix partners across Clinical, Finance, Network, Technology, and Data & Analytics to deliver, implement, and improve insights solutions.
  • Establish standards, coach colleagues, and advance reusable, automated, self-service, and AI-enabled approaches that improve the quality and scalability of business insights.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7 plus years of experience in healthcare business insights, healthcare consulting, business intelligence, population health, clinical operations, managed care, performance measurement, or related work.
  • Demonstrated success independently leading complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
  • Experience owning senior business-partner relationships and influencing decisions without direct authority in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience designing and stewarding dashboards, scorecards, KPI frameworks, decision-support capabilities, or other insights products.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative information into actionable business recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and modern data, visualization, and productivity tools sufficient to guide solution design and partner effectively with technical teams.
  • Executive-level written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and deliver with limited oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience with clinical operations, care management, utilization management, provider performance, quality measurement, population health, healthcare affordability, or program evaluation.
  • Experience connecting clinical outcomes, operational performance, and financial value in a managed care or health services environment.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, Snowflake, Python, Alteryx, Excel, SharePoint, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience designing self-service solutions, automated workflows, product roadmaps, and governance models.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analysis, research, automation, coding, and content development.
  • Experience with continuous improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, statistical process control, or design thinking; advanced degree preferred.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 112,100 - 186,800 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.

Senior Partner Development Manager (SPDM)

Advance your career and grow with one of the fastest growing companies in the industry. At Telarus, partner success, innovation, a positive employee culture, team achievement, and individual development drive our business every day. We are looking for sharp, driven professionals who thrive in a fast paced, relationship focused environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Partner Development Manager (SPDM) plays a key role in driving revenue growth and expanding Telarus’ presence within a defined geographic region. This role serves as the primary point of contact between Telarus and key stakeholders, including existing Technology Advisors, prospective TAs, and Technology Suppliers.

Partner Recruitment

Skills and Competencies
• Natural connector and relationship builder who thrives in networking environments.
• Results driven and competitive with a strong motivation to achieve targets and win market share.
• Strong communicator both verbally and in writing across in person and digital channels.
• Active listener with consultative selling skills and solid business acumen.
• Highly ethical, professional, and accountable.
Qualifications
• 10+ years of experience in technology, telecom, or channel sales strongly preferred.
• Ability to build and manage relationships from executive leadership to operational stakeholders.
• Proven track record of developing and growing a partner ecosystem.
Working Conditions
• Remote role with frequent travel throughout the Rockies region.
• Comfortable leading both virtual and in person engagements.
• Hosting and managing industry and partner events.
• Prolonged periods of computer based work.

OTE: On target earnings. Salary plus commissions. Salary range is based on experience
