title: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments
excerpt: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments 1.
description:
Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Digital Transformation Director is responsible for defining and leading the organization's digital transformation strategy to modernize business operations, enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation through technology.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide digital initiatives involving technology modernization, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud adoption, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and system integration.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, IT teams, business unit heads, and external technology partners to translate business objectives into digital transformation roadmaps, manage strategic technology investments, and ensure successful implementation of digital solutions that deliver measurable business value.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.

Defense and Aerospace Strategic Business Development Manager

Emerging Defense Primes & Commercial Space

Business: Teradyne Defense & Aerospace
Reports To: Worldwide Sales Manager

Our Purpose

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. This position will focus on identifying, qualifying, and creating strategic opportunities with organizations developing next-generation aerospace, defense, autonomy, artificial intelligence, and space systems.

Working closely with sales leadership and named account teams, you will help position Teradyne's test solutions within a dynamic and evolving customer landscape.

title: Event Marketing Manager
excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As Human Interest prepares for its next phase of significant growth and public company readiness, we're seeking an Event Marketing Manager to own and drive events at Human Interest. You will be responsible for 20-25 channel (HCM, Payroll, SBO, Advisor, Accountants, Benefits Brokers, etc.) and prospect (Franchise, HR, etc.) events /quarter. Expect to be hands-on, ready to roll up your sleeves and be creative. Given our rapid pace, you'll also need to be comfortable with speed and constant change (i.e., 24,791 mph) while achieving successful, high quality outcomes.

About the team

The channel events marketing team is responsible for planning and executing events that drive revenue and partnership opportunities for our field teams. The majority of events are partner events, along with industry events and some internal events. There are ~150 events/year and growing.

What you get to do every day

  • Plan, manage and execute external high-profile events. Own end-to-end event logistics, comms, and post-event reporting for assigned events.
  • Work in partnership with the brand/content/marketing team to have consistent messaging and positioning to maximize your contributions while supporting cross-functional initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing team members and sales/partnerships on program strategy, target setting, activations and outreach — but ultimately you are in the driver’s seat and own the outcomes of the event.
  • Regularly evaluate event outcomes and successes, share learnings, and optimize and adjust plans based on those learnings.
  • Research event opportunities based on objectives, target audiences, and industries, and make proactive recommendations for adjustments to our strategy— this is across industry, channel and internal.
  • Own the budget for assigned events, handle contract negotiation, vendor sourcing, online swag portal & invoicing for events and sponsorships. Assist in the facilitation of contracts and invoices through the company’s procurement portal.
  • Conceptualize and pitch bold, outside-the-box event activations, booth concepts, and interactive touchpoints that break through the noise and spark genuine attendee engagement.
  • Be creative and unique by testing different event formats to help engage our internal team, partners, and prospects while developing success metrics to ensure positive ROI.
  • Actively contribute to improving systems and processes to support the ongoing success of the department.

In any given month, the type of projects you’ll work on may include:

  • Strategic planning, setting OKRs, and socializing new programs for events and swag.
  • Event planning for partner offsites, partner promotions, or incentive trips.
  • Measurement and reporting, including setting targets, monitoring performance, and sharing pre-and-post-event

What you bring to the role

  • 5+ years of relevant experience (event marketing, field marketing, project management)
  • Proven experience carrying out concurrent event program efforts, including event planning & reporting
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high growth software company where change is a constant – with a bias towards being proactive and self-directed
  • Self-starter, ability to lead innovative, entrepreneurial efforts and drive for excellence
  • Extreme attention to detail and highly organized
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • Able to function independently, as well as collaboratively with other team members
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet a plus

Nice to have

  • Completion of CMP certification

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $80,000 - $95,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

title: Senior Staff AI Security Engineer, AI Platform (AI Native)
excerpt: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The AI Native Platform team is a cross-functional engineering organization built to lay the infrastructure foundations for Life360's AI-native transformation. We are not exploring what might be possible, we are building the platform that makes it operational.

The team works across four interconnected areas: how Life360 safely accesses and governs the use of frontier AI models and external integrations; the agent deployment and workflow infrastructure that lets teams build, test, version, and operate autonomous agents with the same rigor applied to any production software; how we safely democratize data, information, and knowledge across the organization, making it queryable and usable by AI systems and humans reliably; and a multiplayer AI workbench that gives every employee a purpose-built environment tuned to their role, with relevant tools, knowledge, and workflows rather than a general-purpose chat interface.

The work is deliberate, high-velocity, and built to last. The bar is high: real use cases, production deployments, measurable outcomes.

Security is not a checkpoint on this team. It is part of how we build. We are looking for engineers who want to be in the room where the architecture is designed and in the codebase where it's being built.

About the Job

We are hiring a Sr. Staff AI Security Engineer to secure Life360's AI infrastructure as it takes shape. You will sit within the AI Native Platform team, reporting directly to the CISO, working alongside the engineers designing and building each layer of the platform.

This role is grounded in execution with real architectural reach. You'll drive delivery across key security domains while contributing to design decisions that shape how the platform is built. The patterns we are securing are still being defined, and part of the work is building and validating those patterns under real conditions. You’ll be active in architecture reviews, own security implementation across your domains, and build the controls that make it safe to move fast with AI. In a domain where the playbooks are still being written, part of the role is writing them. You won't be doing this alone, you'll work alongside additional security engineers and the broader team building the platform, with the expectation that this function grows as the platform does.

The data at stake has real weight. Life360's systems carry real-time location data and family relationship graphs for tens of millions of people, including children. These are crown jewels in the truest sense — irreplaceable to the families who trust us with them. Securing the AI systems that interact with this data is not a compliance exercise. It is a core obligation of the product.

The US-based salary range for this position is $209,000 to $309,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Secure how Life360 accesses frontier models. Design, build, and iterate the access controls, policy enforcement, and authorization patterns that govern how systems interact with the frontier models they rely on.
  • Build secure patterns for MCP access and tool use authorization. Build and own the controls that vet, risk-tier, and govern how we integrate with external tools and services via MCP as adoption expands across engineering teams.
  • Design and build the identity and authorization model for autonomous agents: service identities, scoped credentials, and least-privilege access patterns. Define and enforce the trust boundaries that govern how agents interact across orchestration chains.
  • Design and build agentic observability and adversarial defenses. Build the telemetry pipelines and behavioral monitoring that provide visibility into AI system behavior. Implement architecture-level defenses against prompt injection and related adversarial attack classes.
  • Shape security for the common AI end-user platform. Lead design reviews, build access controls, data boundary enforcement, and abuse detection that keep a shared AI environment safe across users with different privilege levels.
  • Secure the shared knowledge layer. Define access control and data governance for retrieval augmented and reasoning systems, ensuring AI-powered tools don't surface sensitive data to the wrong systems or users.
  • Build AI supply chain integrity into the platform. Develop model provenance practices, service vetting, and dependency controls that keep the AI stack trustworthy as it grows.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, and Data Platform to ensure the right controls are built into pipelines handling real-time location, family relationship data, and data involving minors.

What We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years in security engineering with depth in application security, cloud security, IAM, or detection — and a track record of building controls that earn adoption, not just approval.
  • Hands on builder shipping security controls that hold up in production. You’re not an advisor but a practitioner who can define patterns that last.
  • Hands-on fluency with LLM and agentic systems. You've built with these tools, broken them, and shipped fixes for prompt pipelines, RAG architectures, and multi-agent orchestration from the inside.
  • Solid grounding in IAM for non-human systems: service identities, OAuth, secrets management, RBAC/ABAC, and least-privilege architecture at scale.
  • Experience with production telemetry and detection — defining detections and building response paths for threat surfaces without established playbooks.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and in-flight builds. You're energized by figuring things out — writing first-draft standards, testing approaches, and scaling what works.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and the ability to push back when it matters. You carry risk, tradeoffs, and technical decisions across engineering, product, and security leadership without losing precision — and can reshape a risky decision clearly and constructively.
  • Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, and adjacent compliance environments for consumer data at scale.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with frontier model API security, tool-use authorization patterns, or access governance for AI systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and their trust, identity, and authorization challenges.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graph architectures, vector stores, or RAG systems — and the access control and data boundary problems they introduce.
  • Red teaming or adversarial testing against AI systems: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data extraction, model inversion, or supply chain attacks.
  • Background in consumer technology or another domain where personal data sensitivity is a core product obligation — not just a legal requirement.
  • Experience designing or reviewing security for internal enterprise AI platforms serving non-technical users.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: Running parallel workstreams instead of hand-holding one agent at a time.
  • Judgment and ownership: Review AI-generated code, analyses, and models as critically as a colleague's pull request. You are accountable for everything you ship, whoever or whatever wrote it.
  • Velocity: Turn AI fluency into output. We expect you to deliver more production ML, faster, than the same work would take without AI.
  • Team leadership: Share your AI workflows with the team and raise the AI fluency of the data scientists and engineers around you.
  • Continuous learning: Keep up with new AI tools and techniques, test them on real team problems, and bring recommendations to the team.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

Role Overview

The Account Manager serves as the commercial and strategic relationship leader across a dedicated portfolio of approximately 50 existing public sector accounts. Operating in close partnership with dedicated Solutions Architects and delivery consultants, this individual is directly accountable for maximizing net revenue retention (NRR) through proactive contract renewals and targeted account expansion. Growth opportunities span the complete suite of Conducive's offerings: third-party software licensing and ingest tier upgrades, specialized professional consulting services, and long-term managed services contracts.

Key Responsibilities

1. Account Governance & Portfolio Retention (~50 Accounts)

  • Portfolio Ownership: Own end-to-end commercial retention and health across ~50 public sector accounts, proactively tracking contract expiration dates, funding windows, and fiscal year-end deadlines.
  • Executive Business Reviews: Lead structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to assess system utilization, platform health, SLA metrics, and future architecture roadmaps.
  • Proactive Health Monitoring: Collaborate closely with delivery consultants and engineering teams to identify and remediate operational or adoption blockers well ahead of renewal cycles.

2. Multi-Stream Growth & Quota Execution

  • Software & Licensing Expansion: Identify and close capacity ingest upgrades, additional workload licensing, and module additions across Splunk and associated observability/SIEM ecosystems.
  • Professional Consulting Services: Scope and position technical consulting packages, cloud migrations, architecture modernizations, and bespoke implementation projects.
  • Managed Services Engagements: Pitch and secure multi-year managed operations, continuous administration, monitoring support, and staff augmentation agreements.
  • Commercial Deal Leadership: Shepherd opportunities from identification through technical scoping, proposal and statement-of-work (SOW) drafting, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

3. Technical & Pre-Sales Collaboration

  • Solutions Architecture Alignment: Partner with dedicated Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, architectural reviews, and solution demonstrations.
  • Value Translation: Translate complex agency compliance mandates, logging bottlenecks, and security directives into clear, actionable technical workstreams.

4. Public Sector Procurement & Operational Diligence

  • Procurement Navigation: Navigate government purchasing channels, state term contracts, piggyback mechanisms, GSA schedules, and sole-source justification requirements.
  • CRM Hygiene & Forecasting: Maintain rigorous, audit-ready CRM documentation—tracking renewal pipelines, probability stages, contract values, and delivering highly dependable monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

Role Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Domain Experience: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience directly within enterprise logging, SIEM, or observability domains (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel).
  • Account Management Track Record: Demonstrated success in a dedicated Account Management or Commercial Customer Success role with dual quota accountability for renewals and net-new expansions.
  • Public Sector Acumen: Direct experience managing relationships and contracts within state, local, higher education (SLED), or federal government accounts, including understanding of fiscal budget cycles.
  • Technical Literacy: Solid foundational understanding of SIEM/logging architectures, data onboarding, ingestion volume sizing, and compliance frameworks to independently lead initial qualification conversations.
  • Exceptional Detail Orientation: High standard of organizational diligence, contract tracking rigor, and disciplined pipeline governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Splunk Certifications: Splunk Core Certified Power User, Advanced Power User, or equivalent platform credentials.
  • Blended Solution Selling: Proven background structuring blended deals combining software licenses, advisory consulting SOWs, and recurring managed services.
  • Contract Vehicles: Working knowledge of major public sector contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA Schedule 70/MAS, OMNIA, state-wide master contracts).

excerpt: Editorialist melds personal styling, editorial content, and shopping into one seamless digital experience powered by proprietary technology and e-commerce tools.
description:
Editorialist melds personal styling, editorial content, and shopping into one seamless digital experience powered by proprietary technology and e-commerce tools. Editorialist.com, our media property, delivers sophisticated content and commerce to aspirational and affluent consumers. Our stories connect readers with bespoke product and service solutions for fashion, accessories, beauty, and wellness needs. The cornerstone of our tech platform—the Editorialist app—blends content, digital services, and e-commerce for our elite clientele, individuals with an average net worth in excess of $550 million. Our co-founder and CEO Rafael Ortiz previously co-founded NexTag, the largest comparison shopping site for products and services, and was responsible for marketing and business development until its sale for $1.2 billion.

About the role:

  • We are looking for an experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our high-performing engineering team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership of large technical challenges, designing scalable systems, and contributing to both architecture and execution. You’ll work across the full web stack—, , , MySQL— while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive product and platform initiatives from inception to production.
  • As a senior engineer, you’ll not only build robust features but also help guide technical direction, champion code quality, and contribute to a culture of performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of scalable full-stack applications using , , , and MySQL.
  • Drive architecture discussions and system design for new modules and features with an eye on scalability, modularity, and performance.
  • Own end-to-end implementation — from planning to deployment — ensuring best practices in coding, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.
  • Contribute to building performant RESTful APIs and cleanly integrating backend services with modular frontend components.
  • Continuously improve client and server-side performance, including TTFB, LCP, code splitting, caching, DB tuning, and Lighthouse score optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with design, product, DevOps, and other engineering teams to build user-centric, scalable experiences.
  • Review code, provide architectural guidance, and advocate for engineering excellence within the team.
  • Use Docker and CI/CD pipelines ( Jenkins) for deployments to AWS infrastructure in a microservices environment.
  • Leverage AI developer tools to increase productivity and guide others in their effective usage.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of professional experience in full-stack web development, including recent experience in a senior or lead capacity.
  • Advanced proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), , (SSR, routing, data fetching), and .
  • Strong experience with relational databases, particularly MySQL, including schema design and performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Tabnine, etc.) and their application in team workflows.
  • Proven ability to identify and debug performance bottlenecks across both frontend and backend by analyzing server-level metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, logs, network latency, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience optimizing client-side performance using techniques like bundle splitting, lazy loading, and Lighthouse auditing.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for measuring frontend performance and user interactions.
  • Deep understanding of REST APIs, microservices communication patterns, error handling, and API versioning.
  • Proficiency with Docker, CI/CD with Jenkins, and working knowledge of AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, etc.).
  • Clear, maintainable coding style with experience in code reviews, testing frameworks ( Jest, React Testing Library), and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience with API documentation tools like Swagger/Postman, and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Knowledge of CDNs (like Cloudflare) and internationalization/localization strategies for web apps.

What You’ll Get

  • A fast-paced, tech-savvy startup environment where your work directly impacts product and business outcomes.
  • The autonomy to architect systems, make technical decisions, and see your ideas shipped to production.
  • Opportunity to work with state of the art tech, modern, performance-focused JavaScript stack.
  • Opportunity to drive cross-functional initiatives and contribute to the technical direction of the platform.
  • High ownership, real impact, and the satisfaction of building things that matter at scale

title: Senior Tax Analyst - Avalara for Accountants
excerpt: What You'll Do Avalara’s Accounting Channel is at the heart of how we serve the accounting and CPA community, and the Managed Returns for Accountants (MRA) team is where that commitment becomes real.
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara’s Accounting Channel is at the heart of how we serve the accounting and CPA community, and the Managed Returns for Accountants (MRA) team is where that commitment becomes real. As a Senior Tax Analyst on the MRA team, you are the primary compliance expert and relationship anchor for a select portfolio of accounting firms. You own the end-to-end returns experience for those firms, from onboarding through filing, notice resolution, and continuous improvement.

This is not a passive service role. We expect you to bring deep tax compliance expertise, a relentless drive to improve how work gets done, and a genuine commitment to making your teammates and your customers better. You will be the firm’s most trusted resource on multi-jurisdictional transaction tax compliance, and you will use that expertise to drive automation, improve quality, and elevate the capability of everyone around you.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Compliance and Filing Operations

  • Prepare, review, and file multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax, business and occupation, and gross receipts tax returns for monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual filing cycles
  • Manage a select portfolio of accounting firms as their dedicated primary point of contact for all returns-related questions and escalations
  • Research and resolve jurisdictional tax notices on behalf of customers with clear, timely, and well-documented communication
  • Perform quality assurance reviews related to sales and use tax content and jurisdiction form changes

Customer and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the first point of contact for accounting firm returns questions, setting clear expectations and relaying complex compliance information in an accessible, actionable manner
  • Own the onboarding and validation of new sales and use tax returns customers, ensuring a smooth transition into Avalara’s platform
  • Communicate regularly and effectively with customers, jurisdictions, and internal teams as part of research and resolution workflows
  • Take full ownership of customer satisfaction, demonstrating empathy and proactive responsiveness to customer needs

Process Improvement and Team Enablement

  • Identify, develop, and implement automation improvements to serve customers across a variety of market and tax verticals
  • Identify process and technology gaps and recommend improvements that reduce risk, increase throughput, and improve customer outcomes
  • Assist with implementation, training, and documentation initiatives in support of the broader team
  • Coordinate and lead training for junior-level employees, serving as a knowledge resource for critical troubleshooting and in-cycle risk reduction
  • Apply expert knowledge of jurisdiction websites and taxpayer-facing portals, including data input nuances and system limitations

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance AND a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience in multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax compliance, returns preparation, or tax operations
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work through ambiguous compliance scenarios
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tax concepts into clear guidance for accounting professionals and internal stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities to meet strict filing deadlines
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new software applications, platforms, and tools
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with depth in Excel (including Power Pivot, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, and related functions)
  • Must be available and working during US business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Masters) in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance
  • Experience with a Big 4 firm, a large corporate tax department of a multinational company, or a large ERP integration
  • Expert understanding of an Avalara customer’s data flow from AvaTax portal to Returns Console
  • Deep understanding of user platform features related to jurisdiction configuration, including nexus, exemptions, marketplace rules, filing calendars, reporting, and transaction data
  • Working knowledge of transaction flow across the business and the downstream impact on returns preparation and filing
  • Familiarity with returns content areas including transaction tax calculation, transaction data flow, returns mapping, and returns filing automation

Bar Raiser Expectation

We hire people who make Avalara better. This role is not just about performing the job, it is about joining Avalara with the expectation that you will raise the standard for everyone around you. We expect this person to leave the team measurably stronger than when they arrived.

  • You are expected to set a higher standard for quality, rigor, and accountability in compliance work, not just meet existing standards
  • You will actively mentor and develop junior team members, sharing your expertise in ways that multiply the team’s capability
  • You will challenge current processes, identify gaps, and implement improvements rather than accepting the status quo
  • You will bring a perspective and depth of experience that pushes your peers to think more critically and work more effectively
  • You will demonstrate Avalara’s values in how you operate: integrity, accountability, and a commitment to the customer
  • Candidates who are not prepared to actively contribute to team growth and organizational improvement are not the right fit for this role, regardless of technical skill

AI Bar Raiser Expectation

We expect every Senior Tax Analyst to be an AI Bar Raiser on their team. This means more than using AI tools; it means you bring stronger AI fluency and applied AI capability than the team you are joining, and you actively use that expertise to elevate the team’s overall capability.

  • You will demonstrate a working command of AI-powered tools applied to tax compliance workflows, including automated return preparation, anomaly detection, notice pattern recognition, and data reconciliation
  • You will identify high-value opportunities to apply AI and automation to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase throughput across MRA operations
  • You will teach, model, and coach your teammates on effective AI-assisted workflows, raising the floor of AI fluency across the team
  • You will critically evaluate AI outputs, understanding where automation adds value and where human judgment and expertise must remain central
  • You will contribute to Avalara’s broader AI adoption strategy within the Returns organization by piloting new approaches, documenting what works, and sharing findings across teams
  • Candidates who have general familiarity with AI tools but cannot articulate how they would apply AI to elevate team performance will not meet the AI Bar Raiser standard for this role

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Creative Director
excerpt: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate.
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

  • Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
  • Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
  • By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

A brand system that morphs

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
  • Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

The team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
  • Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
  • A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
  • Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

You'll provide day-to-day social media and community management services across Beatport's social channels. Working with the Head of Social, Electronic, you'll prepare approved content for publication, look after our community, keep an eye on what people are saying, and contribute to community reporting.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who lives on social, knows electronic music, and enjoys connecting with people and keeping things organised.

You’ll support our presence across Instagram, TikTok, Threads, X, Facebook, YouTube and Twitch, with a combined audience of over 6 million followers.

The engagement is expected to require approximately 20 hours of services per week , ideally spread across five weekdays at approximately four hours per day, with coverage agreed with the team. Content assets will be supplied by our design team, so no original content creation is required.

Social

Community

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT

The Center for Gender & Refugee Studies (CGRS) defends the human rights of people seeking asylum in the United States. With strategic focus and unparalleled legal expertise, for over 25 years CGRS has championed the most challenging cases, fought for due process, and promoted policies that deliver safety and justice for refugees. We are the trusted partner and proven resource for legal services providers and human rights organizations and bring invaluable data and compelling personal stories to shape the public narrative. Through technical assistance and training, we empower advocates to take on complex asylum cases, providing them with the tools they need to craft winning arguments and secure protections for their clients. We use strategic litigation to advance sound asylum laws and protect due process rights. And our policy advocacy and education work provide critical expertise to policymakers at all levels of government, leading the movement to honor our commitments to refugees and asylum seekers under U.S. and international law. CGRS is committed to building an anti-racist and anti-oppression organization that lives its values internally and externally.

THE ROLE and responsibilities

CGRS is seeking an experienced litigator who is passionate about refugee rights and committed to working collaboratively with directly impacted individuals and their lawyers and using litigation in combination with other advocacy strategies to promote the rights of asylum seekers. Information about our current docket is available at . The position is a dynamic one that will reflect the vision and flexibility of the organization in the changing landscape of attacks on refugee rights.

The Senior Staff Attorney/Senior Counsel will report directly to the CGRS Director of Litigation. This role will be focused primarily on CGRS’s systemic litigation efforts, and the successful candidate will be involved in CGRS’s other core program areas of Policy & Advocacy and Technical Assistance & Training, as they relate to ongoing litigation efforts. Working in close collaboration with other members of the legal program staff, the Senior Staff Attorney/Senior Counsel will be responsible for the following:

  • Collaborate in developing and lead strategic federal litigation and advocacy to protect and expand the rights of asylum seekers. This includes conducting factual investigations; performing legal research; drafting motions, briefs, and other court filings; conducting discovery; appearing in court; and maintaining communication with directly impacted individuals and community-based organizations.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with the private immigration bar, pro bono counsel, non-profit immigration practitioners, and other stakeholders supporting asylum seekers.
  • Represent CGRS in various fora, including local, national, and international coalitions, community meetings, conferences, working groups, and the press.
  • Provide strategic legal guidance and technical assistance to attorneys engaged in federal court litigation, including consulting on legal strategy, reviewing draft pleadings, and providing feedback.

About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

The Role:

Trase is seeking a Solution Architect to help enterprise customers turn AI ambition into practical, measurable business outcomes. You will partner with Sales to lead the technical presales process, from discovery and solution design through demonstrations, proofs of concept, and technical validation.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced technical presales leader who has helped sell AI solutions and wants to build more than individual deals. You will help shape how Trase brings its platform to market, turn customer insights into better products, and build the technical sales playbook that supports our next stage of growth.

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with Sales to own the technical presales process across enterprise opportunities, aligning technical requirements with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer workflows, existing systems, data environments, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement.
  • Design credible AI solutions that address customer needs, including integration approaches, data flows, deployment requirements, and security considerations.
  • Build and deliver tailored demonstrations that show how Trase’s AI agent platform solves real customer problems.
  • Scope and lead proofs of concept with clear success criteria, realistic timelines, and a path from evaluation to production.
  • Explain AI capabilities, limitations, and architectural tradeoffs clearly to audiences ranging from hands-on engineers to executive decision-makers.
  • Address technical questions, support security and architecture reviews, and help customers evaluate feasibility, value, and implementation requirements.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to validate proposed solutions, communicate customer feedback, and ensure a clear handoff from presales to delivery.
  • Develop reusable demos, reference architectures, discovery guides, and technical sales materials that improve consistency and help the team scale.
  • Help refine Trase’s positioning and presales approach as our products, customers, and go-to-market motion evolve.

About You:

You are a technically credible, commercially minded problem-solver who enjoys working directly with customers. You bring deep technical presales experience and a track record of selling AI solutions, along with the initiative to build processes where they do not yet exist. You bring:

  • 5+ years of technical presales experience in a solutions engineering, solution architecture, or similar customer-facing role.
  • Experience helping sell AI solutions, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer workflows, business value, and buying decisions.
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, including the ability to uncover the problem behind a customer’s initial request.
  • Technical fluency across enterprise software, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, data systems, and security fundamentals.
  • A practical understanding of LLMs and AI agents, including their capabilities, limitations, evaluation needs, and enterprise deployment considerations.
  • The ability to build convincing demonstrations and prototypes, investigate technical issues, and collaborate effectively with engineers.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts without relying on jargon.
  • A desire to help grow and scale a company by creating repeatable approaches, sharing what works, and taking responsibility beyond your immediate deal pipeline.

Preferred Experience:

  • Designing or demonstrating enterprise AI solutions involving LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, or workflow automation.
  • Building prototypes or integrations using Python, JavaScript, or similar tools.
  • Leading enterprise proofs of concept and helping customers move from technical evaluation toward production deployment.
  • Supporting complex sales cycles with multiple business, technical, and security stakeholders.
  • Selling into healthcare and/or financial services.
  • Experience at a similar-stage, high-growth startup, where priorities evolve quickly and success depends on ownership, resourcefulness, and collaboration.
  • Helping establish or scale a solutions engineering function, including reusable assets, technical qualification practices, and sales-to-delivery handoffs.

$160,000-$185,000 base salary. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

HighLevel is hiring a fully remote Systems Support Specialist II to join our IT team. This role covers the afternoon shift (2:00 PM – 10:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday) and is responsible for day-to-day administration, support, and troubleshooting across our core collaboration, identity, and endpoint management systems.

The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable owning escalated tickets end-to-end, and proficient across a modern SaaS-based IT stack spanning identity/device management, collaboration tools, and workflow/access tooling.

This person will be the sole internal IT team member covering this shift. Strong independent judgment and ownership are essential. They will also serve as the direct escalation point for our L1 MSP when a ticket needs to be escalated beyond L1 during shift hours.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 1/2 IT support to employees across multiple regions, resolving tickets related to accounts, devices, access, and collaboration tools.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Rise8, you will:

  • Develop and deliver configuration and deployment automation required for continuously improving the functionality, availability, and manageability of platform and associated services
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable infrastructure in cloud environments
  • Automate deployment process and infrastructure management
  • Develop and implement SLOs to measure and maintain system reliability

  • Participate in on-call rotations, ensuring high availability of critical systems

Qualifications

  • Currently possess or able to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • A background of 6-10 years in cloud/platform operations or related roles across diverse environments.
  • Experience working with various programming languages/frameworks and assisting dev teams with incorporating logging & metrics.
  • Observability platform experience (preferably Datadog)
  • Expertise in container orchestration, specifically Kubernetes.
  • Proficient use of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools, with a focus on Terraform.
  • Subject Matter Expertise in Linux Operating Systems administration.
  • Skilled in developing automation solutions using scripting languages to streamline recurring tasks.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot operating systems and applications effectively.
  • Experience handling large-scale production systems and adeptness in resolving production-related challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, and a keen interest in collaborative work environments.
  • Enthusiasm for skill growth, a penchant for tackling intriguing tasks, and addressing complex issues.
  • A degree (BA/BS) in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance for US Government work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in troubleshooting challenges using the Linux/Unix command line interface.
  • Possession of recognized Professional Certifications such as RHCE, Linux+, MCSA, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Developer, Security+, CISSP, and CCNA.
  • Background in DevOps automation practices.
  • Direct experience in client interaction.

Salary

The annual salary range for this role as it is posted is $168,993 - $211,241 regardless of final candidate location within the United States. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule in a 100% distributed workforce
  • Premium Insurance: We cover up to 100% of the employee premium and up to 80% of the combined dependent premium on our base health plan, depending on pay band. We also cover 100% of the premium for employee and dependent Dental and Vision as well as employee premiums for Life and Disability coverage.
  • Retirement: 401k match at 10% gross pay.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 4 weeks combined accrued vacation and sick leave, 11 Federal holidays, your birthday, jury duty, and bereavement.

Or Rise8 is part of the the Life Time Corporate Partner program. In lieu of your $500 annual wellness benefit, you can instead get a $75 monthly credit towards a Life Time membership ($900 annual benefit).

All of Rise8’s work in this area is with Federal Government customers that require our employees involved with their projects be U.S. citizens. As such, this role requires U.S. citizenship. If hired, you would also be required to go through a background investigation.

description:
Mitek (NASDAQ: MITK) is a global leader in digital & biometric identity authentication, fraud prevention, and mobile deposit solutions. Our verified identity platform and advanced image capture solutions are built on the latest advancements in biometric recognition, artificial intelligence, computer vision and machine learning, and trusted by over 7,500 organizations worldwide. We are headquartered in San Diego, California, with operations in the United Kingdom, Spain, France, Mexico, and the Netherlands. Visit us at www.miteksystems.com.

We are Virtual 1st! Whether you choose to work remotely from your home office or in-person from one of Mitek’s offices, our practices, processes and tools are designed to enable your success. At Mitek, the Future of Work is about flexibility and preference wherever and whenever we are working. Because we care about our candidates, employees and customers, we include an in-person meeting as part of our hiring process. It’s one of the ways we live our mission to “Protect What’s Real.”

At Mitek, we believe that teams are more resilient, effective, and innovative when they benefit from a wide range of ideas, lived experiences, and perspectives. The strength of our organization is deeply rooted in the people who power it.​ We know that a workforce reflecting the richness of our communities and customers helps us better serve their needs.

We are looking for a passionate and customer-focused Technical Support Engineer to join our Global Customer Support team in the United Kingdom.

In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring our customers get the most out of Mitek's identity verification and cheque verification solutions. You will investigate and resolve technical issues, provide expert guidance, and collaborate with internal teams to deliver an excellent customer experience.

You will combine technical troubleshooting skills with a consultative approach, helping customers overcome challenges while building strong, trusted relationships.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes pride in making a meaningful difference to customers.

What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional technical support: Provide technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution to Mitek customers, helping them use our solutions effectively.

  • Investigate and resolve technical issues: Take ownership of customer-reported incidents, apply structured troubleshooting techniques, and drive issues through to resolution.

  • Build strong customer relationships: Understand customers' business needs, objectives, and technical challenges, ensuring they feel supported throughout the resolution process.

  • Manage customer escalations: Coordinate technical investigations, communicate progress clearly, and ensure timely follow-up and resolution.

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Customer Success Managers and internal technical teams to investigate issues affecting product performance, customer workflows, and production environments.

  • Become a product expert: Develop a deep understanding of Mitek's solutions and serve as a trusted technical resource for customers and colleagues.

  • Improve knowledge sharing: Research recurring technical issues, create and maintain support documentation, and contribute to customer self-service resources.

  • Drive continuous improvement: Share customer feedback and technical insights with internal stakeholders to help improve our products and support experience.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience or knowledge relevant to technical customer support, SaaS operations, or software-based services.

  • Familiarity with web service technologies, including REST/JSON and XML/SOAP.

  • Understanding of software distribution and Software Development Kit (SDK) business models.

  • Knowledge of SaaS operating models and customer support processes.

  • Familiarity with service desk and incident management platforms such as Zendesk.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with familiarity with evidence-based troubleshooting approaches.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly and effectively.

  • A customer-first mindset, with a strong commitment to delivering results and building positive relationships.

  • The ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-focused when managing challenging technical situations.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience supporting or operating a B2B web platform.

  • Knowledge of API integrations and related troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.

  • Understanding of Microsoft Windows Servers, SQL, and Internet Information Services (IIS).

Who You Are

  • A natural problem-solver who enjoys investigating technical challenges and finding practical solutions.

  • A collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment.

  • An excellent communicator who can translate complex technical information into clear, actionable guidance.

  • Customer-focused, proactive, and committed to delivering a positive support experience.

  • Organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing circumstances.

  • Curious and eager to develop your technical expertise and contribute to continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical partner for our customers, delivering timely solutions, and contributing to a more effective and proactive customer support experience.

    You'll know you're making an impact when:

  • Customers feel supported and confident: You build trusted relationships, understand their challenges, and consistently provide clear, timely, and effective technical guidance.

  • Technical issues are resolved efficiently: You take ownership of investigations, identify underlying causes, and help minimise disruption to customers' operations.

  • Complex problems are communicated clearly: Customers and internal stakeholders understand the issue, the investigation process, and the next steps towards resolution.

  • Collaboration leads to better outcomes: You work effectively with Customer Success Managers and technical teams to resolve escalations and improve the overall customer experience.

  • Knowledge sharing improves support efficiency: Your documentation and contributions to self-service resources help customers find answers and prevent recurring issues.

  • You continuously grow as a technical expert: You strengthen your understanding of Mitek's products and technologies while contributing ideas that improve how we support our customers.

Why Join Mitek?

    At Mitek, your work will support technology that organisations rely on to deliver secure and trusted identity and cheque verification experiences.

    As a Technical Support Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Make a meaningful impact: Help customers resolve important technical challenges affecting their business operations.

  • Work with innovative technology: Develop expertise in digital identity verification, cheque verification, SaaS platforms, and web services.

  • Collaborate globally: Work with customers and colleagues across different teams and functions.

  • Grow your expertise: Strengthen your technical troubleshooting, incident management, and customer-facing skills.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement: Help shape a better support experience by sharing knowledge, identifying recurring issues, and supporting product improvements.

If you're passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping customers succeed, we'd love to hear from you!

We take pride in enabling career growth in an environment of innovation and teamwork. Our commitment to all Mitekians is to do meaningful work that matters. Our culture is defined by delivering our best to our customers by providing high value solutions and impactful outcomes, by continuously challenging convention, and by caring for each other through collaboration and celebrating our successes. Paid time off: generous annual leave, company holidays, volunteer time off
