excerpt: Sexual Abuse and Sexual Assault Litigation Attorney To be considered for this role, pleasecall 866-996-6549 and follow the step-by-step instructions outlined by our Co-Founder and Managing Partner.
description:
Sexual Abuse and Sexual Assault Litigation Attorney

To be considered for this role, pleasecall 866-996-6549 and follow the step-by-step instructions outlined by our Co-Founder and Managing Partner. In addition, please complete your application here. You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions. We look forward to hearing from you!

About:

We are a high-impact, plaintiffs-only law firm handling complex and high-stakes litigation with a specialized focus on various areas of torts, including individual and institutional sexual abuse cases. Our practice is dedicated to representing survivors, and we are known for our compassionate client approach paired with aggressive, strategic advocacy in the courtroom.

The Sexual Abuse and Sexual Assault Litigation Attorney plays a crucial role in driving results for survivors. This position requires an attorney with a proven track record of success in representing plaintiffs in sex abuse cases, although we will consider prosecutors who seek to transition from sex crimes prosecutions to civil practice. The position focuses on the core elements needed to build powerful cases: identifying critical evidence, thoroughly analyzing institutional failures and developing insurance coverage, working with social workers and therapists to build client trust and discover the emotional truth of the client’s story, taking sensitive witness depositions, working with trauma-informed expert witnesses, and preparing compelling cases that give survivors a voice.

This is not your typical Associate role. We're looking for someone who wants to make a meaningful difference in survivors' lives, thinks like a trial lawyer from day one, and be mentored by seasoned litigators and trial lawyers. This is an exceptional opportunity for an attorney passionate about advocating for sexual abuse and sexual assault survivors with a dynamic and trauma-informed team.

Responsibilities:

  • Handle all phases of sexual abuse and sexual assault litigation, including sensitive pleadings, trauma-informed discovery approaches, motion practice, and bellwether/trial preparation.

  • Lead discovery efforts focused on institutional accountability, including identifying key documents revealing patterns of negligence, taking depositions, and written discovery.

  • Depose witnesses and institutional representatives, while defending sensitive client depositions.

  • Draft pleadings, motions (including those addressing statute of limitations, institutional liability, and evidentiary motions unique to sexual abuse and assault cases), discovery requests/responses and other critical litigation documents.

  • Work closely with specialized expert witnesses – including psychologists, psychiatrists, institutional safety experts, and damages experts – from vetting to preparation.

  • Have experience with or at least a willingness to learn the art of psychodrama to work with trauma survivors in developing their stories and emotional truths for trial under trial lawyers experienced in using this method.

  • Participate in trial preparation with a focus on sensitive survivor testimony, institutional or company accountability themes, damages presentations, and pretrial filings.

  • Be able to at least second chair, and preferably first chair, sexual assault trials with a proven track record of being a first or second chair of a sexual assault or abuse trial.

  • Collaborate with partners and senior attorneys on high-level strategy addressing the unique challenges of sexual abuse litigation, and the training of other attorneys to support the practice.

  • Capacity to manage complex, emotionally challenging legal matters both independently and as part of a trauma-informed team.

Qualifications:

  • A Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school

  • 6+ years of litigation experience preferred, ideally with some exposure to trauma-informed legal practices

  • Strong legal research, writing, and oral advocacy skills with sensitivity to survivor-centered approaches

  • A passion for survivor advocacy and a "find-a-way" mentality in overcoming institutional barriers

  • Comfortable taking initiative while maintaining appropriate emotional boundaries in sensitive cases

  • Experience with complex civil litigation, institutional liability cases, or similar is a plus

  • Understanding of the psychological impact of sexual trauma is valued

  • Clerkship experience is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Exemplifies our Core Values of Doing Good by Doing Right™: Results Driven, Excellence Without Paralysis, Compassionate and Authentic, In It Together, and Innovative Growth

  • Adheres to all government and industry regulations, including settlement disbursements and the protection of regulated sensitive data

  • Exceptional communication skills for interacting compassionately with survivors while maintaining professional boundaries

  • Problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify process improvements in how institutions can be held accountable

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all Confidential Information, particularly regarding survivor identities and sensitive case details

  • Excellent analytical skills, with an ability to identify patterns of institutional negligence

  • Superior organizational and time management skills while handling cases that may be emotionally challenging

  • Ability to balance the emotional weight of this work with professional objectivity and self-care

Benefits:

Financial Benefits

  • 401k Contributions: The ﬁrm oﬀers a discretionary match up to 5%. This includes a 100% match on the ﬁrst 3% of contributions and a 50% match on the next 2%, based on annual compensation.

  • Charitable Donations: The Chaﬃn Luhana Foundation makes an annual donation to a charity of each team member’s choice.

Healthcare Benefits

  • Medical Insurance: $600 toward monthly health premiums for team members or their families. Team members pay just $1.

  • Dental Insurance: Full coverage, with only a $1 monthly contribution from the team member.

  • Vision Insurance: Full coverage, with only a $1 monthly contribution from the team member.

  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): Team members receive a $1,000 contribution from the ﬁrm in their HRA account if enrolled in the PPO health plan.

  • Family / Dependent Care (DCR): Team members can contribute up to $7,500 pre-tax for dependent care.

  • Flex Spending Account (FSA): Team members can contribute up to $1,000 pre-tax for medical expenses.

Commuter Benefits

  • Tax-free Transit Commute (TRN): Team members can contribute up to $340 per month pre-tax toward transit tickets.

  • Discounted Parking (PKG): Team members can contribute up to $340 per month pre-tax toward parking.

Time Off to Recharge & Renew

  • Paid Time Oﬀ (PTO): 15 PTO days per year, increasing to 20 days after 3 years with the ﬁrm.

  • Sick Days: 3 paid sick days per year.

  • Celebrate the Holidays: Oﬃce is closed for 10 public holidays.

  • Oﬃce Closure: Oﬃce is typically closed between Christmas and New Year’s Day.

Culture & Development of Team

  • Casual Dress: Enjoy our business casual dress code.

  • Enhance Your Skills: Up to $500 annually for continued education or training.

  • Learn How You’re Wired: Take a Kolbe Assessment to learn your instinctive method of operation.

  • Time Management: Time management luncheons with senior leadership to elevate team and organizational success.

  • Free Workouts: Free access to GreenTree SportsPlex for Pittsburgh oﬃce.

Recognition at the Firm

  • Value Team Members: Bonusly points for peer-to-peer recognition, redeemable for gift cards, trips, dinners, and more.

  • Eat, Drink & Be Merry: Free team lunches and happy hours.

  • Annual Bonus: Year-end discretionary bonus.

BVGroup brings over 80 years of expertise to every bet, delivering technology-driven betting and gaming experiences to a global audience.

Reporting to the Director of Product - Sports & Casino, you will be responsible for expanding our global game provider network, evolving our multi-tenant content management capabilities and delivering engaging player features such as tournaments, jackpots, recommendations and personalised content experiences and will be working closely with Product Owners across PAM, Offers Hub, Payments, Player Retention, Compliance and Brand Configuration to deliver a seamless and connected player experience across the wider BV360 platform.

  • Owning the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for the BV360 eGaming Portal, ensuring a best-in-class player experience backed by scalable multi-tenant SaaS capabilities.

  • Managing the integration, optimisation and ongoing evolution of third-party game suppliers and aggregators, maintaining a catalogue that seamlessly serves thousands of titles across multiple operators, brands and jurisdictions.
  • Driving the capabilities of the eGaming Content Management Module, enabling operators to independently manage game catalogues, lobby layouts, game tiles, localised content, assets and promotional placements.
  • Leading the design and delivery of gamification and engagement features, including multi-supplier tournaments, progressive jackpots, recommended games, favourites, recently played and personalised content experiences.
  • Defining, documenting and delivering product reporting and analytics requirements, ensuring operators have visibility into game performance, supplier performance, jackpot contributions, tournament engagement, player behaviour and commercial outcomes.

  • Working with game suppliers and strategic partners to evaluate new content, platform capabilities and opportunities that strengthen BV360's casino offering.
  • Driving commercial outcomes by identifying opportunities to improve engagement, retention, game consumption and operator performance across the platform.
  • Act as Product Owner within one or more feature teams, translating business goals into clear user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.
  • Use product analytics, operational data and player behaviour insights to drive prioritisation, measure success and continuously improve the casino experience.

Skills & Experience:
  • Relevant experience as a Product Owner within iGaming, preferably owning a Casino Platform, Gaming Lobby, Casino Aggregator or related product domain.

  • Deep understanding of casino player journeys, engagement mechanics and casino operational workflows.
  • Proven experience defining data specifications, reporting requirements and business intelligence capabilities for casino products.
  • Strong understanding of casino performance metrics, including turnover, GGR, margin, RTP performance, player engagement and supplier reporting.
  • Proven track record of launching or managing casino gamification products, such as tournaments, leader boards, jackpots or other engagement mechanics.

  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to leverage analytics and experimentation to inform product decisions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across product, engineering, design, commercial and operational teams.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.

  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.

What you’ll bring:

title: DevOps Release Engineer
excerpt: What You'll Do As a DevOps and Release Engineer, you'll lead the release management and deployment pipeline across our Salesforce, Boomi, and AWS environments, ensuring changes move safely and predictably from development through production.
description:
What You'll Do

As a DevOps and Release Engineer, you'll lead the release management and deployment pipeline across our Salesforce, Boomi, and AWS environments, ensuring changes move safely and predictably from development through production. You'll partner with Salesforce developers, integration engineers, and cloud infrastructure teams to build guardrails that catch breaking changes before they reach customers. This role is critical to reducing production incidents caused by uncoordinated changes across interconnected systems.

This is a remote role reporting to the Senior Manager of Business Technology.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Review and validate Salesforce, Boomi, and AWS deployment requests, ensuring you check change sets for dependency conflicts before promoting them between environments.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines using Salesforce CLI, change sets, and GitLab for Salesforce deployments, alongside Terraform for AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Troubleshoot deployment failures with engineering teams and maintain automated rollback procedures to minimize production impact.
  • Build monitoring dashboards to ensure deployment issues are identified and addressed before they affect customers.
  • Establish and enforce release governance standards including approval gates, dependency checks, environment promotion criteria, and change advisory board (CAB) processes.
  • Define and report on important deployment metrics — deployment frequency, change failure rate, mean time to recovery (MTTR), and lead time for changes — to improve release performance.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure all deployments meet organizational controls, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Develop runbooks, deployment strategies, and operational documentation to ensure repeatability and knowledge transfer across engineering teams.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, release engineering, or a similar role supporting enterprise environments
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, change sets, and Salesforce metadata deployments
  • Proficiency with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Terraform for infrastructure provisioning
  • Experience managing release processes across multiple interconnected systems, including Salesforce, Boomi, and AWS
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve deployment failures
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across multiple engineering teams
  • Experience implementing release governance practices, including approval gates, dependency checks, automated validations, and rollback procedures
  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or another programming language for scripting, automation, troubleshooting, and improving DevOps workflows
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus, including building dashboards, analyzing metrics, and troubleshooting system and deployment issues
  • Experience applying AI-powered tools and automation, such as GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted code reviews, or AI-driven testing frameworks, to improve deployment efficiency and reduce manual effort
  • Familiarity with Boomi or similar integration platforms and their deployment processes
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps Center or third-party Salesforce release management tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Flosum
  • Knowledge of AWS CloudFormation, CDK, or other infrastructure-as-code tooling beyond Terraform
  • Exposure to SRE practices, incident management frameworks such as FireHydrant or Opsgenie, and observability platforms such as Datadog or Splunk
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS DevOps Engineer, Salesforce Administrator/Developer, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate, are preferred

As a Bar Raiser

  • You are expected to elevate the organization's DevOps and release engineering capabilities, rather than to maintain existing processes. This includes:
    • Hold standards for release quality, deployment reliability, automation across Salesforce, Boomi, and AWS environments.
    • Create a culture of "automation first" by eliminating manual deployment activities, reducing operational risk, and improving deployment velocity through scalable CI/CD practices.
    • Use data, operational metrics, and production insights — not assumptions — to improve deployment success rates, release predictability, change failure rates, and recovery times.
    • Simplify complex cross-platform deployment workflows into standardized, repeatable, and release processes that scale with business growth.
    • Establish and improve engineering guardrails, including dependency validation, release governance, automated testing, approval gates, rollback strategies, and deployment observability.
    • Mentor developers, integration engineers, and platform teams on DevOps best practices, release discipline, Infrastructure as Code, and to raise engineering across the organization.
    • Challenge existing deployment practices respectfully and driving continuous improvements that reduce technical debt, improve system reliability, and strengthen collaboration.
    • Stay current with modern DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering capabilities, introducing practical innovations that improve developer productivity while maintaining security and governance.
    • Leave every deployment pipeline, release process, operational framework, and engineering standard stronger and easier to operate than before.
  • You will do not simply manage releases — it raises our engineering by improving how software is built, validated, governed, deployed, and operated across interconnected enterprise platforms.

As an AI Bar Raiser

  • Avalara is committed to building a workforce that uses artificial intelligence to lead smarter, faster, and more scalable outcomes. Expect to raise the AI capability of our DevOps and release engineering practice:
    • Identify and adopt AI-powered tools that improve deployment pipeline efficiency, such as AI-assisted code review, intelligent test selection, anomaly detection in deployment telemetry, and predictive change risk scoring.
    • Champion the use of AI and automation to eliminate repetitive, error-prone manual release activities. Use tools like GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted runbook generation, or LLM-driven incident summarization to accelerate engineering workflows.
    • Evaluate and pilot new AI-native DevOps capabilities (e.g., AI-powered observability, automated root cause analysis, intelligent rollback triggers) and bring well-reasoned recommendations to the team.
    • Model responsible AI use — applying AI tools with appropriate governance, validating AI-generated outputs, and maintaining human accountability for all production decisions.
    • Mentor peers on practical AI tool usage within the DevOps lifecycle, helping the broader team develop AI fluency and reducing resistance to adopting AI-assisted workflows.
    • Improve for how AI amplifies engineering capacity — not as a novelty, but as a measurable lever for deployment reliability, developer productivity.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

title: Staff Performance Engineer, JavaScript Engine (SpiderMonkey)
excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. Job Title

Director, Business Operations

Job Description Summary

The Director, Business Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the account, driving consistent execution, governance, performance management, and continuous improvement. The role connects account leadership and service-line teams to ensure priorities are translated into disciplined programs, measurable outcomes, and effective change.

The Director leads and coordinates key business operations functions including program management, performance and compliance governance, communications and change management, technology/BI enablement, process improvement, and cross-functional initiatives. The role serves as an integrator across teams, helping identify gaps, establish accountability, standardize processes, and advance initiatives that improve both operational performance and the client experience.

Job Description

Operational Governance & Account Management

  • Maintain the account's overall business operating framework, including governance routines, reporting cadence, decision-making processes, and escalation pathways.
  • Facilitate cross-functional governance to ensure business priorities remain aligned and issues are identified and addressed quickly.
  • Establish clear standards for documentation, accountability, follow-through, and management reporting.
  • Identify operational gaps, risks, and barriers to execution and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.

Performance Management

  • Develop and maintain an integrated approach to account performance management, providing leadership with a clear view of operational health, risks, opportunities, and emerging trends.
  • Establish meaningful KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and reporting standards in partnership with service-line leaders and Business Intelligence resources.
  • Use performance data to identify trends, root causes, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate complex operational information into concise executive-level insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Establish routines for reviewing performance, documenting actions, assigning ownership, and monitoring progress through resolution.

Program Management

  • Lead or oversee strategic, cross-functional programs that require coordination across multiple service lines, functional teams, or service providers.
  • Establish appropriate program governance, including scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and success measures.
  • Maintain visibility to key account initiatives and provide leadership with concise reporting on progress, decisions, risks, and required actions.
  • Coordinate resources across functions to resolve dependencies and accelerate execution.
  • Ensure initiatives transition effectively from strategy and planning into implementation and sustainable business-as-usual operations.
  • Provide structured program-management support for complex process improvements and account transformation initiatives.

Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Develop and lead a structured continuous-improvement approach across the account.
  • Drive internal audit routines to ensure compliance
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, strengthen controls, improve cycle times, and reduce operational variation.
  • Facilitate cross-functional process reviews and root-cause analysis for recurring operational challenges.
  • Standardize effective practices across regions and service lines where doing so improves consistency, control, or client experience.
  • Establish mechanisms to capture lessons learned and translate them into sustainable process improvements.
  • Evaluate opportunities for automation, centralization, technology enablement, and alternative ways of working.
  • Track the measurable business impact of improvement initiatives.

Technology, Data & AI Enablement

  • Provide business leadership for the account's technology, analytics, and digital-transformation priorities.
  • Partner with Technology and Business Intelligence leaders to develop a roadmap aligned with operational and client priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to use technology, automation, BI, and AI to improve productivity, visibility, controls, and decision-making.
  • Establish business requirements and priorities for technology initiatives, ensuring technology investments address clearly defined operational needs.
  • Champion responsible adoption of new tools and capabilities across the account.
  • Connect technology deployment with process redesign and change management so that solutions result in sustainable adoption rather than simply technical implementation.
  • Monitor value realization and adoption after new tools or capabilities are introduced.

Communications & Change Management

  • Develop an integrated approach to business communications and organizational change across the account.
  • Ensure employees and stakeholders understand major priorities, initiatives, changes, and expectations.
  • Partner with leaders to develop clear, consistent messaging for organizational and operational changes.
  • Build stakeholder engagement and change plans for all account needs

About Seemplicity

Attackers now use AI to find and exploit exposures faster than security teams can fix them. Seemplicity closes that gap with AI technology uniquely built for autonomous exposure response.

No more dashboards that only grow. Just exposure risk that goes down. Seemplicity: from found to fixed at machine speed.

For partners, this matters by opening up a powerful new revenue stream and helping the partner solve the most pressing concern for security organizations. Seemplicity can sit on top of the exposure management scanners, cloud, AppSec and EDR tools customers already own, so it complements the vendors already on the reseller's line card instead of displacing them.

Seemplicity is building a channel-first go-to-market (GTM). Partners will source, build and close a growing share of our business, and this role owns making that happen.

As a channel account leader, you will drive our partner ecosystem, with value-added resellers at the core and technology partners, MSPs/MSSPs and systems integrators around them. You recruit the right partners, build joint plans that produce pipeline, run incentive programs that change partner behavior, and hold every relationship to measurable results and every partner organization accountable on their commitment to Seemplicity.

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

Our Surplus & Specialty Lines (S&S) Division develops customized coverage solutions for complex exposures, difficult-to-insure risks and niche segments of the market. S&S has over 850 employees (including more than 250 based in India), 10+ locations in the United States and 2 locations in India. Our product reach includes Sharing Economy, Environmental, Energy, Transportation, Construction, Excess & Umbrella, Primary Special Risk, Security, and other industry segments. S&S is the second largest division within C&F at over $1.5 billion in annual gross written premium.

The Vice President, Small Commercial Operations is responsible for leading and optimizing the operational capabilities that support the Small Commercial business within Crum & Forster Surplus & Specialty Lines (“S&S”). This role is accountable for developing and executing operational strategies that improve efficiency, scalability, consistency, and service delivery while supporting the business’s growth and long-term strategic objectives.

The VP will drive the evolution of Small Commercial operations through process standards, technology enablement, workflow optimization, and effective resource management. Working in close partnership with underwriting leadership, technology, shared services, and other business stakeholders, this leader will identify and execute upon opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen operational controls, and enhance the experience of internal and external customers.

The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with a broad understanding of insurance workflows and the ability to translate business priorities into sustainable, technology-enabled solutions. The role requires a collaborative, results-oriented leader capable of managing complex initiatives, developing high-performing teams, and adapting operations to meet the changing needs of the Small Commercial business.

What you will do for C&F:

Operational Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute the operational strategy for Small Commercial Lines in alignment with business objectives, growth priorities, and the broader S&S strategy.
  • Oversee day-to-day operational activities, ensuring processes are efficient, consistent, scalable, and responsive to business needs.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate redundancies, standardize processes, and improve operational effectiveness.
  • Establish appropriate operational performance measures and use data-driven insights to identify trends, address inefficiencies, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Anticipate operational challenges and develop proactive solutions that support business continuity and future growth.

Process Optimization & Technology Enablement

  • Lead initiatives to modernize and streamline operational processes through technology, automation, workflow redesign, and effective use of available tools.
  • Partner with technology and business stakeholders to identify opportunities to enhance systems, improve data quality, and reduce manual intervention.
  • Evaluate the impact of new technologies and process changes on operational performance, employee effectiveness, and service delivery.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of new processes, systems, and tools, ensuring appropriate change management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Promote scalable operating models that can accommodate evolving business needs, increased volumes, and new products or distribution opportunities.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong partnerships with Small Commercial Lines underwriting leadership and other business stakeholders to understand priorities and align operational capabilities with business needs.
  • Collaborate with technology, corporate functions, and other operational teams to coordinate initiatives, resolve issues, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable operational plans, ensuring clear ownership, appropriate prioritization, and effective execution.
  • Provide regular updates to business partners and senior leadership regarding operational performance, key initiatives, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Anticipate the needs of internal and external customers and ensure operational processes support timely, consistent, and high-quality service.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators to assess operational productivity, service quality, process efficiency, and overall effectiveness.
  • Analyze operational results and identify root causes of performance gaps, developing and implementing corrective action plans as needed.
  • Ensure operational resources and workflows are aligned with business demand, service expectations, and organizational priorities.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.
  • Maintain appropriate operational procedures, controls, and documentation to support consistency, risk management, and compliance with applicable requirements.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, develop, and motivate the Small Commercial Lines Operations team, establishing clear expectations, priorities, and accountability.
  • Build organizational capabilities and develop talent to support current operational requirements and future business growth.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, problem-solving, and effective cross-functional partnership.
  • Manage competing priorities and complex initiatives while maintaining focus on business outcomes and operational commitments.
  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization and lead teams through operational, technological, and organizational change.

Qualifications & Attributes for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required.
  • Minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in insurance operations, underwriting operations, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience in a leadership or management capacity, with demonstrated success leading teams and managing operational performance.

title: Senior Clinical Data Manager
excerpt: Description SUMMARY ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely.
description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Vacation, PPK, health allowance
  • Home-based position with teleworking allowance
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

This position is opened to candidates across Poland (home-based position).

Recruitment process: what to expect

  • As part of the recruitment process for this position you will meet various team members at Indero
  • The first interview will be conducted by phone (20 minutes) and the second via video conference (1 hour)
  • The second interview includes a short presentation for which reasonable advance preparation is required (preparation is not timed and can be completed over a few days). You may think of it as one interview question for which you have the opportunity to develop a strong structured response that goes beyond the surface.

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Poland.

title: Junior Customs Declaration Agent
excerpt: Position Summary We are seeking a detail oriented Junior Customs Declaration Agent to support Singapore import and export customs permit processing for a trade technology client.
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a detail oriented Junior Customs Declaration Agent to support Singapore import and export customs permit processing for a trade technology client. The role processes assigned permit requests from receipt to completion: reviewing documents, validating information prefilled by the client's AI assisted platform, clarifying missing details with customers, preparing and submitting declarations, and returning completed permits.

No customs background is required. You will complete a structured training program and work under the guidance of a Team Lead and a Senior Processor, moving to independent processing once you pass the readiness assessments.

Job Details

Work setup: Work from Home

Work schedule: Monday to Friday, day shift. Start times are staggered between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM, Philippine time, to cover 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Holidays: Work on public holidays may be required based on the assigned roster

Training: Three weeks of structured training, followed by supervised processing of live transactions before independent work

Responsibilities

Request intake and document review

  • Receive and take ownership of assigned customs permit requests in the client's portal and ticketing system.
  • Review commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, bills of lading and other supporting documents for completeness and consistency.
  • Validate the information prefilled by the platform against the source documents, correct discrepancies and complete missing fields.

Declaration processing

  • Prepare, validate and submit Singapore import and export permit declarations following approved procedures and customer specific instructions.
  • Monitor submitted declarations for approvals, rejections and amendments, and act on outstanding requests.
  • Identify exceptions and escalate cases that need specialist input to the Senior Processor or Team Lead. Never submit a declaration that should be escalated.
  • Process requests within the agreed turnaround times while meeting accuracy targets.

Customer communication and case closure

  • Contact customers to request missing documents, clarify instructions and provide status updates.
  • Return approved permits and related documents to customers promptly and close completed requests.

Records, quality and development

  • Keep complete case notes and clear handover information for open requests.
  • Complete all required training, knowledge checks and readiness assessments.
  • Take part in coaching and quality reviews and apply updates to customer specific procedures.

Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of BPO experience in back-office processing, data entry, document review or customer service.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate work in a high volume or transaction-based environment.
  • Clear written and verbal English, with the ability to write concise, professional messages to customers.
  • Comfortable working in web portals, ticketing systems and Microsoft Excel.
  • Able to follow detailed procedures, manage several open requests at once and meet daily productivity and accuracy targets.
  • Willing to complete the full training program and pass the readiness assessments before handling live transactions.
  • Has a quiet home workspace and a stable internet connection suitable for a Work from Home setup.
  • Willing to work the assigned day shift, including public holidays when rostered.

Nice to Have's

  • Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, shipping documentation, or import and export operations.
  • Familiarity with commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills and bills of lading.
  • Exposure to customs permit declarations for Singapore or other Asia Pacific markets.
  • Experience validating data produced by OCR, AI or other automation assisted tools.

title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate - Oncology Biotech
excerpt: SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Redmond, WA and Princeton, NJ.
description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Redmond, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

SystImmune is seeking a high quality, ambitious and experienced Senior Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support SystImmune’s clinical trials. The Sr. CRA is responsible for the management and oversight of their assigned clinical study sites to ensure data quality and patient safety in accordance with ICH-GCP guidelines, local regulations, and applicable SOPs. The Sr CRA must be self-motivated, independent, and able to work in a small team environment. The successful candidate will be a highly organized individual who can also multitask and adjust direction based on changing project/corporate priorities.

Responsibilities
  • Perform Site Evaluation Visits, Site Initiation Visits, Interim monitoring visits and Close Out Visits.
  • Prepare the study reference manual, including liaising with the Contract Research Organization (CRO) team (i.e., central lab, specialty labs and vendors) to ensure efficient preparation and delivery of study materials to investigator sites.
  • Responsible for ensuring investigator sites have met all contractual and regulatory requirements for site initiation and first release of study drug.
  • Assist in the development of study/program plans (i.e., Monitoring Plan, eCRF Completion Guidelines, Data Management Plan, Safety Management Plan, etc.).
  • Manage patient recruitment strategies, proactively identifying barriers to recruitment while proposing solutions (i.e., study-site webinars, newsletters or other potential creative solutions).
  • Monitor recruitment, data quality and patient safety while on site and remotely through EDC systems and direct site communication.
  • Liaise with study site personnel to ensure timely and correct entry of data into eCRF, including the timely resolution of data queries.
  • Maintain project files including ethics committee approvals, curricula vitae of investigators and study personnel, clinical investigators brochure, protocols, case report forms instructions, consent documents, clinical-trial material shipping orders, start-up meeting attendance documentation, letters of agreement, lab reference ranges, and all investigator and site correspondence.
  • Identify and complete follow- up of SAEs at study sites.
  • Assist with data listing, data coding, patient profile reviews, database lock, and site close-out activities
  • Ensure appropriate and timely submission of documents to the Trial Master File.
  • Perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in health science or related field.
  • 5+ years monitoring Oncology trials independently conducting on-site and remote monitoring visits.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills required.
  • Excellent organizational, multi-tasking and time management skills required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing/maintaining site relationships and securing compliance
  • Working knowledge of International Conference on Harmonization Good Clinical Practice guidelines
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office Products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams) and other clinical trial systems (e.g., CTMS, EDC and eTMF)
  • Ability to travel as required (50-75%)

Compensation and Benefits:
The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.

SystImmune is a leading and well-funded biotech company with a bright future. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success. SystImmune offers a comprehensive benefits package including: 100% paid employee premiums for medical/dental/vision, also STD, LTD, a 401(k) plan with a 50% company match of up to 3% and a vesting schedule of only 5 years, 15 PTO days per year, sick leave, plus 11 paid holidays and MORE.

We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success.

SystImmune is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diverse talent and encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

description:
ABOUT VITALIEF
Vitalief is a specialized clinical research consulting and solutions company focused on helping academic medical centers (AMCs), health systems, hospitals, and research organizations improve clinical research operations and accelerate clinical trial delivery.

Our solutions span Clinical Research Consulting, Workforce and Resourcing Solutions, and Technology-Enabled Managed Services and Outsourcing Solutions. Through our proprietary AI-enabled platform, VELARA, we combine clinical research expertise, technology, and innovative delivery models to help clients streamline operations, improve efficiency, and scale their research programs.

POSITION OVERVIEW
Vitalief is seeking an entrepreneurial, results-driven Director of Business Development – Clinical Research Solutions to drive revenue growth and expand our presence in the academic medical center and health system markets. This individual will generate new business, develop strategic client relationships, and expand existing accounts by positioning Vitalief's consulting, workforce / resourcing, technology, and managed services solutions.

Initially an individual contributor, the Director will independently manage the full business development lifecycle, from prospecting and relationship development through solution positioning, proposals, negotiations, and contract execution. Working closely with executive leadership and subject matter experts, this individual will identify client needs, develop customized solutions, and help shape Vitalief's commercial strategy and continued growth, with opportunities for increasing leadership responsibility as the company expands.

WHY JOIN VITALIEF?
  • Innovation-Driven: Be part of the cutting edge of service and technology to dramatically change the way research is conducted at leading clinical research sites for the better.
  • PEOPLE FIRST culture: with opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Competitive benefits: include 20 PTO days + 9 paid holidays; Company-paid life insurance and short/long-term disability; 401(k) retirement program; Comprehensive healthcare plans.
  • Compensation:Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus performance-based bonuses and equity incentives.
  • Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Primarily remote with occasional travel (up to 15%) to client sites, industry conferences, and occasional meetings with leadership in Greater Philadelphia.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Development & Revenue Growth
  • Develop and execute strategies to acquire new clients and expand existing accounts.
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities within AMCs, health systems, hospitals, and other clinical research organizations.
  • Build relationships with clinical research executives, research administrators, and other key decision-makers.
  • Independently manage the sales lifecycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, presentations, proposals, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build and maintain a qualified sales pipeline and achieve established revenue targets.

Consultative Solution Selling
  • Understand client challenges and position Vitalief's solutions to improve clinical research operations, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Sell Vitalief's three primary service offerings:
  • (1) Clinical Research Consulting: Strategic and operational consulting to improve research infrastructure, processes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • (2)Workforce and Resourcing Solutions: Flexible workforce solutions providing clinical research professionals and specialized expertise.
  • (3)Technology-Enabled Managed Services and Outsourcing: Outsourced clinical research operations leveraging specialized expertise, scalable delivery models, and VELARA AI technology.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and delivery leaders to develop customized solutions aligned with client needs and budgets.

Account Expansion & Market Development
  • Identify opportunities to expand services within existing client organizations.
  • Develop relationships across departments, service lines, and clinical research functions.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging market opportunities.
  • Represent Vitalief at relevant industry conferences and networking events.
  • Provide market intelligence and strategic feedback to executive leadership.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 7 to 10 years of progressive business development or sales experience, preferably within the clinical research industry.
  • Demonstrated success selling one or more of the following Clinical Research services: Consulting services; Workforce/staffing solutions; Technology, software, or SaaS solutions; Managed services or outsourced clinical research operations.
  • Established relationships and experience developing business within AMCs, health systems, hospitals, or other clinical research organizations.
  • Strong understanding of clinical research operations, research administration, and the challenges facing research organizations.
  • Proven ability to independently generate new business, develop sales pipelines, manage complex sales cycles, and close engagements.
  • Experience with consultative, solution-based selling involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a growing organization.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Standing, sitting, walking, visual perception, talking and hearing. Lifting up to 20lbs. Ability to travel up to 15%.

Aviator is Avalara’s AI-native command center, shifting customers from navigating complex software menus to achieving complete tax and compliance outcomes through conversational, guided, and autonomous agent workflows.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the overarching Product-Led Growth (PLG) vision and experimentation roadmap for Aviator, driving user activation, time-to-first-value (TTV), retention, and self-serve expansion.

  • Turn Aviator into the primary growth flywheel for Avalara by designing intelligent, in-agent growth loops where conversational interactions naturally guide customers toward deeper automation and multi-product capabilities.

  • Lead a high-cadence experimentation program, testing conversational UX patterns, agent prompts, proactive contextual triggers, dynamic UI elements, and onboarding flows.

  • Partner with Data Science, AI Labs, UX Research, Product Analytics, Product Marketing, and Core PM teams to scale high-impact growth flywheels across all customer touchpoints.

1. High-Velocity Growth Experimentation

  • Establish and run a continuous, sprint-based experimentation cadence, deploying high-velocity multivariate and A/B tests across the entire user journey (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue).

  • Apply behavioral psychology, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and user friction reduction to test in-app messaging, interactive onboarding tours, contextual tooltips, and dynamic defaults.

  • Continuously test and refine conversational touchpoints, including agent prompt variations, response structures, tone, dynamic cards, and proactive notification triggers.

2. Agentic Growth Loops & AI Customer Experience (AI CX)

  • Design self-reinforcing in-agent growth loops that guide users seamlessly from their initial conversational query to full delegation of complex, multi-product autonomous workflows.

  • Leverage real-time contextual triggers (e.g., filing deadlines, transaction volume spikes, nexus threshold updates) to proactively surface intelligent next-best-action recommendations.

3. Self-Serve Expansion & Monetization

  • Architect frictionless self-serve upgrade pathways and contextual cross-sell mechanisms for core Avalara products (AvaTax, Managed Returns, Exemption Certificate Management, Tax Registrations) within agent workflows.

  • Build repeatable frameworks that convert low-tier or exploratory conversational engagement into qualified trials, automated tier upgrades, and multi-product expansion.

  • Direct experience designing or optimizing AI Customer Experiences (AI CX), conversational UX, LLM-powered copilots, or autonomous agentic workflows.

  • Strong fluency with quantitative analysis and growth tooling (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Heap, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, SQL).

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and executive communication skills, with demonstrated ability to align product, engineering, data science, and commercial teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

About the Role

Love bringing events to life? As an Congress & Pharma Events Project Managersupporting Life Sciences clients, you’ll lead congress and pharmaceutical events in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment where compliance, precision, and great client service all matter. You’re Good At

excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.
