description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Bilingual Customer Service & Scheduling Assistant (Healthcare)

Location: Remote – Colombia
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Practice Administration / Patient Services
Compensation: $8–$10 USD/hour, based on experience, qualifications, bilingual proficiency, and EMR knowledge
English Proficiency: Fluent in both English and Spanish (verbal and written communication)
Start Date: December 1, 2026

About the Role

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare management consulting firm that partners with medical practices to improve operational efficiency, patient services, and sustainable business growth. It supports healthcare organizations across specialties such as neurology, sleep medicine, internal medicine, pathology, and surgical services, and helps practices streamline operations while maintaining a positive patient experience.

We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and highly communicative Customer Service & Scheduling Assistant to support patient communications and appointment scheduling for a U.S. medical practice. As a primary point of contact for patients, you will handle incoming calls, coordinate medical appointments, answer general inquiries, and ensure patient information is documented accurately.

The ideal candidate is fluent in English and Spanish, has strong telephone communication skills, and can deliver professional, empathetic service in a fast-paced healthcare environment. Experience with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, particularly eClinicalWorks (eCW), is highly valued.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Work remotely while supporting a U.S. healthcare practice.

  • Help patients access medical services through professional and compassionate communication.

  • Develop experience in patient scheduling, healthcare administration, and EMR systems.

  • Collaborate with medical and administrative teams.

  • Contribute to an organization focused on service quality and long-term patient relationships.

What You'll Do

Patient Communication & Customer Service

  • Answer incoming patient calls promptly, professionally, and courteously.

  • Respond to questions about appointments, referrals, office information, and general procedures.

  • Provide appointment preparation instructions and communicate office policies.

  • Handle challenging patient interactions with patience, empathy, and professionalism.

  • Direct calls to clinical staff, providers, billing, or other appropriate departments.

Appointment Scheduling & Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel medical appointments accurately.

  • Manage provider schedules to support appointment availability and patient access.

  • Conduct appointment reminder calls, patient recalls, and follow-up scheduling.

  • Coordinate scheduling requests while maintaining accurate patient information.

Patient Records & Administrative Support

  • Verify patient demographics, contact information, and insurance details.

  • Document patient communications and scheduling activities in the EMR system.

  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.

  • Assist with general administrative tasks as assigned.

Compliance & Operational Efficiency

  • Follow HIPAA requirements and established patient confidentiality procedures.

  • Manage high call volumes while maintaining accuracy and excellent service.

  • Collaborate with the Call Center Supervisor, Practice Manager, and other team members.

  • Support efficient workflows and timely resolution of patient inquiries.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in customer service, call center operations, or medical office support.

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish.

  • Excellent telephone etiquette, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask effectively.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to handle sensitive patient interactions with empathy and professionalism.

  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and time management.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare, medical practice administration, or patient access services.

  • Experience using Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, insurance verification, and patient scheduling workflows.

  • Experience managing high call volumes in a healthcare setting.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish.

  • At least one year of experience in customer service, call center operations, or medical office support.

  • Ability to handle high call volumes with accuracy, empathy, and professionalism.

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW), which is strongly preferred.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote, part-time independent contractor role.

  • Strong telephone etiquette and accurate documentation in the EMR system.

How Success Is Measured

  • Professional, empathetic, and timely handling of patient calls.

  • Accuracy of appointment scheduling and patient information.

  • Efficient management of provider schedules and patient inquiries.

  • Quality and completeness of EMR documentation.

  • Consistent compliance with patient confidentiality requirements.

  • Reliability, organization, and effective collaboration with the medical practice team.

Why Join Us

  • Support patient care while building valuable experience in U.S. healthcare administration.

  • Work with a team that values professionalism, compassionate service, accuracy, and operational excellence.

Important Notes

  • Experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is strongly preferred but not required.

  • The position involves extended computer use, frequent telephone/headset communication, and repetitive data entry.

  • The role requires the ability to handle high call volumes while protecting confidential patient information.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

excerpt: Make Every Experience Matter Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients.
description:
Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 

Role description:

Our partner, a global biopharmaceutical company, is moving its commercial and medical engagement to Vault CRM and building an agentic, AI-powered CRM on top of it. We are looking for a strong CRM Product Owner who owns this platform end-to-end: sets the vision and priorities, runs the decision process, and brings business and technical teams together around one product.

You will report to the Program Lead and work closely with Medical, Commercial, IT, data, AI and country teams, as well as Veeva and system integrators. You bring working Veeva CRM experience; a dedicated Veeva expert team at Viseven supports you on deeper technical product questions, so your focus is ownership, alignment and decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product. Set the vision, roadmap and backlog for the new CRM, including a unified X-Pages workspace and AI-powered capabilities.
  • Align business and technology. Translate Medical, Commercial and country needs into clear priorities, and explain technical options and constraints back to the business.
  • Negotiate and decide. Balance competing requests across departments and countries, agree trade-offs, and keep decisions recorded and respected.
  • Run the process. Set up and lead governance: decision forums, backlog refinement, release planning, and acceptance of delivered work.
  • Work with the technical team. Discuss system capabilities, integrations and data with architects and engineers well enough to challenge and agree on solutions.
  • Shape the AI agenda. Identify where AI agents add value for reps and MSLs, define use cases with the AI team, and make sure guardrails and compliance are in place.
  • Drive adoption. Keep stakeholders and field users engaged, measure adoption and value, and steer the product accordingly.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in product ownership or product management of enterprise platforms, including 3+ years with CRM or commercial systems.
  • Proven track record of aligning business, medical and IT stakeholders and negotiating priorities across departments and countries.
  • Strong process leadership: roadmaps, backlogs, governance and decision-making across several teams and vendors.
  • Solid general understanding of CRM infrastructure: data models, integrations, master data and analytics, enough to discuss system capabilities with technical teams.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Veeva CRM (Salesforce-based or Vault): functional knowledge of core modules such as call reporting, CLM, Approved Email and Engage, and how they connect to PromoMats and Network.
  • Understanding of what AI agents and GenAI can and cannot do in a business system, ideally from at least one real initiative.
  • Knowledge of pharma commercial and medical processes and regulated environments (GxP, GDPR).
  • Fluent English; confident with senior, international, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice-to-have:

  • Vault CRM experience or participation in a migration to Vault CRM; Veeva certifications.
  • Experience with Vault CRM X-Pages or MyInsights.
  • Exposure to Veeva AI agents, Salesforce Agentforce or custom agents.
  • Understanding of APIs and integration platforms such as MuleSoft.
  • Product certification (CSPO, PSPO or SAFe POPM).
  • French or German.

Why Viseven?

Purpose in Every Service

Your work will contribute to solutions that help pharmaceutical companies bring innovations to market faster and improve how healthcare information reaches people globally. We build technology with purpose — because better communication can lead to better health outcomes.

Care and Connection

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and connected. At Viseven, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and genuine care are part of everyday work — for our teammates, clients, and communities. From charity and sustainability initiatives to an inclusive and supportive environment, we grow stronger together.

Grow and Go Beyond

We encourage bold ideas, ownership, and continuous growth. Whether it’s leading new initiatives, shaping products, or expanding your expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact and evolve alongside a global organization.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based salary reviews

  • Professional and career growth opportunities in a global environment

  • Flexible work format with remote opportunities

  • Paid time off (18 business days) and sick leave according to company policy

  • Family leave (3 paid business days) for important life moments

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage

  • English language courses

  • Professional development through forums, conferences, and learning programs

  • Team-building activities and corporate events

  • A collaborative international team where your ideas matter

Grow your expertise while shaping communication for the world’s leading pharma brands. Over 50% of our team has been with Viseven for 5+ years. Join us!

Data Scientist, Machine Learning | Rx360

About Rx360

Rx360 is building a wearable device and AI companion that helps seniors live independently while staying connected to the people who care about them. Our mission is to give older adults confidence in their daily lives and provide their families with peace of mind.

Our team works across hardware, firmware, software, and AI. We move quickly, care deeply about the people we build for, and maintain a high bar for quality, reliability, and trust.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to transform wearable sensor data into intelligence that helps keep seniors safe. You'll develop the machine learning systems behind fall detection, fall-risk prediction, and the health and activity insights delivered through our AI companion. You'll own the full model lifecycle, from raw sensor data and labeling through validation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and own machine learning models for fall detection using IMU, barometer, and PPG sensor data, achieving high sensitivity with minimal false alarms.
  • Build fall-risk and fall-prevention models that identify changes in gait, activity levels, sleep patterns, and heart rate trends before falls occur.
  • Create and manage real-world datasets collected from older adult users, including data collection, labeling, and ground-truth processes in collaboration with pilot and clinical partners.
  • Design validation strategies and success metrics, including sensitivity, false alarms per wearer-day, and time-to-alert.
  • Partner with firmware engineers to optimize models for deployment on wearable devices with limited memory, compute, and battery resources.
  • Define sensor data requirements and build scalable data pipelines that support reliable collection, labeling, storage, and model training.
  • Generate meaningful health and activity insights, including steps, activity levels, sleep quality, heart rate trends, wear time, and anomaly detection.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate false positives and missed events, and continuously improve performance through retraining and optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with product, hardware, firmware, software, clinical, and AI teams to shape product direction and technical requirements.
  • Ensure privacy, security, and responsible handling of sensitive health data throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Communicate technical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, including production-grade ML systems.
  • Required: At least 2 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.
  • Hands-on experience working with time-series sensor data such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, or PPG signals.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, alongside traditional machine learning techniques.
  • Experience solving rare-event and imbalanced-data problems, with a strong understanding of model evaluation, error analysis, and balancing false alarms versus missed detections.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models to embedded or resource-constrained devices, or close collaboration with firmware teams in doing so.
  • Experience designing data collection processes, labeling workflows, and data pipelines using SQL and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote, asynchronous environment across multiple time zones.
  • Curiosity, persistence, ownership, and a strong bias for action.
  • Empathy for older adults and those who support and care for them.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in digital health, wearables, connected medical devices, or clinical validation studies.
  • Familiarity with on-device ML frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers or Edge Impulse.
  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy and regulatory frameworks including GDPR, HIPAA, FDA, or MDR requirements.
  • Startup experience, particularly in early-stage product development and launches.

Join us on the Product Management team as a Product Manager – Mobile & IoT, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. Start your journey with Anova today!

This role’s center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You’ll own the mobile experience of Anova Unify: the iOS and Android apps our customers and field teams rely on, and how they work with our devices and cloud platform.

The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery for the Unify mobile platform. Reporting to the Platform Software Product Manager, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands-on role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won’t be handed a roadmap to execute — you’ll help shape it.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Own the mobile roadmap. Set the direction for the Unify mobile app across iOS and Android, including release planning, app store cadence, and how mobile features work with devices in the field.
  • Lead customer discovery. Run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews — to understand what customers need, what they’ll pay for, and how IoT transforms their business. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis.
  • Own the mobile backlog end-to-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, prioritize based on real customer insight, and keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity.
  • Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release, monitor adoption after launch, and iterate until customers can point to the value.
  • Deliver predictably. Keep your area shipping on cadence, with clear specs, edge cases handled, and engineering unblocked.
  • Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner, make trade-off calls with good judgment, and know when to escalate.
  • Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova’s physical devices, connectivity layer, mobile app, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
  • Enable go-to-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you’ve shipped and why it matters.
  • Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area and keep a feedback loop with support and customer success, so you surface patterns early and bring the voice of the customer into every decision.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment.

Preferred Qualifications -

Job Title: Analyste de la paie 1 / Payroll Analyst 1

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Êtes-vous un professionnel de la paie qui aime relever des défis complexes tout en évoluant dans un environnement collaboratif et stimulant?

IQVIA recherche un Analyste bilingue de la paie I pour se joindre à son équipe de paie canadienne. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à assurer un traitement exact et ponctuel de la paie des employés partout au Canada, tout en veillant au respect des réglementations fédérales et provinciales en matière de paie, y compris les exigences du droit du travail au Québec.

Vous intégrerez une équipe hautement collaborative où les employés bénéficient d'une grande autonomie, sont encouragés à proposer des idées et profitent de possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel ainsi que de formations croisées en matière d'opérations de paie canadiennes et américaines. L'équipe se distingue par son excellent équilibre travail-vie personnelle, son faible taux de roulement et une culture qui valorise la contribution de chacun.

Principales responsabilités

  • Soutenir l'administration des impôts et taxes liés à la paie, les remises gouvernementales, les dépôts et les déclarations réglementaires.
  • Préparer et rapprocher les écritures comptables liées à la paie ainsi que les interfaces avec le grand livre.
  • Effectuer le rapprochement des dépenses salariales et analyser les écarts.
  • Effectuer le rapprochement des cotisations et retenues salariales versées à des tiers.
  • Veiller à ce que les communications et la documentation relatives à la paie soient conformes à la Loi 96 du Québec et disponibles en français.
  • Posséder une connaissance du calcul et de l'administration des transactions de paie liées à la CNESST.
  • Soutenir les activités de paie dans plusieurs provinces canadiennes en veillant au respect des différentes législations provinciales.
  • Produire des rapports sur la paie et répondre aux demandes des employés et des intervenants internes.
  • Participer aux audits de paie, aux examens de conformité et aux activités de fin d'exercice.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des finances, des ressources humaines et de la paie afin d'améliorer continuellement les processus et les contrôles de paie.
  • Contribuer à des projets spéciaux, à l'amélioration des systèmes et à des initiatives d'automatisation.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme universitaire (baccalauréat) ou expérience pertinente équivalente.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral, avec d'excellentes compétences en communication.
  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en paie.
  • Expérience de la gestion complète de la paie canadienne, y compris les traitements et déclarations de fin d'année.
  • Expérience de l'administration de la paie dans plusieurs provinces, notamment en ce qui concerne les réglementations spécifiques au Québec, les rapprochements liés à la WSIB et les activités de conformité de la paie.
  • Excellente maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, notamment :
    • RECHERCHEV (VLOOKUP)
    • Tableaux croisés dynamiques
    • Fonctions SI (IF)
    • Outils de rapports et d'analyse de données.
  • Expérience avec des systèmes de paie et de gestion des ressources humaines (SIRH), tels que :
    • Dayforce
    • Workday
    • FDT Pro
    • Autres plateformes de paie d'entreprise.

excerpt: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst drives the day-to-day sales compensation operations for Jamf's global sales organization and serves as the technical and modeling lead for the team. This role supports monthly commission controls, commission platform administration and commission plan modeling. The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst works closely with Finance, Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Legal, and HR to design plans that motivate our sales teams, keep incentive cost predictable.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Own the monthly commission close and annual plan calendar, setting priorities across controls, CaptivateIQ updates, and model deadlines.
  • Serve as a primary hands-on resource for CaptivateIQ (CIQ) administration. Configure and maintain plan logic, data imports, crediting rules, and attribute and hierarchy mappings, and test all changes before release.
  • Resolve commission inquiries and disputes, report monthly inquiry metrics to improve plans, communications, and training.
  • Support the sales compensation exception (SSE) review process and ticket resolution, including windfall and off-cycle compensation cases. Prepare formal compensation treatment memos for leadership.
  • Build and maintain reporting and forecasting tools and serve as the primary sales compensation data partner to Revenue Operations, including Domo dashboards, source data validation, and the plan rule documentation.
  • Build and maintain multi-scenario Excel models that evaluate plan structures (quota credit, accelerators, quota amplifiers, gates, and caps) against incentive cost, rep earnings, attainment distribution, and quota-to-OTE ratios.
  • Support the annual sales compensation plan proposal but validating assumptions against prior-year actuals, tying model outputs to leadership materials, and contributing recommendations to Finance and Sales leadership.
  • Serve as a mentor and help train junior analysts on CaptivateIQ, plan modeling, and audit procedures. Support the Senior Manager in onboarding new team members.
  • Develop field-facing communications, including plan documents, FAQs, talk tracks, and office hours materials, that explain plan mechanics and changes to sales leaders and reps, and present complex analysis to executives.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, automate repeatable work, and strengthen controls over compensation operations, including SOX-relevant processes.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Total Rewards, sales compensation, or incentive compensation, including direct experience with commission plan modeling (Required)
  • Working knowledge of SQL for extracting and validating commission data and experience with Python or openpyxl for file processing or validation (Required).
  • Understanding of financial controls and audit requirements, including SOX and familiarity with commission accounting under ASC 340-40. (Required)
  • Sound judgement and discretion with confidential compensation matters. (Required)
  • Demonstrated analytical skills and attention to detail across multiple files and presentations before sign-off. (Required)
  • Advanced, hands-on proficiency with CaptivateIQ or a comparable incentive compensation platform, including configuring incentive plans, building calculation logic, managing data loads, and troubleshooting calculation results. (Preferred)
  • Excel modeling skills, including multi-scenario models with built-in validation checks, checks and testing for unintended outcomes such as windfalls or plan gaming. (Preferred)
  • Working knowledge of sales compensation plan design, including quota setting, accelerators, decelerators, caps, gates, multipliers, SPIFs, and kickers along with sales alignment and territory planning. (Preferred)
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce and Workday data structures used in sales compensation, such as opportunities, bookings, quotas, territories, and organizational hierarchies. (Preferred)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • 4 Year / Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or other business-related field (Required)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Position Summary:

The Senior CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
  • Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.

  • Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.

  • Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.

Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. May prepare or assist in preparation of study-specific presentations/training materials and tools.
  • Assists the team managers in the preparation and review of protocols and other study documentation.
  • Supports the design and development of CRFs and clinical trial documents as they pertain to clinical monitoring activities (i.e. operating manuals, monitoring guidelines, etc.).
  • Assists with review of clinical study reports.
  • Functions as a mentor, assisting with the training and developing of new employees and junior monitors.
  • Interacts with client, participates in proposal activities, including development and client presentations.
  • Initiates payment requests for investigators.
  • Travels as necessary according to project needs.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Europe: University degree life science/pharmacy/other health related discipline or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline or be a licensed health care professional.
  • N. America: 4-year college degree or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • 3.5 years or more as a CRA in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. Significant site management experience or equivalent experience in clinical research

Other Required:

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential. A team player
  • Evidence of a client focused approach
  • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required.
  • Ability to travel overnight. Up to 60% travel on average, based on regional requirements. International travel as needed
  • Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based
  • Select opportunities require Oncology experience preferably in early phases

Preferred:

  • Graduate, postgraduate degree
  • Experience monitoring in rare and complex therapeutic areas
  • Experience monitoring EDC trials and EHR records
  • Experience in biopharma or relevant therapeutic area
  • Relevant site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, submissions) experience for the particular country
  • Ability to monitor study sites, with supervision, according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines
  • Ability to resolves project related problems and prioritize workload to meet deadlines with oversight from management. Can assist junior CRAs in problem resolution

Competencies:

title: Senior Customer Success Operations Manager
excerpt: Chainguard is the trusted source for open source.
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As the Senior Customer Success Operations Manager, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling the operational infrastructure that supports Chainguard's post-sales organization, including Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Renewals.

You'll serve as a strategic partner to Customer Success leadership, translating business priorities into scalable processes, systems, and performance frameworks that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and revenue retention.

This role requires someone who can think strategically, influence cross-functional decisions, and drive complex initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll help shape how we operate as we scale, with a focus on automation, data-driven decision-making, and delivering a consistent, customer-centric experience.

What you'll do:

Customer Success Operations Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the Customer Success Operations roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Partner with CS leadership to translate organizational priorities into measurable operating plans, processes, and performance expectations.
  • Support capacity planning, resource allocation, and productivity modeling across Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support.
  • Identify operational gaps and lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how our post-sales teams operate.

Systems Strategy & Operational Infrastructure

  • Own the strategy, implementation, and optimization of our Customer Success technology ecosystem, ensuring systems support business needs as we scale.
  • Partner with Business Systems and IT to drive integrations, automation, and data integrity across Salesforce, CS platforms, support systems, and product analytics tools.
  • Establish scalable processes and workflows that reduce manual effort and improve visibility across the customer lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools and technology investments that improve operational efficiency and the customer experience.

Renewals Strategy & Operations

  • Lead the operational implementation of our Renewals function, including forecasting processes, quota tracking, performance measurement, and renewal workflows.
  • Establish reporting and analytics around renewal attainment, gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), churn, and contraction.
  • Partner with CS, Sales, and Finance to improve renewal predictability, identify retention risks, and establish clear accountability for revenue outcomes.
  • Develop scalable processes for renewal engagement, risk identification, escalation, and cross-functional coordination.

Performance Measurement & Business Insights

  • Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards that measure customer outcomes, retention, and operational productivity.
  • Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Drive consistent business reviews and operating cadences to evaluate performance, identify risks, and prioritize improvements.
  • Support annual planning through data analysis, productivity benchmarks, and operational recommendations.

Process Optimization & Customer Experience

  • Design and implement scalable processes across onboarding, adoption, customer engagement, renewals, and support.
  • Establish operational playbooks, service-level expectations, and accountability frameworks that improve consistency and execution.
  • Partner cross-functionally to identify friction points in the customer journey and implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Lead change management, enablement, and adoption for new processes, systems, and initiatives.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related function within B2B SaaS.
  • Proven experience owning operational strategy and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a high-growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of Customer Success operating models, SaaS retention metrics, renewal forecasting, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience building and scaling operational processes, systems, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Deep Salesforce expertise and experience working with CS platforms, support systems such as Zendesk, and product analytics tools.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including forecasting, financial modeling, performance reporting, and translating data into business recommendations.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership across Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Business Systems.
  • Ability to independently identify business challenges, develop solutions, and influence decisions across functions.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.

Strongly preferred:

  • Experience building or scaling Customer Success Operations at a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Experience supporting the launch or transformation of a dedicated Renewals organization.
  • Familiarity with Professional Services operations, including utilization, delivery capacity, and resource planning.
  • Experience implementing and integrating CS technology platforms and driving automation.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or other analytical and automation tools.
  • Background in cybersecurity, developer tools, or enterprise infrastructure software.

Base salary: $140,000-$165,000.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You will own the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function, spanning Procurement Operations, Accounts Payable, supplier onboarding, and payments. You will set the governance model and service standards, partner with executive stakeholders, and build a team that delivers consistently.

In this role, you will:

  • Own end-to-end P2P performance, from requisition and PO through receipt, invoice, approval, payment, and accrual, and align every tower (Procurement, AP, Supplier Management, Payments, Close) to one operating model
  • Establish and enforce operational governance: policies, controls, SLAs/KPIs, approval matrices, and audit readiness (SOX), with regular performance reviews
  • Ensure accurate, timely processing of requisitions, POs, and invoices, and the completeness of accruals and liability reconciliations for the financial close
  • Design supplier onboarding and master-data standards, with attention to risk, compliance, and payment integrity
  • Own payment-run integrity, including approval controls, banking batch oversight, and fraud and duplicate-payment prevention
  • Resolve escalated payment and process issues, and use root-cause research to prevent repeat issues
  • Partner with suppliers, Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders to define and deliver the automation and transformation roadmap
  • Report on P2P performance using defined KPIs (touchless invoice rate, on-time payment, cycle time, exception rate, DPO) and optimize working capital through payment terms and early-pay discounts
  • Oversee supplier risk, contract and PO compliance, and spend visibility across the vendor base
  • Manage change by rolling out policy, process, and system updates with clear stakeholder communication and adoption tracking
  • Elevate customer satisfaction across internal stakeholders and suppliers by owning the service experience, measuring CSAT/NPS, and acting on feedback
  • Deliver quarterly business reviews with senior and executive stakeholders, presenting performance, risks, and the improvement roadmap
  • Hire, develop, and coach a high-performing team, and hold every team member to a consistent standard through documented processes, training, performance calibration, and clear accountability
  • Build the training, onboarding, and succession plans that keep team capability uniform across locations
  • Model and embed Samsara’s values as the team scales globally

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years in procure-to-pay, AP, or procurement operations, including 5+ years managing teams and managers
  • Demonstrated end-to-end P2P expertise across multiple towers, with the ability to align cross-functional dependencies
  • Track record of running operational governance: SLAs, KPIs, internal controls, and audit/SOX compliance
  • Experience owning a team budget, managing vendor relationships, and managing remote, cross-time-zone teams
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level QBRs and improving stakeholder satisfaction
  • Proven ability to develop, train, and calibrate teams to a uniform standard
  • ERP experience (NetSuite preferred) plus a P2P platform such as Zip, Coupa, or Ariba
  • Bachelor’s in accounting, finance, business, or supply chain
  • Preferred: APM, CPSM, CPA, or equivalent

An ideal candidate also has:

  • The ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions
  • A history of being a collaborator, strategic thinker, and influencer
  • Experience scaling P2P operations in a high-growth, multi-entity, and multi-currency environment
  • Lean Six Sigma or similar process-improvement credentials, with automation and AI experience

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$117,040—$209,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose.

The Manager, Mainframe Systems Programming will coordinate and delegate the responsibilities of their assigned IT teams, as they pertain to systems programming. Oversee the day-to-day functions aligning with their Global Leader(s) responsibilities/duties while maintaining on-going project management and statuses. The Manager will oversee training sessions with resources so that they can be equipped with new knowledge and skills to remain current. Manager will do semi-yearly reviews, set yearly goals, aligning to the Business Unit and Company.

HONESTY, RELIABILITY, COLLABORATION, CURIOSITY, PASSION

What You Will Do:

  • Provide thought leadership within assigned tower and Business Unit
  • Provides Technical support for SW solutions.
  • Provide direction to Team Leaders and resources.
  • Possess communication skills to participate in client/team/Business unit meetings as well as providing documentation for client operational meetings.
  • Enhance the performance of others through mentoring and guiding.
  • Keep abreast of changes in standards, technologies or methodologies
  • Administer, update, weekly project management documents, aligning projects with client and BU activity.
  • Manage team’s ticket queue and following up on aging tickets
  • Provide risk assessment and risk management

· Administer quarterly review(s)

  • Set quarterly and yearly goals, aligning to the Business Unit and Company
  • Review assignments for accuracy and quality where applicable.
  • Delegate responsibilities where applicable.
  • Attend/facilitate client/team meetings where applicable.
  • Collaboration with other departments
  • Develop, assess, adhere to completion of personnel, departmental, and company goals.
  • Participate in and provide timely responses to all internal and external audits
  • Participating in on-boarding of new client.
  • Own all facets of performance and career management for the team. Regular one-on-one meetings with all team members.
  • Provide both technical and ‘soft skill’ mentoring in order to maintain a well-rounded, well-balanced team. This includes project management, quality audits, and coordination of training sessions as well as day-to-day oversight of the team.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.  

What You Will Need:

  • 10 years of Mainframe Systems Programming experience
  • 5+ years of related experience within an IT Operations environment with a bachelor’s degree. Relevant work experience will be considered in place of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 - 5 years of management experience in related field

· Good problem-solving skills

  • Self-motivated and have attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively coordinate and lead internal resources to accomplish key milestones
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to deliver informative and well-organized presentations
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and leadership skills with ability to work and build relationships across multiple levels of an organization
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment with ability to learn quickly

Other Qualifications

  • Microsoft Office skills including Microsoft Project, Excel, Word, Teams, Sharepoint
  • ServiceNow, or similar ITSM tool, skills including Incident, Request, Change and Problem ticket workflows

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

· Unlimited Paid Days Off

  • Three health plan options through UMR

· 401k with company match

  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Paid Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, and Sabbatical Leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding

· Enhanced fertility coverage

· Wellness program

· Flexible work schedule

  • Depending on location, ability to take advantage of fitness centers

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $102,000 to $148,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

Ensono is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment to our Associates and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (L4)
excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Staff Machine Learning Engineer on Twilio’s Conversation Memory team.

About the job

In this role, you will build the foundational AI/ML capabilities that power intelligent engagement experiences for Twilio customers - letting any application, human or AI agent, or channel know who a customer is, what they have done, and how best to reach them.

This role requires a builder and curious mindset, someone who can bridge the gap across theoretical research, production-grade experimentation and enterprise quality software. You will lead rapid research cycles to solve complex problems regarding contextual intelligence and large scale ML problems ensuring every interaction feels seamless and personalised.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build out new functionality within a fast moving product seeing rapid adoption.
  • Take a nebulous idea, design a rigorous experiment, and execute it within weeks.
  • Conduct deep-dive research into state-of-the-art LLM orchestration, retrieval strategies, and data-driven personalization.
  • Build ML systems that hold up at Twilio scale.
  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, high-delivery environment.
  • Proactively leverage and integrate the latest AI development stacks to bypass boilerplate engineering and focus on core differentiation.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years applied ML/AI experience with a track record of owning technically ambitious systems end to end rather than contributing to someone else's design.
  • Comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setting with ambiguous requirements and a strong bias for action.
  • Proficiency in Python programming language.
  • Experience building cloud-based services on AWS, GCP, or Azure, with high-volume data, streaming or real-time inference paths, and a range of data stores.
  • Strong fundamentals of statistical machine learning algorithms, transformer models, LLMs
  • Ability to raise the technical bar of a team through mentorship, design review, and standards, without formal management authority.
  • Experience in building cloud-based services using AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong communication skills and highly effective collaborator who works well with teammates.

Desired:

  • Prior experience building autonomous agents that handle multi-turn conversations and maintain long-term context/consistency.
  • Strong background in predictive modeling on user behavior, including experiment design and the causal or counterfactual methods needed when randomization is partial.
  • Prior experience working in a globally distributed team.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India - Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana State, Maharashtra and New Delhi.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst
excerpt: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country.
description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Role

Machinify is rebuilding how health plans audit and pay claims — at scale, with AI. As a Senior Healthcare Data Analyst you will sit at the intersection of domain expertise and data engineering: translating raw claims feeds into trusted canonical models, driving payment integrity insights, and serving as the internal expert on how claims flow through adjudication. This role is for someone who knows healthcare data cold and is excited to pair that knowledge with modern AI tooling to move faster and build smarter.

What You'll Do

  • Claims mapping & transformation — Design and implement data transformations that convert raw medical and institutional claims (837 EDI, UB-04, CMS-1500) into Machinify's canonical models, applying healthcare coding standards (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS) throughout.
  • Data quality & pipeline validation — Perform detailed audits to detect, troubleshoot, and resolve issues impacting accuracy and completeness; write SQL and Spark SQL queries to validate pipeline output end-to-end.
  • Platform expertise — Develop deep working knowledge of Machinify's platform—from data ingestion through claims adjudication—so that analytical solutions are accurate, traceable, and business-aligned.
  • Payment integrity — Identify overpayment patterns, COB issues, and billing edit opportunities by applying expertise in payer policy, CMS regulations, and provider reimbursement methodologies.
  • AI-assisted workflows — Actively drive AI adoption: prompt and iterate with LLMs to accelerate analysis, identify manual processes ripe for automation, and contribute to AI-assisted pipeline development.
  • Client onboarding — Support onboarding of new client data feeds, ensuring smooth integration with minimal disruption and clear documentation of transformation logic and lineage.
  • Cross-functional partnership — Partner with data engineers, data science, clinical staff, and product managers to translate complex healthcare requirements into scalable data solutions; collaborate with data scientists to enable advanced analytics and ML use cases.
  • Subject matter leadership — Serve as the go-to SME on claims coding, adjudication rules, and payer policy—mentoring analysts and engineers and advising stakeholders on risk, trends, and business impact.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years working directly with healthcare claims data — 837 EDI, encounter data, medical billing — ideally at a health plan, payment integrity vendor, or healthcare analytics firm.
  • Deep knowledge of claim types (professional and institutional), coding systems (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS), and standard form formats (UB-04, CMS-1500).
  • Hands-on payment integrity experience: overpayment detection, COB, billing edits, or claim editing logic.
  • Familiarity with CMS regulations and commercial payer guidelines as they apply to claims adjudication and payment policy.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency; comfortable writing complex analytical queries against large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and best practices for analytics.
  • Strong communicator — able to discuss healthcare process and payment logic directly with health plan clients, clinicians, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of provider reimbursement methodologies — MS-DRG/APR-DRG pricing, fee schedules, per diem, and capitation.
  • Proficiency with Spark SQL or a comparable distributed query engine for large-scale data environments.
  • Exposure to ETL/ELT pipeline development or close collaboration with data engineers on pipeline design.
  • Exposure to value-based care arrangements or risk adjustment (HCC coding, RADV).

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Full Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & their families
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work
  • Unlimited FTO
  • Competitive salary, equity, 401(k) including employer match

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $170,000 plus private equity.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law. description:
About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for a Product Marketing Manager:

In this role, you will own positioning, messaging, and field enablement, helping LastPass deliver on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected. As a staff-level Product Marketing Manager, you will also shape go-to-market strategy across our product portfolio.

About the team:

The Product Marketing team at LastPass sits at the intersection of product, sales, and brand — translating complex security and identity capabilities into clear, compelling narratives that move markets. We are a collaborative, curious group that moves quickly, sweats the details, and believes great marketing starts with a deep understanding of the customer.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You will work closely with Product Management to shape positioning and launch strategy, with Sales Enablement to ensure the field is equipped to win, and with Brand and Creative to bring campaigns to life. You will also partner with Business Operations to track performance and inform how we prioritize marketing investment.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Define and own the positioning and messaging framework for LastPass products, ensuring clarity and differentiation across customer segments and channels
  • Lead go-to-market planning for product launches, coordinating with Product, Sales, and Brand to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact
  • Develop sales enablement materials — including battle cards, pitch decks, and competitive intelligence — that equip the field to engage buyers and win competitive deals
  • Partner with Brand and Creative to produce compelling content — case studies, thought leadership, and web copy — that supports demand generation and strengthens brand authority
  • Conduct customer and market research to surface insights that sharpen product positioning and influence roadmap prioritization
  • Use data-driven insights to refine product marketing strategy and demonstrate contribution to pipeline and growth

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Proven experience in product marketing, with a track record of owning end-to-end go-to-market strategies for B2B SaaS or technology products
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling messaging that resonates with both technical buyers and business decision-makers
  • Strong analytical background, with proven experience using data and market research to inform positioning decisions and measure program effectiveness
  • Proven experience working cross-functionally, influencing stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Brand without direct authority
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, staying organised and delivering quality work under tight deadlines

It's great, but not required:

  • Background in cybersecurity, identity, or access management — familiarity with the security landscape would accelerate time-to-impact in this role
  • Experience with competitive intelligence platforms or win/loss analysis programs, with the ability to translate findings into actionable field guidance

description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

We're hiring for a Staff and Senior Backend Engineer to join our expanding Right Payer Solutions product team across Subrogate and COB product lines.

Our Culture @ Machinify

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity — a genuine interest in understanding the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers' needs, and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence — what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like: fast, but always under structured human oversight.

The Role

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This role is available for candidates located in the United States or Canada.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution.
