title: Information & Digital Transformation Specialist (Freelance mogelijk)
excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Doel van de functie Je fungeert als digitaal aanspreekpunt van de technische dienst en vertegenwoordigt de behoeften van de dienst bij IT.
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Doel van de functie

Je fungeert als digitaal aanspreekpunt van de technische dienst en vertegenwoordigt de behoeften van de dienst bij IT. Je brengt die behoeften in kaart, vertaalt ze naar concrete oplossingen en werkt samen met de betrokkenen aan de uitvoering en opvolging.

Vanuit de technische context leer je de processen, medewerkers en systemen kennen. Je haalt digitale behoeften op, denkt mee over verbeteringen en vertaalt vragen vanuit de dienst naar duidelijke voorstellen voor IT. Daarbij bewaak je dat de gekozen oplossingen aansluiten op de dagelijkse werking.

De eerste grote opdracht is de SharePoint-migratie. Je analyseert hoe de bestaande informatie verder kan worden geordend en verdeeld over de bedrijfsomgeving in SharePoint.

Ook na de migratie blijf je het aanspreekpunt voor digitale verbeteringen en de samenwerking met IT. Je volgt nieuwe behoeften en projecten op, houdt de verbeterplanning actueel en realiseert toepassingen rond AI, gestructureerde data, automatisering, rapportering en proces- en systeemoptimalisatie.

Resultaatsgebieden

  1. De technische dienst vertegenwoordigen richting IT
    • Je houdt zicht op de digitale behoeften van de technische dienst en bepaalt samen met de betrokken medewerkers welke verbeteringen voorrang krijgen.
    • Je vertaalt vragen naar concrete vereisten, bespreekt mogelijkheden en randvoorwaarden met IT en bewaakt dat oplossingen aansluiten op de werking van de dienst.
    • Je volgt afspraken, beslissingen en de uitvoering op. Blokkades maak je tijdig bespreekbaar en je blijft het aanspreekpunt voor nieuwe vragen, wijzigingen en vervolgprojecten.
  2. Processen en informatie in kaart brengen
    • Je onderzoekt werkprocessen, rollen, documenten, databronnen, systemen en afhankelijkheden samen met de betrokken medewerkers.
    • Je inventariseert bestaande informatie, brengt eigenaars in kaart en identificeert ontbrekende gegevens, mogelijke duplicaten en verouderde documenten. Je vertaalt deze bevindingen naar concrete verbeteringen.
  3. De informatiestructuur uitwerken en onderhouden
    • Je vertaalt de werking van de technische dienst naar een passende SharePoint-inrichting met bibliotheken, metadata en weergaven, bijvoorbeeld per project, installatie, documentstatus of revisie.
    • Samen met de informatie-eigenaars bepaal je wat behouden, gemigreerd, gearchiveerd of verwijderd wordt. Je past de afgesproken regels voor toegang, versiebeheer en bewaring toe.
    • Je controleert of de inrichting blijft aansluiten op de werking en past ze aan wanneer processen of behoeften veranderen.
  4. De SharePoint-migratie voorbereiden en uitvoeren
    • Je maakt binnen de afgesproken scope een migratieplan met prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden en werkpakketten voor de technische dienst en andere afdelingen. Je organiseert de opschoning en mapping zonder elk document afzonderlijk te beoordelen.
    • Samen met het projectteam en IT voer je proefmigraties en migratiegolven uit, controleer je de resultaten en verwerk je bevindingen en gebruikersfeedback.
  5. Digitale verbeteringen realiseren
    • Je vertaalt knelpunten naar prototypes en praktische oplossingen, zoals een documentenregistratie, een goedkeuringsworkflow met Power Automate of rapportering in Power BI over tekenplannen.
    • Je bouwt of configureert oplossingen zelf, schakelt waar nodig specialisten in en test de toepassingen met gebruikers.
    • Je voert verbeteringen stapsgewijs in en volgt het gebruik en de resultaten op.
  6. AI-toepassingen uitwerken
    • Je selecteert geschikte toepassingen voor documentanalyse, ondersteuning bij bestekcontroles of het toegankelijk maken van technische kennis.
    • Je bouwt en test kleinschalige prototypes met goedgekeurde hulpmiddelen, zoals Copilot of agents.
    • Je beoordeelt de meerwaarde en risico's en werkt succesvolle toepassingen verder uit, met afspraken over gegevensgebruik, beheer en menselijke controle.
  7. Medewerkers begeleiden en kennis overdragen
    • Je betrekt medewerkers bij demonstraties, tests en de ingebruikname. Je zorgt voor beknopte instructies, opleiding en ondersteuning.
    • Je verwerkt feedback, helpt medewerkers digitale mogelijkheden beter te benutten en zorgt voor duidelijke beheerafspraken.

Verwachte resultaten

  • Een actueel overzicht van de digitale behoeften en prioriteiten, met duidelijke afspraken en opvolging richting IT.
  • Een gevalideerde procesanalyse en informatie-inventaris, inclusief eigenaars, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en risico's.
  • Een bruikbare SharePoint-structuur, migratieklare werkpakketten en uitgevoerde migratiegolven.
  • Toegepaste afspraken over toegang, eigenaarschap, versiebeheer, bewaring en archivering.
  • Gerealiseerde prototypes en oplossingen rond AI, data, automatisering en processen.
  • Werkinstructies en duidelijke opvolging van gebruik, resultaten, risico's en volgende stappen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt minstens drie jaar relevante ervaring in businessanalyse, informatieanalyse, functionele analyse, procesverbetering of digitale implementatie.
  • Je combineert ervaring met procesanalyse met het zelf bouwen of configureren van oplossingen, van behoefteanalyse tot ingebruikname en verdere verbetering.
  • Je hebt sterke praktische kennis van Microsoft SharePoint Online en Microsoft 365, aangevuld met ervaring met automatisering en AI-toepassingen.
  • Je hebt praktische ervaring met Microsoft Power BI en kunt rapporteringen vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten voor de technische werking.
  • Je beschikt over kennis van information management, waaronder metadata, taxonomie, records management, bewaartermijnen en informatiebeveiliging.
  • Je hebt een kwalificatie in projectmanagement volgens de PMO-richtlijnen.
  • Je hebt technische affiniteit en begrijpt de werking van een productieomgeving, high-techomgeving of R&D-omgeving, bij voorkeur in een technische, industriële of sterk gereguleerde context.
  • Je kunt grote, ongestructureerde informatieverzamelingen onderzoeken en er duidelijke prioriteiten in aanbrengen.
  • Je hebt inzicht in architectuur-, beveiligings-, privacy- en informatiebeheerkaders.
  • Je kunt de behoeften van de technische dienst onderbouwen en bespreken met IT-specialisten. Je vraagt door, bewaakt afspraken en blijft constructief wanneer standpunten verschillen.
  • Je werkt op bachelor- of masterniveau, bijvoorbeeld in engineering, informatiebeheer, bedrijfskunde of IT.
  • Je communiceert mondeling en schriftelijk sterk in het Nederlands en kunt je in het Engels uitdrukken in een professionele context.
  • Je bent al in aanraking gekomen met grootschalige migraties van netwerkschijven naar SharePoint Online.
  • Je hebt kennis van PowerShell, Power Automate of vergelijkbare analyse- en automatiseringshulpmiddelen.
  • Ervaring met AI-prototypes, veranderbegeleiding, gebruikersadoptie of procesmodellering is relevant voor deze functie.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

description:
Leidos Health & Services Sector is seeking an experienced IT Applications Development & Operations Manager to lead the development, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise healthcare technology solutions supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA).

The position is responsible for managing the technical team supporting a 24/7 healthcare contact center built primarily on Salesforce Health Cloud and Amazon Connect, with integrations to enterprise healthcare systems and supporting cloud services.


This is Future work upon winning award


The successful candidate will provide hands-on technical leadership and management oversight across the software development lifecycle, system administration, configuration management, release management, and production support. The manager will ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions supporting nurse advice services, care coordination, appointment scheduling, referral management, and beneficiary engagement.

The position will collaborate with dedicated cybersecurity engineers, Leidos security personnel, and government stakeholders to ensure system development and operations comply with applicable DoD/DHA security and Authority to Operate (ATO) requirements.

Primary Responsibilities:


Application Development and Technical Leadership

  • Lead a multidisciplinary technical team consisting of Salesforce and Amazon Connect developers, system administrators, software testers, reporting specialists, and cybersecurity engineers.
  • Oversee the design, development, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment of Salesforce Health Cloud and Amazon Connect applications.
  • Manage software development activities, including requirements analysis, backlog prioritization, technical design, sprint planning, code reviews, testing, and production releases.
  • Provide technical oversight of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, Amazon Connect, AWS services, APIs, identity management, and healthcare information systems.
  • Ensure engineering teams follow established software development standards, architecture principles, quality controls, and documentation requirements.

Configuration Management and Release Management

  • Establish and oversee configuration management processes for Salesforce, Amazon Connect, AWS services, and supporting integrations.
  • Manage application environments, version control, change requests, configuration baselines, and deployment procedures.
  • Oversee CI/CD processes, automated testing, release planning, production deployments, and rollback procedures.
  • Ensure changes are properly documented, tested, approved, and implemented without unnecessary disruption to contact center operations.
  • Coordinate Salesforce platform updates, AWS service changes, system enhancements, and technology modernization initiatives.

Production Operations and Technical Support

  • Oversee Tier 2 and Tier 3 technical support for the Salesforce and Amazon Connect environments.
  • Manage incident response, technical troubleshooting, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective maintenance.
  • Monitor system availability, performance, integration health, application reliability, and technical service-level agreements.
  • Establish support procedures and escalation processes for a 24/7 contact center, including after-hours on-call coverage for critical incidents.
  • Coordinate with contact center operations leadership to resolve technical issues affecting agent productivity, call routing, patient engagement, and service delivery.
  • Maintain operational documentation, system configuration records, troubleshooting guides, and disaster recovery procedures.

Team and Program Management

  • Manage technical staffing, workload assignments, performance, mentoring, professional development, and resource planning.
  • Coordinate development priorities and technical deliverables with program management, government stakeholders, and operational leadership.
  • Manage technical risks, dependencies, schedules, vendor relationships, and technology-related costs.
  • Establish and report key engineering and operational performance metrics, including release quality, system availability, incident resolution, backlog progress, and SLA performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, development efficiency, automation, and operational effectiveness.

Cybersecurity and Compliance Oversight

  • Ensure technical teams implement applicable security controls, secure development practices, access controls, encryption, logging, and configuration requirements.
  • Coordinate with dedicated cybersecurity engineers and Leidos/government security teams to support DoD RMF, ATO activities, vulnerability remediation, and continuous monitoring.
  • Ensure technical changes are evaluated for potential impacts to the authorized system configuration and security posture.
  • Support cybersecurity assessments, audits, incident investigations, and corrective action planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience consistent with Leidos policies.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in information technology, enterprise application development, systems integration, or IT operations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical teams of 10 or more employees, including software developers, system administrators, engineers, or technical support personnel.
  • Experience leading enterprise software development and application sustainment activities across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Experience managing enterprise CRM, cloud contact center, or comparable business-critical application platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, AWS, or comparable cloud application technologies, including system configuration, application integration, deployment, and production operations.
  • Experience overseeing Agile development teams, software testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and release management.
  • Experience managing Tier 2/Tier 3 application support, incident management, root cause analysis, and operational service levels.
  • Experience with REST APIs, enterprise integrations, authentication, and cloud-based application architectures.
  • Experience coordinating technical teams and resolving complex cross-system issues.
  • Understanding of secure software development, cloud security principles, access management, and regulated data protection requirements.
  • Strong leadership, communication, technical planning, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work remotely in a private, secure environment with reliable connectivity, consistent with program requirements.
  • Ability to coordinate critical production incident response outside normal business hours when necessary.
  • US Citizenship and ability to meet applicable DoD/DHA personnel security and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing Salesforce Health Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud development and administration teams.
  • Experience managing Amazon Connect or comparable cloud contact center implementations and operations.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon Lex, MuleSoft, or other enterprise technologies.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, 24/7 healthcare contact centers.
  • Experience supporting DoD, DHA, VA, or other federal healthcare programs.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7, FHIR R4, and EHR integration.
  • Experience supporting applications in AWS GovCloud, Salesforce Government Cloud Plus – Defense, or other regulated cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, FedRAMP, DoD RMF, ATO requirements, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps, Git-based configuration management, automated testing, and CI/CD tools.
  • Certifications such as PMP, ITIL, Certified ScrumMaster, Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or comparable technical credentials.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, subcontractors, budgets, and technical delivery schedules.

title: Group Demand Planner
excerpt: GROUP DEMAND PLANNER Manufacturing | Procurement | Supply Chain About the Opportunity Our client, an established manufacturing organisation, is seeking a highly experienced and analytical Group Demand Planner to take ownership of group-wide raw material demand planning, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), inventory optimisation and supply continuity across multiple manufacturing sites.
description:
GROUP DEMAND PLANNER

Manufacturing | Procurement | Supply Chain

About the Opportunity

Our client, an established manufacturing organisation, is seeking a highly experienced and analytical Group Demand Planner to take ownership of group-wide raw material demand planning, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), inventory optimisation and supply continuity across multiple manufacturing sites.

This is a senior, technically demanding opportunity for a supply chain professional who understands complex manufacturing processes, integrated production environments and the importance of balancing material availability with working capital efficiency.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in developing and improving MRP systems, strengthening planning accuracy and ensuring uninterrupted production across the group.

Key Responsibilities

Demand & Supply Planning

  • Develop and maintain a rolling 12–18-month raw material demand plan aligned with sales forecasts, production schedules and S&OP.
  • Manage MRP planning across multiple manufacturing sites.
  • Coordinate material requirements across integrated manufacturing operations.
  • Balance internal production, external procurement and imported raw materials.
  • Conduct scenario planning for production changes, supplier disruptions and material shortages.

MRP Systems & Optimisation

  • Develop, implement, maintain and continuously improve MRP planning logic and parameters.
  • Ensure accuracy of bills of material (BOMs), lead times, safety stock, reorder points and master data.
  • Identify and resolve MRP inefficiencies and planning discrepancies.
  • Establish consistent planning standards across manufacturing sites.
  • Drive improvements in ERP utilisation, planning automation and reporting.

Raw Materials & Imports

  • Plan and manage imported raw materials, including international lead times, shipping and customs clearance.
  • Identify critical materials and implement appropriate inventory and supply risk strategies.
  • Monitor stock availability, supplier performance and potential supply disruptions.
  • Optimise inventory levels while minimising production stoppages and excess stock.

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

  • Collaborate with Procurement, Production, Sales, Finance, Logistics and Operations.
  • Contribute to monthly Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP).
  • Monitor KPIs relating to material availability, forecast accuracy, stock cover and inventory performance.
  • Develop dashboards and reports to support informed business decisions.
  • Mentor planners and buyers and promote continuous improvement.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics or Industrial Engineering.
  • Minimum 8–10 years' experience in demand planning, materials planning or supply planning within a manufacturing environment.
  • At least 5 years' hands-on experience developing, implementing and maintaining MRP systems.
  • Proven experience in process or heavy manufacturing.
  • Experience working across multiple manufacturing sites or group operations.
  • Strong understanding of integrated manufacturing processes, production planning and material dependencies.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and managing imported raw materials.
  • Advanced knowledge of ERP/MRP systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups and modelling.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management capabilities.

Highly Advantageous

  • SYSPRO ERP/MRP experience.
  • Experience in vertically or backward-integrated manufacturing environments.
  • APICS CPIM, CSCP or SAPICS certification.
  • Power BI reporting experience.
  • Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma exposure.
  • Experience optimising inventory, reducing stock-outs and improving MRP performance.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a commercially astute, technically strong planning professional who can see the bigger picture across an entire manufacturing supply chain.

You must be confident challenging MRP outputs, improving planning systems, managing critical supply risks and influencing stakeholders at senior management level.

This is not a traditional demand forecasting role. We require someone with proven, hands-on MRP development and implementation experience within a complex manufacturing environment.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Group-wide exposure across multiple manufacturing operations.
  • Opportunity to influence critical supply chain and procurement decisions.
  • Ownership of MRP optimisation and planning improvements.
  • Direct engagement with senior management.
  • Opportunity to drive measurable improvements in inventory, efficiency and production continuity.

How to Apply

If you have extensive manufacturing planning experience and a proven track record in MRP development, implementation and optimisation, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through Boardroom Appointments with your updated CV.

Only candidates meeting the minimum requirements will be considered.

excerpt: 📋 Tasks and responsibilities • Join a collaborative development team responsible for a SCADA system used by dispatchers 24/7 to keep the power perimeter balanced across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands.
description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

  • Join a collaborative development team responsible for a SCADA system used by dispatchers 24/7 to keep the power perimeter balanced across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands. The geographical scope is expected to expand, with more smaller and flexible assets being integrated.
  • Develop tools that support the real-time control of power plants, the integration of flexibility assets and compliance with European grid codes in support of the energy transition.

The tools are mainly used to:

  • Monitor production assets and the available capacity of power plants.
  • Exchange information between TSOs and the real-time SCADA system, or Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition system.
  • Calculate the real-time setpoint to be sent to power plants, based on the production plan, real-time acquisition and other inputs such as FCR, aFRR and mFRR, in order to maintain the balance of the power perimeter.

FCR stands for Frequency Containment Reserve, aFRR for Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve and mFRR for Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve. Similar balancing mechanisms are used in other countries.

  • Work with Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600, a SCADA solution for power generation control that uses custom logic and algorithms for real-time automated decision-making. The back-end logic is written in SCIL, the native language of the platform.
  • Develop and maintain the SCADA platform that supports the balance of the power perimeter.
  • Design and build clear, responsive web interfaces for dispatchers using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript or TypeScript within the MicroSCADA framework.
  • Work with Git and contribute to the further development of the SCADA landscape.
  • Apply architectural design and software craftsmanship principles such as SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI to create scalable, clean, maintainable and resilient code.
  • Collaborate in an Agile environment with analysts, dispatchers and technical teams.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to reduce repetitive work, generate tests, document code and understand unfamiliar parts of the code base more quickly. You remain responsible for the design and quality of the solution and help identify where AI adds value in an industrial context.
  • After a full onboarding, participate in a shared on-call rotation, mostly remotely, to support system availability and grid stability. Critical incidents are handled with support from the team.

📝 Your profile

  • You have relevant experience in an industrial OT environment.
  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is essential.
  • You care about building reliable, maintainable software.
  • No prior SCIL knowledge is required. Training and coaching are provided, and the skills developed are transferable beyond this platform.

💼 Offer

You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

(Freelance is also possible)

title: Senior Clinical Data Manager (Romania)
excerpt: Description SUMMARY ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely.
description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position

We are seeking an experienced Change Manager III to lead change management efforts on large-scale, complex projects and programs utilizing change management, project management, and Lean principles and techniques. This position will support all stages of the project lifecycle—including scoping, planning, management, and implementation—with a frequent focus on technology and large-scale organizational change.

Under minimal supervision, the Change Manager III will act as a liaison between internal and external partners, contractors, and stakeholders to facilitate collaboration, build consensus, promote accountability, and drive adoption.

This expert-level position will support highly integrated, enterprise-wide initiatives and programs consisting of multiple interrelated projects involving numerous stakeholders, high levels of ambiguity, competing priorities, and project interdependencies.

  • Schedule & Location: 100% Remote (Must be available to work standard Pacific Standard Time [PST] hours).
  • Contract Duration: 6-month contract with the possibility of an extension.

What You Will Do

Planning & Development

  • Identify change impacts, desired mindsets, and behavioral changes needed to realize change benefits within projects and varying team cultures.
  • Utilize the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) toolset to develop internal and external change management strategies and plans that outline components, communications, milestones, priorities, needs, and resources.
  • Organize, facilitate, and participate in stakeholder meetings to identify needs and build alignment throughout the change process.
  • Collaborate in analyzing business needs to identify process impacts and inform business cases, project proposals, and project plans.
  • Identify how people will experience change and develop tactical plans to engage teams and support individuals throughout the transition.

Change Management & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Work closely with project managers, process improvement managers, and project team members to support change management initiatives.
  • Apply expert stakeholder leadership skills and act as a collaborative partner and resource to project team members.
  • Monitor, measure, and track program adoption, change integration into the business, and mitigation needs.
  • Communicate adoption status through formal and informal presentations, reports, and updates to sponsors, business owners, and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with project leaders to represent the organization regarding project status and alignment with strategic plans.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build consensus among groups with differing viewpoints.
  • Equip people leaders to remain visible and support their teams throughout the change process.

Implementation & Quality Assurance

  • Utilize change management toolkits, templates, and advanced change management techniques to facilitate project adoption.
  • Develop and recommend processes and process improvements.
  • Identify potential difficulties or barriers to project goals and take appropriate steps to mitigate or avoid them.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable standards, policies, laws, rules, and regulations outlined in the project plan.

Documentation, Evaluation & Administration

  • Maintain appropriate project records, information, documentation, and reports.
  • Close project files upon completion, review records to ensure documentation is appropriate and complete, and provide change sustainment plans.
  • Facilitate evaluations of progress and challenges following implementation to identify potential system or process improvement opportunities.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance for the implementation, configuration, and ongoing support of internal systems, technology, and analytics.
  • Actively participate in business unit planning and performance metrics, recommend and draft policies/procedures, and participate in cross-departmental initiatives.
  • Assist in delivering EPMO-sponsored training, mentoring, and leading communities of practice to advance change management tools and team growth.

Organizational Responsibilities

  • Perform work in alignment with the organization’s mission, vision, and values, and adhere to all compliance requirements.
  • Support the organization’s commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion by fostering a culture of open-mindedness, cultural awareness, compassion, and respect for all individuals.
  • Strive to meet annual business goals in support of strategic objectives and perform other duties as needed.

You Will Be Successful If You Have:

  • Thorough knowledge of project management and organizational change management principles, methods, and techniques.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare and health insurance policies, principles, and practices, along with an advanced understanding of multiple health plan functions and system implications.
  • Advanced knowledge of multiple project management frameworks, including variations of Agile and Waterfall development methodologies.
  • Ability to integrate process improvement and redesign principles and techniques such as Lean, PDSA, or Six Sigma.
  • Expert-level ability to develop formal, detailed change management plans aligned with established timelines and budgetary guidelines.
  • Advanced ability to lead and motivate peers, cross-functional partners, and management toward achieving project goals.
  • Proven skill in managing multiple activities, matrixed teams, organizational communications, and competing priorities within time and budget constraints.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration/planning systems such as Smartsheet and Mural.
  • Strong resource planning skills and experience negotiating with resource managers for team member skills and availability across the project lifecycle.
  • Exceptional listening, verbal and written communication, documentation, meeting facilitation, and presentation skills across all organizational levels.
  • High degree of professionalism, adaptability, focus, and stress management when working with diverse internal and external business partners.
  • Ability to meet physical and cognitive demands of a remote role, including seeing, reading, and performing repetitive finger/wrist movements for at least 6 hours per day, and hearing/speaking clearly for 3 to 6 hours per day.

What You Will Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years of change management-related experience, including at least 5 years managing change on projects.
  • Leadership: Proven experience independently leading a variety of medium- and large-scale change efforts, including leadership on occasional enterprise-wide, complex initiatives.
  • Industry Background: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the healthcare or managed care industry.
  • Certification: Change Management certification (Prosci, Kotter, or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications

title: Director UX Research
excerpt: Location Details: United States, Remote At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team.
description:
Location Details: United States, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.

We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!

What you'll get to do...

Research Strategy and Prioritization
  • Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made
  • Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity
  • Distinguish between what the research team should own directly and what the broader UX community can handle with the right support
  • Help GoDaddy continue to mature in how it uses AI to test, validate, and accelerate insight generation — developing a point of view on where AI-assisted methods are appropriate and where human judgment remains essential
  • Represent research as a key influence on product direction, not a validation step after building
AI Evaluation and Emerging Experience Research
  • Lead research into the human dimensions of GoDaddy's AI products: how customers understand, trust, accurately address, adapt to, and recover from experiences involving artificial intelligence
  • Partner on evaluation frameworks for agentic and AI-assisted features — contributing methodological expertise on trust, control, edge cases, and live-product monitoring — before and after launch
  • Bring leadership to research questions that don't have established playbooks: prompt and workflow analysis, human-in-the-loop testing, behavioral data interpretation in AI contexts
  • Stay current on AI-experience research methods and bring that knowledge into the team and the wider build group
Standards, Enablement, and Research Craft
  • Set the research quality bar for the entire Product UX organization. This includes UX designers conducting generative and iterative research, as well as partner teams running their own small-batch testing.
  • Refine existing frameworks, guardrails, and playbooks so that designers and partner teams can run clean discovery: when directional research is enough, when it isn't, how to synthesize and share findings, so they compound across the org
  • Lead all aspects of the continued development of UX designers running research — building research craft, raising quality standards, and driving the integration of AI research tools and methodologies into how the broader design organization works
  • Ensure shared infrastructure remains current and usable: repositories, taxonomies, participant panels, consent and data governance standards, AI-assisted workflows
Team Leadership and Development
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a research team that includes both existing researchers and new hires
  • Build toward complementary strengths across the team: generative and assessment-focused research, quantitative and mixed-methods capability, AI evaluation proficiency, and research operations
  • Mentor UX researchers directly on craft, career development, and the evolving demands of researching technology-enhanced product experiences
  • Build a culture where rigor and velocity are treated as compatible, not competing, where "directional and fast" and "deep and strategic" are both valued depending on the decision at stake
Cross-Functional and Organizational Influence
  • Operate as a peer to the Design, Product, and Engineering leaders — shaping product strategy, not just informing it
  • Partner with different departments to ensure research is connected to commercial priorities, not siloed within the build organization
  • Build organizational confidence that product decisions are grounded in real customer understanding, particularly as AI capabilities expand faster than product intuition can track

Your experience should include...

  • 10+ years of UX or user research experience, with demonstrated proficiency in mixed-methods approaches
  • 4+ years leading research teams, with direct responsibility for hiring, mentoring, and performance development
  • Meaningful experience researching AI-driven, technically complex, or developer-facing products
  • Track record of refining and operationalizing research standards, frameworks, or enablement tools that extended research quality beyond the immediate research team
  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, not just delivering studies but shaping direction
  • Experience partnering with various departments beyond just a build or product organization

You might also have...

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, SMB products, or multi-product platforms where research prioritization across a large portfolio was a core challenge
  • Familiarity with research operations at scale: participant recruiting infrastructure, insight repositories, governance frameworks
  • Proficiency working with behavioral data, product analytics, or telemetry alongside qualitative findings
  • Background in human-computer interaction, cognitive psychology, behavioral science, or related fields

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

About the role

The Senior Software Engineer on the Underwriting team designs and builds backend services and systems that power Coalition’s cyber insurance underwriting decisions. They integrate security, insurance, and proprietary data to apply business rules, statistical models, and machine learning in assessing and monitoring risk. This role is highly cross-functional, partnering closely with underwriters, data science, and other engineering teams to scale and automate Coalition’s underwriting and core decisioning workflows.

title: Data Analyst (Power BI & Data Modeling)
excerpt: We are seeking a Data Analyst (Power BI & Data Modeling) to own the design, build, and maintenance of our Power BI reporting and the underlying data models that turn platform and business data into decisions.
description:
We are seeking a Data Analyst (Power BI & Data Modeling) to own the design, build, and maintenance of our Power BI reporting and the underlying data models that turn platform and business data into decisions. Working across the data platform (Azure Databricks / SQL / Postgres sources), you will model clean, well-documented datasets and deliver self-service dashboards, KPIs, and ad hoc analysis for business and operations stakeholders. This role is the dedicated owner of trustworthy self-service reporting and a single, consistent definition of key metrics across the business — enabling faster, data-driven decisions and reducing the ad hoc reporting burden currently carried by engineers and analysts.

This is a remote role in the USA.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent is required.
  • Power BI report and dashboard design, including DAX measures, Power Query (M), data refresh and gateway setup, row-level security, and workspace / publishing management.
  • Dimensional / star-schema data modeling: fact and dimension design, managing granularity and relationships, and building semantic models for self-service reporting.
  • Strong SQL: writing and optimizing queries (joins, aggregations, window functions) against relational sources.
  • Strong analytical mindset: translating ambiguous business questions into metrics, validating data, and presenting clear findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Data quality and documentation: reconciling figures to source, defining measures consistently, and maintaining a data dictionary.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills; self-starting, detail-oriented, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Finance / financial-services domain experience (reading revenue, cost, billing, or AML / compliance data) preferred.
  • Databricks / Spark SQL, Python for analysis, and Git version control preferred.
  • Experience working with large or regulated datasets preferred.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for business, operations, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Design and maintain dimensional / semantic data models (star schema — facts and dimensions) that power self-service reporting.
  • Author and maintain DAX measures and Power Query (M) transformations with consistent, documented definitions.
  • Reconcile reported figures back to source systems and resolve data-quality issues before they reach reports.
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics and KPIs.
  • Produce ad hoc analysis to answer specific business and operational questions.
  • Maintain a data dictionary and report catalog; configure refresh schedules, gateways, and row-level security.
  • Support month-end and periodic reporting cycles.

IQVIA Digital powers exceptional brand experiences, delivering innovative solutions based on a customer-first, insights-driven, and integrated omnichannel vision. We provide authenticated, privacy-enhanced data and analytics, innovative fit-for-purpose healthcare technology, and the expertise to enable an effective and adaptable marketing model that drives better quality of care and patient outcomes. IQVIA is the leading global provider of data, advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services for the life sciences industry. Learn more at

Product

The Product team is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for IQVIA Digital's portfolio of data, technology, and media solutions. Through close partnership with clients and cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market, Technology, Data Management, and Operations teams, the team translates market insights and customer needs into innovative, scalable products. Built upon IQVIA's industry-leading healthcare data assets and privacy-by-design foundation, these solutions deliver differentiated value to clients, drive business growth, and advance IQVIA Digital's leadership in the healthcare marketing ecosystem.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a portfolio of data-driven personalization products within IQVIA Digital’s Personalization Science suite. This role will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of solutions that enable healthcare brands to deliver highly targeted, omnichannel engagement with healthcare providers (HCPs) and consumers, powered by IQVIA’s proprietary data and analytics.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of data, analytics, and marketing technology—responsible for translating complex healthcare datasets and behavioral signals into scalable, client-facing products that drive measurable engagement and business outcomes.

What You’ll Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and execute the roadmap for a portfolio of personalization and audience products, including:
    o Behavioral intelligence and engagement platforms (e.g., activity and content consumption insights)
    o HCP data and profiling solutions (e.g., multi-attribute segmentation and targeting)
    o Audience products (intent-based, predictive, and modeled audiences)
    • Identify opportunities to expand personalization capabilities across channels, use cases, and client segments.

Product Delivery & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end product development—from concept through launch and iteration.
    • Partner with engineering and data science to build scalable, SaaS-based solutions integrated into a broader martech ecosystem.
    • Deliver capabilities that enable right message, right channel, right time engagement across digital touchpoints.

Data & Analytics Innovation

  • Translate IQVIA’s clinical, behavioral, and engagement data into productized insights and targeting solutions.

• Drive development of:

o Identity resolution and audience building capabilities
o Predictive models and intent signals
o Real-time or near-real-time engagement triggers
• Work closely with data science teams to operationalize advanced analytics into market-ready offerings.

Customer-Centric Product Development

  • Engage directly with pharma clients, agencies, and internal commercial teams to:

o Validate product-market fit

o Gather requirements and prioritize features
o Ensure products deliver measurable marketing impact
• Incorporate feedback loops into roadmap decisions and product evolution.

Commercial Performance

  • Support go-to-market strategy, including positioning, packaging, and pricing of products.
    • Partner with sales and client teams to drive adoption, growth, and retention.
    • Track performance against product KPIs such as usage, revenue contribution, and client outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective layer across product, engineering, data science, and commercial teams.
    • Drive alignment across stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
    • Ensure products meet privacy, compliance, and consent standards critical to healthcare data usage.

What We’re Looking For

8–12+ years in product management, with experience delivering data-driven or platform-based products

Background in one or more of:

o Marketing technology (martech/adtech)

o Data and analytics platforms

o Healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries (strongly preferred)

Experience working with:

o Audience segmentation and targeting products
o Behavioral data or digital engagement signals
o AI/ML or predictive modeling (practical application vs theory)

Core Capabilities

  • Strong product execution mindset—comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving delivery
    • Ability to translate complex data and technical concepts into clear product value propositions
    • Customer-first thinking with a bias toward measurable outcomes
    • Experience working cross-functionally across technical and commercial teams
    • Strong communication skills, including ability to influence senior stakeholders

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare provider (HCP) engagement or pharma commercialization
    • Familiarity with identity resolution, privacy frameworks, and consent-driven data ecosystems
    • Experience integrating products with third-party platforms or open ecosystems

How Success is Measured

  • Delivery of roadmap milestones and product releases
    • Growth in adoption and revenue across assigned portfolio
    • Measurable improvement in client engagement outcomes
    • Strength of product-market fit and client satisfaction
    • Contribution to overall personalization platform innovation

Why This Role Matters

Personalization is a core driver of modern healthcare engagement. IQVIA Digital’s Personalization Science platform connects data, analytics, and activation to enable more relevant, human-centered interactions across the care continuum.

In this role, you’ll directly shape how leading healthcare brands engage their audiences—turning complex data into meaningful, scalable experiences.

description:
Job Title: Principal Cloud Engineer

Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Principal Cloud Engineer

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Principal Cloud Engineer to lead the design, architecture, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure and platforms across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure and overall Cloud FinOps

The ideal candidate will combine strategic enterprise architecture and operations leadership with deep, hands-on technical experience. This individual will define cloud standards, develop multi-cloud solutions including high availability and disaster recovery, modernize enterprise infrastructure, and drive cloud finops initiatives

The Principal Cloud Engineer will play a critical role in defining the cloud and AI infrastructure strategy, including infrastructure supporting Generative AI, machine learning, GPU workloads, and enterprise AI platforms.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On AWS Architecture & Operations

  • Design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade AWS infrastructure and cloud-native solutions.
  • Demonstrate hands-on expertise with:
    • AWS Organizations, Control Tower, multi-account strategy, and landing zones.
    • Amazon VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, and network security.
    • EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, Auto Scaling, and serverless architectures.
    • S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, and data storage services.
    • IAM, AWS Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and CloudTrail.
    • CloudWatch, AWS Config, Systems Manager, and operational monitoring.
    • CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK, and infrastructure automation.
    • AWS Backup, Elastic Disaster Recovery, and cross-region resilience.
  • Design and implement secure, highly available, fault-tolerant, and multi-region AWS architectures.
  • Establish automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, performance, availability, and security issues.

2. Hands-On Microsoft Azure Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect, implement, and manage enterprise-scale Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Demonstrate hands-on expertise with:
    • Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, Subscriptions, and Azure Policy.
    • Azure Virtual Networks, VNet Peering, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Private Link, and Azure Firewall.
    • Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets, AKS, Azure Functions, and App Services.
    • Azure Storage, Azure Files, Azure Managed Disks, and Azure NetApp Files.
    • Azure SQL, Azure Database services, and data platform integrations.
    • Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud.
    • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Microsoft Sentinel.
    • Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and cross-region disaster recovery.
    • Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, and Azure DevOps.
  • Establish enterprise governance, identity, security, networking, and operational standards.
  • Design resilient Azure architectures using availability zones, paired regions, and geo-redundant services.
  • Lead cloud infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives.

3. Cloud FinOps & Cost Optimization

  • Establish and lead enterprise Cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) strategy and governance.
  • Develop cloud financial management practices across AWS and Azure.
  • Implement cloud cost visibility, accountability, forecasting, budgeting, and chargeback/showback models.
  • Establish tagging standards, cost allocation, resource ownership, and financial governance.
  • Optimize cloud spending through:
    • Rightsizing and workload optimization.
    • Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Azure Reservations.
    • Compute scheduling and automated resource shutdown.
    • Storage lifecycle management and tiering.
    • Kubernetes and container resource optimization.
    • Network and data transfer cost optimization.
    • GPU and AI infrastructure utilization optimization.
  • Implement AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, and AWS Cost and Usage Reports.
  • Implement Azure Cost Management, budgets, and cost allocation.
  • Develop FinOps dashboards, executive reporting, and cost optimization KPIs.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to improve cloud financial accountability.
  • Establish continuous cost optimization practices while maintaining performance, security, and availability.

4. Cloud Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Define enterprise cloud disaster recovery (DR), business continuity, and resiliency architecture across AWS and Azure.
  • Design and implement disaster recovery strategies for mission-critical applications, databases, infrastructure, and enterprise platforms.
  • Establish Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) based on business criticality.
  • Architect and implement:
    • Multi-region and cross-region disaster recovery.
    • Availability Zone and regional resilience.
    • Backup, replication, and recovery automation.
    • Active-active and active-passive architectures.
    • Pilot light, warm standby, and hot standby recovery models.
    • Immutable backups and ransomware-resilient recovery.
    • Database replication and point-in-time recovery.
  • Implement AWS Backup, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Develop automated recovery orchestration and infrastructure rebuild capabilities using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Establish DR testing, recovery validation, failover/failback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Lead disaster recovery exercises, business continuity assessments, and recovery readiness reviews.
  • Define DR metrics, reporting, and compliance evidence for executive stakeholders and auditors.

5. AI Infrastructure & Generative AI

  • Implement enterprise AI infrastructure architecture supporting machine learning, Generative AI, and large language model workloads.
  • Support cost-efficient infrastructure for AI/ML training, inference, GPU Infrastructure and model deployment.
  • Leverage AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2 GPU instances, and EKS.
  • Leverage Azure services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, AKS, and GPU-enabled virtual machines.
  • Optimize GPU utilization, model inference costs, compute capacity, and AI workload performance.
  • Collaborate with data science, data engineering, and application development teams to enable enterprise AI adoption.

6. Cloud Governance & Compliance

  • Embed security-by-design principles into cloud architecture and engineering.
  • Establish Zero Trust architecture, identity governance, privileged access management, and least-privilege controls.
  • Design secure cloud networking, encryption, secrets management, and key management strategies.
  • Implement cloud security posture management and continuous compliance monitoring.
  • Align cloud solutions with relevant standards and frameworks, including NIST, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities, threats, and cloud security risks.
  • Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards and reusable automation frameworks.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and application deployment.
  • Enable self-service infrastructure provisioning through standardized cloud platform services.

7. Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, security, and application teams.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical assessments, and solution evaluations.
  • Develop architecture diagrams, technical design documents, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Influence enterprise technology decisions and cloud investment strategies.
  • Mentor senior engineers, architects, and technical leads.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executive leadership and business stakeholders.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise IT & Cloud infrastructure, AI Platform and Cloud FinOps
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and managing AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing and supporting Cloud FinOps including FinOps architecture, FinOps tools, and FinOps process for showback, chargeback, cost optimization and executive reporting
  • Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise disaster recovery and business continuity solutions across AWS and Azure
  • Extensive experience with enterprise networking, compute, storage, databases, security, and identity management.
  • Experience designing infrastructure for AI/ML, GPU workloads, and Generative AI platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty.
  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert.
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional.
  • Kubernetes certifications such as CKA or CKAD.
  • Relevant AI/ML cloud certifications.

Since 2018, Wisetack has been building transparent and intuitive consumer lending products that help service-based businesses thrive (think HVAC companies, veterinarians, or auto repair shops).

Our leadership team comes from top fintech companies such as Lending Club, Affirm, and Varo Money. And we’re backed by leading VCs, including Insight Partners, Greylock, Quadrille, and Bain Capital Ventures (investors in Airbnb, LinkedIn, Instagram, Dropbox, and more).

Having raised $84M, we’re a well-funded startup and have invested in people and technology while growing our partnerships — responsibly.

We’re also proud to have received recognition from the fintech world. Awards we’ve won include:

  • Ranked #21 on 2024 Inc. 5000 based on revenue growth
  • Ranked #15 on 2024 Deloitte Fast 500 based on revenue growth
  • 2024 Best Embedded Finance Solution for Banking Tech Awards
  • 2023 Best Consumer Lending Program by Tearsheet
  • 2023 Best Point of Sale Product by Fintech Breakthrough

But what you’ll find us gleaming about the most is the recognition from our own customers, particularly our sky-high NPS rating of 79. (For reference, the average score is 44 for financial services and 36 for SaaS companies.)

As a result of our efforts in building this healthy company culture, we’ve been nominated to several Great Places to Work lists, such as Best Small Workplaces, Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance.

Like any startup, we’re in it for the long haul, and we’re looking for people willing to join our journey of building something special together.

This process starts with our company values, which guide us in everything we do — and have played a critical role in our success. We valiantly abide by them, and would expect you to do the same:

  • Put customers first (that’s our M.O.)
  • Act fast (leverage our startup environment).
  • Lead the way (show and tell).
  • Take ownership (everyone is hands-on here).
  • Be a good human (no egos, build financial products that do right by people).

Learn more about our values here.

The Role

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Wisetack, you are responsible for generating qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting. You’ll engage home services business owners, introduce Wisetack’s financing solutions, and convert cold outreach into high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.

This is a high-activity, metrics-driven role focused on creating new opportunities—not waiting for them. Success is defined by consistent pipeline generation, strong conversion rates, and disciplined execution, and collaborating with your account executives.

Responsibilities

  • Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and experiment with new ways to work more efficiently and effectively
  • Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting (calls, email, SMS) targeting home services businesses
  • Engage & qualify inbound leads in a timely manner
  • Identify and engage decision-makers, turning cold outreach into qualified meetings
  • Maintain strong funnel conversion rates (connect → conversation → meeting → opportunity)
  • Build and prioritize target account lists using tools like ZoomInfo
  • Effectively qualify prospects (revenue, ticket size, financing usage, sales process) & handle objections on prospect calls
  • Partner closely with Account Executives for collaboration and seamless handoffs
  • Maintain accurate CRM data and execute structured outreach cadences
  • Maintain and track performance against KPIs (activity, meetings, pipeline) and continuously improve messaging

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound prospecting or a high-volume, customer-facing role
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Strong phone presence with the ability to build trust quickly
  • Familiarity with fintech, payments, or consumer financing
  • Experience using Salesforce, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, AI-powered prospecting tools, or similar technologies
  • AI-forward mindset with an eagerness to adopt emerging tools that improve research, personalization, productivity, and results
  • Growth-oriented and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Highly organized, resilient, and motivated by results

Bonus points

  • Experience selling into home services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, etc.)
  • Background in B2B, fintech, or startup environments
  • Track record of top performance in outbound roles

Conclusion

The base salary for the position is $75,000, plus annual target variable of $15,000, equity, and benefits. Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level and competencies.

Spend a little time on our About Us page and check out our Press page and our blog for more. If you think this might be a fit, we’d love to hear from you!

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making. Our data practices are described in Wisetack’s Privacy Policy.

description:
Job Title: Specialist II PSS Remote based Canada

Job Location: Toronto

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Fortrea is currently seeking a Specialist II (Patient Safety Solutions) to perform clinical trial and post approval adverse event case processing. This role requires strong clinical knowledge as well as an understanding of the US Healthcare system.


This is a full-time, home-based position in Canada that will require willingness to work flexible hours as needed to meet business needs.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Assist with the overall Clinical Safety and/or PSS operations associated with products including the entire adverse events process which may include safety data collected from clinical trials and/or post marketing setting (i.e., unsolicited reports). Manage and process expendable adverse events to the required standard and submit them to the client and the regulatory agencies (if required) within the agreed/stated timelines. The post holder is responsible for providing this service to clients either as a support function to the client project groups or as stand-alone business. Responsible to provide all clients, both internal and external, with the appropriate quality of service in a safe and cost-effective manner. He/she will be expected to comply with the legal requirements of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974, the COSHH regulations 1989 and the EC (European Commission) Directives 1992/3 as documented in the Company's Health and Safety Manual.


Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Manage the receipt and processing of all adverse event reports reported either spontaneously from any source or solicited from a clinical trial including safety database entry, AE review, write patient narratives with coding, follow-up of missing information, lists assessment against appropriate label (For Marketed products, if applicable).
  • Submission of expedited Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reports to clients, Regulatory Authorities, Ethics Committees, investigators, third party vendors, Partners and Fortrea project personnel, if required and as agreed with client during study set-up, within study specified timelines.
  • Ensure all cases that require expediting reporting to worldwide Regulatory Agencies or other recipients are prioritized for processing and submission within the regulatory and/or study specific applicable timelines.
  • Prepares timely pharmacovigilance reports for products and safety issues, including Individual Case Summary Reports (ICSRs) of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), Annual IND reports, European Annual Safety Reports (ASRs), Development Safety Update Report (DSUR), Periodic Reports (PRs) line listings, and aggregate reports.
  • Perform peer/independent QC of Safety reports as needed.
  • Work with Data Management or client on reconciliation of safety databases, if appropriate.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of Fortrea's safety database conventions or client-specific database conventions, as appropriate.
  • Maintains a comprehensive understanding of Fortrea PSS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WI), guidance documents and directives associated with safety management, reporting, and pharmacovigilance.
  • Assist in signal detection, trend, and pattern recognition activities, as appropriate. Monitor workflow for assigned studies/programs to ensure all the timelines are met.
  • Assist in the development of departmental Work Instructions (WI) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), as appropriate.
  • Participate in the generation of monthly status and other project-specific reports ensuring the quality and accuracy of metrics/data provided.
  • Support/train less experienced safety staff in all aspects of case-handling, adverse event reporting and other work, as needed.
  • Begin to prepare Safety Management Plans (SMPs), Reconciliation Plans and other safety-specific plans under supervision.
  • Responsible for making decisions regarding adverse event reporting within the guidelines of each specific project.
  • Actively participates in project team and client meetings and liaise with clients, where appropriate.
  • Assist with proactive quality issue resolution and implementation of actions, as needed.
  • Support audit or inspection preparations.
  • Assist in the review of cumulative safety data for submission to Drug Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs), regulatory authorities or clients.
  • Assist with the set-up of, and the provision of data to Safety Committees/DSMBs. Build and maintain good PSS relationships across functional units.
  • Demonstrate role-specific Competencies and company values on a consistent basis.
  • Assist in the co-ordination of endpoint committees, as required.
  • Any other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Non-degree + 2-3 years of Safety experience or 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Associate degree + 2-3 years of Safety experience or 4 years of relevant experience.
  • BS/BA + 2 years of safety experience or 3-4 years of relevant experience.
  • MS/MA + 2 years of safety experience or 2-3 years of relevant experience.
  • PharmD + 2 years of safety experience or 2-3 years relevant experience.
  • For PharmD, a one-year residency of fellowship can be considered as relevant experience.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Good verbal and written communication skills and good presentation skills.
  • Ability to interact and influence with line and middle management, staff, and external contacts on a functional and tactical level.
  • High degree of accuracy with attention to detail.
  • Functions as a team player.
  • Ability to present and share useful business information across departments and functions.
  • Ability to anticipate and identify problems and take appropriate action to correct them.
  • Knowledge of medical and drug terminology.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) related to clinical safety documentation.
  • Knowledge of ICH Guidelines.
  • Knowledge of Medical Device reporting desirable.
  • Knowledge of worldwide regulatory requirements and reporting of adverse event for both marketed and investigational products.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of industry and R and D processes and objectives.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Good keyboard skills, preferably with knowledge of MS office and Windows would be beneficial.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Degree preferred to be in one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Biological Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Medical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related area.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Office environment.

Pay Range: CAD 75.000-105.000

Benefits: All job offers will be based on a candidate's skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Application Deadline: 11/19/26

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.
