BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

BlackSky is looking for a strong, self-starting and eager engineer to join our Mission Planning Engineering team. This integrated product team is working to develop and maintain optimized autonomous operations for the BlackSky constellation. The Mission Planning Team works closely with the Mission Management SW Development team: Mission Planners own requirements documentation, initial scope and design documentation, and will lead SW feature development efforts by writing prototype code and/or written system level requirements which are executable by the SW development team. Strong candidates will have deep mission planning algorithm design experience, specifically for satellite or aerial imaging applications. Prior experience with different types of image planning logic, such as point targets, strip mapping, or pushbroom scanning or equivalent experience with time assignment problems is essential. The candidate should have solid experience in developing both prototype code and software system requirements.

In this role, you will develop and track system level requirements, schedules, and technical implementation for a wide variety of mission planning products and see them through to operation on orbit. Opportunities will exist for prototype code development in Python or Go, as well as internal tooling development for measuring KPIs, troubleshooting performance problems, and identifying and correcting inefficiencies in planning algorithms. While the primary responsibility of this hire will be to define system level and software requirements and prototype code, a strong background in production level software or embedded systems experience in spacecraft or autonomous vehicles will be valuable.

We have offices in Herndon, VA and Seattle, WA but are open to remote candidates.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to mission planning integrated product team, interfacing with mission planning, ground software, and operations and product engineers to plan and execute autonomous constellation operations software features.
  • Model, implement, and test concepts of operation for autonomous planning of various constellation activities including imaging, system calibration, propulsion, or other critical activities. This may involve leveraging heritage or building novel algorithms, as well developing new problem formulations to optimize image capture planning while respecting various other constraints and activities.
  • Model satellite subsystems (communications, power, attitude) using methods that are compatible with existing and future ground and control software algorithms as needed to support Mission Planning functions.
  • Support ongoing constellation operations and customer fulfillment efforts as a mission planning subject matter expert.
  • Translate product concepts to engineering requirements and facilitate review and discussion among engineering, product and software stakeholders.
  • Occasional 24/7 support expected during Launch and Early Operations or Anomaly Response in support of debugging and fixing mission planning algorithms.
  • Other relevant duties assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or higher in one of the following fields: aerospace or mechanical engineering, systems engineering, computer science or equivalent.
  • At least six (6) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience with automation of complex systems (satellite, vehicle fleets, drones, shipping/delivery logistics etc.).
  • Experience with planning or optimization algorithms and fluency with inputs/outputs/constraints to such systems.
  • Experience writing technical requirements and driving to implementation.
  • Experience with project management or software product development.
  • Working knowledge of Go or Python.
  • Knowledge of software design, maintenance, and implementation including data structures, data retrieval and storage, algorithm efficiency, and maintainable scalable code.
  • Demonstrated initiative to identify and solve problems or inefficiencies in your current field of expertise.
  • Possess strong team and inter-team cooperation and organization skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong understanding of audience.
  • Ability to sustain a workload consisting of several concurrent, independent activities.
  • This program this role supports requires US citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise in satellite or aerial imagery mission planning algorithms, specifically prior experience with point target, strip mapping, pushbroom, whiskbroom, wide area capture or stereo capture planning.
  • Fluent in satellite first principals such as orbital mechanics, attitude dynamics, and satellite systems.
  • Demonstrated experience with modelling/simulation projects.
  • Strong familiarity with orbital mechanics, attitude dynamics, and satellite systems.
  • Experience with planning algorithms and fluency with inputs/outputs/constraints to such systems.
  • Expertise with integer or linear program solvers.
  • Experience with embedded systems pertaining to satellites or other autonomous vehicles.
  • Experience with AI coding agents

Reporting to the Corporate Controller and working closely with our external reporting team, this person will lead the use of AI and automation across our accounting and reporting processes, redesigning how we close, consolidate, report, and document so the work is faster, more automated, and well controlled. excerpt: Overview The HIM Certified Coder is responsible for accurate and timely coding of hospital inpatient, hospital outpatient and/or professional fee encounters using appropriate ICD10/ICDPCS, CPT, or HCPCs codes and appropriate coding software such as computer assisted coding and encoders as a means to ensure compliant billing of Carle claims.
description:
Overview

The HIM Certified Coder is responsible for accurate and timely coding of hospital inpatient, hospital outpatient and/or professional fee encounters using appropriate ICD10/ICDPCS, CPT, or HCPCs codes and appropriate coding software such as computer assisted coding and encoders as a means to ensure compliant billing of Carle claims. HIM Certified Coder is responsible for understanding and applying all regulatory coding guidelines, such as National and Local Coverage Determinations and application of CPT modifiers. HIM Certified Coder is also responsible for understanding and applying coding knowledge to resolve billing edits related to coding. HIM coder uses Carle electronic medical record systems to review clinical encounters.

Responsibilities

Responsible for accurately coding all records according to the appropriate coding classification (ICD-10 and/or CPT and/or HCPCs and modifiers) system. The assignment of codes will accurately reflect the diagnoses and procedures pertinent to the patient. Provides interdepartmental coding assistance, as needed, to determine accurate coding assignment. Develops methodology to provide a coding process that is compliant with regulatory agencies including the utilization of reference materials such as, but not limited to, Center for Medicare Services (CMS) publications, Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, etc. Facilitates optimization of revenue while maintaining compliance standards for the organization through varied venues and tasks (auditing/monitoring, training, facilitation of charges through the claim scrubber system, assisting with various patient or payor related charge/account inquiries, research on various coding/billing related topics as requested by various sources internal and external to the organization, etc.). Serves as an expert resource regarding CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, all other necessary coding systems, and regulatory guidelines for all internal and external parties. Serve as liaison for coding and billing staff to ensure accurate charge capture. Reports any documentation and coding improvement needs based upon review findings. Responsible for maintaining coding certification, knowledge and skills to successfuly perform job duties Performs provider and peer coding audits as requested Assist with monitoring of internal controls for coding and billing. Facilitates external audit activities and reporting of such activities to the appropriate administrative personnel.

Qualifications

Certifications: Certified Professional Coder (CPC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Outpatient Coder (COC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Coding Specialist - Physician-Based (CCS-P) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), Education: , Work Experience:

Statusphere is an influencer-marketing technology platform built for enterprise brands to make human-generated content scalable, measurable and brand-safe across social, retail and paid media channels. The platform uses AI to automate and orchestrate large-scale creator programs, from sourcing and vetting influencers, to fulfillment, compliance, tracking and rights management. Statusphere is entering a new stage of growth, with increasingly large enterprise customers, hundreds of active brand portals, and significantly greater complexity across the business. We are looking for an experienced VP of Customer Success to build the Customer Success organization required for that next stage.

The VP of Customer Success will own the strategy, organizational design, talent, performance, training, systems, and evolution of the Customer Success function at Statusphere. We are looking for someone who has previously built and led high-performing Customer Success teams and who knows what excellent Customer Success looks like inside a rapidly scaling organization.

This leader will be responsible for transforming Customer Success from a primarily reactive execution function into a proactive organization of highly knowledgeable marketing and platform experts who can serve as true strategic partners to Statusphere customers. Because our customers rely on Statusphere as part of their broader marketing strategy, this person must bring both strong Customer Success leadership experience and meaningful expertise in influencer and creator marketing.

The VP, Customer Success is responsible for defining and executing the strategy that drives customer retention, expansion, and long-term brand success. Reporting to the CEO, this role will lead the Customer Success organization, establish scalable processes and operating rhythms, and ensure brands realize measurable value from the Statusphere platform while delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience.

As a key member of the leadership team, the VP, Customer Success will work closely with the Head of Sales to align across the customer lifecycle, including renewal and expansion strategies, customer handoffs, and compensation programs that promote collaboration, shared accountability, and long-term revenue growth.

Customer Success Strategy & Organizational Design

  • Success Associates, enterprise-focused roles, and potential Customer Support functions.

  • Develop headcount and hiring plans based on future business needs.

Training & Enablement

  • Create a comprehensive onboarding program for new CSMs and Customer Success Associates.
  • Build ongoing education and certification around the Statusphere platform.

Performance Management & Compensation

  • Define clear KPIs for the Customer Success organization.
  • Determine how individual CSM performance should be measured.
  • Develop Customer Success scorecards and operating metrics.
  • Establish customer health measures that provide early visibility into risk.
  • Build incentive and bonus programs aligned with customer and company outcomes.
  • Establish management cadences for reviewing team performance, capacity, customer health, and risk.
  • Create accountability around performance while maintaining a customer-first culture.

Customer Health, Retention & Renewals

  • Own the overall Customer Success strategy for driving strong retention.
  • Establish consistent methodologies for measuring customer health.
  • Ensure risks are identified and escalated early.
  • Build processes for addressing at-risk customers.
  • Create clear accountability for renewal readiness within Customer Success.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Brand Partnerships on retention and expansion.
  • Provide executive leadership with visibility into customer health across the portfolio.

Enterprise Customer Success

  • Define how Statusphere should service its largest and most complex enterprise customers.
  • Partner closely with the VP of Enterprise Client Partnerships.
  • Determine appropriate enterprise portfolio sizes and staffing models.
  • Decide when enterprise relationships require dedicated CSMs, Associates, or other resources.

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver

Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right — balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.

You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls — which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff — that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.

What You'll Do

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve the Hardest Escalations

  • Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance
  • Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions
  • Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs

  • Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals
  • Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)
  • Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

Set the Standard for the Team

  • Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team
  • Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience
  • Uphold team expectations by leading through example
  • Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations
  • Working knowledge of margin and cost tradeoffs, and comfort applying that knowledge to real-time approval decisions
  • Deep, near-expert familiarity with the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your sector
  • Track record of coaching or supporting less-tenured teammates through difficult issues
  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a track record of getting ahead of problems rather than reacting to them
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications, where applicable within your sector

Advancement to Ops Expert

Ops Expert is a step up in scope, not just tenure: it moves from executing within your sector to being the escalation point leadership and account managers turn to directly, with elevated coaching and live-operations responsibility. To advance, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 9-12 months in the OS III role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS III performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
  • Demonstrated ability to guide teammates in real time — catching and correcting issues as they happen, not just after the fact
  • Working familiarity with monitoring and resourcing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Twilio, live dashboards) beyond your own queue
  • Willingness to obtain additional certifications required for the Expert tier, where applicable, in addition to your existing sector certifications
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as the sector's top escalation resource and take on informal team-leadership responsibility

Compensation

  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options

What You'll Do

Avalara is transforming tax compliance into a seamless, automated digital experience. Within our Micro & Emerging Business unit, we are building a unified self-serve compliance platform for small merchants and lodging operators by bringing DAVO and MyLodgeTax together.

As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead the cross-functional operations of this flagship initiative. You will drive alignment, accountability, and execution across dedicated engineering teams, central platform groups, business development, billing systems, and shared services. Reporting to Evan Wright (VP & GM, SMB Business), this role gives you startup-style agility and scope backed by the data, customers, and infrastructure of an established global SaaS leader.

Lead program delivery. Own the integrated plan, milestones, and critical path for the DAVO and MyLodgeTax consolidation, including the platform rebuild, customer migration, and security and compliance deadlines.

Run the cross-team operating model. Set up operating rhythms, dependency maps, and clear service agreements with engineering, central platform, business development, filing operations, and corporate systems teams.

Drive billing and systems work. Coordinate roadmaps and delivery for card and ACH checkout, self-serve pricing and quoting, HubSpot, ERP integrations, and the APIs underneath them.

Align partner integrations. Coordinate timelines across POS and property-management integrations, marketplace apps, and integration partners so customers can sign up and onboard without talking to sales.

Give executives clear visibility. Build dashboards tracking self-serve conversion, support volume, and acquisition economics, and write decision memos that make trade-offs easy to act on.

Modernize how programs run. Use AI tools for status updates, risk detection, and documentation, and help CPMO turn what works here into playbooks for the rest of Avalara.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy, campaign planning, and execution for DAVO to accelerate merchant acquisition, trial sign-ups, and active user growth.

  • Own marketing initiatives across app marketplaces, POS ecosystems (e.g., Clover, Square, Toast, Shopify, and others), and merchant-embedded channels to drive app installs and partner-referred growth.

  • Partner with Product and Growth teams to optimize the self-serve buying journey, conversion paths, digital onboarding, and activation funnels.

  • Develop compelling, merchant-centric messaging, landing pages, digital campaigns, and educational content that articulate the time-saving and compliance benefits of daily automated sales tax.

  • Plan and execute multi-channel demand generation programs across digital advertising, email nurture streams, partner co-marketing, and industry activations.

  • Utilize modern marketing technology, automation, and AI-powered tools to scale campaign testing, optimize messaging variations, and eliminate friction across marketing funnels.

  • Track and analyze full-funnel PLG telemetry and marketing performance metrics (install-to-activation rates, customer acquisition cost, retention, and ROI) to steer marketing investments and campaign optimizations.

AI Proficiency

  • Use approved AI and automation tools to streamline operations, including project setup, documentation accuracy, sales queue handling, and invoicing workflows.

  • Build reusable prompts, templates, and lightweight automations to reduce manual rework and help delivery teams prepare client projects faster.

  • Track efficiency and data quality gains, sharing effective AI workflows and best practices across the team.

What AI success looks like:

  • Demonstrated experience applying practical AI/automation tools to improve day-to-day workflow speed, quality, and documentation accuracy.

  • A proactive mindset for identifying process bottlenecks and building scalable, reusable solutions.

What You'll Need to be Successful

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs at a SaaS or enterprise technology organization.

  • Proven track record delivering programs involving subscription billing, payments/checkout workflows, or complex enterprise platform and integrations.

  • A track record of driving accountability across a matrixed organization without direct authority.

  • Experience delivering against fixed milestones and deadlines, including legacy platform migrations.

  • Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to distill technical and commercial trade-offs into clear recommendations.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your daily work to synthesize information and move faster.

Preferred

  • Experience with product-led growth (PLG) or self-serve funnels.

  • Experience with POS, property-management, or e-commerce partner integrations.

  • A background in tax, compliance, or fintech.

  • Solid foundation in Agile, Scrum, or SDLC delivery frameworks

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

description:
As apharmaceutical support industry leader, UBC is devoted toempowering health solutions for a better tomorrow. We take pride inimproving patient outcomes and advancing healthcare. At UBC we provide services to enhance the entire drug development process and commercialization lifecycle - From clinical trial support to real-world evidence generation.

Embark on arewarding career journeywith UBC!Grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the world around you. UBC fosters a culture built on ourCore Valuesbeing:Collaborative, Conscientious, Curious, Consultative, and Compassionate. We believe in aninclusive workplace that fosters creativity.

If you are seeking a career that willchallenge, inspire, and reward you,join us at UBC!

Brief Description

The Executive Director, Scientific Strategy & Evidence Sciences provides senior scientific and strategic leadership across UBC’s Evidence Development Solutions (EDS) organization. This role is responsible for shaping portfolio‑level evidence strategy, scientific direction, and integrated solution frameworks that support late‑stage research, post‑marketing commitments, and value‑focused evidence generation.

Operating at an Executive Director level and reporting into UBC senior leadership, this role serves as a unifying scientific authority across Evidence Sciences, integrating methodological rigor, strategic thinking, and market‑relevant solution development. The Executive Director partners closely with Business Development, Evidence Sciences Operations, Epidemiology, Analytics, Medical & Scientific Solutions, and other cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure UBC’s evidence offerings are scientifically robust, strategically differentiated, and aligned to evolving client and regulatory expectations.

Depending on assignment and organizational need, the role may emphasize portfolio‑level scientific leadership and evidence standards, or market‑facing scientific strategy, solution shaping, and client engagement.

Specific Job Duties

Scientific & Evidence Strategy Leadership

  • Provide senior scientific leadership and direction across evidence generation methodologies, including real‑world evidence, epidemiology, evidence synthesis, quantitative analytics, and outcomes research.
  • Establish and champion scientific standards, methodological rigor, and evidence quality expectations across portfolios and programs.
  • Advise on fit‑for‑purpose evidence strategies aligned to regulatory, HTA, payer, and post‑marketing requirements.
  • Serve as a scientific authority for complex or novel evidence approaches, ensuring credibility and defensibility of UBC’s solutions.

Portfolio‑Level Solution Strategy

  • Shape integrated evidence strategies and solution frameworks that leverage UBC’s capabilities across Evidence Sciences, Patient & Physician Services, analytics, and partner ecosystems.
  • Translate scientific innovation into coherent portfolio‑level narratives that support client decision‑making and long‑term value generation.
  • Partner with Evidence Sciences Operations to ensure alignment between scientific strategy, delivery feasibility, and operational execution.

Business Development & Client Engagement

  • Act as a senior scientific and strategic partner to Business Development in shaping win strategies, solution narratives, and proposal positioning.
  • Contribute to and/or executive‑author proposal content, executive summaries, and scientific rationales for complex opportunities.
  • Participate in capabilities presentations, bid defenses, and strategic client discussions as a senior scientific representative.
  • Support sales enablement through thought leadership, training, and articulation of differentiated evidence approaches.

Thought Leadership, Partnerships & External Engagement

  • Author and sponsor thought‑leadership assets including white papers, blogs, abstracts, posters, and case studies.
  • Represent UBC as a scientific and strategic thought leader at industry conferences, scientific meetings, and client forums.
  • Evaluate and cultivate external partnerships that enhance UBC’s evidence sciences capabilities and strategic positioning.
  • Support Strategic Business Initiatives (SBIs) and leadership exchanges, contributing scientific insight and strategic direction.

People Leadership & Organizational Contribution

  • Provide senior leadership and mentorship to scientific and strategic leaders across Evidence Sciences functions, either directly or through matrixed structures.
  • Coach and develop senior SMEs and emerging leaders, fostering a culture of scientific excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to organizational planning related to capability development, capacity evolution, and future scientific needs.

Governance & Enterprise Alignment

  • Ensure evidence strategies and scientific practices align with UBC policies, SOPs, quality systems, and applicable regulations.
  • Partner with Quality, Regulatory, and Operational leaders to manage scientific risk and uphold compliance standards.
  • Track and communicate performance indicators related to scientific contribution, strategic initiatives, and portfolio impact, as appropriate for the role’s focus.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Executive‑level leadership responsibility for senior scientific and strategic contributors across Evidence Sciences, either through direct or matrixed leadership.
  • Direct a multi‑functional leadership team (Epidemiology; Patient & Physician Services—advocacy, recruitment; Creative Services).
  • Set operating priorities, manage financials and utilization, and develop capacity plans aligned to portfolio demand and BD pipeline.
  • Accountable for scientific mentorship, leadership development, and strategic alignment across assigned areas of responsibility.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics, public health, biomedical sciences, or a related scientific discipline; PhD preferred.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in evidence generation, real‑world evidence, epidemiology, analytics, HEOR, or related scientific domains.
  • Demonstrated experience operating in senior scientific leadership or portfolio‑level strategic roles.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory, HTA, payer, and post‑marketing evidence requirements.
  • Proven ability to bridge scientific rigor with strategic thinking and market‑relevant solution development.
  • Experience supporting business development, complex proposals, and senior client engagements.
  • Recognized thought‑leadership presence or demonstrated ability to represent scientific leadership externally.
  • Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global organization.

UBC Benefits:

At UBC, employee growth and well-being are always at the forefront. We offer an extensive range of benefits to ensure that you have everything you need to thrive personally and professionally. Here are some of the exciting perks UBC offers:

  • Remote opportunities
  • Competitive salaries
  • Growth opportunities for promotion

  • Flexible work environment
  • Discretionary PTO (Paid Time Off)
  • Paid Holidays

  • HSA/FSA
  • Telemedicine (Virtual doctor appointments)
  • Wellness program
  • Adoption assistance
  • Short-term disability (after 90 days of employment)
  • Long-term disability
  • Life insurance
  • Discount programs

UBC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that fosters respect for each other, our clients, and our patients.

As the Enterprise AI Capability Program Lead, you will own the system that makes this shift possible. You'll lead our enterprise reskilling and AI capability program, guiding managers, leaders, and eventually all employees from AI awareness to structured experimentation and workflow redesign.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Personally teach, coach, and mentor managers and functional leaders as they build fluency and lead redesign in their own teams, including facilitating workshops and working sessions across functions globally.
  • Build reusable tools, templates, and frameworks, including ones that help leaders break roles into tasks, assess AI suitability, and redesign around the human-AI boundary so the work scales beyond direct engagement.
  • Translate complex AI and org-design concepts into approachable, compelling content for a management audience.
  • Build the infrastructure that turns individual experimentation into organizational learning: mechanisms for surfacing use cases, an AI champions network across functions, and forums where practical wins get shared and repeated.
  • Own measurement of the program's impact as evidenced by the change in work itself (e.g., speed, quality, capacity redirected to higher value tasks) versus adoption metrics.
  • Progressively expand the program beyond managers to a full employee-wide reskilling agenda, sequencing where the next capability gap or opportunity matters most.
  • Own the long-term, continuous improvement of both the capability program and manager effectiveness in this area; this is a durable mandate you keep improving, not a program you launch once and hand off.
  • Report regularly to senior leadership on program impact, with a clear, evidence-based answer to “how is the organization working smarter because of this program.”

title: DevOps
excerpt: The role Proto is hiring a DevOps Engineer to manage, scale, and secure the cloud and infrastructure powering our AI agent platform – products that put AI agents in the hands of governments, regulators, and businesses across emerging markets.
description:
The role

Proto is hiring a DevOps Engineer to manage, scale, and secure the cloud and infrastructure powering our AI agent platform – products that put AI agents in the hands of governments, regulators, and businesses across emerging markets.

You will own infrastructure as code, automated CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and site reliability from day one. You will also play an important role in deploying and managing GPU infrastructure for AI workloads, supporting LLM and other AI model deployments, and helping enterprise clients implement Proto's platform within their own on-premise environments.

You will work in a lean, remote-first team where infrastructure improvements, AI deployments, and customer implementations happen in days, not quarters.

What you will do

You will build and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure, GPU environments, and automated release pipelines while supporting enterprise and on-premise deployments.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.
  • Develop, automate, and optimize robust CI/CD deployment pipelines for high availability and zero-downtime releases.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, container orchestration, and microservices deployment across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize GPU infrastructure for AI workloads, including GPU-enabled servers, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and GPU drivers.
  • Support deployment and operation of AI models, LLM inference services, and GPU-accelerated applications.
  • Assist with infrastructure sizing, GPU resource allocation, and performance optimization for AI model serving and inference workloads.
  • Lead and support customer deployments in on-premise and private cloud environments, including restricted or air-gapped networks.
  • Package, configure, and deploy containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose, including Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Work with customer IT and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot deployment issues involving networking, firewalls, proxies, storage, and system dependencies.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems to ensure high service uptime and performance.
  • Drive Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, incident management, and automated failover and recovery processes.
  • Collaborate with development, security, and QA teams to enforce DevSecOps best practices and infrastructure security standards.

Proto | DevOps Engineer

What you bring

You are an infrastructure expert who excels in cloud architecture, automation, system reliability, and deploying production workloads across different environments.

  • 3+ years' professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Deep expertise with cloud providers (AWS), Kubernetes container orchestration, and Docker containers.
  • Proven track record implementing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience managing Linux servers and production infrastructure.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications across cloud, private cloud, or on-premise environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, storage, and application deployment environments.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong scripting abilities in Python and Bash for infrastructure automation and tooling.
  • Expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure, networking, IAM, security groups, VPCs, load balancing, and storage services.
  • Experience managing and tuning relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and cache layers (Redis).
  • Proficiency with monitoring, observability, and log aggregation tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK).
  • Hands-on experience with service mesh, ingress control, and networking fundamentals (DNS, VPN, load balancing, firewalls, and reverse proxies).
  • Familiarity with Linux administration, system performance tuning, and resource management.

Nice to have

None of these is essential, but each will help you hit the ground running.

  • Hands-on experience deploying and managing GPU infrastructure, particularly NVIDIA GPUs (L4, T4, A10, A100, H100, H200, or similar).
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA CUDA, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, GPU drivers, and GPU monitoring tools such as DCGM.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML models and LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM, Ollama, Triton Inference Server, or Hugging Face TGI.
  • Experience with GPU resource scheduling, multi-GPU deployments, and optimizing GPU utilization.
  • Previous experience supporting enterprise on-premise deployments, private cloud environments, or air-gapped infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with Linux GPU server configuration and troubleshooting, including CUDA compatibility and driver management.
  • Experience with VMware, Proxmox, or other virtualization platforms.
  • Understanding of security hardening, network isolation, and deployment requirements for regulated environments.
  • Background in natural language processing or computational linguistics.
  • Previous experience at a SaaS or AI company.
  • Previous experience deploying AI models.
  • Fluency in multiple languages.

Proto | DevOps Engineer

Why Proto

Proto is a Canadian-registered AI communication platform company deploying AI agents for governments, regulators, and private sector organisations across emerging markets. The work is real, the impact is public, and the team is small enough that you will shape what we build.

  • Real-world impact: Your code serves citizens, institutions, and businesses in markets where good technology changes daily life.
  • Ownership: A lean team means broad scope, fast decisions, and visible results.
  • Global reach: Work with clients and colleagues across multiple countries and regions.
  • Growth: Learn from the frontier of applied AI, with room to grow into technical leadership.
  • Remote-first: We have worked remotely since the start, with a tested process for team collaboration that maximises productivity.

About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role

At Hello Heart, we empower people to understand and improve their heart health through technology and behavioral science. As Director, Global Supply Chain, you will own sourcing execution, supplier performance, component lifecycle risk, demand and supply planning, and sales and operations planning for our global electronics supply chain.

Reporting to our Director, Global Supply Management and Logistics, you will be a hands-on individual contributor. You will recommend supply strategies, execute approved plans, negotiate with manufacturers across Asia-Pacific, and partner with Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, Finance, and Operations to balance availability, cost, quality, and working capital.

Responsibilities

  • Source, evaluate, and onboard electronics manufacturers and component suppliers, especially in China, Taiwan, and Vietnam. Lead competitive bids, due diligence, supplier qualification, agreements, and launch readiness.
  • Own supplier performance for cost, quality, delivery, and capacity. Lead quarterly reviews, scorecards, corrective actions, escalations, and recovery plans.
  • Own bill of materials sourcing data, approved sources, pricing, lead times, and lifecycle risks. Coordinate alternate components, last-time buys, and manufacturing transitions with Engineering, Quality, and Regulatory.
  • Monitor factory capacity, yields, and build readiness. Partner with Logistics on shipment planning, fulfillment handoffs, relabeling, and repackaging.
  • Recommend and execute multi-year sourcing plans for supplier diversification, geographic redundancy, capacity, tooling, cost, and continuity.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms using should-cost, bill of materials, and landed-cost analysis. Drive savings, secure required approvals, and protect quality and launch timelines.
  • Manage risks from Asia-Pacific lead times, freight, tariffs, customs, supplier finances, and geopolitical changes. Develop alternatives and inventory or capacity buffers with clear tradeoffs.
  • Manage supplier contracts, purchasing commitments, renewals, approvals, and records with Legal and Finance, including quality agreements, tooling ownership, and inventory liability.
  • Own a rolling 24-month demand and supply plan using client launches, eligible populations, campaigns, conversion, seasonality, and replacements. Model upside and downside scenarios.
  • Translate demand into component, production, capacity, purchasing, inventory, and delivery plans; reconcile supplier commitments, open orders, and in-transit supply.
  • Lead monthly sales and operations planning and weekly execution reviews. Build dashboards for forecast accuracy, supply adherence, inventory health, and supplier performance; drive decisions and follow-through.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of global electronics sourcing, supplier management, and supply planning experience, including negotiations and execution.
  • Direct experience with Asia-Pacific electronics factories, component suppliers, manufacturing lead times, freight, tariffs, customs, and Incoterms; willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally.
  • Expertise in bills of materials, component lifecycle management, supplier qualification, forecasting, inventory, capacity planning, and sales and operations planning.
  • Proven supplier performance improvement, cross-functional influence, cost analysis, and commercial negotiation skills.
  • Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and material requirements planning systems, spreadsheets, financial models, and dashboards.
  • Experience using or customizing AI agents and repeatable workflows for planning, reporting, and supplier follow-up, with output validation and human review.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified in Planning and Inventory Management or Certified Supply Chain Professional certification.
  • Experience with regulated electronics or medical devices, Food and Drug Administration supplier controls, and manufacturing diversification in Mexico.
  • Experience forecasting enrollment-driven demand for employer or health-plan programs.

title: Enterprise Risk Management Lead
excerpt: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe MALPB operates in a complex, fast-moving regulatory environment. The Risk and Compliance team is responsible for ensuring that our expansion is grounded in a bulletproof governance framework that matches the speed of our technology.
Having successfully established our foundational ERM policies, taxonomy, and risk registers, we are entering the integration phase. This team is building the future of "AI-Native" risk management—where governance frameworks are embedded into daily business operations through automated data pipelines and LLM orchestration.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a risk professional who combines strong enterprise risk management (ERM) experience with an analytical mindset and an interest in technology. Grounded in risk, audit, or compliance, you’ll help strengthen risk management across Stripe MALPB by bringing independent judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and clear communication to complex business challenges. ERM expertise is the primary focus, complemented by SQL skills and curiosity about how AI and automation can improve risk and control processes.
We are looking for a rare breed of professional: someone with the executive presence to stand up a banking governance program, combined with the hands-on engineering capabilities to automate it themselves.
As Enterprise Risk Management Lead, you will lead MALPB’s ERM program end-to-end, translating its established framework into consistent practices across the bank. You will provide independent second-line oversight and challenge, deliver clear reporting to management and the Board, and improve how the bank identifies, assesses, monitors, and responds to risk.

Responsibilities

  • Lead risk assessments. Run the annual Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) cycle, providing independent second-line challenge of first-line risk assessments, risk ratings, and control effectiveness.
  • Maintain core risk infrastructure. Maintain the Master Control Library, Central Risk Register, and enterprise risk taxonomy, with effective version control and change management to reflect evolving operations and emerging risks.
  • Monitor risk appetite and remediation. Aggregate, analyze, and validate Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against Board-approved risk appetite thresholds. Escalate breaches, require appropriate Management Action Plans (MAPs), and track remediation.
  • Deliver decision-ready reporting. Combine quantitative risk metrics with qualitative assessments of emerging risks to produce the quarterly Enterprise Risk Scorecard and present clear, actionable insights to the Management Risk Committee and Board of Directors.
  • Apply data-driven analysis. Use basic SQL queries and existing reporting tools to extract and sample data for control verification, partnering with technical teams on more complex analysis, automation, and system integrations.
  • Use AI to improve execution. Explore and apply AI tools to support control monitoring and testing, partnering with technical teams to develop agents that flag potential anomalies or control deficiencies for expert review.
  • Advance continuous monitoring. Progressively supplement point-in-time testing with automated dashboards and ongoing monitoring of key operational and regulatory controls.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise risk management, operational risk, or risk advisory within a regulated financial institution, fintech company, or Big Four technology-risk practice.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and embedding ERM programs—including RCSAs, KRIs, risk registers, and control libraries—within active, fast-paced business operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret large datasets, assess data quality, and translate findings into meaningful risk insights.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write basic queries for data extraction and analysis.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience constructively challenging senior business leaders and preparing concise, Board-level risk reporting.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to learn how to build and apply AI agents to risk management processes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a regulated fintech company, digital bank, or complex global payments processor.
  • Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, such as ServiceNow or Archer, including how their configuration can support a scalable ERM program.

We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with $1.5 B USD in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Job Overview

The Regional Commercial Manager will develop and execute our commercial growth strategy across Latin America, with primary responsibility for growing sales of technical products, packaged equipment and engineered solutions to EPC companies operating within the region.

The role combines direct account leadership and sales execution with responsibility for developing a regional commercial strategy. This strategy will reflect market opportunities, customer feedback, competitive intelligence and our product value propositions, aligned with the company’s market segmentation approach and the strategic direction of Product Directors.

The successful candidate will translate regional opportunities into actionable growth plans, qualified project pipelines and sustainable, profitable sales. Working closely with the Regional Business Line Manager, they will also recommend the market coverage, partnerships and resources needed to strengthen our regional presence.

Responsibilities

Regional Commercial Strategy

  • Lead the development of the Latin America commercial strategy, in collaboration with the Regional Business Line Manager and Product Directors.
  • Prioritise countries, EPC accounts, end-market sectors and product offerings based on market potential, customer requirements, competitive positioning and our ability to deliver.
  • Develop country and account plans with clear objectives, actions, milestones and resource requirements.
  • Use market data and customer feedback to refine product positioning, identify gaps in our offering and recommend opportunities for growth.
  • Evaluate appropriate routes to market, including direct sales, local representatives and strategic partnerships, and recommend the coverage needed to execute the strategy.
  • Translate strategic priorities into regional budget inputs, sales forecasts and pipeline development objectives; adjust plans as market conditions change.

EPC Account Leadership and Business Development

  • Lead commercial relationships with assigned EPC accounts, building engagement across engineering, procurement, project management and executive leadership.
  • Develop existing accounts and secure new relationships with regional EPCs and international contractors delivering projects in Latin America.
  • Identify projects early and position our products during feasibility, front-end engineering and specification development.
  • Understand customer procurement processes, supplier qualification requirements, project schedules and decision-making structures.
  • Build relationships with relevant end users and project stakeholders to support EPC engagement and equipment selection.
  • Coordinate with other regional sales teams on shared accounts and international projects.

Value-Based Selling and Scope Expansion

  • Communicate clear value propositions addressing technical performance, reliability, lifecycle cost, delivery and project execution requirements.
  • Expand individual product opportunities into larger equipment packages by identifying appropriate complementary products, auxiliaries, controls and integration scope.
  • Develop opportunities in adjacent applications using the capabilities of our core products and established technical expertise.
  • Work with Technical Sales, Applications and Product Directors to validate application suitability, define package boundaries and establish competitive positioning.
  • Increase order value and customer penetration while maintaining appropriate margins and disciplined management of scope and risk.

Commercial Execution and Performance

  • Deliver assigned territory sales targets and agreed Management by Objectives (MBOs), covering both sales results and strategic development.
  • Lead opportunity qualification, commercial strategy, proposal follow-up and negotiations within delegated authority.
  • Assess project maturity, funding readiness, purchasing arrangements and competitive position to prioritise opportunities and internal resources.
  • Provide accurate regional sales forecasts and maintain a qualified pipeline aligned with priority markets and product offerings.
  • Maintain current account plans, project information, next actions and opportunity risks in the CRM system.
  • Review performance against targets and implement corrective actions where pipeline coverage, conversion or strategic progress falls behind expectations.
  • Work with relevant internal specialists to address payment terms, currency exposure, logistics and other commercial factors affecting regional competitiveness.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with Technical Sales and Applications teams to develop suitable solutions and timely, competitive proposals.
  • Establish clear opportunity priorities, responsibilities and customer commitments with supporting functions.
  • Maintain commercial leadership and continuity of customer communication throughout technical engagement and proposal development.
  • Provide structured market feedback to Product Directors and Marketing to support positioning, product development and sales tools.

Support effective order handover, ensuring agreed scope, commercial terms and customer expectations are clearly communicated.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of professional qualifications and relevant industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of progressive experience in technical sales, business development or commercial management within industrial equipment, packaged systems or engineered solutions.
  • At least five years in sales management or regional commercial leadership, including developing growth strategies, guiding teams and coordinating resources across functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing country or regional commercial plans, translating market intelligence into measurable business growth.
  • Strong experience selling to EPC companies and managing complex project opportunities within Latin America.
  • A proven record of achieving sales objectives, developing strategic accounts and managing extended sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers.
  • Demonstrated experience expanding core product sales into packaged equipment or broader engineered solutions and developing opportunities in adjacent applications.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin management and contract negotiation.
  • Experience working within an international organisation and influencing technical, product and operational stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English, with willingness to travel regularly throughout Latin America and occasionally internationally.

Desirable

  • MBA or postgraduate qualification in business, leadership or a relevant technical discipline.
  • Experience in industrial gases, LNG, cryogenic equipment or related process industries.
  • Experience developing and managing local representatives, agents or strategic commercial partners.
  • Portuguese language capability, particularly for engagement with the Brazilian market.
  • An established network of EPC and industrial customer relationships within the region.

Personal Attributes

  • A self-motivated commercial leader who combines strategic thinking with active involvement in customer development and sales execution.
  • Effective at working independently, managing time and prioritising opportunities across a geographically dispersed territory.
  • Comfortable building a regional business presence and operating where processes or market coverage are still developing.
  • Collaborative and credible with customers, technical specialists and senior management.
  • Curious, receptive to feedback and willing to adjust strategies as evidence and market conditions evolve.
  • Disciplined in follow-through, commercial judgment and delivering on commitments.

Measures of Success

  • Achievement of territory sales targets and agreed commercial objectives.
  • Development and execution of an approved Latin America commercial strategy.
  • Growth in qualified pipeline and conversion within priority countries, accounts and segments.
  • Increased packaged-equipment sales and successful expansion into adjacent applications.
  • Development of strategic EPC relationships, new accounts and repeat business.
  • Forecast accuracy, CRM discipline and effective use of internal resources.
  • Delivery of agreed MBOs and milestones for regional market development.

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Oncology - UK

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted to high standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. You’ll take ownership of site activities from qualification and initiation through monitoring and close-out, helping sites deliver accurate, timely study data.

Beyond your own sites, you’ll have opportunities to contribute as a Lead CRA on global studies, coordinate and mentor CRAs, support study teams, and provide input into monitoring plans, protocols, CRFs, and study-specific tools.

Your clinical research expertise, sound judgment, and ability to build effective relationships with sites and study teams will help keep studies on track while maintaining compliance with GCP, applicable regulations, protocols, and SOPs.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 6-8 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the UK.


What You'll Do

  • Lead site activities across the study lifecycle, including feasibility, qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, site management, and close-out visits.
  • Monitor protocol adherence, patient safety, informed consent, source documentation, study data, CRFs, and investigational product accountability to support high-quality study delivery.
  • Partner with sites to resolve data queries, maintain Investigator Site Files, complete regulatory and ethics documentation, and provide required documentation for the Trial Master File.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies and work with Project Management to evaluate study deliverables and milestones.
  • Mentor less experienced CRAs and site staff, including conducting accompanied visits, delivering training, and providing guidance on monitoring and site management activities.
  • Review site visit reports and provide clear, constructive feedback while ensuring findings and follow-up activities are appropriately documented.
  • Contribute to Clinical Monitoring Plans, protocols, CRFs, study-specific tools and templates, and process initiatives related to monitoring and site management.
  • Collaborate actively in study team meetings, investigator meetings, and bid defenses while maintaining regular communication with investigative sites.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or Pharmacy degree with at least 3 years of CRA experience; a four-year degree in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or a related science with at least 5 years of CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably nursing or life sciences, with at least 7 years of CRA experience.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Thorough knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, GCP, ICH Guidelines, applicable FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong understanding of two to three therapeutic areas, with the expertise required to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent planning, organization, time management, communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, leadership, and mentoring skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and EDC systems.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, together with fluency in the local language(s) of the countries under responsibility.
  • A valid current passport and driving license.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

excerpt: What You'll Do The Senior Tax Analyst is a key contributor to Avalara’s Premium Managed Returns Service (PRS) offering, where you will provide a high level of service to customers enrolled in the Premium Managed Returns Service.
description:
What You'll Do

The Senior Tax Analyst is a key contributor to Avalara’s Premium Managed Returns Service (PRS) offering, where you will provide a high level of service to customers enrolled in the Premium Managed Returns Service. You will be responsible for identifying areas of improvement as well as serving an elite group of customers with highly complex returns as their primary point of contact. The ideal candidate is highly driven, detail oriented and proficient at balancing multiple priorities. This position directly protects client revenue, mitigates tax exposure, and advances Avalara’s AI-first operational strategy by embedding automation and AI into daily compliance work.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

  • Protects customer revenue through accurate, on-time state and local sales and use tax compliance support.
  • Reduces compliance risk by applying deep jurisdictional expertise and robust variance, exception, and notice management.
  • Increases operational scale by designing and refining Premium Managed Returns Service workflows, data ingestion patterns, and automation that reduce manual effort.
  • Enhances customer trust as a knowledgeable, proactive, senior point of contact for complex portfolios on the PRS product.
  • Raises team capability by mentoring junior analysts and sharing documentation, process improvements, and AI best practices.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Compliance and Filing Operations

  • Prepare, review, and file multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax, business and occupation, and gross receipts tax returns for monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual filing cycles
  • Manage a select portfolio of customer accounts as their dedicated primary point of contact for all returns-related questions and escalations
  • Research and resolve jurisdictional tax notices on behalf of customers with clear, timely, and well-documented communication
  • Perform quality assurance reviews related to sales and use tax content and jurisdiction form changes

Customer and Relationship Management

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customers’ sales and use tax returns questions, setting clear expectations and relaying complex compliance information in an accessible, actionable manner
  • Own the onboarding and validation of new sales and use tax returns customers, ensuring a smooth transition into Avalara’s platform
  • Communicate regularly and effectively with customers, jurisdictions, and internal teams as part of research and resolution workflows
  • Take full ownership of customer satisfaction, demonstrating empathy and proactive responsiveness to customer needs

Process Improvement and Team Enablement

  • Identify, develop, and implement automation improvements to serve customers across a variety of market and tax verticals
  • Identify process and technology gaps and recommend improvements that reduce risk, increase throughput, and improve customer outcomes
  • Assist with implementation, training, and documentation initiatives in support of the broader team
  • Coordinate and lead training for junior-level employees, serving as a knowledge resource for critical troubleshooting and in-cycle risk reduction
  • Apply expert knowledge of jurisdiction websites and taxpayer-facing portals, including data input nuances and system limitations

AI Bar Raiser Expectation

This role is an opportunity to be at the leading edge of Avalara’s AI-first mission within one of our most complex and high-stakes compliance operations. We are looking for someone who goes beyond using AI — someone who brings deeper AI expertise than the current team and actively raises the capability of the people around them. The successful candidate will be a genuine AI Bar Raiser: a practitioner who can demonstrate, teach, and institutionalize AI-enabled ways of working that make the entire PRS team faster, more accurate, and more scalable.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, reconciliations, exception review, and return preparation while maintaining or improving quality.
  • Use AI to draft clear, professional customer and jurisdiction communications, apply judgment and domain expertise before sending.
  • Summarize complex issues, RCAs, and action plans with AI to improve clarity and reduce preparation time for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and implement at least one AI-enabled workflow enhancement (e.g., standardized prompts, variance review patterns, notice response templates) within the first 12 months.
  • Quantify measurable AI impact such as reduced review hours, faster cycle times, or lower notice/rework rates.
  • Apply AI responsibly in alignment with Avalara security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Share AI best practices, examples, and lessons learned to elevate team productivity and capability.

What You'll Need to be Successful

12-Month Success Signals

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex, multijurisdictional customers on PRS with minimal escalation.
  • Achieve consistent 100% on-time filing performance (or agreed SLA targets) for assigned portfolios.
  • Maintain high accuracy with visible reductions in rework, variances, and notices relative to baseline.
  • Implement at least one documented AI-driven workflow or process improvement adopted by the broader team.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of AvaTax, Returns Console, PRS, including data flows and key configuration patterns.
  • Contribute meaningfully to at least one cross-functional initiative (e.g., product feedback loop, automation pilot, training series) with clear, documented outcomes.
  • Recognized by peers and leaders as a “go-to” SME for PRS based compliance in at least one or two critical domains (e.g., specific jurisdictions, firm segment, workflow type).

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field AND a minimum of 5 years of directly related experience in multi-jurisdictional sales and use tax compliance, returns preparation, or tax operations
  • Master’s degree in a relevant field AND a minimum of 3 years of directly related experience may be substituted for the above
    • Note: A degree is required for this role. Work experience alone, without an accompanying degree, does not satisfy the education requirement
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to work through ambiguous compliance scenarios
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tax concepts into clear guidance for accounting professionals and internal stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities to meet strict filing deadlines
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new software applications, platforms, and tools
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with depth in Excel (including Power Pivot, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, and related functions)
  • Must be available and working during US business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Masters) in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance
  • Experience with a Big 4 firm, a large corporate tax department of a multinational company, or a large ERP integration
  • Expert understanding of an Avalara customer’s data flow from AvaTax portal to Returns Console
  • Deep understanding of user platform features related to jurisdiction configuration, including nexus, exemptions, marketplace rules, filing calendars, reporting, and transaction data
  • Working knowledge of transaction flow across the business and the downstream impact on returns preparation and filing
  • Familiarity with returns content areas including transaction tax calculation, transaction data flow, returns mapping, and returns filing automation

Bar Raiser Expectations

Avalara’s strongest hires do not simply fill a role — they raise the level of the team they join. This is an opportunity to bring your expertise, your judgment, and your drive to a group of talented compliance professionals and make them measurably better. The right candidate will leave every process, workflow, customer relationship, and colleague stronger than they found them. We are looking for someone who joins Avalara, makes the team better than it is today, and raises the bar for everyone around them.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer outcomes, deadlines, and quality.
  • Exercise sound judgment in decisions that impact customers, scalability, and risk, using data and AI insights where appropriate.
  • Act as a “go-to” SME for critical PRS compliance functions or customers, leading through influence across teams.
  • Leaves processes, workflows, and documentation stronger than found by identifying issues, proposing solutions, and driving them to completion.
  • Elevate peer performance through mentoring, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and modeling Avalara’s AI-first, customer-obsessed culture.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
