  • Monitor quality metrics and related signals across workflows. Investigate changes, identify underlying causes, and distinguish meaningful performance shifts from noise or limitations in the data.
  • Translate findings into prioritized recommendations and lead feedback loops with BPO partners and internal teams. Track follow-through and assess whether interventions improve decision quality and operational performance.
  • Help shape and operationalize a scalable moderation quality strategy. Balance accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and policy intent when recommending changes to quality processes.
  • Establish quality plans for new product and policy launches, working with stakeholders to clarify standards, review methods, readiness criteria, and escalation paths before launch.
  • Partner with Trust & Safety Product and Engineering to define QA tooling needs, clarify requirements, and evaluate whether tooling changes improve quality workflows and outcomes.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive quality issues clearly to partners and leaders, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and influence action without direct reporting authority.
  • Use AI or automation where appropriate to accelerate analysis and quality work; validate outputs, apply critical judgment, and remain accountable for recommendations and decisions.

  • Experience in Policy, Content Moderation, Content Quality, Content Safety, labeling, or a closely related domain.
  • Strong analytical judgment: able to identify patterns in incomplete or conflicting data, test assumptions, and make sound recommendations.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, manage tradeoffs and escalations, and adapt plans as priorities change.
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, including experience building trust and driving decisions across distributed, cross-functional teams.

title: Superviseur(e), Annotation de données
excerpt: À propos de l’entreprise À Torc, nous avons toujours cru que la technologie des véhicules autonomes transformera la façon dont nous voyageons, transportons la marchandise et faisons des affaires.
description:
À propos de l’entreprise

À Torc, nous avons toujours cru que la technologie des véhicules autonomes transformera la façon dont nous voyageons, transportons la marchandise et faisons des affaires.

Leader de la conduite autonome depuis 2007, Torc a passé plus d’une décennie à commercialiser des solutions aux côtés de partenaires chevronnés. Nous faisons maintenant partie de la famille Daimler, ce qui nous permet de nous concentrer uniquement sur le développement de logiciels pour les camions automatisés. Nous transformerons la façon dont le monde transporte la marchandise.

Joignez-vous à notre équipe : catapultez votre carrière au sein de l’entreprise ayant contribué à créer la technologie de conduite autonome (CA). Nous sommes la première entreprise de logiciels de CA ayant eu la vision de faire équipe directement avec un constructeur de camions.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) superviseur(e), Annotation de données d’expérience pour diriger une équipe d’annotateurs(trices) de données qui contribue au processus d’annotation et d’assurance qualité des données de Torc. Dans ce rôle, vous guiderez une équipe chargée d’étiqueter des informations provenant de différents capteurs (notamment des images et des données LiDAR) afin d’aider à entraîner les systèmes d’IA utilisés dans les camions autonomes, tout en assumant le leadership quotidien de cette équipe.

Vos responsabilités

À titre de superviseur(e), Annotation de données, vous allierez vos connaissances pratiques du travail d’annotation à la gestion directe de personnes. Vous serez le guide de votre unité et vous participerez activement au besoin afin de respecter les échéances et de résoudre les problèmes. Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :

Leadership d’équipe

  • Assurer la supervision directe d’une équipe d’annotateurs(trices) de données
  • Élaborer et gérer les plans opérationnels courants de l’équipe
  • Donner des directives aux membres de l’équipe conformément aux politiques établies et aux orientations de la direction
  • Recommander des changements à l’équipe, à l’unité ou aux politiques et procédures
  • Accompagner les membres de l’équipe et soutenir leur développement de carrière
  • Assumer la gestion du rendement de votre équipe, y compris offrir une rétroaction continue et constructive
  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires pairs et l’équipe People Operations pour l’analyse du rendement et les processus connexes liés aux personnes

Supervision de l’annotation et de la qualité

  • S’assurer que l’équipe annote avec précision des objets dans des environnements 2D et 3D, y compris des boîtes englobantes, des cuboïdes et d’autres formes
  • Superviser la révision des données pré-étiquetées afin de s’assurer qu’elles respectent des lignes directrices détaillées
  • Soutenir l’équipe dans l’acceptation, le rejet ou la correction des annotations, et veiller à ce que des notes claires soient fournies lorsque des corrections sont nécessaires
  • Réagir aux changements de procédure ou aux commentaires issus du processus d’assurance qualité et transmettre les mises à jour à l’équipe
  • Aider l’équipe à apprendre et à maîtriser progressivement les outils d’annotation internes

Profil recherché

  • Expérience antérieure en gestion ou en supervision d’une équipe, idéalement dans un environnement de production, d’opérations de données, d’annotation ou un autre environnement axé sur les processus
  • Grand souci du détail et solide compréhension des flux de travail d’annotation et d’étiquetage
  • Capacité à garder une équipe concentrée et efficace lors de tâches répétitives à haut volume
  • Aisance à soutenir plusieurs projets et à réorganiser les priorités de l’équipe au besoin
  • Autonomie et motivation, avec la capacité de diriger une équipe avec une supervision minimale
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication, tant avec votre équipe qu’avec vos partenaires interfonctionnels
  • Capacité à appliquer les commentaires reçus et à favoriser l’amélioration continue des compétences et des méthodes de travail de l’équipe

La connaissance de l’anglais est exigée puisque la personne retenue devra collaborer de façon journalière avec des collègues anglophones aux États-Unis et travailler avec la documentation technique rédigée uniquement en anglais.

Notes supplémentaires sur le poste

Déplacements, formation et sécurité

  • Nécessite de se déplacer vers des lieux à l’extérieur du site; un permis de conduire américain valide et un dossier de conduite sécuritaire sont exigés
  • Peut devoir se déplacer à l’occasion vers d’autres sites; possibilité de déplacements à l’international, ce qui exige de pouvoir obtenir un passeport et les documents appropriés
  • Nécessite l’équipement de protection individuelle (EPI) approprié dans les zones désignées
  • Nécessite une formation technique continue afin de maintenir le plus haut niveau de connaissances dans le domaine

Exigences physiques

  • Capacité de faire preuve de souplesse et volonté de faire occasionnellement des heures supplémentaires
  • Capacité de travailler et de collaborer entre plusieurs sites et fuseaux horaires
  • Exposition occasionnelle aux conditions météorologiques extérieures

Avantages d’être un(e) employé(e) à temps plein chez Torc (Canada)

Torc se soucie de ses membres d’équipe et s’efforce d’offrir des avantages et des ressources pour soutenir leur santé, leur équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, ainsi que leur avenir. Notre culture est collaborative, dynamique et axée sur le travail d’équipe. Torc offre :

  • Une rémunération concurrentielle qui comprend une composante de prime et des options d’achat d’actions
  • Assurance médicale, dentaire et de soins de la vue pour les employés(es) à temps plein
  • Régime d’épargne-retraite (REER) avec contribution de l’employeur équivalente à 4 %
  • Subvention pour le transport en commun (région de Montréal seulement)
  • Horaire flexible et vacances payées généreuses
  • Fermetures de bureaux à l’échelle de l’entreprise pendant les jours fériés
  • Assurance vie

À Torc, nous nous engageons à cultiver un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous célébrons l’unicité de chaque membre de l’équipe de Torc. Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination par rapport à l’origine ethnique, la religion, la couleur de peau, la nationalité, le genre (y compris la grossesse, les enfants ou autre condition médicale), l’orientation sexuelle, l’identité de genre, l’expression de genre, l’âge, le statut de vétéran ou les handicaps.

Même si vous ne répondez pas à 100 % des qualifications énumérées pour ce poste, nous vous invitons à postuler.

Notre rémunération reflète le coût de la main-d’œuvre sur plusieurs marchés géographiques. Le salaire est déterminé en fonction d’un certain nombre de facteurs et peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l’expérience liées au poste. La rémunération globale de Torc comprendra également notre régime de primes corporatives et d’options d’achat d’actions. Selon le poste offert, des primes à la signature, une aide à la réinstallation et d’autres formes de rémunération pourraient être offertes dans le cadre d’un ensemble de rémunération globale, en plus d’une gamme complète d’avantages médicaux, financiers ou autres.

$62,300CAD - $74,800CAD

excerpt: What will the role involve?  • Lead Newsdesk Operations: Take a primary leadership role on the GloucestershireLive and SomersetLive newsdesks, shaping operations, processes, workflows, brand values, and content, while supporting BristolLive with content editing and leadership duties as required.
description:
What will the role involve?

  • Lead Newsdesk Operations: Take a primary leadership role on the GloucestershireLive and SomersetLive newsdesks, shaping operations, processes, workflows, brand values, and content, while supporting BristolLive with content editing and leadership duties as required.
  • Drive Audience & Subscription Growth: Partner with the Head of Brand (South West) and senior colleagues to achieve consistent, sustainable growth in key metrics—specifically building secure, loyal audiences and accelerating our subscription model.
  • Content Creation & Senior Editing: Publish and edit accurate, legally sound (IPSO-compliant) content at pace across homepages, social media, and newsletters, ensuring Reach digital publishing standards are met at all times.
  • People Management & Culture: Mentor and develop news reporters and Local Democracy Reporters (LDRs), setting clear expectations, celebrating success, and fostering an inclusive culture of trust and safety (including support for the Belonging Project).
  • Agile & Flexible Leadership: Work collaboratively across South West teams (Breaking News, Video, Engagement, Sport, and fellow site editors) and take on breaking news and antisocial early, late, or weekend shifts where required.

This role is a remote role however you will have access to our Bristol Hub 5 days a week. Candidates based in the South West would be preferrable.

Who are we looking for?

  • Experienced Editor or Rising Senior Reporter: A senior or experienced content editor with a track record of acting up into leadership roles, or a senior reporter with a strong record of standard-setting journalism ready to take the next career step.
  • Strategic & Digital Savvy: Possess strong digital publishing, video creation/editing, and social media skills, backed by experience in audience strategy, brand identity, and customer value strategy.
  • Agenda-Setter: A proven track record of leading forward planning, campaigns, and agenda-setting local journalism, supported by strong local knowledge.
  • Inclusive & Collaborative People Manager: Strong people management, delegation, decision-making, and communication skills, with a demonstrable commitment to furthering inclusivity in the newsroom.
  • Core Behaviours: Demonstrable collaboration, determination, imagination, and a relentless focus on our readers.

How we'll look after you

We take good care of our people - and that means more than just a pay packet. Whatever your role, you'll get a range of benefits, including:

  • 25 days' holiday (plus bank holidays), as well as an extra day after you've been with us for three, five and 10 years. We also have a scheme to help you buy extra holiday if you want to.
  • An extra day's paid leave each year to volunteer for a cause close to your community or your heart.
  • Big moment day - an extra day’s paid leave for a moment that matters to you - like getting married, moving house or welcoming a new addition to the family (human or furry!)
  • Help saving for your retirement - we'll match your company pension contributions up to 6% and you can contribute through salary sacrifice.
  • Supportive and progressive people policies - we’re proud to have a range of policies to support people in their lives in and outside work, including enhanced family leave and policies to promote flexibility, inclusion and progression. We believe you shouldn’t have to wait to join us to know what to expect from us, which is why we share this overview of the policies we have in place to support families and carers. If there's something you want to understand more about, just ask - it won’t make a difference to your application.
  • A healthcare cash plan - giving you money back for a range of medical expenses and fast access to doctor's appointments.
  • Car lease scheme - you can buy a brand new electric or hybrid car through our leasing partner, and pay for it through salary sacrifice.
  • Wellbeing support - including a 24/7 assistance programme for you and your family.
  • Financial Wellbeing – Access Stream, our app for managing your finances, pay, rewards and benefits all in one place
  • Access to lots of discounts - including 15% off with Reach's very own online marketplace, Yimbly, where you can buy everything from homewares to beauty products.
  • Interest-free loans - including for season tickets and technology.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t tick every single box, please don’t let that stop you from applying.

We know that everyone has their own story to tell, and we value potential, passion and the perspectives that different backgrounds bring to our work.

Diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us better serve our audiences, which is why we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and supported. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair and welcoming to all, without discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are looking for an Digital Editor to join us at GloucestershireLive & SomersetLive on a 6 month fixed term contract to cover a Family Leave.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced content editor or an ambitious senior reporter with a strong track record of standard-setting journalism to step into a pivotal leadership role managing the day-to-day operations of our GloucestershireLive and SomersetLive brand teams, while working closely with and supporting our flagship BristolLive newsdesk.

You will play a leading role in shaping brand values, workflows, people and content across both titles. Your goal is to deliver agile, high-impact journalism that informs, inspires, indulges and empowers our readers in their local lives, with a primary focus on accelerating the growth of our subscription model alongside our wider monthly audience targets.

About us

Hello, we’re Reach. Every day, our trusted news, stories and content connect with millions of people where they live - whether that’s on their social feed or at their neighbourhood newsstand; through their local community or their take on the hot topic of the day.

We're home to more than 120 trusted brands - from household names like the Mirror, Express, Daily Star and Daily Record, to local titles like MyLondon, BelfastLive, and the Manchester Evening News, and brands making a splash in the US like the Irish Star.

It's our ability to understand people and the things that matter to them that makes us the UK and Ireland's largest commercial news publisher. We reach 70% of the UK's online population and speak to over 100 million social followers around the world. And we’re just getting started…

Your story, with Reach

As a modern media organisation, we're much more than just news. And it takes a wide range of people and skills to serve diverse audiences, customers and communities like we do.

We know everyone has their own story to tell, so we’ve built an environment where every background is respected and every day is a day to explore.

We’ll help you build a career that works with your life, while giving you the space to create and grow.

title: Sr. People Business Partner
excerpt: About Engine Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel.
description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the role

Engine is growing fast, and our go-to-market teams are where that growth shows up first. As Senior People Business Partner for GTM, you'll be the strategic partner to the leaders who run Sales, Account Management and Customer Success, and Partnerships. You'll shape how we hire, ramp, organize, and keep revenue talent. You'll help leaders build a high-performance culture: keeping the bar clear and high, building talent density, and leading teams through fast, constant change.

You'll also work differently from most HR teams. At Engine, People Business Partners run AI agents for routine work, so your time goes to the problems that move the business.

Why this role is different

  • AI is how the work gets done. Agents handle routine requests, reporting, and first drafts. You own the judgment and the outcome.
  • Human-led strategy. We use AI for routine work and save our strategic skills for what matters most: leadership coaching, org design, and professional development. The business owns its goals; we partner with leaders to hit them.
  • High performance is the standard. We build for talent density: the strongest possible team in every seat, a clear and high bar, and fast action when it isn't met.
  • Change is constant. Segments, territories, and teams shift fast. You'll help leaders move through it with clear plans and clear communication.
  • Real scope. You'll partner with senior GTM leaders and help shape how a high-growth revenue organization scales.

What you'll do

Org design and change leadership

  • Partner with GTM leaders to turn revenue goals into people plans: headcount, org structure, spans and layers, and segment or territory changes.
  • Spot talent trends across the GTM organization and shape org plans that put strong talent in critical roles ahead of growth.
  • Lead organizational change in a fast-moving business, such as sales reorgs, new segments, territory shifts, or integrations, from design through communication and adoption.
  • Prepare leaders to communicate change clearly, anticipate reactions, and keep teams performing through transitions.

High performance and talent density

  • Help GTM leaders set clear, high performance expectations and hold them consistently, including direct feedback and timely action on underperformance.
  • Run talent reviews, calibration, and succession planning for GTM, focused on keeping top performers and building talent density.
  • Make sure talent decisions (promotions, ratings, exits) reflect a consistent, high bar across GTM teams.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and People Enablement to raise the hiring bar for quota-carrying roles and shorten onboarding and ramp.

Data and compensation insight

  • Turn people data into clear recommendations for senior GTM leaders on performance, talent density, regretted attrition, ramp, productivity, and engagement.
  • Partner with Compensation and Sales Operations on incentive plan design, quota-related people issues, and compensation cycles.

AI and workforce systems

  • Run AI agents end to end for routine PBP work in your client group, covering accuracy, governance, adoption, and retirement.
  • Design AI-enabled workflows that fit GTM priorities, and check agent analysis before it reaches leaders.
  • Help GTM leaders adopt people agents that change how they manage their teams.

Employee relations and compliance

  • Handle complex employee relations matters with fairness and sound judgment, and advise leaders on systemic trends.
  • Translate legal and policy requirements into practical guidance for GTM teams, partnering with Legal as needed.
  • Lead core People programs for GTM, including performance reviews, compensation cycles, and engagement.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of progressive HR or People Business Partner experience, including at least 3 years supporting go-to-market teams (Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or Partnerships) in a high-growth company.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders, including C-suite, and influencing without direct authority.
  • A strong grasp of GTM operating models: quotas, territories, incentive compensation, ramp, and sales productivity.
  • Proven org design and workforce planning experience.
  • Change leadership in a fast-paced business. You've led reorgs or rapid scaling and kept teams performing through it.
  • A track record of raising the bar. You've coached leaders to set clear expectations, act on underperformance, and build talent density.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You've built or run AI tools or agents in your own work and can explain where they fall short.
  • Strong data skills. You build the analysis and turn it into a clear recommendation.
  • Sound judgment on employee relations and compliance.
  • Experience in tech, SaaS, travel, or marketplace businesses is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. HR certification (such as SHRM-CP or PHR) is a plus.

  • Scheduling and calendar management

The Scrum Master is an experienced Agile delivery professional responsible for enabling cross-functional teams to deliver business and technology outcomes effectively and predictably. This role facilitates Agile practices, removes delivery impediments, strengthens team operating practices, and partners with Product Owners and technology leaders to improve planning, execution, transparency, and continuous improvement. The Scrum Master serves as a facilitator and delivery leader rather than an administrative coordinator.

Remote hires will be required to travel to our headquarters in Ankeny, IA (company paid) on their first 1-3 days for orientation.

Salary Range: $106,200-118,000 plus 10% bonus

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

-PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
  • Partner with Product Owners to support effective backlog management, prioritization, and readiness
  • Help teams establish realistic sprint commitments based on priorities, dependencies, and available capacity
  • Monitor delivery progress and identify risks or impediments that may affect commitments
  • Facilitate resolution of cross-team dependencies and delivery blockers
  • Coach teams in Agile and Scrum practices and strengthen team ownership and accountability
  • Identify opportunities to improve team processes, collaboration, and delivery predictability
  • Facilitate retrospectives that result in meaningful, measurable improvements
  • Help teams balance delivery commitments with sustainable capacity
  • Promote transparency and constructive communication across Product, Technology, Quality Assurance, and business partners
  • Maintain visibility into sprint goals, commitments, dependencies, risks, and delivery forecasts
  • Use delivery data and Agile metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement
  • Partner with Project and Program Managers when initiatives span multiple teams or require broader program coordination
  • Surface delivery risks early and facilitate appropriate escalation and resolution
  • Support coordination across multiple Scrum teams when initiatives have shared dependencies
  • Coach Product Owners, team members, and stakeholders on effective Agile ways of working
  • Identify recurring systemic impediments and partner with leadership to address them
  • Encourage experimentation and continuous improvement based on measurable outcomes

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Agile delivery, Scrum Master, technology delivery, or related roles
  • 3+ years serving as a Scrum Master for software or technology teams
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating complex, cross-functional delivery
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile principles, backlog management, estimation, capacity planning, and iterative software delivery
  • Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira
  • Strong facilitation, conflict-resolution, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to work effectively with Product Owners, engineers, quality assurance professionals, architects, project managers, and business stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or comparable Agile certification
  • Experience supporting multiple teams or complex enterprise technology initiatives
  • Experience operating in organizations using a combination of Agile, product, and project-delivery methodologies
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Dynamics365 or MuleSoft technologies

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Job Title: Account Partner - Safety

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Account Partner for Safety, you will lead the strategic expansion and adoption of our Safety solutions across our largest and most critical global pharmaceutical accounts. In this role, you will be responsible for generating opportunities, winning new business, and driving the digital transformation of pharmacovigilance operations through complex enterprise sales cycles. Serving as the dedicated executive relationship owner, you will cultivate deep C-suite relationships, collaborate with internal strategy teams and account leads to maximize value, and help organizations modernize their operations through innovative cloud technology.

What You'll Do

    • Lead Strategic Account Growth: Map out and execute long-term Veeva Safety adoption strategies across top global pharmaceutical strategic accounts
    • Drive Revenue & ACV: Meet and exceed pipeline generation, contract expansion, and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for assigned enterprise accounts
    • Orchestrate Complex Sales Cycles: Manage end-to-end, complex enterprise sales cycles, orchestrating internal and external cross-functional resources to deliver tailored customer solutions
    • Cultivate Executive Relationships: Establish and lead an ongoing communication cadence with C-suite leaders and key decision-makers to position Veeva as a long-term strategic partner
    • Collaborate Internally: Partner collaboratively with Safety Strategy and Dev Cloud Account Partners to drive a unified, matrixed account management strategy
    • Provide Industry Thought Leadership: Stay current on pharmacovigilance (PV) and life sciences industry trends, proactively engaging customers to solve complex operational and regulatory challenges
    • Champion Customer Success: Act with urgency, integrity, and a relentless focus on customer success

Requirements

    • 10+ years of combined experience across enterprise sales, strategic account management, and consulting services
    • 3+ years of dedicated account management managing global Fortune 500 accounts, maintaining long-term ownership of executive relationships
    • Life Sciences software background, including consultative sales experience within enterprise software/SaaS or management consulting
    • Proven executive presence, with a track record of cultivating and influencing C-level relationships across multiple business and IT functions
    • Strong commercial negotiation skills, with demonstrated success closing complex, multi-million dollar enterprise contracts
    • High autonomy and drive, with the self-motivation to execute strategic account plans with minimal direct supervision
    • Excellent communication skills, including top-tier written, verbal, interpersonal, and executive presentation capabilities; fluency in English is required

Nice to Have

    • Safety Domain Expertise: Experience selling Pharmacovigilance (PV) software solutions or hands-on familiarity with industry safety databases
    • Community Engagement: Experience building, owning, and leading customer community forums, executive roundtables, or industry events
    • Matrix Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to navigate and collaborate effectively within a complex, global matrix organization
    • Language Skills: Professional working proficiency or fluency in German

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
#RemoteUK

description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for a Researcher to join the Property Tax Content team, focusing on researching and maintaining property tax jurisdiction, assessor, collector, and depreciation content, and supporting the team's shift toward AI-enabled compliance research. This role involves developing foundational property tax research expertise, strong attention to detail, and contributing to the accuracy and reliability of the content that powers the team's AI-enabled workflows.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Research, monitor, translate, and interpret assessor and collector notices, depreciation schedule updates, and jurisdiction rule changes; evaluate content accuracy and make sound decisions on property tax content updates and actions.
  • Maintain existing assessor master data, collector addresses, depreciation tables, forms, and filing deadlines for assigned jurisdictions by continuously monitoring changes at the state and local level.
  • Contact assessing and collecting jurisdictions and authorities directly to source forms, deadlines, and compliance requirements.
  • Document research findings clearly and consistently in required formats and tools.
  • Conduct web and subscription-service research and stay active on property tax and local government news to catch emerging changes early.
  • Help build and test simple, repeatable AI-enabled research workflows — such as structured prompts, checklists, or validation steps — that turn property tax content into reliable training material for Avalara's AI research agents.
  • Validate AI-generated property tax content against primary assessor and collector sources, and flag inaccuracies or content gaps for senior researchers to resolve.
  • Share reusable research templates, prompts, or workflows with the team so improvements you make benefit others, not just your own research.
  • Work and communicate effectively with team members to accomplish tasks in a timely, efficient, and productive manner.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required

  • Graduation (bachelor’s degree) plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.
  • Excellent logical and analytical skills.
  • Strong English writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment.
  • Demonstrated aptitude or hands-on experience using AI tools to build simple, repeatable research workflows (e.g., structured prompts, checklists, templates), with the ability to explain what you built and how it works.

Preferred

  • Background or coursework in accounting, finance, real estate, or a related field.
  • Prior exposure to property tax, assessment, valuation, or real estate compliance research.
  • Experience building or contributing to an AI-enabled research or validation workflow that was adopted by others on a team.
  • Familiarity with how large language models or AI research agents use source content, and comfort translating research judgment into structured, reusable formats.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

OVERVIEW

The Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technical leader within the organization. The role owns the technical sales strategy, evaluation approach, and architectural direction for a focused set of the company's largest and most complex customers. Operating at the intersection of cloud native platforms, business outcomes, and executive decision making, the CNA guides customers through discovery, validation, and financial justification. Each engagement is expected to result in a clear technical win and a credible path to company wide adoption, positioning Everpure's product portfolio as a standard platform for cloud native data management. This is a senior individual contributor role within pre-sales, centered on influence, quality of execution, and long-term outcomes rather than transactional activity.

description:
About Emplicit

Emplicit is a results-driven ecommerce agency that combines omnichannel marketing with marketplace management. We partner with consumer brands to grow sales across Amazon (US, CA, UK, EU) and marketplaces such as TikTok Shop, Walmart, and Target. We build strategy, run media, optimize catalogs and content, and deploy advanced reporting and automation to drive measurable ecommerce outcomes.

Role Summary

We're not looking for a relationship babysitter. We're looking for a commercially-minded strategist who understands the Amazon ecosystem, thinks like a Business Director, and isn't afraid to challenge a client's C-suite when the strategy needs to change.

You'll own a portfolio of 18–25 brands — the majority selling on Amazon, with some on Walmart and TikTok Shop. Your job is to retain them, grow them, and turn them into Emplicit advocates. You will be backed by a dedicated, cross-functional pod of Marketing Managers and Coordinators to ensure you can stay focused on high-level strategy, not day-to-day data entry.

That means real relationships. C-suite trust. Proactive conversations before problems surface. Upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch. And the commercial instincts to know when to push and when to listen. AI gives you an edge — but the calls, the trust, and the revenue are yours to win.

Reports to the Director of Client Success & Partnerships.

Remote - US Time Zones

What you’ll own

Client Relationships & Retention

  • Own a portfolio of 18–25 high-growth Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop brands—retaining them, scaling them, and turning them into brand advocates.
  • Build genuine C-suite relationships across every account — the kind of trust that makes clients call you first
  • Multi-thread across 3–5 stakeholders per client — Champion, Decision Maker, Influencer
  • Proactively identify and address churn risk before it becomes a conversation you didn't see coming
  • Convert satisfied clients into public advocates — targeting one case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Revenue & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and close upsell opportunities across your full portfolio — upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch
  • Build Scopes of Work (SOWs) and business cases for service expansions
  • Shift client perception from "cost" to "investment" through data-backed ROI storytelling
  • Own P&L and revenue forecasting for your accounts
  • Lead onboarding for 2+ new brands per month, from handoff through go-live

Strategy & Internal Leadership

  • Run forward-looking QBRs that drive strategy, not just recap performance
  • Challenge client assumptions with a Challenger mindset — prescribe strategic pivots even when it's a hard conversation
  • Direct Marketing Managers and Project Coordinators toward unified client goals — you set the mission, they execute the tactics
  • Orchestrate the onboarding journey for incoming brands, partnering closely with Project Coordinators to build a flawless operational foundation and establish immediate authority with the client.
  • Serve as the ultimate Pod Leader for the cross-functional team assigned to your accounts. You don't just run weekly meetings and monthly reviews; you own the pod's cultural and operational alignment, actively surfacing team-identified upsell leads and transforming them into a healthy pipeline.
  • Partner with our ops team to help shape the AI and automation tools that make this role scalable — from churn-risk flagging to proposal workflows

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Stakeholder roadmaps and Joint Success Plans underway for your full portfolio

● 2+ new brands onboarded per month

  • First upsell opportunities identified and in active proposal stage
  • Genuine relationships established with C-suite contacts at every account

Ongoing KPIs

  • 95%+ client satisfaction across your portfolio
  • 5+ upsell opportunities presented monthly; 2–3 closed per month.

● 2–3 new SOWs completed per month

  • Active multi-threaded relationships across 100% of accounts
  • One public case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Must have

  • You possess high emotional intelligence and excel at turning tense client situations into wins. You don't just manage accounts; you build indispensable strategic partnerships, resulting in industry-leading client retention and advocacy.
  • Amazon fluency: Seller Central, TACoS, BSR, Buy Box — you understand the deep cause-and-effect relationship between these marketplace levers and your client’s bottom line. You are "fluent" because you know how to manipulate these elements to protect client margins, prevent costly listing disruptions, optimize ad spend against total profitability, and strategically scale their market share.
  • You have a proven history of spotting untapped revenue within existing portfolios. You know how to align a client's business goals with our additional services, seamlessly introducing upsells and cross-sells that drive mutual growth.
  • You act as a trusted consultant, not an order-taker. You are comfortable challenging a client’s assumptions, steering them away from poor marketplace strategies, and backing up your recommendations with hard data and industry insights.
  • You operate like the CEO of your book of business. You focus on lagging indicators like net revenue retention (NRR) and portfolio profitability, proactively identifying risks and pivot strategies before they affect the bottom line.
  • You can distill complex Amazon data into clear, high-level narratives for executive stakeholders. Whether you are drafting a watertight SOW or commanding a boardroom QBR, your delivery is polished and persuasive. Crucially, you possess a sharp commercial lens and act as the strategic bridge between the client and our internal delivery teams—masterfully delegating and guiding internal resources to champion the client’s goals while aggressively driving our company’s bottom line.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Walmart Connect or TikTok Shop advertising
  • Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Intentwise, or Merchant Springs
  • HubSpot power user — CRM hygiene, pipeline management, automations
  • Prior agency experience — you understand the pace and P&L realities

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI productivity tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) beyond basic chat functions. Ideally, you have experience building custom agents, automating workflows, or managing AI-driven projects—or you possess a fierce curiosity to learn how.
  • Experience helping build internal processes, playbooks, or automation workflows from scratch

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus tied to upsell revenue you generate

● Healthcare (medical/dental/vision)

● 401k with employer match

● Remote, flexible PTO

  • Budget for training & professional development
Salary: $85,000 – $95,000 / year

  • Shape the “what and why” of product decisions, not only the “how.”
  • Work with ambiguous problem spaces and help turn them into clear, actionable direction.

Design Systems and Foundations

  • Partner with design system manager to evolve, and govern shared foundations, aligning on standards where systems overlap and making deliberate decisions where they diverge across Enverus products.
  • Establish patterns, components, and principles that scale across squads and reduce inconsistency.
  • Operate across squads to ensure coherence, quality, and long-term scalability of the product experience.
  • Read and write front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React) well enough to prototype in production-like conditions, review implementation details, and collaborate closely with Engineering on how the system is built and maintained.

Leading Through Ambiguity

  • Bring structure to a complex, evolving organization: create clarity where little exists today, without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Design ways of working that fit both agile product teams and the more waterfall-style processes that exist across the business.
  • Lead large initiatives that span multiple product areas or systems.

Craft and Quality

  • Set design standards and lead critiques and design reviews across teams.
  • Simplify complex workflows, particularly in data-heavy and domain-specific products.
  • Raise the bar on craft, from interaction details to information architecture to visual systems.

Influence and Communication

  • Frame design vision in business and user terms, and make the case for it to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Align multiple teams around a shared direction, and facilitate discussions that lead to clear decisions.
  • Tell compelling stories with research, prototypes, and data to build conviction.

Mentorship and Capability Building

  • Mentor designers across teams and help grow the design practice from the ground up.
  • Influence design decisions beyond the design team, across the wider Enverus organization.
  • Help build the culture, processes, and habits that a design-led organization needs.

Working with AI

  • Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.
  • Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.
  • Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.
  • Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • At least 3 years of experience in a staff, senior, or equivalent product design role, with demonstrated ownership of complex work.
  • Strong, mature product design craft across interaction, visual, and systems design.
  • Working knowledge of front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React), enough to collaborate effectively with engineers on design system implementation and product delivery.
  • Experience working in agile product environments, and comfort working within waterfall processes where they exist.
  • Proven ability to establish structure and build systems within an organization that lacks formal processes.
  • Comfort working across multiple design systems or product-specific component libraries.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • High autonomy: you make design decisions, push back when needed, and manage trade-offs without needing detailed oversight.
  • Hands-on curiosity about AI tools and a practical sense of how they can change design and development work.

Preferred

  • Experience building or scaling a design system.
  • Experience designing for complex, data-intensive, or B2B domain products.
  • Experience introducing design practice or process into a company that is early in its design maturity.
  • Experience mentoring designers or leading design reviews across teams.
  • Experience using AI tools in a design or prototyping workflow, and a point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

description:
EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. As an AI-enabled service leader, we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO, we’re driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Product Manager will partner with a cross-functional team to bring the EBSCOhost AI Companion functionality to market, with a specific focus on Linked Data functionality powered by the EBSCO Scholarly Graph (ESG). The EBSCOhost AI Companion is a suite of research workflows that help users discover, understand, and engage with research content through natural-language conversational interactions – all powered by AI and Linked Data. Answers / responses are grounded in authoritative EBSCOhost content and include references and links, with further enrichment through industry data services. You will help develop and bring to market solutions for direct use by library users and researchers of all varieties. The Product Manager will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Technology and other departments.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute go-to-market efforts for EBSCOhost AI Companion features, especially those powered by Linked Data from EBSCO Scholarly Graph

  • Collaborate with Technical teams to communicate market needs and feedback

  • Facilitate meetings with library customers and publisher partners, to discuss EBSCOhost AI Companion Linked Data features and benefits, and conduct Beta testing programs with customers and end-users.

  • Define metrics, measure, and assess the impact of AI Companion’s Linked Data functionality post-launch.

  • Build and deliver stakeholder updates

  • Drive business requirements for future roadmap items

Your Team

This role reports to a Vice President of Product Management and works closely with teams across Product Management, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Satisfaction. The Product Management team is comprised of 30+ Product Managers who represent different platform and functionality level initiatives. The team is customer-facing and drives business requirements across the EBSCOhost suite of products and services.

About You

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience
  • Must have experience working closely with customers
  • Comfortable presenting internally and externally, including in stakeholder forums
  • Experience working with Linked Data, knowledge graphs, and library data providers
  • Ability to work collaboratively across the organization with various teams

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience working specifically with Scopus, ORCID, CrossRef, and OpenAlex
  • Understanding of the library industry and how libraries leverage EBSCO products
  • Strength in building a go to market plan from the ground up
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to build credibility with team members and stakeholders.

Pay Range

USD $108,610.00 - USD $155,155.00 /Yr.

description:
We Are:

Accenture LearnVantage helps organizations transform how their people learn and work. We partner with enterprise clients to design and deliver high-quality, scalable, outcome-driven learning that builds the skills their workforces need. Udacity, now part of Accenture LearnVantage, brings deep expertise in technical upskilling through hands-on, project-based online learning. Together we build learning experiences that help people gain in-demand skills in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and more.


You Are:

You are analytical, curious, and highly attentive to detail. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, but you do not guess when the evidence is not there. You like finding the connection between things that may not obviously fit together, and you have the judgment to recognize when something does not align or needs a closer look. You work well within established standards and methods while knowing when to ask questions, challenge assumptions, or raise a risk. You are someone others can rely on for thoughtful, accurate work in a specialized and evolving industry.


The Work:

The Credentialing & Assessments team within Learning Experience connects business and workforce needs with practical solutions for validating skills, knowledge, and experience. As a Credentialing & Assessments Sr Analyst, you will help translate those needs into approaches that are credible, feasible, and aligned to industry practices. Working across internal initiatives and client delivery, you will provide support needed to shape solutions, inform decisions, and move credentialing and assessment work from concept through delivery.

  • Support job task analysis, job analysis, and competency analysis activities by gathering, organizing, mapping, and documenting role and skill requirements.
  • Develop and maintain rubrics and structured evaluation frameworks used to evaluate skills, performance, evidence, work products, or other defined criteria.
  • Conduct alignment mapping and crosswalks across competencies, skills, tasks, learning and assessment objectives, credential requirements, and learning content to established methodologies.
  • Conduct mapping audits and gap analyses to identify missing, insufficient, duplicated, or misaligned coverage across learning, assessment, skills, or credential requirements.
  • Support credential and assessment development activities, including blueprinting, documentation, quality review, validation activities, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Research and analyze credentialing requirements, partner requirements, credential applicability, and alignment to learning and workforce needs.

  • In this role, you will work in the Credentialing & Assessment team and report into a Credentialing & Assessment Associate Manager. This position is US remote.

  • You will expand your credentialing and assessment experience across a wide range of business, workforce, and client needs.

description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. In this role, you will become part of a small, senior product engineering team for an established US mental health platform where clients book licensed psychologists and psychotherapists, complete with US insurance integrations and subscription billing. You will take full end-to-end ownership of product features—from frontend architecture to backend services and cloud deployment—leveraging a modern stack based on React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Delivery: Design, implement, and deploy robust full-stack features from initial concept through production rollout
  • Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture, including component libraries, design systems, state management, and clear module boundaries for the engineering team
  • Backend & API Development: Build and maintain scalable backend services and APIs (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC), covering authentication, RBAC, billing workflows, and audit logging
  • Code Quality & Testing: Write clean, secure, and maintainable code; establish and drive a risk-based testing strategy with strong end-to-end test coverage
  • Internal Tooling & AI Adoption: Develop internal productivity tooling (CLIs, agent-based workflows) and proactively utilize AI coding tools as force multipliers
  • Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, champion engineering best practices, and mentor teammates in adopting modern standards
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, UX/UI design, and executive leadership to shape the roadmap and guide core UX decisions

Requirements:

  • Experience: 6+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling SaaS products as a Full Stack Engineer
  • Communication: Upper-Intermediate to Advanced (Fluent) English proficiency, both written and spoken
  • Software Design & Architecture:
    • Demonstrated experience designing solutions for complex features and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation
    • Deep understanding of API architectural styles (monolith, microservices, serverless), design patterns, and engineering standards
    • Hands-on experience defining frontend architecture (design systems, shared component libraries) utilized by multiple developers
    • Proven ownership of critical product domains from discovery to launch (e.g., onboarding, billing, access control)
  • Software Development:
    • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and advanced React patterns
    • Solid background in Node.js or Python building high-performance backend services; willingness and ability to work primarily in a Python / FastAPI codebase
    • Strong relational database skills in PostgreSQL (data modeling, schema design, complex queries, and aggregations)
    • Practical commercial experience with distributed systems and event-driven patterns using message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.)
  • Quality Assurance:
    • Hands-on experience with modern testing frameworks across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest)
    • Ability to define, track, and maintain code quality metrics; familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools
  • DevOps & Cloud Deployment:
    • Practical knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
    • Experience deploying, configuring, and operating backend services on a public cloud (GCP or AWS)
  • Ways of Working:
    • High degree of autonomy and seniority: ability to lead a problem space independently, balance technical trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    • Availability for a 3–4 hour daily working overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) for key ceremonies, planning, and stand-ups

Desirable:

  • Prior experience as a Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, or core team member at an early-stage or growth-stage product company
  • Domain knowledge in HealthTech / Digital Health (HIPAA compliance, health insurance workflows) or FinTech / Payments
  • Production experience with Stripe billing, subscription life-cycles, and payment processing
  • Familiarity with Micro-frontends, Next.js, React Native, or Expo
  • Hands-on experience with Go, Elixir / Phoenix, or gRPC
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / GKE)
  • Experience developing MCP servers, CLI developer tools, or LLM-assisted internal automations
  • Active involvement in hiring, conducting technical interviews, and mentoring junior/middle engineers
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

You will be executing on our inbound/outbound sales motion that supports the hyper-growth & scale of the Sales team at Megaport. In this role, you will have the chance to implement creative processes along the way & shape the world-class processes we are implementing.

Your priority is to respond to our prospects, qualify if Megaport is a suitable solution, and generate new meetings and opportunities from inbound marketing qualified leads and outbound prospecting campaigns.

Who You'll Work With

As a member of this team, you will report to our Sales Development Manager in our GTM Transformation team. You will support the Sales organization and partner with the team closely to execute a winning growth strategy. Most importantly, you'll be joining a tight-knit team of driven SDRs where the bar is high and the culture is higher – we genuinely care about each person winning, and our goal is simple: make you want to punch the air every morning when you show up to work!

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Use Phone/Email/LinkedIn to connect with prospective customers.

  • Follow up, manage, and drive qualified inbound marketing leads to book a meeting and create sales opportunities, with the mission to effectively grow the sales pipeline to achieve our regional revenue goals.

  • Utilize and leverage our various sales and lead generation tools to identify, develop and manage marketing leads effectively including Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks and Zoominfo.

  • Identify and source sales opportunities that align with the ideal customer profile for Megaport for the purposes of maximizing solution value and product adoption.

  • Manage & interact with prospects via our website live chat tool.

  • Work side by side with Megaport Sales Executives and other Megaport sellers to help drive Megaport revenue growth.

Work in coordination with sales executives, solution architects and broader POD account teams to identify potential customers, qualify and schedule demonstrations.

  • Keep informed on new products, services, and other general information of interest to customers, through successful completion of sales training and self-study.

  • Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to execute various demand generation campaigns.

  • Invite and drive attendance to company events and regional trade shows.

  • Develop your sales career through ongoing training and 1:1 coaching.

    • This is an individual contributor and compensation carrying position.

What We Are Looking For

    We are looking for individuals who have a passion to work in a high growth environment and grow their sales career. We expect team members to have the following:

  • Action oriented and highly organized individual who is resourceful, result oriented & adaptable.

  • Excellent time management skills.

  • Strong work ethic & drive to be successful in ambiguous situations, self-motivated, able to solve problems and work with limited direction.

  • A goal-oriented and customer-focused mindset.

  • Ability to handle fast-paced change with new processes and the ability to fail fast & learn fast.

  • Excellent listening, verbal and written communications skills.

  • Display self-discipline and focus to effectively manage an intense and high volume business.

  • A growth mindset, consistently working to improve your skills, be open to feedback and learn constantly.

  • Ability to achieve and exceed weekly, monthly and quarterly goals and production levels as defined by sales management.

  • Ability to build meaningful business relationships with customers, prospects and internal team mates.


    • Preferred but not required

  • A basic understanding of SaaS and/or networking, cloud offerings.

  • Has experience in a fast paced or start up environment.

  • 6+ months of B2B sales development (SDR / ADR / BDR) experience preferred

  • Speaks Japanese

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available
  • Generous leave plans – including 4 weeks of paid annual leave, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program
  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives
  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave
  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely
  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent
  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos awards
  • For U.S. employees – access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus a 401(k) plan

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact

Role summary

Enterprise Security is hiring a Technical Program Manager to bring delivery discipline to three connected programs: Vulnerability Management, Configuration Management, and Attack Surface Management. You will manage the OKR and epic portfolio, keep priorities current, and make sure committed work is loaded into each engineering team's agile backlog, so delivery dates will hold.

Why this role matters

These programs span many teams and stay active for multiple quarters. Dependencies, shifting priorities, and unclear ownership can stall critical work. You will be the person who tracks, communicates, and resolves cross-team dependencies so engineers can stay focused on technical delivery, and leaders can focus on strategy and people.

What you'll do

  • Manage the OKR and epic portfolio across all three programs, including creation, refinement, sequencing, and status tracking.
  • Lead ongoing reprioritization as scope and demand change and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Work with team leads, so each team's agile funnel reflects current priorities and supports committed delivery dates.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and blockers across teams, and drive them to resolution or escalate early.
  • Produce executive-ready status, risk, and progress reporting for the whole portfolio.
  • Run gate reviews and go/no-go checkpoints for major milestones.
  • Model team capacity against competing priorities and raise conflicts early.
  • Build repeatable standards, such as OKR governance and intake and planning templates, that scale across teams.

Qualifications

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 12+ years of program or project management experience in software, security, or infrastructure organizations. OR similar experience with education.
  • A track record of managing multi-team programs with competing priorities and dependencies.
  • Strong working knowledge of agile delivery, including backlog, epic, and sprint planning in enterprise tools (such as ServiceNow Agile).
  • Experience managing OKRs and tying delivery to measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • The ability to influence and align teams without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in security operations, vulnerability management, configuration or compliance management, CMDB, or attack surface and exposure management.
  • Familiarity with regulated or government environments, such as FedRAMP and federal directives.
  • Experience launching a new program, including defining metrics and reporting cadence.
  • Experience with capacity planning and portfolio-level road mapping.
  • PMP, SAFe, or similar certification (nice to have, not required).

Success measures for the first 6 to 12 months

  • A single, current OKR and epic view across VM, CM, and ASM.
  • Each team's agile funnel aligned to committed delivery dates.
  • Cross-team blockers resolved on a predictable cadence.
  • ASM success measures defined, with regular reporting to leadership.
  • A reduction in program coordination work carried by managers and engineers.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Planner, Key Account Planning is responsible for developing a strategic annual retail and net sales plan by channel for their accounts. This role requires a data-driven, analytical mindset to interpret business trends, identify growth opportunities and optimize inventory productivity to reduce liabilities. By proactively identifying strategies to drive revenue and mitigate unproductive stock, the Key Account Planner plays a pivotal role in achieving financial targets.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams – including Marketing, Sales Operations, Customer Service, and respective Retail Account Buying Teams – the Key Account Planner ensures seamless execution of account strategies. Through precision planning and strategic inventory management, this role directly contributes to maximizing sales performance and delivering on both gross and net sales objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

FORECASTING

  • You will support and partner with Director and ED, Key Account Planning in building bottoms up budgets and on-going forecasting and achievement of retail and net sales plans
  • You will forecast returns and DIFs, managing discontinuations to reduce RTV liabilities, retrieving necessary approvals, and partnering with finance on timing and estimates
  • You will analyze retailer OTB monthly, ensuring no changes or potential issues after each month’s lock
  • In partnership with Director, Key Accounts, you will develop CEP & mid-month retail and shipment projections with keen communication to ED, Key Accounts on changes
  • You will build and revise monthly retail HPLN in accordance with monthly CEP projections, collaborating with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment
  • You will ensure orders are received from retail partners in a timely manner and troubleshoot errors
  • You will collaborate with internal partners on creating sales goals by door, week, quarter, and channel during budgeting and re-trending moments
  • You will build retail sales plans for new launches, tracking achievement and sell-thru of established sales objectives, including analysis for Limited Edition and Holiday product lines

REPORTING

  • You will be using COGNOS and retailer reporting, pull weekly sales data and analyze sell-thru results to inform weekly commentary
  • You will provide weekly sales recap to key internal stakeholders and leadership, summarizing achievements, promotions, marketing activities
  • You will deliver weekly by door sales recaps to SEEs

MISCELLANEOUS

  • You will support monthly consensus process by providing updated retailer sku projections, insights, and relevant reporting
  • You will track ROI and sales lift on retailer secondary exposures and marketing activities to inform co-op spend
  • You will plan and allocate monthly sampling and GWPs to strategically support retail sales
  • You will consistently communicate with field and retail partners regarding inventory concerns and business opportunities
  • You will maintain agendas for weekly recurring touch bases with internal stakeholders and retail partners
  • You will execute ad hoc reporting and analysis requests

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in related field
  • You have 5+ years of retail planning experience (Buying Office or extensive Head Quarter experience)
  • You are highly skilled in inventory planning, forecasting gross/net shipments, and bottoms up build required
  • You have advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint (pivot tables, vlookups, sumif, etc.)
  • You can fully read, analyze and understand retailer OTB’s
  • You have demonstrated ability to build gross to net and retail sales plans from the bottom up
  • You have strong knowledge and experience with the prestige cosmetic industry & retail planning systems
  • You can work under pressure and fluctuating deadlines with a high number of tasks
  • You should possess strong analytical, organizational and communication skills
  • You have strong attention to detail, high sense of responsibility, dependable and self-starter
  • You must be flexible and adaptive to changing priorities
