excerpt: Position Summary: The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management.
description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Central Monitor will play a key role in ensuring the quality and integrity of clinical trial data through centralized monitoring activities, statistical data review, and proactive risk management. This position involves leading the development of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) plans, conducting study risk assessments, identifying study KRIs (in collaboration with Functional leads), performing ongoing centralized statistical monitoring, remote centralized data review, and facilitating monthly RBQM meetings. works independently and manages report review and issue escalation for more complex studies and/or portfolios of work. Further, the Central Monitor may mentor junior colleagues, and may support the development of processes, procedures and other documentation to ensure a high functioning team

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Lead Development of RBQM Plan: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement comprehensive RBQM plans tailored to each study's specific needs - including identification of critical data & process, definition of KRIs & QTLs and centralized monitoring approach
  • Study Risk Assessment: Conduct thorough risk assessments for clinical studies, identifying potential issues and developing mitigation strategies, in consultation with functional team leads and PM
  • Centralized Statistical Monitoring: Perform centralized statistical monitoring & data analysis on study data to detect anomalies, trends, and potential risks, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
  • RBQM Meetings: lead facilitation of monthly RBQM meetings by supporting review of study data, documenting findings, action plans and coordination of data cleaning activities to support study deliverables
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of data quality and integrity through proactive monitoring and timely interventions.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, and other departments to support proactive oversight and management and data cleaning for studies
  • Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations on monitoring activities, findings, and recommendations for sponsors and study teams.
  • Operational Insights: Oversee operational study metrics, including data entry trends, SDV backlog, site health trending and proactively communicate issues to study team members to drive towards resolution & proactive remediation
  • Mentor and Support Junior Colleagues: Act as a mentor to more junior Central Monitors - sharing best practices, lessons learned, etc. to improve team performance
  • Sponsor Engagement and Communications: support discussions with Sponsors around risk management and proactive data cleaning

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (life sciences, statistics, data management, clinical operations) or relevant/equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Minimum 5 years experience in clinical monitoring, clinical trial management or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and the clinical development process

Other Required:

  • Highly effective oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with project team members
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English, including strong grammar and scientific vocabulary skills
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Strong understanding of RBQM principles and methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn how to extract pertinent information from protocols, electronic study data systems, clinical systems, dashboards, and to leverage these data to assess risk
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis and data monitoring tools.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated experience with integrated risk planning & management
  • Ability to mentor junior team members

Preferred:

  • CRO experience as a Central Monitor

Skills:

  • Statistical analysis and data monitoring
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Report writing and presentation
  • Collaboration and teamwork

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers

description:
Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.

About the role
You'll build the site, run it, and make it the place enterprise data teams go to discover, see, and try our product, as buyer behavior shifts toward doing more of the research on their own. It's a role for a web developer or engineer who wants to own the whole site, not a slice of it.

We're a small growth team that likes to build. You'll be the team's only engineer, reporting to the Sr. Director, Growth, and working every day with growth, product marketing, and content. As AI changes how marketing gets done, we're investing in how we work: prototyping first, and creating a builder suite that lets the whole team build, not just engineers. You'll have a direct line to the outcome.

What sets this role apart:
  • The site is yours. You're the engineer who owns it, with the tools and support to do it well. You decide how it's built and run, with the freedom to move quickly from an idea to a live page. Owning it runs both ways: when something breaks, it's yours to fix.
  • You'll shape how the site looks, not just how it works.Working from our brand system, you'll take ideas from a prototype, a draft, or a two-line brief to a finished page, with a real say in the design.
  • Every visit counts.Our buyers are a focused, technical audience, so who visits matters as much as how many. You'll make sure every change can be measured, and work with marketing and sales to decide what worked.
  • Today the site runs on WordPress, with PostHog for product analytics.You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves as the site grows.

What you'll do

  • Help marketers ship on their own.Build the foundation of components and templates they launch pages from, so the result looks right without a design review. Step in to add new components when they hit a limit, and build new ideas end to end when they need something the system can't do yet.
  • Improve the journeys that matter most.Work from the homepage and platform pages through to the free trial, demos, and proof-of-value requests. Bring an experimentation mindset: treat each change as a test, judge it by its results, and ship behind feature flags.
  • Build new ways to understand, see, and try the product. Buyers now research with AI and want to try software on their own before they talk to sales. Give them walkthroughs, demos, assessments, and an assistant: start small, scale what they use, and build each one as a pattern we can reuse. You'll shape where this goes with marketing.
  • Run the site and evolve its architecture. Own hosting, security, releases with preview and rollback, performance, consent and accessibility, and structured data for search and AI answers. Shape the architecture and platform underneath so the site keeps up with what we want to build next.
  • Make every conversion land. Every form, chat, or demo signup is captured, matched to the right account, and routed to its owner while the visitor is still on the site. You'll partner on the event schema and own how it's implemented, including what happens when a match fails.
  • Lend engineering depth. Pitch in on the internal AI tools our team builds, helping make them production-ready.

How we'll measure success
From the start, you'll get hands-on with the site's code, its hosting, and every path a buyer takes to reach us. Expect to keep it running and ship improvements while you learn it. From there, success looks like this:
  • When the right buyers convert, it reaches the right person within minutes.
  • Marketers can ship more on their own each quarter.
  • Your changes hold up, and when one causes a problem, it's fixed quickly.
  • Every change has a clear goal, and we decide whether to keep it based on the result.

What you bring

  • Production web engineering. You've built and run a marketing site from components to release, and kept it running when something broke.
  • Reusable page building. You've taken a two-line brief to a shipped page with no designer, and built it so others could reuse it.
  • CMS experience.You've built and updated pages in WordPress or a similar CMS, and you're comfortable picking up a modern front end like React.
  • Forms and CRM integration.You've connected a site's forms or signups to a CRM so each one reaches the right account and owner, and added checks to keep it that way.
Nice to have
You don't need all of these. Most people we'd hire bring experience in two:
  • Improving a page using experiment results, account-level behavior and what sales told you
  • A headless CMS (such as Sanity or Contentful) with a modern front end (React, Next.js, or Astro)
  • A custom capture layer or a thin backend for a marketing site
  • Interactive experiences such as guided product tours, AI assistants, hands-on sandboxes, or personalized pages
  • Structured data that changed how pages appear in search or AI answers
  • A design system, in Figma or in code
  • A multilingual site
  • Getting to know an established codebase quickly, and changing its architecture safely while it stays live
Don't match every line? We care more about how you think and how fast you learn than whether you've done this exact job before. If you're curious and learn quickly, we'd still like to hear from you.

Why Semarchy

description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

excerpt: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies.
description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health is building the most complete and accurate catalog of home medical equipment and supplies in the industry, and that catalog is at the heart of our entire platform. Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term.

As our Catalog Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories.

A large part of this job is working shoulder to shoulder with engineers and a product manager. You will sit with the Cat Crew R&D team, translate merchandising problems into requirements they can build against, and translate technical constraints back into business impact for the rest of the organization. Just as important, you will be the person who notices when the platform is quietly costing the team time or accuracy, names that gap clearly, sizes it, and advocates for fixing it.

The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities,and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together.

What You'll Do

  • Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories.
  • Partner closely with the Cat Crew R&D team to shape near-term catalog software capabilities. Work directly with engineers through scoping, development, and delivery rather than handing off a spec and walking away.
  • Own catalog functionality enhancement requirements end to end: definition, business justification, and the case for prioritization, then drive them forward with the Catalog Product Manager and Engineering.
  • Surface gaps between what the business needs and what the platform does today. Document the workarounds people have quietly adopted, quantify what they cost in time, accuracy, or scalability, and bring that case to Product and Engineering leadership.
  • Serve as the catalog administrator: govern attributes, values, naming conventions, and data-quality standards across the catalog.
  • Maintain and evolve core catalog assets, including the global catalog style guide, training about existing and new functionality, glossary, and design review guide.
  • Interview category managers and subject-matter experts to learn each category's ideal state, balanced with a curiosity about current state workarounds and platform limitations.
  • Lead design reviews for category managers and analysts and provide effective feedback.
  • Up-level the merchandising team's catalog and taxonomy skills, continuing the trajectory started with the contract taxonomist.
  • Drive the standardized identification of sourcing/provenance attributes, including manufacturer, brand, and product line.
  • Set the long-term strategic direction for catalog data management, quality, and governance, and act as the senior authority the organization consults on catalog and taxonomy decisions.
  • Collaborate with our clinical division to launch new categories, making sure the catalog and taxonomy support new clinical use cases.
  • Advance AI-assisted catalog tooling and workflows, such as Claude skills for catalog building and quality monitoring, and codify repeatable processes.

About You

  • Deep expertise in taxonomy, information architecture, and metadata or attribute modeling, ideally for a large, complex product catalog.
  • Hands-on experience administering catalog or product information management (PIM) systems and defining data-quality standards.
  • A track record of spotting business gaps and doing something about them. You notice when a process is broken or a tool is falling short, you can articulate the cost in concrete terms, and you can make the case for investment to people who did not ask for it.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous catalog problems into clear requirements, and of justifying and prioritizing enhancement work against business impact.

As an Inbound SDR on the night shift, you make sure every inbound lead from the US and LATAM is treated fast and every demo is booked properly. You are the first person a prospect speaks to after they ask for a demo or contact us, so the first call sets the tone.

Your main objective: every demo request is called within 5 minutes, every meeting is booked with the right person and a clear agenda, and every booked meeting actually takes place. You are measured on speed to lead, show rate and the share of your meetings that AEs qualify as SQLs.

  • Call every inbound lead within 5 minutes of a demo request, and keep trying by phone, email and chat until we reach them.

  • Set a clear agenda for every meeting, so the prospect and the AE know what will be discussed.
  • Make sure each lead is routed to the right AE, product line and region.
  • Make meetings stick: brief the AE and follow up on every no-show the same day to rebook.
  • Check and enrich lead data, and flag spam, duplicates and poor-fit leads to the Growth team.
  • Keep Salesforce and HubSpot accurate: log every touch, outcome and disqualification reason, and leave full notes so AEs never re-ask the basics.
  • Use AE feedback on meeting quality to sharpen how you qualify.
  • Share what you hear from leads with the Growth team: which forms, campaigns and objections come up most.

What you bring

  • At least 1 year in a phone-based, customer-facing role, such as inbound SDR, lead response or inside sales.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, and confidence on the phone with senior buyers in HR, finance and payroll.
  • Strong qualification skills: you can tell in a short call whether a lead fits.
  • Speed and discipline: you act on a new lead immediately and stay calm under pressure.
  • Organized follow-up and accurate CRM habits.
  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot or a similar CRM, and with dialers or sales engagement tools. You are comfortable using AI tools to prepare and follow up.
  • You can work the night shift, Tuesday to Saturday, 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM Philippine time (Monday to Friday US time, covering the US and LATAM), or Monday to Friday, 3 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine time with excellent attendance and reliability.
  • Stable high-speed internet with a backup connection, a headset and a quiet workspace.

Nice to have

  • Spanish or Portuguese for LATAM leads.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, HR tech, payroll or fintech.
  • Experience selling to HR, finance or payroll leaders.
  • Experience with scheduling and lead routing tools.

Job Description

Job Summary

Provides senior level support for designing, implementing, and maintaining the security framework for Molina’s artificial intelligence and machine learning systems. Serves as the subject matter expert for securing AI/ML workloads operating within Molina’s Microsoft Azure and Databricks environments.

Job Duties

  • Designs Secure AI/ML Architectures: Develops and promotes secure, resilient, and scalable architecture patterns for AI/ML solutions built on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, and other platforms.
  • AI/ML Threat Modeling: Conducts comprehensive threat modeling and risk assessments specifically for AI/ML systems, identifying vulnerabilities related to model inversion, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection.
  • Agentic AI Security: Leads the threat modeling, risk assessment, and security control design for autonomous AI agents, focusing on mitigating risks such as prompt injection, tool abuse, and uncontrolled agentic behavior.
  • AI Tools: Establishes and enforces a comprehensive security and governance framework for our AI tools, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, ensuring the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of contextual data.
  • MLSecOps Integration: Collaborates with our MLOps and Data Science teams to embed automated security controls ("shift-left") into the entire machine learning development lifecycle, from data ingestion to model deployment.
  • Architectural Guidance: Maintains AI Reference Architectures and Guidance and updates the specification and publication of AI Standards and Patterns around AI technology, development, security, privacy, and observability.
  • Strategic Advisory & Business Alignment: Consults on AI capabilities across business and technology platforms, ensuring alignment between AI architecture frameworks and the organization’s strategic goals. Offers actionable recommendations on solution design, risk mitigation, and cross-domain impacts.
  • Partner & Collaborate: Partners with solution architects, technology leaders, business, governance, cyber security, compliance, and privacy teams to identify AI risks, documents design decisions, and provides enterprise patterns to resolve issues.
  • Threat Research: Stays current with the latest threats and vulnerabilities targeting AI systems and develops proactive strategies to defend against them. Designs capabilities for AI Governance and Observability.

Job Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in a senior cybersecurity role (e.g., Security Architect, Cloud Security Engineer), or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Proven, hands-on experience securing AI/ML workloads and data pipelines within Microsoft Azure and Databricks platforms.
  • Deep understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle and MLOps practices.
  • Strong understanding of network, application, and data security controls in a cloud-native environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the unique security challenges and threat landscape of AI/ML systems.
  • Proficient in Python and familiarity with data science and AI libraries.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Displays intellectual curiosity, integrity, and is motivated by achieving long-term business outcomes.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and lead cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • In-depth understanding of Agentic AI security, including common attack vectors and mitigation techniques.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and securing the infrastructure that supports it.
  • Familiarity with MLSecOps principles and tools for security testing and automation in for Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or Azure Security Engineer Associate/Expert.
  • Exposure to governance and compliance regimes; a good understanding of security and privacy management, and regulatory requirements including Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act (HIPAA HITECH).
  • Experience supporting agile teams by providing guidance on design, opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
  • Experience designing Generative AI (GenAI) solutions, with experience in Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), Large Language Models (LLM), OpenAI, CoPilot Studio, Agentic AI frameworks such as Langchain, LangGraph and Agent Development Kit (Google ADK), Data Foundry, and Data Fabric.

excerpt: Description SUMMARY ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely.
description:
Description

SUMMARY

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​The Senior Clinical Data Manager will lead and manage multiple clinical studies, ensuring that data are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Innovaderm standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines

.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Senior Clinical Data Manager must:

· Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.

  • Be the data management liaison to the project team, sponsor and external vendors, as needed.
  • Be able to manage three to four concurrent studies independently, with minimal supervision.
  • Be able to take decision with minimal support from manager.
  • Attend meeting with sponsor and answers Data Management related question.
  • Provides input for timelines and monitor scope of work to ensure timely and within budget completion of assigned tasks.
  • Be responsible for the development of electronic case report form (eCRF) specifications (including data capture screens and edit check specifications) needed to build a study-specific clinical database/electronic data capture (EDC) system.
  • Be responsible for or assist in the programming and ongoing maintenance of the clinical database.
  • Be responsible for the validation and testing of the clinical database (e.g. User Acceptance Testing).
  • Be responsible for the development of eCRF completion guidelines and other training material required to train site users and monitors.
  • Conduct training for site users/monitors on the clinical database.

· Develop data transfer agreements and specifications with vendors providing external data (e.g. laboratory results).

  • Conduct reconciliation between external data and data in the EDC system to ensure consistency, including reconciliation with sponsor safety databases for adverse events/serious adverse events data (if needed).
  • Provide support to study team in the development of external systems capturing clinical data, e.g. ePRO or IWRS, and ensuring that any data transfer requirements between these systems and EDC are documented and tested appropriately.
  • Be responsible for the development of the data management plan (DMP), and other clinical data management related documentation.
  • Be responsible for ongoing data review/cleaning during study conduct and also during preparation for database lock/close.
  • Code medical terms in the clinical database, as required.
  • Generates data listings and reports needed for data review by the project manager (or other study team members) in preparation for database close/lock.
  • Monitor study status (e.g. enrollment, CRFs monitored/approved, etc.) on an ongoing basis and provides data status reports to the project team, as needed.
  • Ensure that data management documentation is complete and up-to-date in the trial master file (TMF).
  • Respond to users requiring assistance with the EDC system.
  • Be responsible for archiving of the clinical database and related documents.
  • Participate in the definition, writing and updating of data management Work Instructions
  • Mentor and train Clinical Data Coordinators, as needed.
  • Provide basic support to less experienced Clinical Data Managers, as needed.

· For any studies where any of the above activities have been outsourced to an external service provider:

    • Oversee/manage the vendor to ensure that timelines and deliverables meet with sponsor and protocol requirements;
    • Ensure that their work is done in accordance with effective work orders and Innovaderm SOPs (if applicable).

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

· B.Sc. or in a related field of study.

· M. Sc. or in a related field of study is an asset;

· 5 to 8 years of clinical data management experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or contractual research organization (CRO) industry.

· Understanding of the drug development process and of applicable regulations, including Good Clinical Practices, ICH Guidelines.

· Extensive experience working with EDC systems, and/or database structures.

· Demonstrated skills in database programming an asset.

· Good understanding of CDISC SDTM/CDASH standards;

· Highly organized and detail-oriented with effective project planning and time management skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French an asset.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel.

· Knowledge of SAS or similar, an asset;

· Excellent problem solving abilities;

· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated agility to organize and prioritize multiple competing demands.

· Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug dictionaries.

· Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.

What You’ll Bring

Our Values

​Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal, State and Local Government Consulting
excerpt: Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch.
description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

People are at the center of all we do, and that’s why we empower career growth, provide industry-leading benefits packages, encourage a flexible work environment, and foster a culture of inclusion to support the needs of our team. We share a collective passion for our mission and our people. Guided by our seven core values, The Attain Way, our vision is the foundation of our culture—to be and attain the best.

We are seeking a Principal to grow and lead our state and local government consulting work. This leader will develop the market strategy, build executive relationships, win new business, and oversee consulting engagements that help public agencies improve operations and services for the people they serve.

The ideal candidate brings established government relationships and a record of selling and delivering consulting services. Working across Attain’s strategy, technology, and data teams, the Principal will build a sustainable portfolio of business and develop the consulting talent needed to support its growth.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Client Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a growth strategy that identifies priority markets, agency needs, target accounts, and opportunities for Attain’s services.
  • Build trusted relationships with state and local executives, agency leaders, and procurement stakeholders; expand existing accounts and establish new clients.
  • Personally originate and close consulting engagements, with accountability for agreed bookings, revenue, and profitability goals.
  • Lead pursuits from opportunity qualification through proposals, presentations, pricing, negotiations, and contracting, in partnership with internal teams.
  • Develop teaming relationships and maintain a qualified pipeline, account plans, and reliable forecasts.

Collaboration with Delivery Leaders

  • Partner with capability and delivery leaders to identify, qualify, and pursue state and local government opportunities aligned with Attain’s offerings and delivery strengths.
  • Develop joint account and pursuit plans that define client needs, key relationships, competitive positioning, and responsibilities for advancing opportunities.
  • Engage delivery leaders early to shape solutions, validate scope and staffing, and develop compelling proposals and presentations.
  • Collaborate on pricing and contracting strategies that balance competitive positioning, delivery risk, and profitability.
  • Coordinate with delivery leaders on existing accounts to identify expansion opportunities and connect clients with additional Attain capabilities.
  • Ensure a coordinated transition from pursuit to delivery, maintaining alignment on commitments, client expectations, and success measures.

Technology Partner Engagement

  • Build relationships with state and local government sales and alliance teams at strategic technology partners, including, but not limited to, Salesforce, Snowflake, and Workday.
  • Develop joint account plans and conduct regular pipeline reviews to identify shared priorities, secure introductions, and advance opportunities.
  • Connect technology partner teams with Attain’s delivery leaders to shape solutions and demonstrate relevant expertise.
  • Coordinate joint pursuits, proposals, demonstrations, and executive engagement to strengthen Attain’s competitive position.
  • Collaborate on targeted campaigns, events, and thought leadership that generate qualified opportunities and increase Attain’s visibility.
  • Translate partner insights on agency priorities, procurement timelines, and technology roadmaps into actionable market and pursuit strategies.

Consulting Delivery

  • Serve as an executive advisor and engagement leader on organizational transformation, business process improvement, program management, and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Translate agency priorities into practical recommendations, delivery plans, and measurable improvements in program performance and constituent services.
  • Oversee engagement scope, staffing, budgets, quality, and risk; resolve escalations and maintain client confidence.
  • Connect clients with Attain specialists in areas such as data and analytics, change management, grants management, and enterprise technology.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop consultants and engagement leaders; align staffing and capability investments with anticipated demand.
  • Build repeatable service offerings and consulting methods that address emerging state and local government needs.
  • Manage portfolio performance, including engagement margins, resource utilization, client satisfaction, and account growth.
  • Represent Attain through industry associations, conferences, and thought leadership; share market insights across practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in management consulting or professional services, including substantial work with U.S. state and local government clients.
  • 5+ years leading consulting teams, client accounts, or a service offering with responsibility for business development and financial performance.
  • Demonstrated success personally winning and expanding consulting engagements, supported by measurable sales or revenue results.
  • Established relationships with government decision-makers and an understanding of public procurement, budget cycles, solicitations, and contracting approaches.
  • Experience leading complex consulting engagements involving multiple stakeholders and delivering results within scope and budget.
  • Strong executive communication, proposal development, facilitation, and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building a state and local government consulting portfolio, entering new markets, or launching service offerings.
  • Expertise in one or more government domains, such as finance and administration, health and human services, transportation, public safety, or grants administration.
  • Experience combining management consulting with technology implementation, data and analytics, or organizational change.
  • Advanced degree in business, public administration, public policy, or a related field.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to balance business development, client delivery, and team leadership in a growing consulting environment.
  • Willingness to travel for client engagements, pursuits, and firm activities based on business needs.

Additional Information

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

  • Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs
  • 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)
  • Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting
  • Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us
  • A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Partners is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

Salary Range
$150—$230 USD

title: Director, Data Warehouse Engineering
excerpt: Overview Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!
description:
Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a true data warehouse expert to help modernize a critical enterprise platform. You’ll lead the evaluation, optimization, and future direction of an overloaded Redshift-based environment, guide major migration and architecture decisions, and partner with a sizable data engineering organization to bring the warehouse to the next level. We’re looking for a leader who combines deep technical credibility with strong strategic judgment, stakeholder influence, and a forward-looking view on how AI can improve data architecture, warehouse management, and ETL performance.

Position Summary:

Mercury Insurance is looking for a Director, Data Warehouse Engineering to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of our enterprise data warehouse platform. This leader will own the direction of the data warehouse engineering function and help modernize the way data is built, governed, and delivered across the company.

This role combines people leadership, architectural depth, and operational excellence. You will lead teams that build and support scalable EDW data platforms, enterprise data models, and high-reliability pipelines that serve analytics, reporting, operational use cases, and AI-enabled solutions. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Product, and business stakeholders to ensure Mercury’s data foundation is trusted, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience leading data warehousing and data engineering organizations, modernizing enterprise data platforms, and driving execution across a complex environment. This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who can set vision, raise engineering standards, and develop high-performing teams while staying connected to the technical details that matter.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$118,078 to $330,661 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$118,078 to $330,661 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$118,078 to $330,661 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $201,933 to $280,462

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and operating model for data warehouse engineering in support of Mercury’s enterprise data strategy.
  • Lead multiple teams or a broader engineering function responsible for enterprise data warehouse development, data marts, core data models, and scalable data pipelines.
  • Drive modernization of the data platform, including data modeling standards, orchestration patterns, testing frameworks, observability, and automation to optimize efficiency.
  • Establish engineering standards for reliability, performance, scalability, data quality, and maintainability across the warehouse and pipeline ecosystem.
  • Cross-collaborate with engineering/technology and data sciences teams to establish SLAs, data contracts, and data quality standards.
  • Oversee the design and implementation of end-to-end data processing solutions that support enterprise reporting, business operations, data science, and AI use cases.
  • Partner with senior leaders across Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, and business teams to align investments, priorities, and delivery plans.
  • Translate business goals into a clear portfolio of data platform capabilities, delivery of roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead the evolution of enterprise data models, including decisions on grain, entities, relationships, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Drive a data product mindset across the organization, helping teams move from reactive ticket-based delivery to scalable, reusable data capabilities.
  • Build a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, continuous improvement, automation, and disciplined execution.
  • Mentor and develop managers, senior engineers, and technical leads, while strengthening succession planning and organizational capability.
  • Build and manage multiple teams to execute on establishing data strategy.
  • Guide to capacity planning, prioritization, vendor and tool decisions, and resource allocation across the function.
  • Partner with engineering teams to productionize pipelines and integrations with strong service levels, resilience, and operational support.
  • Champion governance, controls, and best practices that improve trust in enterprise data and reduce manual effort and technical debt.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve developer productivity, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate delivery.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field
  • Master’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and/or experience

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 15+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or related disciplines, with significant experience leading high-performing engineering teams and managers.
  • 10+ years of strong people leadership experience, including coaching leaders, building teams, setting expectations, and creating accountability.
  • Proven success leading enterprise-scale data warehouse or lake house platforms in complex business environments.

Preferred:

  • 5 or more years of experience leading large-scale data warehouse overhauls, pipeline migrations, and performance improvement initiatives across legacy platforms and modern cloud architectures.

  • Strong technical and strategic background evaluating platforms such as Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies, with the ability to recommend a path forward and build stakeholder alignment.

  • Experience leading and developing data engineering organizations, including inheriting and guiding teams responsible for warehouse architecture, ETL performance, and execution at scale.

  • Experience with leveraging AI to drive process efficiencies across optimization, modernization, management, performance.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture and data modeling.
  • Redesign and migration of foundational data pipelines and warehouse structures involving 1000s of tables, data pipelines and feeds.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders to prioritize roadmaps, resolve trade-offs, and deliver business value.
  • Lead production support for EDS and support mandatory data requirements.
  • Mastery of modern modeling approaches, including 3NF, dimensional, star, and snowflake patterns, with the judgment to apply the right model for the business need.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence in data engineering, including testing, data quality frameworks, observability, incident reduction, and service reliability.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL and strong proficiency in Python.
  • Production experience with modern data engineering tools and practices, including Informatica, DBT, orchestration platforms such as Airflow, Tivoli, or Dagster, and Git-based development workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouse or Lakehouse technologies such as Redshift, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
  • Familiarity with layered(medallion) data architecture patterns.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD, automation-first engineering practices, and scalable software delivery in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences without authority.
  • Experience using AI tools such as OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini to solve high-value operational or engineering problems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience in insurance, SaaS, or marketplace environments is a plus.

Pay Range

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

The Role

The Lead DevOps Engineer owns the technical direction, standards and delivery of IREN's AWS platform and DevOps practice. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you'll set the architecture and governance model for our AWS estate — multi-account landing zone, guardrails, IAM, networking, pipelines and observability — lead and mentor DevOps Engineers, and be the escalation point for cloud platform design and delivery decisions across the enterprise and our AI Cloud business. You'll partner with Cybersecurity, Compliance and Business Systems leaders so the platform is secure by design, audit-ready and cost-efficient.
AWS is the primary platform. IREN also runs a Microsoft Azure/M365 estate for identity and productivity, so you'll own the integration standards between the two clouds — identity federation, shared pipelines, monitoring and evidence collection — and be able to step into Azure work when needed.
This role sits within IREN's corporate Information Technology team and is a critical hire to remove single points of failure on production cloud platform work.

Responsibilities

Architecture & governance
  • Define and own the AWS platform architecture: AWS Organizations and multi-account landing zone (Control Tower or equivalent), SCP guardrails, Config/Security Hub conformance, network topology (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect/VPN to sites) and tagging and naming standards.

  • Build and strengthen Later’s reputation within the talent ecosystem through consistent, high-quality partnerships.
  • Champion operational excellence and hold a high bar for performance across the Services team.

Research/Best Practices

  • Stay ahead of platform shifts, monetization models, and compliance regulations (FTC, platform-specific rules).
  • Continuously benchmark industry best practices and apply insights to evolve Later’s talent partnership approach.
  • Experiment with new systems, processes, and partnership models to test-and-learn at scale.

What success looks like:

  • Upholds high operational excellence, leading the organization of ongoing casting and trend-identification efforts.
  • Builds and maintains a differentiated network of creators and representatives that provides a competitive advantage.
  • Drives measurable impact on campaign success, client retention, and revenue growth.
  • Consistently identifies and secures high-impact creator talent that elevates campaign performance and client outcomes.
  • You excel at balancing campaign management, relationship management, and the creation and maintenance of operational workflows.
  • The cross functional team and customers view you as a trusted advisor on talent, who serves as a go to across verticals of talent and different types of talent integrations.
  • Establishes Later as a preferred partner for top-tier talent and their teams.

What you bring:

  • 4-5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or talent management, with a proven track record of building and scaling high-impact creator programs; agency background preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in sourcing, negotiating, and managing high-profile influencer, athlete and celebrity relationships across multiple partnership models.
  • Strong network of creator, agent, and manager relationships across key verticals and platforms.
  • Strong strategic and analytical skills with experience managing scalable systems that improve efficiency and outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of social platforms, creator economics, and cultural trends.
  • Experience implementing AI and workflow to increase operational efficiencies.
  • Exceptional negotiation and relationship management skills, with the ability to cultivate trust and secure competitive agreements.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with cross-departmental teams.
  • Strong understanding of FTC guidelines, brand safety standards, and compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with influencer marketing platforms, CRM systems, and campaign analytics tools.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset—operationally excellent, solutions-oriented, and energized by scaling complex systems in a fast-paced environment.
  • Clear communicator with strong judgment and attention to detail, with experience representing an organization externally.

How you work:

  • Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
  • Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
  • Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
  • Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
  • Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:

$80,000 - $90,000 OTE

*Co-op team members, independent contractors, and freelancers are not eligible for company benefits.

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

excerpt: über das arbeiten bei envelio Zu einfach ist langweilig!
description:
über das arbeiten bei envelio

Zu einfach ist langweilig! Gemeinsam haben wir die Mission, die Energiewende voranzutreiben. Wir lieben, was wir tun und dabei ist uns kein Thema zu groß. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Arbeit und wachsen an jeder neuen Aufgabe. Kurz gesagt: Own it, love it, grow with it.

Wir sind ein bodenständiges Team aus Kaffee- und Mate-Liebhaber:innen. Unser Geek-Humor resultiert in einer rituellen Nutzung von Emojis und der enzyklopädischen Herausarbeitung von unnützem Wissen. Mehr als 250 envelianer:innen mit über 20 verschiedenen Nationalitäten sind bereits an Bord. Komm dazu und wachse mit uns!

deine rolle

Als Platform Operations Engineer (all genders) bist du verantwortlich für den zuverlässigen Betrieb, das Monitoring und das Deployment der Softwarelösungen von envelio in komplexen Kundenumgebungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Updates, Fixes und neue Versionen der Intelligent Grid Platform (IGP) reibungslos in Cloud-, On-Premise- und Operational-Technology-(OT-) Umgebungen ausgerollt werden.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der tägliche Betrieb der Kundensysteme: Du überwachst die Systemgesundheit, spielst Updates ein, wartest Cluster und koordinierst die Lösung von Incidents. Du trägst aktiv zu einem stabilen 24/7-Betrieb bei, indem du Probleme frühzeitig erkennst, auf Incidents reagierst und für klare Kommunikation und saubere Übergaben sorgst. Du hältst den Betrieb nicht nur am Laufen, sondern verbesserst ihn auch kontinuierlich durch Dokumentation, Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI in zahlreichen operativen Prozessen.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Engineering, SRE und Kunden. Gemeinsam mit internen Teams sowie den IT- und OT-Teams unserer Kunden klärst du Betriebsmodelle ab, verschaffst dir ein Verständnis der bestehenden Infrastruktur und stellst sicher, dass unsere Software in realen Netzumgebungen zuverlässig und sicher läuft.

wie du etwas bewirkst

  • Du gestaltest unser neues Operations-Team und seine Prozesse aktiv mit und wächst mit ihm
  • Du spielst Software-Updates, Patches und Fixes in Kundenumgebungen ein, in Cloud-, On-Premise- und OT-Setups
  • Du begleitest Incidents vom ersten Alert bis zur Mitigation und koordinierst das Troubleshooting zwischen Operations, Engineering und SRE
  • Du trägst zu unserem 24/7-Betrieb bei, indem du an einer Bereitschafts-Rotation teilnimmst und für eine schnelle Reaktion bei den kritischsten Incidents sorgst
  • Du unterstützt Kunden bei Rollouts, Upgrades und operativen Incidents
  • Du dokumentierst kundenspezifische Setups, operative Abläufe und Deployment-Prozesse
  • Du trägst dazu bei, Deployment- und Betriebsprozesse kundenübergreifend zu verbessern und zu standardisieren
  • Du unterstützt interne Teams, indem du Erkenntnisse aus dem realen Kundenbetrieb in Produkt- und Engineering-Entscheidungen einbringst

Wie wir in Operations zusammenarbeiten

  • Wir sorgen für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und effiziente Abstimmung zwischen Teams
  • Wir gestalten unsere Bereitschafts-Rotation nachhaltig, unterstützt durch:
    • symptombasiertes Alerting, damit Engineers nur alarmiert werden, wenn Kunden tatsächlich betroffen sind
    • gepflegte Runbooks für alle pagerrelevanten Alerts
    • Signal statt Rauschen, damit jede Alarmierung auch wirklich ein menschliches Eingreifen erfordert
    • ein angemessen großes Team, mit dem Ziel einer Bereitschaftswoche alle fünf Wochen
  • Wir behandeln Verbesserungsarbeit neben dem laufenden Betrieb als Priorität
  • Wir setzen stark auf KI und Automatisierung, um operative Routinearbeit langfristig zu reduzieren

dein profil

Perfektion ist ein Mythos! Viel mehr interessiert uns der Mensch hinter dem Bildschirm. Diese Kriterien sind also eher als Orientierungshilfe für dich gedacht. Wir sind gespannt, wie deine individuellen Fähigkeiten zu uns passen.

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb komplexer Produktionsanwendungen auf Cloud-Infrastruktur (z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP) und weißt, wie man Services unter realen Bedingungen zuverlässig betreibt
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit containerisierten Produktionsumgebungen (orchestriert mit Kubernetes o. Ä.) und kannst Deployments im Produktivbetrieb bewerten (Rollouts, Rollbacks)
  • Du bist sicher im Troubleshooting von Linux-Systemen und Netzwerken (Logs, Systemzustand, Connectivity)
  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis grundlegender Security-Konzepte
  • Du hast bereits mit Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. Terraform) und Configuration-Management-Tools (z. B. SaltStack, Ansible) gearbeitet
  • Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit Monitoring- und Observability-Plattformen (Datadog, Grafana o. Ä.)
  • Du kennst Teile unseres Tech Stacks oder traust dir zu, dich schnell einzuarbeiten
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch
  • Du arbeitest gerne hands-on operativ, von Deployments bis zum Troubleshooting in Produktionsumgebungen
  • Du arbeitest gut mit Software-Engineers zusammen und kannst operative Rahmenbedingungen in technische Anforderungen übersetzen
  • Du bist strukturiert, zuverlässig und übernimmst Verantwortung für operative Aufgaben
  • Du bleibst ruhig, wenn etwas schiefgeht, hältst dich an Abläufe und weißt, wann du eskalierst
  • Du arbeitest gerne teamübergreifend und mit Kunden zusammen und kannst technische Themen klar und pragmatisch erklären

unser tech stack

  • Cloud (Azure, T Cloud Public) sowie vom Kunden betriebene On-Premise-/OT-Umgebungen
  • Containerisierte Anwendungen, primär in Python und TypeScript geschrieben, orchestriert mit Kubernetes und Helm
  • Standard-Backing-Services wie PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis
  • GitLab & GitLab CI zur Steuerung des Software-Delivery-Lifecycles
  • Terraform, SaltStack und Automatisierungs-Tooling zur Unterstützung von Deployments und Betrieb
  • Datadog für Monitoring, Alerting und Dashboards
  • Linux-Systeme, VPN-Technologien (Site-to-Site)

deine benefits

  • Passe den Arbeitsmodus an deinen Lifestyle an – fully remote oder hybrid mit Office-Option
  • Option zum mobilen Arbeiten aus dem Ausland (bis zu 90 Tage pro Jahr von überall in der EU oder den USA)

  • Unterstützung deiner Gesundheit mit der Urban Sports Club Kooperation
  • Flexible Nutzung eines monatlichen Mobilitätsbudgets (z.B. Jobrad, ÖPNV)
  • Zeit und Budget für individuelles Wachstum
  • optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Professionelle Unterstützung für dein psychisches Wohlbefinden durch unseren Partner nilo – für dich und deine Familie
  • Regelmäßige Tech und Growth Talks zum internen Wissensaustausch
  • Regelmäßige Company und Team Events

Analista de Pruebas de Rendimiento (QA Performance) Semi-Senior
