title: Senior Director, Relationship Management
excerpt: About the Job We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Senior Director, Relationship Management Manager with B2B experience focused on building and growing relationships and ultimately scaling revenue.
description:
About the Job

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Senior Director, Relationship Management Manager with B2B experience focused on building and growing relationships and ultimately scaling revenue. The ideal candidate will have a passion for problem solving, developing relationships, managing complex out-of-the-box solutions and thinking critically about the relationships they manage.

This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration and partnership in order to be successful. Leading a team of relationship managers, you will serve as a primary day-to-day point of contact and advocate for zerohash’s diverse B2B client base which includes broker dealers, banks, neo-banks, merchant acquirers, fintechs, on-ramps and leading non-financial brands. You will also serve as an escalation point for business and account related issues and be a creative, trusted advisor for both clients and internal partners. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of the crypto and fintech landscape, exceptional relationship-building skills, and a strategic mindset to foster and sustain high-impact partnerships.

This is a fully remote role.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at client organizations, including executives, business development teams, and technical experts, to facilitate collaboration and drive joint initiatives
  • Develop customer relationships into zerohash advocates to help build a strong community of customers
  • Lead a team of talented, experienced relationship managers acting as both a coach and an escalation point.
  • Lead collaboration across cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, product, legal, and finance to ensure the client has a smooth onboarding experience and that the client strategy aligns with the broader business goals.
  • Organize and lead monthly calls and quarterly business reviews with supported clients and also contribute to monthly revenue tracking and reporting to leadership as well as clients.
  • Create account-based strategies with a focus on enablement, account mapping, share of wallet expansion, upselling and co-marketing.
  • Work with Engineering, Product, Sales, Finance and Marketing teams to channel the client voice internally, impact product roadmaps, and ensure our solutions meet the needs of the market.
  • Quarterback additional service usage by identifying upsell and cross sell opportunities and adoption of new products.
  • Negotiate client agreements, contracts, and other legal documents, ensuring alignment with the company's goals and objectives.
  • Responsible for ensuring the highest level of service delivery across the business measured by NPS
  • Design and implement data driven reporting to track client satisfaction
  • Own retention and contract renewals
  • Excel at operating in a dynamic and quickly changing environment
  • Maintain operational excellence, identifying and implementing improvements to client-related processes (CRM system, internal systems) on an ongoing basis.

Requirements

  • Motivated by zerohash’s mission and creating a seamless, best in class experience for our highest value clients
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 7-10 years of experience in B2B Relationship Management/ Business Development; with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience in people management and leadership
  • Experience growing client relationships including cross-sell/expansion
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to explain complex topics simply
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • The ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Receptive to feedback and implements changes immediately with a positive attitude
  • An interest in being a relationship builder, collaborative partner, and dynamic project manager
  • Experience working in a complex ecosystem of SaaS or payments products
  • An ability to translate complex business concepts into concise and easy to understand conversations, and put structure to nebulous, unstructured problems
  • Travel requirements up to 20% to zerohash offices and client locations (depending on business need)
  • Maintain focus on operational excellence, identifying and implementing improvements to partner-related processes (CRM / Finance etc.) on an ongoing basis
  • Experience in fintech, brokerage, payments, and/or the crypto industry

Preferred

  • Highly self-motivated, proactive, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-confident, resilient and goal focused
  • Motivated by a startup environment
  • Experience working with product and engineering teams

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior SD-WAN Network Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Network Engineer with strong SD-WAN expertise, advanced routing and switching skills, and experience supporting large enterprise networks.


What You'll Do

  • Engineer and support APEX/EDGE, BGP, VRF/VPN, multi-transport, and network resiliency solutions.

  • Provide technical guidance and escalation support to junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Collaborate with government customers, engineering teams, and program leadership to support network modernization initiatives.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 8–12 years of relevant experience, or approximately 12–16 years of experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with SD-WAN, MPLS, BGP, VRF, VPNs, and enterprise routing and switching.
  • Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/UDP, IPSec, Layer 2/Layer 3 routing, CCMP, and firewall technologies.
  • Experience with SD-WAN underlay/overlay architectures, routing policies, and network segmentation.
  • Experience with at least one network management platform, such as:
    • Palo Alto Panorama
    • Cisco Prime
    • Cisco DNA
    • Junos Space
  • Hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco
    • Juniper
    • Palo Alto
    • Dell Networking
    • Remote Access VPN (RAVPN)
    • GlobalProtect
    • AppGate
  • Experience with network device patching, upgrades, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Experience implementing DoD STIGs and network security hardening.
  • Familiarity with SFTP, SSH, SCP, SNMP, and NTP.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise network migrations.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex network issues and provide technical guidance to other engineers.
  • Strong communication, technical documentation, and customer-facing skills.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts or maintenance windows when required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with Cisco SD-WAN technologies.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW).

  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or similar network automation tools.
  • Experience using Python scripting for network automation and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing and optimizing geographically dispersed enterprise networks.
  • Strong knowledge of DoD cybersecurity requirements and network security standards.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or subject matter expert for network engineering and migration projects.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced networking technologies while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

You'll collaborate with experienced technical teams, solve complex engineering challenges, and help modernize critical military network infrastructure.

description:
Inbound Call Specialist – Contractor (Remote)

Department: Enrollment Operations

Reports to: Senior Enrollment Operations Manager

Type: 1099 Contractor | 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday

Compensation: $25/hour, no W-2 benefits

Overview

As our Inbound Call Specialist, you'll be the first voice patients hear when they call Aviary Health about our virtual cardiac rehab program. You'll own inbound calls from start to finish: answering questions about eligibility and coverage, scheduling patients who are ready to start, and getting everyone else to the right person on our team. We're rolling out new inbound calling tools, including a shared call queue, hold, live transfer and callback scheduling, and this role will be central to how we use them.

This role is for an experienced inbound call professional who is comfortable owning a busy queue, can move between scheduling, insurance questions and routing in a single call, and makes every patient feel heard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inbound Call Handling: Answer calls from the shared queue during your shift, find the patient's record, and resolve the reason for the call on first contact whenever possible.
  • Scheduling: When a patient is ready, schedule their first session on the call, confirm the date and time, and explain next steps, including device or app setup.
  • Eligibility and Coverage: Explain eligibility, insurance coverage and expected cost (copay, deductible or coinsurance) clearly and compassionately, using the patient's coverage notes.
  • Routing and Transfers: Place callers on hold or transfer them live to the right party (Enrollment Specialists, Insurance, Clinical, or Patient Experience/tech support) when the call needs someone else, and set a callback when no one is available.
  • Missed Calls and Voicemails: Promptly return voicemails and missed calls, especially from patients calling back after our outreach.
  • Retention: When a patient wants to cancel or reschedule, understand why and work to keep them in the program before rebooking or routing.
  • Documentation: Record every call accurately and promptly in our patient management system.
  • Feedback: Flag recurring caller issues or routing gaps to the Senior Enrollment Operations Manager so we keep improving the call experience.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of inbound call handling experience, ideally in a healthcare call center, patient access or scheduling role.
  • Experience scheduling appointments in real time on a live call.
  • Comfortable explaining insurance terms (copays, deductibles, coinsurance, Medicare and Medicare Advantage) in plain language.
  • Experience using hold, transfer and queue features in a phone system while navigating a CRM or patient management system.
  • Calm, empathetic and professional with older adults, caregivers and frustrated callers.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate, timely documentation.
  • Available 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace suitable for confidential patient calls.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telehealth, cardiac rehab, or other healthcare enrollment settings.
  • Experience in a metrics-driven environment (answer rate, first-call resolution, scheduling conversion).

Contract Details

  • Contract Type: 1099 Contractor
  • Schedule: 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday (about 40 hours/week)
  • Compensation: $25/hour
  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based)

*Note: This is a 1099 contractor position

About the Role

Anovia is looking for a Project Engineer to deliver Microsoft 365, identity, and migration projects for our clients. This is hands-on cloud engineering, not advisory work: you build and harden tenants, untangle hybrid identity, manage devices through Intune, and move mail, files, and users between platforms without losing data or a weekend.

You will work across many client tenants at once, typically with two to five projects running in parallel at different stages. Each project is yours to execute — discovery, build, pilot, cutover, handover — with a senior engineer available for architecture calls.

The experience bar

• 5-10 years in IT overall, with at least 2 years administering Microsoft 365 and Entra IDacross more than one organization or tenant.

• At least five migrations you personally executed— mailbox, tenant-to-tenant, file, or Active Directory domain — with the tooling you used named.

• You own the technical execution and escalate architecture decisions. You are not expected to design a client's identity strategy from scratch; you are expected to implement one correctly and spot when it is wrong.

What you'll do

Migrations

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

• Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens, and hold to them.

• Reconcile what actually moved against what was supposed to move, and chase the difference.

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

• Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens and hold to them.

• Reconcile what moved against what was supposed to move and chase the difference.

Azure and endpoints

Delivery and handover

• Write the as-built documentation into IT Glue and brief the service desk, so nothing undocumented is left behind.

• Keep project time and status current in the PSA so account managers can see where things stand.

• Join client calls to explain what is changing, what will briefly break, and when.

Required qualifications

All four of the pillars below are required. Within each, you should be able to do most of what is listed without supervision.

1. Microsoft 365 administration

• Exchange Online: mail flow, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, mailbox delegation, message trace, retention basics

• Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover

• SharePoint Online and OneDrive: site and library creation, permission inheritance, sharing policies, sync troubleshooting

• Microsoft Teams: provisioning, guest access, and how Teams relates to the SharePoint site behind it

• Microsoft 365 admin center, license assignment, and group-based licensing

2. Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

• Users, groups, dynamic groups, administrative roles and units

• Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync: installation, OU and attribute filtering, and resolving sync errors

• Hybrid join versus Entra join, and when each applies

• Conditional Access policy design, MFA rollout, SSPR, and why security defaults are not enough

• Enterprise applications and SAML or OIDC single sign-on

3. Azure

• Virtual machines, virtual networks, NSGs, public IPs, site-to-site VPN

• Azure Files with AD DS or Entra authentication; Azure Virtual Desktop basics

• Azure Backup and Recovery Services vaults

• Subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, and enough cost management to not surprise a client

4. Intune

• Enrollment: Windows Autopilot, co-management, BYOD, Apple and Android enrollment

• Compliance policies, configuration profiles, and the Settings Catalog

• App deployment: Win32 packaging (.intunewin), Store apps, and line-of-business apps

• BitLocker policy and Defender for Endpoint onboarding

• Update rings and Windows Update for Business

5. Migration delivery— demonstrable experience in at least two of:

• On-premises Exchange to Exchange Online: cutover, staged, or hybrid using the Hybrid Configuration Wizard

• Tenant-to-tenant migration following an acquisition, divestiture, or rebrand

• Google Workspace or IMAP to Microsoft 365

• File server or NAS to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, or Teams

• Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain

• Another MDM platform into Intune

6. Windows Server and AD DS

• Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file and print services

• Hyper-V setup and configuration

7. PowerShell

• Bulk operations against Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, and Entra

• You read and modify scripts rather than only running ones you found

8. Working style

• Experience working on a fully remote team.

• Client-facing: comfortable explaining a downtime window to a non-technical stakeholder.

• Documentation discipline — across many tenants, undocumented work is lost work.

• Available for scheduled after-hours and weekend cutover windows.

• Prior MSP or multi-client experience.

Required qualifications

• Security and compliance:Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery), Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Secure Score remediation, CIS benchmarks, HIPAA or CMMC-adjacent client work

• Privileged identity:Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, entitlement management

Helpful Qualifications

• Hypervisors:VMware ESXi, Nutanix Acropolis

• Other platforms:AWS, Google Workspace administration, Egnyte, Citrix ShareFile, Cloudflare, QuickBooks Online

• Apple ecosystem:macOS and iOS deployment, Apple Business Manager, Jamf, Mosyle, or Intune for Mac

• Network and edge:SonicWall and Fortinet firewalls, Cisco Meraki and Ubiquiti wireless, Cisco and Dell switching

• Storage:QNAP, Synology, and Dell NAS, particularly as a migration source

• MSP tooling:ConnectWise Manage and Automate, Sention, Autotask, Kaseya, NinjaOne, Datto RMM, IT Glue, Hudu; multi-tenant M365 administration tools such as Nerdio, inforcer, CIPP; password management such as Keeper; M365 migration tools such as BitTitan.

The Opportunity

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, partnering closely with C-level executives and business leaders to set financial and operational goals and budgets, track performance, and translate results into actionable insights. This role connects financial and operational information across the organization, ensuring the right stakeholders have the context they need to make timely, informed decisions. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

Who You Are

You’re an intellectually curious, proactive finance professional who enjoys connecting the dots and turning complex information into clear, actionable insights. You combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to build credibility and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including C-level executives.

You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and moving forward without perfect information. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and have the confidence to surface risks, opportunities, and differing perspectives when they matter.

Delivery Lead

﻿Location: United States, remote/home-based

Our client provides full-stack enterprise AI solutions built on their agentic data platform. They help large enterprises solve complex business problems that require AI, infrastructure, and cross-functional data working together, the kind of problems that do not fit neatly inside a single team, system, or department. The client's flagship account is a multi-billion-dollar conglomerate in Vietnam spanning banking, aviation, and real estate, helping the group take on one of the hardest problems a conglomerate can face: establishing a single, trusted notion of "customer" across independently run subsidiaries so the group can pursue cross-business initiatives that were previously out of reach. Our client is growing quickly, building a global delivery team with people based in both Vietnam and the US, and are just getting started on their domestic client base.

Our client is in search of a Delivery Lead to take executive ownership of the overall client delivery relationship on an established international account and to help build the delivery organization that will support company growth. This is a senior, client-facing leadership role for someone who has run complex, multi-workstream programs inside a top-tier consulting firm or GSI, is skilled at holding a distributed team accountable for outcomes rather than executing the work personally, and is comfortable managing distributed, majority-offshore teams.

The Delivery Lead will initially take executive ownership of a flagship Vietnam engagement, helping their client establish a unified view of the customer across its subsidiaries and deliver on the group-level initiatives that depend on it. A Vietnam-based Director, who runs day-to-day delivery execution, and a Technical Program Manager (with two additional hires in process) will report directly into this role; the Delivery Lead is accountable for the quality and pace of that execution without performing it personally. The Delivery Lead will travel to Vietnam roughly once a month for a week at a time to maintain the in-person relationships that anchor the account. Over time, this role has a clear path to build out and lead a global delivery function spanning both our international and, as they build out their domestic sales motion, US-based accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hold executive accountability for the overall client delivery relationship, ensuring the cross-subsidiary customer resolution initiative at the core of our platform work, and all supporting workstreams, are governed, on schedule, and aligned to client expectations

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-workstream technology or business transformation programs from initiation through delivery

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA)—the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin–Madison—is seeking an Associate Director of Development to expand major gift fundraising with the UW Libraries and the UW Parent Philanthropy Program.

You’ll manage a portfolio of prospects, cultivate relationships with high‑priority alumni, parents, and other friends of the university, and secure significant philanthropic commitments to support UW–Madison. Success in this position requires strong relationship‑building skills, sound judgment, and the ability to represent a wide range of campus priorities with clarity and purpose.

This role offers a unique dual appointment supporting two growing and exciting programs at the university. Half of the position will work closely with the UW Libraries Dean and senior staff to enhance the unit’s advancement and major gifts program, while the other half will focus on fundraising with UW Parents. The position will join a growing team of Directors of Development focused on university-wide fundraising priorities. You will collaborate closely with colleagues to identify opportunities, develop strategies for both programs, and strengthen engagement with under-engaged prospect pools.

Who is WFAA?The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is a private, nonprofit corporation that encourages individuals and organizations to make gifts to the university and to connect with the UW. In 2014, the UW Foundation merged with the Wisconsin Alumni Association® to better serve a growing population of UW alumni and donors. We believe that private support grows out of good relationships between campus leaders, faculty and program staff who need support, and the alumni and friends who want to invest in UW–Madison. We provide important engagement opportunities to link UW–Madison alumni to each other and to their alma mater, building a strong community of Badgers.

Diversity and Inclusion:

Just as the university community benefits from differing viewpoints, perspectives, and experiences, inclusion and diversity are imperative for the success of our mission. WFAA values people and the differences that they bring to the organization, and creates an environment in which all staff members and constituents feel respected and have opportunities to thrive.

Essential Functions

Major Gift Development:

  • Implement development strategies for both the UW Libraries and for UW Parents, managing a portfolio of prospects and donors in varying stages of involvement to advance them strategically through the development continuum.
  • Educate potential donors about philanthropy and the case for supporting the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
  • Artfully ask for the right gift, at the right time, in the right way, being mindful of both the donor’s philanthropic passions and university priorities
  • Plan and implement recognition for donors, such as writing thank yous, making personal calls, arranging meetings, delivering stewardship reports and gifts, hosting events, etc.
  • Understand the mission and needs of the University and articulate them effectively to potential donors and volunteers

Campus Relations

  • Curate and review data to understand fundraising opportunities for your unit and make recommendations accordingly. Request data/reports from WFAA to meet needs of donors and campus staff as needed.
  • Build strong relationships with UW Libraries staff and maintain a knowledge base about the unit, such as news, gift opportunities, and donor stories.
  • Prep and staff UW Libraries Dean and other senior staff for donor engagements.
  • Communicate, problem solve, and anticipate needs of UW Libraries campus staff regarding accounting for donor created funds and serve as liaison between WFAA accounting department and campus staff.

Collaborative and Administrative

  • Take initiative to become familiar university-wide fundraising priorities and ensure strong internal working relationships with programmatic leads across WFAA.
  • Support and offer feedback on alumni and parent engagement activities when needed.
  • Prepare briefings and other reports for volunteers, campus partners and WFAA.
  • Utilize WFAA’s customer relationship management (CRM) tool to plan, implement and record all development-related activity in a timely manner. This includes regular progress reports on prospect qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Plan and execute travel arrangements with responsibility for tracking and submitting related expense reports.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional work experience
  • 1 + years of professional fundraising/ development experience or related experience.
  • Experience and demonstrated success in fundraising or related activities.
  • Excellent oral, written, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills required.
  • Ability work in evenings on occasion for key events and meet travel requirements (up to 25%).

Other Qualifications:

  • College degree, or equivalent preferred.
  • Ability to articulate the case for private support with sufficient effectiveness so that individuals understand the vision and strategy of the Center and choose to invest in the vision.
  • Ability to work independently, in addition to as a member of an effective development team.

At WFAA, we are dedicated to creating an inspiring, creative, and respectful work environment for our employees. We offer competitive pay and an outstanding benefits program, including a generous 10% 401k contribution after just one year of service! Join us and be part of a team that values your growth and well-being. Click here to learn more about our employee benefits!

Its legal corporate name is registered as the University of Wisconsin Foundation.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

This may not be the right role for you if:

  • You aren’t willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You aren’t a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won’t get us there.

In this role, you will:

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Location: Remote – UK or EU (independent contractor engagement)

About Us

MobileAction is a leading app growth and analytics platform that has been empowering developers, marketers, and global brands to make smarter decisions across the mobile ecosystem since 2013. Powered by large-scale data, machine learning, and AI, our products span ASO, Apple Ads automation, competitive intelligence, and market analytics, supporting over $2 billion in Apple Ads spend in 2026, with enterprise customers including Google, Meta, Spotify, and Grammarly.

In 2026, MobileAction joined InMobi, one of the world's leading advertising and AI technology companies, accelerating our mission to build next-generation mobile growth solutions. At MobileAction, you'll work alongside talented teams, help some of the world's leading mobile companies grow, and make a direct impact on customer success.

About the Role

    We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to help mobile app advertisers and agencies grow with Apple Ads. Apple Ads will be your primary sales focus, and you'll play a key role in expanding its reach across the mobile advertising market.

    Beyond Apple Ads, you'll have the opportunity to leverage InMobi's broader advertising portfolio, including InMobi DSP, Glance, Accelerate, and Bing Ads. When an advertiser could benefit from solutions beyond Apple Ads, you'll be well positioned to identify the opportunity and collaborate with the relevant InMobi teams to bring those solutions to market.

    This is a quota-carrying, new-business-focused sales role where your impact is visible and measurable through the media spend and revenue you help generate and grow. Reporting to the Head of Sales, you'll own the commercial sales journey, from prospecting and initial conversations to launching test campaigns, negotiating budgets, and closing deals. You'll also work closely with Account Management, Ad Operations, Customer Success, and Product teams to turn successful partnerships into long-term, scalable business.

    This role is a great fit if you have a background in digital advertising, particularly in mobile user acquisition, whether at a DSP, ad network, ad platform, MMP, or performance marketing agency, and enjoy building relationships with the people responsible for user acquisition budgets.

What You'll Do

  • Drive new business acquisition by identifying, engaging, and converting mobile app advertisers and agencies across verticals such as gaming, fintech, e-commerce, and subscription apps.

  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, your professional network, inbound opportunities, agency relationships, and industry events.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery to presenting solutions, launching test campaigns, negotiating budgets, and closing deals.

  • Develop and grow relationships with UA leaders, growth teams, marketing decision-makers, and agencies responsible for mobile advertising budgets.

  • Work closely with Account Management and Ad Operations to turn successful test campaigns into scaled, long-term Apple Ads partnerships.

  • Bring MobileAction's data, automation, and ASO capabilities into your sales conversations to demonstrate how advertisers can maximise the value of their Apple Ads investments.

  • Identify cross-selling opportunities for InMobi's broader advertising portfolio, including InMobi DSP, Glance, Accelerate, and Bing Ads, collaborating with the relevant teams to develop additional business opportunities.

  • Build compelling, performance-driven business cases using metrics such as CPI, CPA, ROAS, and LTV.

  • Develop commercial strategies to increase advertiser investment, expand existing partnerships, and achieve revenue and media spend targets.

  • Share market intelligence, advertiser feedback, and competitive insights with Product and Marketing teams to help shape product development and positioning.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data in the CRM to ensure clear visibility into commercial performance.

  • Represent MobileAction and InMobi at industry events, conferences, and agency meetings, with occasional travel as required.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, with a strong commercial background in sales, business development, or client-facing roles at a DSP, ad network, ad platform, MMP, or performance marketing agency.

  • Proven track record of acquiring new advertisers, closing deals, and achieving or exceeding commercial targets.

  • Experience growing advertising budgets and turning initial test campaigns into scaled, recurring partnerships.

  • Strong understanding of mobile user acquisition and performance marketing metrics, including CPI, CPA, ROAS, and LTV.

  • Ability to build relationships with UA leaders, growth teams, and agencies, and engage decision-makers responsible for user acquisition budgets.

  • Strong negotiation, consultative selling, and closing skills.

  • Experience managing sales pipelines, maintaining accurate forecasts, and working with CRM systems.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in an international environment.

  • A proactive, results-driven mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Apple Ads, either as a seller, agency, or advertiser.

  • Experience selling programmatic, DSP, or search advertising solutions.

  • Familiarity with ASO, app intelligence, or SaaS platforms serving mobile marketers.

  • Knowledge of mobile attribution and measurement tools such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch.

  • An established network among mobile app advertisers, UA leaders, growth teams, and performance agencies.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Familiarity with sales tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Gong.

Our Culture

  • Open, collaborative, and high-trust environment.

  • Fast-moving startup mindset with global-scale impact.

  • Motivated, supportive, and collaborative teammates.

  • Strong focus on customer success, ownership, and continuous learning.

  • Continuous feedback and transparent communication.

  • Impatient with Actions, Patient with Results.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with an attractive commission structure and performance-based incentives.

  • Fully remote contractor engagement from the UK or EU countries.

  • Company-provided laptop

  • Flexible working hours.

  • An English-speaking, multinational work environment.

  • Access to online learning and professional development resources.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about mobile advertising and excited to help the world's leading mobile companies grow, we'd love to hear from you. Join a fast-moving, global team where your ideas matter and your impact is visible from day one.

Apply now and let's build the next generation of mobile growth together.

Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

excerpt: Команда продуктових аналітиків Київстар. Тех в пошуку Senior Product Analyst.
description:
Команда продуктових аналітиків Київстар.Тех в пошуку Senior Product Analyst. Ти майже з нами, якщо мислиш продуктовими метриками, вільно працюєш з SQL і Python, пишеш промпти не гірше, ніж запити з хитрими JOIN’ами, і вмієш перетворити бізнес-питання на аналітику, за якою ухвалюють рішення.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech – українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв'язку.
Наша місія – змінювати життя в Україні та в світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.
Понад 700 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та веб-рішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.
Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен з нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Які виклики долатимемо разом

  • Підтримка та розвиток data-driven культури: ми приймаємо рішення не «тому що нам так подобається», а «тому що дані / результати експериментів на це вказують»
  • Оптимізація маркетингу на основі даних: побудова ad-level звітності, розрахунок крос-продуктових конверсій в розрізі маркетингу, робота з авдиторіями, активна участь у навчанні рекламних алгоритмів через якісні сигнали (мікро- та макроконверсії)
  • Побудова системи алертингу за ключовими сигналами життєдіяльності продуктів та маркетингу (бізнес-аномалії, якість даних тощо)
  • Побудова аналітичного self-service: створення інструментів для самостійної роботи команд із даними, в тому числі через ШІ-агентів, побудова культури взаємодії з ними
  • Аналітика мультипродуктової екосистеми:
  • проєктування таксономії з урахуванням потреби в оцінці крос-продуктових флоу (почав шлях на сайті, закінчив у додатку)
  • побудова моделі атрибуції: як маркетингової, так і між продуктами
  • рахуємо не тільки маркетингову атрибуцію, а й крос-продуктову
  • робота з безліччю джерел: Google Analytics, Amplitude, рекламні кабінети, зовнішні API, DWH
  • побудова та оптимізація дата-пайплайнів у Airflow (MWAA)
  • аналіз бізнес-ініціатив: є багато ідей для покращень і обмежений ресурс на розробку, ти будеш проводити критичний аналіз цих ініціатив з точки зору бізнесу

Де очікуємо твою проактивність

  • Не просто закриваєш таски, а розумієш, як живе продукт, допомагаєш команді ставити правильні питання та шукати відповіді на них і будуєш системні рішення там, де бачиш повторюваність
  • Не кажеш «працює — не чіпаю», а валідуєш відповідність рішення задачі й за потреби змінюєш існуючі процеси

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • Відмінне знання продуктових метрик та принципів роботи продукту з бізнесової точки зору
  • Досвід проєктування/налаштування продуктової чи веб-аналітики
  • Впевнене володіння SQL для аналізу великих масивів даних, уміння оптимізувати запити та шукати ресурсоємні місця в них
  • Уміння використовувати Python для автоматизації збору та обробки даних, зокрема для роботи з API та інтеграції даних з різних джерел
  • Досвід створення дашбордів і звітів в BI-інструментах (Looker Studio / Power BI)
  • Досвід проведення A/B/n-тестів для оптимізації продукту
  • Здатність ефективно працювати в команді, генерувати гіпотези та пояснювати складні речі простими словами

Плюсом стане

  • Досвід роботи з Google BigQuery (включно з оптимізацією витрат)
  • Досвід роботи з API рекламних платформ (Google, Meta, TikTok та інші)
  • Досвід роботи з Google Analytics і Google Tag Manager включно з написанням кастомного JavaScript для налаштування відстеження подій та ecommerce-аналітики
  • Досвід роботи з Amplitude (графіки, когорти, дашборди, агенти)
  • Досвід роботи з Apache Airflow

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Ремоут онбординг.
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі).
  • Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека.
  • Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників.
  • Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог.
  • Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок Київстар.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Go-To-Market AI product team builds the internal products our sellers, customer success managers, and support reps use every day. As Director, AI Product Management (GTM), you will own an AI-powered GTM platform that creates a step change in impact, brings in new ways of working, centralizes data and insights, and acts as the foundational system for our GTM organization—from problem identification to development, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Functioning much like a general manager with product at the core, this broad leadership role requires you to build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers while driving enablement, cross-functional alignment, and strategic execution.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our internal AI-native GTM platform, and be accountable for whether the business adopts it.
  • Manage the platform as one portfolio, so every part of it shares the same data, intelligence and building blocks, and users get one consistent experience.
  • Build an AI-native product practice. Take the best of traditional product management, such as PRDs, prioritization, launch readiness and measurement, and reinvent it with AI so the team moves faster and builds better.
  • Understand internal users' problems and analyze data to identify what to build, sometimes finding the need before users can articulate it.
  • Write clear requirements and partner closely with engineering, which leads technical implementation, to deliver a high-quality product. Make sure you and your team test the product firsthand.
  • Keep pace with an engineering team that moves fast and ships at high velocity. Gather input from the field quickly, turn it into a clear direction for engineering, and use AI to shorten the loop from feedback to shipped improvement.
  • Define what quality means for AI products, including accuracy, trust, evaluation and human review, and hold every release to that bar.
  • Drive adoption by coaching sellers and partnering with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing, and measure the business impact of what you ship.
  • Set clear, measurable goals for adoption, productivity and business impact, instrument the product to track them, and use the results to decide what to build next.
  • Resolve cross-functional dependencies, such as aligning teams on shared datasets with Data Engineering or getting Product Marketing content into the AI knowledge base, and take on the analytics and operational work needed to make the product succeed.
  • Use AI tools in your own work to build prototypes and mini-apps that engineers can take forward into production, and apply AI to improve how Samsara's go-to-market teams work. Hands-on AI experience is a requirement for this role.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team of product managers.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, or in strategy and operations roles where you owned a product built with engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience leading, developing and mentoring product managers or product-oriented teams, while staying close to execution.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an internal or business-facing product, including defining the problem, working with engineering to deliver it, driving adoption and showing measurable business impact.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, such as building or shipping AI-enabled products, using AI tools in your own work, or prototyping with them.
  • Strong analytical skills, with examples of using data to identify problems, shape product decisions and measure results.
  • Technical fluency and ability to establish credibility with engineers.
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with a record of driving work to completion across teams and stakeholders.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience owning internal tools or AI products used by sales, customer success or other go-to-market teams.
  • Familiarity with the systems and data that run a go-to-market organization, such as CRM, forecasting and sales enablement tools.
  • Experience defining quality, evaluation and trust standards for AI products.
  • Experience coaching end users and working with enablement teams to get a new tool used.
  • Experience leading product teams that use AI throughout their own work, from research and requirements to prototyping and launch.
  • Comfort with fast-changing priorities and with the cross-functional alignment that a company at Samsara's scale requires.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$157,080—$280,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Data Scientist – AI-Driven Financial Crime Detection

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

title: Capture Engineer
excerpt: About Nava Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective.
description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position summary

The Capture Engineer is a territory-based specialist and the primary client-facing role within Nava’s State BD function. This role owns the full capture loop within an assigned portfolio of states - from first signal through close - developing state-specific strategies, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, translating market intelligence into qualified leads, and coordinating cross-functionally to position Nava as the preferred partner before RFPs drop.


The Capture Engineer role brings increased technical rigor, AI-native operating habits, and self-reliance in generating materials and running outbound strategy. The role is designed to compress the specialist-handoff architecture that previously split relationship coverage, technical credibility, and pursuit strategy across multiple people.

What you'll do

Territory Strategy & Capture Planning

  • Own a portfolio of 3–5 states; develop and maintain a territory capture plan for each state defining ICPs, political context, trigger conditions, relationship maps, assets in market, and 90-day activity plans
  • Develop state-specific win strategies that include identification of target opportunities, understanding of political and procurement context, and prioritized next actions
  • Translate market intelligence from the RevOps/BD Analyst layer into qualified leads and recommended actions tied to specific opportunities
  • Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, and working sessions with state agency stakeholders; pull in Solutions Architects only where technical depth genuinely requires it
  • Conduct pre-RFP requirement shaping conversations with agency stakeholders to define procurement requirements that favor Nava’s approach

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain warm, trust-based relationships with 8–12 state agency contacts per territory, including economic buyers, technical evaluators, political blockers, and internal champions
  • Deliver value-additive touchpoints to stakeholders — peer state intelligence, federal guidance, relevant case studies — without explicit asks
  • Hold credible conversations with state CIOs and agency program directors on agency strategic priorities, federal compliance environment, technical architecture, and operational challenges without needing a lifeline
  • Represent Nava at relevant conferences, state-level events, and industry gatherings within assigned territories

AI-Native Content & Asset Generation

  • Self-generate outbound materials including one-pagers, briefing packets, state-specific capability summaries, and demo assets using AI-native tools and Nava’s institutional knowledge base
  • Develop product-based wedge materials — prototypes, demonstration assets, and click-engagement content — that support the state product-led go-to-market motion
  • Operate with an AI-first orientation across intelligence gathering, asset creation, synthesis, and outbound strategy; use AI tools to reduce time on tasks that do not require human judgment

Pursuit & Pipeline Contribution

  • Own win theme development and pursuit strategy on below-threshold opportunities; co-lead with the Capture Manager on above-threshold pursuits
  • Surface opportunity signals into the pipeline — budget shifts, personnel changes, federal compliance pressure, peer state movements — each tied to a recommended next action
  • Coordinate with RevOps so intelligence flows bidirectionally, oriented to the territory capture plan
  • Identify when a POC or product demonstration is the right next move; design and lead those engagements with Solutions Architect depth pulled in as needed

Required skills

  • Experience: 3–7 years in a client-facing, capture, business development, or territory management role in a government technology, civic tech, or public sector consulting environment
  • Government & program fluency: Working knowledge of state government agency operations, federal compliance environment, and the programs Nava serves (SNAP, Medicaid, UI, PFML, child care). Able to hold substantive conversations with agency leaders without needing a subject matter expert in the room
  • Technical credibility: Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with technical buyers (state CIOs, CDOs, agency architects) on implementation approach, data systems, and technology modernization. Does not require engineering depth, but must demonstrate enough technical fluency to engage credibly when technical questions arise
  • Capture & sales motion evidence: Track record of building relationships in a government procurement context, shaping requirements pre-RFP, and developing win strategies on competitive pursuits
  • AI-native orientation: Active user of AI tools for research, writing, synthesis, and outbound asset generation. Treats AI as a core productivity layer, not a novelty
  • Self-reliance & high motor: Proactively generates assets, surfaces insights, and moves territory strategy forward without needing to be directed. Comfortable producing first drafts and prototype materials independently
  • Mission alignment: Genuine orientation toward the mission of improving how government serves people
  • Directional familiarity with the civic tech ecosystem (NASWA, APHSA, Code for America, NASCIO)

Desired skills

  • Experience at a civic tech organization or digital service alumni
  • Background in or strong network into one or more geographic priority states: NY, CA, CO, MA, VA, NJ, MN, PA
  • Experience with product-led go-to-market motions, including POC design, demo facilitation, or prototype-based business development
  • Familiarity with Shipley or similar capture/proposal methodologies
  • Prior experience transitioning from a delivery or technical role into a client-facing or BD capacity

    Role is eligible for a performance-based bonus of up to 10–20% of base salary (role/level dependent), tied to individual quota attainment, in addition to base salary.

Compensation
$119,700—$147,600 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
Please contact the recruiting team at if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.
