description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for a Software Architect (I6) to define, evolve, and drive the next-generation architecture for Avalara Tax Research (ATR)—Avalara’s premier, AI-centric self-service tax research platform providing rules, rates, taxability insights, and AI-assisted research experiences across Indirect Tax, Direct Tax, and Trade.

ATR operates at the intersection of high-scale cloud services, information-dense domain content, and cutting-edge generative AI workflows. In this domain, precision is paramount: tax research demands authoritative, citation-backed accuracy where hallucination is unacceptable.

As a Software Architect, you will shape how ATR scales across microservices, data pipelines, domain knowledge graphs, and multi-agent AI architectures. You will be hands-on with reference implementations and proof-of-concepts while exercising high-order communication and influence—collaborating across engineering pods, negotiating API contracts and integration protocols with cross-functional platform teams, and establishing pragmatic architecture roadmaps.

How This Role Elevates Avalara:

Team:

  • Establishes robust platform patterns, domain-driven service boundaries, and clear technical direction across multiple engineering squads.

  • Raises the engineering bar through hands-on reference designs, rigorous architecture reviews, and mentorship of Staff engineers and Tech Leads.

  • Reduces accidental complexity and technical debt by standardizing microservice design, event-driven interfaces, and AI orchestration protocols.

Business:

  • Accelerates time-to-market for premier AI capabilities across Indirect, Direct, and Trade tax domains without compromising reliability, compliance, or cost efficiency.

  • Strengthens Avalara’s competitive moat by transforming vast, complex tax repositories into high-confidence, programmatic APIs and agentic research workflows.

Customer:

  • Delivers rapid, resilient, and citation-backed research experiences that tax professionals and automated systems can trust implicitly.

  • Translates advanced AI and retrieval architectures into verifiable, audit-proof answers with transparent provenance and sub-second performance.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Architecture & Microservices Strategy

  • Own and evolve the target-state architecture for ATR across microservices, data ingestion, search/retrieval, and AI agent layers.

  • Architect high-throughput, low-latency, resilient distributed microservices utilizing modern cloud-native stacks (Go, PostgreSQL, vector stores, distributed streaming, and event-driven messaging).

  • Define clean service boundaries, gRPC/REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, and integration protocols across disparate domain subsystems.

AI-Native, Multi-Agent & Grounded Retrieval Systems

  • Lead the architecture for ATR’s AI-native capabilities, including advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, semantic routing, and citation attribution pipelines designed for information-dense content.

  • Architect multi-turn, multi-agent systems and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations where domain-specialized agents collaborate to decompose complex research queries and execute structured tax workflows.

  • Integrate continuous AI evaluation, observability, and guardrail frameworks (e.g., Arize or equivalent LLM eval platforms) to measure, benchmark, and systematically improve answer quality, grounding fidelity, and latency.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Technical Influence

  • Serve as the technical authority and primary architecture liaison across engineering pods, product management, security, SRE, and adjacent platform teams.

  • Negotiate integration protocols, contract schemas, and shared infrastructure boundaries with clarity and pragmatic engineering judgment.

  • Translate business strategy into phased architectural blueprints, RFCs, and delivery milestones aligned with organizational operating models (AIM30).

Hands-On Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Build proof-of-concepts (PoCs), reference implementations, and scaffolding for novel agentic workflows, caching strategies, and data access layers.

  • Partner with tax content engineering stakeholders to design ingestion and normalization pipelines for highly structured and unstructured legal/tax datasets.

  • Champion non-functional requirements (NFRs): multi-tenancy isolation, secrets management, role-based access control (RBAC), operational observability, disaster recovery, and cost-to-serve optimization.

 

12-Month Success Signals:

  • Verifiable Accuracy & Grounding: Citation fidelity and answer grounding metrics reach industry-leading accuracy benchmarks with automated evaluation pipelines actively catching regressions.

  • Architectural Cohesion: Service boundaries and API contracts across ATR’s core microservices and domain-specific agents are clearly defined, reducing cross-team delivery dependencies.

  • Multi-Agent & Workflow Maturity: A scalable multi-agent and workflow orchestration framework is established in production, enabling multi-turn research and tool-calling capabilities.

  • Engineering Velocity: Reusable service templates, reference implementations, and standardized evaluation patterns measurably reduce the onboarding and feature delivery time for engineering pods.

  • Operational Rigor: System reliability, P99 latency, and cost-per-query targets meet or exceed established SLA/SLO thresholds under growing enterprise workloads.

AI Expectations:

Avalara is an AI-first company, and ATR is a flagship AI product. Every senior technical leader is expected to demonstrate role-relevant AI leadership:

  • Architecting for Accuracy: Designing retrieval and agent architectures that prioritize grounding, transparency, and provenance over unvalidated generation.

  • Systematic Evaluation: Leveraging automated evals and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to optimize prompts, context windows, chunking strategies, and model selection.

  • Engineering Productivity: Championing agentic development tools and AI-assisted workflows within engineering teams to accelerate code quality, testing, and architecture exploration.

  • Safety & Responsible AI: Implementing robust guardrails for prompt injection defense, data privacy, tenant isolation, and auditability.

What You'll Need to be Successful

What You'll Need to be Successful:

  • Education & Experience: B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, with 10+ years of progressive software engineering and distributed systems experience.

  • Leadership Level: Proven track record as a Staff+ Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Software Architect (I6 equivalent) driving architecture for enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

  • Distributed Microservices Mastery: Deep, hands-on expertise designing, building, and deploying microservices architectures in production using modern back-end languages (e.g., Go, Java, or C#) and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).

  • Applied AI & Information-Dense Retrieval: Demonstrated experience building production-grade RAG and AI applications over dense, authoritative content domains. Strong understanding of embeddings, vector databases, hybrid lexical/semantic search, and chunking/re-ranking strategies.

  • Evaluation & Quality Benchmarking: Hands-on familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (e.g., Arize, Ragas, Phoenix, TruLens, or LangSmith) to benchmark hallucination rates, retrieval precision, and answer relevance.

  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: High-order verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to author crisp architectural design records (ADRs/RFCs), align diverse stakeholders, and negotiate cross-team technical contracts.

  • Security & Cloud Resiliency: Thorough understanding of cloud-native design, container orchestration (Kubernetes), API gateways/service mesh, zero-trust security, and observability (metrics, tracing, structured logs).

Preferred/Nice-to-Have

  • Experience architecting multi-agent systems, agent coordination protocols, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or graph-based workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines).

  • Experience with domain-driven design for complex metadata, knowledge graphs, or regulatory/compliance document repositories.

  • Familiarity with enterprise search engines (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) combined with dense retrieval vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus).

Bar Raiser Expectations:

At Avalara, architects must raise the bar through quality, ownership, judgment, simplification, and measurable business impact:

  • Leave it Better: Elevate ATR’s platform architecture, code quality, and engineering standards well beyond the baseline.

  • Coach & Multiply: Raise the technical trajectory of engineers and leads through active coaching, empathetic design reviews, and leading by technical example.

  • Simplify Complexity: Distill intricate multi-domain tax and AI problems into clean abstractions, clear decision criteria, and executable milestones.

Who We Are

OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.

With 33 offices and distribution centers and more than 1,400 field service professionals, OWL delivers on a service platform that includes construction, compliance and testing, maintenance and repair, modernization and re-imaging, and EV charging solutions to keep businesses and people moving 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

Come join us! For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn.

The Role:

The Vice President of Finance – Critical Infrastructure will serve as a strategic finance partner and key member of the segment leadership team, supporting a group of 3–4 business units with approximately $300–400 million in combined annual revenue.

Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this individual will partner closely with Regional Vice Presidents and business unit leadership to drive financial performance, improve profitability and support strategic business decisions. This role goes beyond traditional financial reporting, requiring a leader who can translate financial results into actionable business insights and identify opportunities to improve margins, productivity and working capital.

The VP of Finance will lead and develop a team of Business Unit Controllers and their respective finance teams, ensuring strong financial controls, accurate reporting and consistent financial processes across the segment.

This is a highly visible leadership position requiring a balance of strong technical accounting knowledge, financial planning and analysis, operational partnership and people leadership. The ideal candidate is comfortable challenging business leaders, understanding the details behind financial performance and helping drive long-term business growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a strategic financial partner to Regional Vice Presidents and business unit leadership, supporting business planning, budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial strategy.
  • Lead, mentor and develop 3–4 Business Unit Controllers and their respective finance teams, building a high-performing organization focused on accountability, analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Analyze financial and operational results to identify trends, risks and opportunities before they impact business performance.
  • Partner with operational leaders to identify and implement EBITDA improvement initiatives, including margin enhancement, pricing strategies, labor productivity, vendor management and working capital improvements.
  • Oversee financial forecasting and reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial information is delivered to executive leadership.
  • Lead monthly financial and business performance reviews, providing insight into financial results, operational trends and recommended actions.
  • Develop and monitor key financial and operational performance indicators to support better decision-making across the business units.
  • Challenge financial assumptions, forecasts and business plans through detailed analysis and collaboration with operational leadership.
  • Oversee monthly close processes, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial controls across the segment.
  • Ensure consistent application of accounting policies and procedures, including percentage-of-completion (POC) accounting and revenue recognition requirements.
  • Support mergers and acquisitions, including financial due diligence, integration activities and post-acquisition performance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize financial processes, improve reporting capabilities and establish best practices across business units.
  • Provide financial guidance and support for pricing decisions, business development opportunities, capital investments and other strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with corporate finance, accounting, FP&A and other executive leadership teams.
  • Conduct regular site visits to business units and field locations to develop a strong understanding of operations and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support annual audits, compliance requirements and other financial or operational initiatives as needed.

Requirements and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field required.
  • CPA and/or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including leadership responsibility within a complex business environment.
  • Experience leading Controllers, accounting leaders or finance teams across multiple business units or locations.
  • Strong understanding of percentage-of-completion (POC) accounting, project-based financial operations and revenue recognition.
  • Experience with financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling and variance analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with operational leaders and influence business decisions through financial analysis and reporting.
  • Experience identifying and implementing initiatives to improve profitability, EBITDA, margins and working capital.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, accounting policies and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed, multi-entity, construction, infrastructure or project-based services environment strongly preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience developing financial dashboards, KPIs and management reporting.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop teams, delegate effectively and drive accountability.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial information to both financial and non-financial audiences.
  • Ability to travel regularly to business unit and field locations, including quarterly visits and additional travel as business needs require.

  • HSA and FSA

description:
Senior FDA Compliance Analyst

Reports to: Head of Third Party Services

Position Summary

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

Core Responsibilities

FDA Regulatory Compliance

  • Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
  • Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

Program Development & Standardization

  • Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
  • Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
  • Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

Auditing & Compliance Monitoring

  • Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
  • Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
  • Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
  • Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

FDA Inspection Readiness

  • Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
  • Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
  • Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
  • Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
  • Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

Education & Training

  • Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
  • Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
  • Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
  • Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

Integration & New Practice Support

  • Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.
  • Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
  • Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
  • Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
  • Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
  • Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
  • Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
  • Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
  • Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

Preferred

  • Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
  • Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
  • Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
  • Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

description:
This role is open to applicants living in the Philippines.

Operations Assistant VA

Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse

Why This Role Matters
Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running.

What You'll Do
• Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval.
• Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed.
• Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list.
• Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication.
• Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company.
• Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery.
• Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned.

Problems You Will Solve
• Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way.
• Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover.
• Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework.
• Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border.
• Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time.

How Success is Measured
• Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month
• Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline
• Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment
• Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery

Why You'll Love It Here
At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up.

Who You Are
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required)
• Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required)
• Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)
• Comfortable with international shipping basics: freight, tariffs, customs declarations, and product classifications
• Strong written English and the persistence to keep vendors responsive across time zones
• Highly organized with a process-driven mindset and commitment to follow-through

Bonus points if you have:

  • Background in the life sciences, biotechnology, or laboratory supplies industry
    • Experience importing from overseas suppliers, including container consolidation and vendor communication on WeChat

About Filtrous
Founded in 2017, Filtrous delivers speed, quality, and value to agile labs. We're a lab supplies distributor serving laboratories across a wide range of scientific and industrial sectors. Our secret? We combine uncompromising product quality with customer service that actually picks up the phone.

Position Details

Compensation $4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour

Job Type Part-time (20 hours per week)

Location Remote
Schedule Monday to Friday, 3:00–7:00 PM PST (7:00–11:00 AM Philippine Time, Tuesday to Saturday)

Ready to Join Us?
If you love keeping complex orders on track, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help shape how a growing company buys and ships, we'd love to hear from you.

Filtrous is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Strategy and architecture

Hands-on build and optimization

As our Security Engineer, you will own the security of EULER's applications: making sure we follow sound security practices and that our platform keeps pace with current security standards.

You will review our platform end to end, from data access and backend services to APIs, integrations, and our AI layer. You will identify risks, explain them clearly, and recommend how to address them. Most fixes will be carried out by our engineering team with your guidance; some you will make yourself.

Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer for utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, including standalone storage and PV-plus-storage facilities. Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.
  • Grow revenue across existing customer relationships.
  • Increase reorder frequency and average order size.
  • Reactivate inactive accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Build a strong network of retail partners.
  • Support the wholesale expansion of an emerging consumer brand.

Target Start Date: December 2026, with the goal of being fully prepared for the January wholesale market.

Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

This is a project management and operations role. You won't be responsible for developing creative strategies or writing scripts. Instead, you'll ensure that every creative project moves smoothly from kickoff to delivery, that deadlines are consistently met, and that everyone involved knows exactly what needs to happen next.

Your mission is simple: keep creative production moving, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure projects are delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

1. UGC Creator Sourcing

  • Source UGC creators across different creator marketplaces.
  • Send them briefs, scripts, and production requirements provided by our Creative Strategists
  • Shortlist creators based on defined profiles, budgets, and project requirements.

  • Verify that all required script lines, product shots, and deliverables have been captured.
  • Check basic technical quality, including lighting, audio, framing, and footage usability.

  • Create and assign editing tasks in ClickUp with all necessary files, briefs, and instructions.
  • Coordinate handoffs between creators and video editors.
  • Track editing progress and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Follow up with editors when tasks are delayed or require attention.
  • Notify Creative Strategists when completed creatives are ready for internal review.
  • Coordinate additional editing rounds when revisions are requested.

  • Own and maintain accurate production dashboards showing the status of every creative project.
  • Track deadlines, deliverables, and project progress across multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Identify bottlenecks, anticipate delays, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide regular status updates to Creative Strategists and leadership.
  • Ensure that no project, task, or deliverable falls through the cracks.
  • Continuously improve production processes, documentation, workflows, and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Previous experience in project management, production coordination, creative operations, or a similar role.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proactive communication skills, including the confidence to follow up persistently and hold people accountable.
  • Ability to work independently, anticipate problems, and find solutions without constant supervision.
  • Experience using project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment with multiple stakeholders and tight deadlines.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience managing UGC creators or influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Experience with Influee or similar UGC platforms.
  • Familiarity with Meta advertising and eCommerce creative production.
  • Experience coordinating video editors or creative production teams.
  • Familiarity with Google Drive, Frame.io, and creative asset management workflows.
  • Experience using ClickUp & Slack
  • Previous experience working at a digital marketing or performance marketing agency.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when:

  • Creative projects are consistently delivered on or ahead of deadlines.
  • Creators and editors are proactively managed, with minimal delays or missed deliverables.
  • Every project has a clearly documented status, owner, and next step.
  • Potential problems are flagged and addressed before they become serious delays.
  • Creative Strategists spend significantly less time managing production logistics and more time focusing on strategy, creative direction, and client performance.
  • Stakeholders always have visibility into production progress without needing to chase updates.
  • Our creative production process becomes faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

Growth Opportunities

Initially, this role will focus primarily on UGC production. As your role evolves, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of additional production workflows, including video ads, static creatives, and other creative formats.

Over time, this position could evolve into a broader Creative Operations Manager role, overseeing the entire creative production pipeline across the agency.

Run Monster Run is looking for creative editors who know how to turn animated chaos into scroll-stopping content!

We're talking funny moments, unexpected plot twists, iconic character moments, and clips that make people stop scrolling and send them straight to their friends. Your mission is to take our existing animation, particularly Episode 2, and turn it into short-form videos that people actually want to watch, share, and engage with.

  • Experience creating short-form videos, fan edits, Reels, memes, or other social-media-first content.

  • A strong instinct for identifying engaging moments and turning them into videos people want to watch and share.

description:
Why this Job is Exciting

The L3 Systems Engineer is a hands-on senior engineering role within the NexusTek Engineering Center, the company's dedicated L3 Center of Excellence for the hybrid cloud stack. This role carries a deep, hire-in specialization in AWS, with Azure and GCP experience preferred and expected to grow on the job as the engineer supports environments across all three public clouds, plus on-premises infrastructure, for mid-market and enterprise managed services clients as well as internal projects and initiatives. As a member of the Engineering Center, this engineer owns the hardest problems alongside other L3 peers for the accounts they support: final-tier escalation resolution, root cause ownership, and platform-grade automation and standards across hybrid cloud environments. This is a fully remote position with limited travel.

Work Environment

  • Fully remote — open to candidates coast to coast within the United States.
  • Limited travel is required; engineering, incident, and client-facing work is largely performed remotely.
  • Rotational on-call schedule shared across the team; this is a required responsibility of the role, and rotation frequency may vary based on team and business needs.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own resolution of escalated incident, service request, and alert tickets across SLA-bound and non-SLA queues.
  • Serve as the L3 escalation point for issues that exceed L1/L2 capability, taking ownership from intake through resolution and RCA closure as needed.
  • Handle direct engineer-to-engineer escalations and mentorship as they arise.
  • Partner with customer technical contacts on long-term solutions, lifecycle planning, and infrastructure health/remediation reviews — remotely, with no on-site presence required.
  • Design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and highly available architectures across AWS, with growing scope across Azure, GCP, and on-premises compute infrastructure.
  • Infrastructure as code experience is a plus.
  • Support of containerized and serverless workloads (Amazon EKS, AWS Lambda) as part of modern, cloud-native platform delivery is a plus.
  • Streamline infrastructure delivery and reduce manual repetitive work.
  • Extend engineering depth into on-premises/hybrid infrastructure and secondary clouds (Azure, GCP) as client environments require — all delivered remotely.
  • Configure and maintain identity and access management controls (IAM, Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO, MFA) across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation, audits, and compliance/audit-readiness activities relevant to client environments (e.g., CMMC 2.0, SOC 2, HIPAA).
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including encryption, centralized logging, and threat-detection tooling.
  • Monitor platform health, ticket SLAs, and service metrics; proactively identify and remediate issues before they escalate.
  • Build and maintain automated health checks, remediation playbooks, and DR/backup validation routines that reduce manual intervention over time.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and procedure guides so knowledge is documented and shared, not single-threaded.
  • Review and perform cost optimization and rightsizing across managed cloud environments.
  • Serve as primary or secondary engineer on project work, including cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, onboarding/offboarding, and lifecycle/EOL upgrades.
  • Participate in customer-facing calls and technical reviews as a senior engineer/subject-matter expert, including project SOW reviews and solutioning discussions.
  • Assist with customer onboarding and managed services transitions, including technical assessments, discovery, and project scoping.
  • Identify and submit new opportunities uncovered during the course of engineering engagements.
  • Contribute to the certification roadmap and internal Skill Builder Workshop program by building and delivering technical content that raises team-wide capability.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers — supporting them well is core to this team's mission.
  • Take ownership of improving processes, tools, and documentation; when something isn't working, take point on fixing it.
  • Communicate early and often on progress, blockers, and risk, and own mistakes quickly so the whole team can learn from them.
  • Participate in a rotational on-call schedule as an escalation engineer, engaged on P1/P2 incidents outside standard business hours when 24x7 L1/L2 cannot resolve them.
  • Acknowledge and respond to after-hours escalations per team SLA commitments, and hand off active incidents with full documentation at the close of the on-call window.

Technical Skills & Tools

  • EC2, Auto Scaling & Compute Services
  • VPC & Hybrid/Cloud Networking
  • EKS & Container Orchestration — a plus
  • Lambda & Serverless (API Gateway / Step Functions)
  • S3 & EBS Storage
  • Organizations / Multi-Account Architecture
  • CloudWatch
  • Microsoft Azure: core compute, storage, networking, and identity (Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO, MFA).
  • Google Cloud Platform: core compute, storage, and networking fundamentals.
  • Prior hands-on AWS specialists without Azure/GCP background are still encouraged to apply; Azure and GCP proficiency is expected to develop on the job.
  • Linux & Windows Server Administration
  • Hybrid Networking, Firewalls & VPN
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Ansible / Configuration Management
  • CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline)
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • Monitoring & Observability (CloudWatch, LogicMonitor, N-Able, SIEM)
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery (Veeam/Commvault, replication, failover testing)
  • Scripting & Automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Security & Compliance Frameworks (CMMC 2.0, SOC 2, HIPAA)

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer — a plus
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (or equivalent) — a plus
  • Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (or equivalent) — a plus

Certification is a plus, not a requirement at hire. Engineers who do not already hold a current AWS certification are expected to obtain at least one recognized AWS certification within 12 months of hire, supported by NexusTek's certification program.

Pay and Benefits:

Estimated Starting Salary/Wage Range:$115,000 to $120,000 annual based on candidate's experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to legally-required benefits, NexusTek offers a benefit package to eligible full-time employees, which currently includes the following:

  • Four weeks of annual accrued PTO
  • Seven paid national holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision options
  • Company-paid life insurance, short and long-term disability
  • Voluntary benefits such as critical illness and accident
  • Voluntary Legal Shield and identity theft protection
  • Discretionary annual 401k match plan
  • Generous employee referral bonus plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Access to over 90,000+ courses in ADP My Learning
  • StandOut employee engagement tools
  • Eligible to apply for a Pluralsight license
  • Eligible to apply for NexusTek Technical Academy or Leadership Academy

We’re happy to provide our comprehensive benefits guide. Each benefit is subject to eligibility requirements as specified in plan documents, and the Company reserves the right to modify the benefits it offers from time to time.

We explore ways to deliver new value, foster creativity and reach beyond boundaries. We use drive and commitment to energize, engage, and inspire others. At Riskonnect, we share this set of expectations and values. They guide us every day in every way. These values are more than words – they unite our organization and bring meaning and purpose to what we do.

#pioneer #spark #focus #community

The Opportunity

Riskonnect, Inc. is seeking a candidate for the position of Business Development Representative (BDR) at Riskonnect. The primary job responsibilities for the BDR are driving a result driven comprehensive demand generations strategy, spanning from acquisition to engagement to conversion. We have ambitious sales targets. As a BDR, you will be a key player in making our numbers work. To be successful in this role, the BDR must utilize consultative selling by understanding key business issues and requirements in order to craft a solution that best meets each prospective customer's needs. The ideal candidate must be both strategic and creative and thrive on metrics, with proven expertise in creating and executing multi-touch demand generation programs that leverage both inbound and outbound tactics.

WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A FIT?

Responsibilities:

  • Create and manage strategy to grow business and drive key business metrics including leads, MQLs, SQLs and Opportunities, using Pardot, Salesforce.com and other tools
  • Develop overall Lead Generation planning efforts including production goals, forecast and measuring overall results
  • Track, analyze and report on performance of KPIs and provide quantifiable metrics and insights through dashboards and monthly reports
  • Measure and report on performance against weekly and quarterly demand goals
  • Propose plans to improve lead quality and maximize pipeline and revenue
  • Accelerate revenue and marketing and sales qualified lead growth via targeted, personalized email nurturing of inbound and outbound leads
  • Collaborate with sales to identify targets for account-based marketing campaigns.
  • Provide prospecting on specific target accounts to enable goals to be achieved
  • Review marketing activity for prospecting.
  • Develop and nurture new leads through the early stages of the sales process.
  • Assist Regional Sales Teams with pipeline management and prospect follow up
  • Stay in constant contact with prospects
  • Assist in the creation, management, process and compliance of CRM data

Required Qualifications:

  • Data and results-driven approach to work (testing, measuring, iterating) with a proven track record of driving lead growth and sales qualified leads
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to analyze data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations
  • Strong understanding of B2B lead generation process and pipeline development and copywriting skills
  • Experience in campaign performance optimization, funnel optimization, creative testing and ROI calculations
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in managing lead generation efforts
  • 4-year degree, or equivalent work experience in a B2B SaaS environment in sales, demand generation, or sales support
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, set and manage expectations in a fast-paced environment
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills, quantitative skills and data-driven mindset
  • Hands on experience in CRM and marketing automation technologies (Salesforce and Pardot preferred)
  • High attention to detail and focus on quality output necessary
  • Self-starter with proven ability to deliver results

WHY BE A PART OF OUR TEAM?

At Riskonnect, innovation starts with our people. We’re a fast-growing, global team of 1,500+ dedicated professionals who bring bold thinking, a collaborative mindset, and a shared commitment to help organizations manage risk with confidence. You’ll work alongside some of the most talented individuals in the industry, united by a purpose to help customers solve their complex risk challenges through cutting-edge technology and world-class service.

Our culture of excellence has earned us consistent recognition, including:

• Best and Brightest Companies to Work For (Nationwide) – 8 years

We’re proud of these honors, but even more proud of the people who made them possible. Ready to be part of something meaningful? Join us.

title: Controller
excerpt: The Controller is a key member of Entreflow’s Finance and Accounting team, supporting the team in managing financial operations across multiple client accounts.
description:
The Controller is a key member of Entreflow’s Finance and Accounting team, supporting the team in managing financial operations across multiple client accounts.

This position represents a professional development opportunity for team members who have demonstrated strong accounting, analytical, and leadership skills and are ready to advance from a Senior Accountant role into broader financial management responsibilities.

The Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely month-end reporting, optimising accounting processes, and delivering high-quality financial insights. The role works closely with the Senior Accounting Technicians, Accounting Technicians and Assistant Controllers to provide strategic financial support, enhance operational efficiency, and maintain Entreflow’s standards of excellence in client service and data accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

Client Financial Management

  • Oversee daily and monthly accounting operations for assigned clients, ensuring accurate and timely bookkeeping and financial reporting.
  • Support Assistant Controllers with financial analysis, interpretation of results, and recommendations that inform client decision-making and business strategy.
  • Prepare, review, and analyse monthly financial statements and reports in advance of client Financial Management meetings.
  • Present financial results and performance insights to clients alongside the Assistant Controller, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor client budgets, forecasts, and KPIs to ensure alignment with business objectives.
  • Coordinate the completion of sales tax filings and collaborate with external tax specialists to ensure efficient year-end processes.
  • Manage and maintain third-party reporting obligations (e.g., to lenders, investors, or regulatory bodies) as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure consistent application of Entreflow’s accounting standards, internal controls, and operational policies.
  • Perform monthly file reviews to verify accuracy, identify risks, and highlight opportunities for improvement or standardisation.
  • Lead the optimisation and automation of client accounting files to improve workflow efficiency and data integrity.
  • Support seamless onboarding of new clients, establishing proper bookkeeping structures and integrating them into Entreflow’s systems and processes.
  • Provide technical accounting support, troubleshooting, and guidance to team members as required.
  • Champion implementation and best practices use of new technology and new features within existing applications to ensure they are being used effectively.

Leadership & Development

  • Serve as a key liaison between the CFO’s, bookkeeping team and the Controller group to ensure information accuracy and alignment of deliverables.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and feedback to junior accounting team members to promote professional growth and maintain high-quality output.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes, templates, and reporting tools.
  • Actively participate in internal initiatives to advance standardisation, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive accounting experience in cloud bookkeeping, accounting, or controllership roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • CPA designation is a requirement
  • Proven experience managing multiple clients, month-end close processes, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Strong understanding of Canadian accounting standards (ASPE/GAAP), financial controls, and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated analytical ability, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and automation tools (QuickBooks Online, Dext, Plooto, etc.) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and train peers on how to use these efficiently in the workplace to maximise efficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to explain financial concepts clearly to non-financial stakeholders e.g. clients and team members.
Salary: $85,000 – $100,000 / year

description:
Do you enjoy collaborating with teams to solve complex challenges?

Do you have a passion for cutting edge technologies?

Join our highly skilled Site Reliability Engineering team!

Our team designs, develops, and manages applications and infrastructure that support Akamai's Compute products and services. Partner with the best

Do what you love

  • Have experience automating with programming languages such as Python and/or Golang as well as scripting languages i.e. bash
  • Possess an understanding of best practices related to systems reliability, observability and monitoring incl. adherence to SLOs.
  • Have experience with configuration management tools such as SaltStack, Terraform and Ansible, as well as CI/CD solutions such as Jenkins
  • Have hands-on mastery in Linux administration and container-based platforms like Docker
  • Have hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools, such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki, web proxies (i.e. nginx/envoy/haproxy) and performance optimization solutions, such as Redis.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: AI Safety Practitioner
Type:Contract
Compensation:$60–$70/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for safety, factual accuracy, policy compliance, and overall quality.

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Journalism, Communications, Psychology, Sociology, Public Policy, Law, Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in AI Safety, Trust & Safety, journalism, public policy, scientific research, security, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, critical thinking, and analytical reasoning skills.
  • Ability to consistently evaluate nuanced and policy-sensitive scenarios.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI Safety, RLHF, SFT, Trust & Safety, or AI evaluation.
  • Familiarity with safety policies, content moderation, or evaluation rubric development.
  • Experience reviewing complex, high-risk, or ambiguous content.

excerpt: Job Overview Ready to help shape the future of the electric grid?
description:
Job Overview

Ready to help shape the future of the electric grid?

Systems Control, a Hubbell company, is seeking a highly motivated Business Development Manager (BDM) to accelerate growth across the utility substation and critical infrastructure markets in North America. As an industry leader in Integrated Substation Solutions, Systems Control designs and manufactures the infrastructure that enables grid modernization, renewable energy integration, electrification, data center expansion, and reliable utility transmission and distribution.

The Business Development Manager will focus on identifying new market opportunities, building executive-level customer relationships, influencing project specifications, and developing strategic partnerships with utilities, EPC firms, consultants, developers, and large end users. This role serves as the bridge between market intelligence, customer strategy, and commercial execution, helping position Systems Control as the preferred partner for complex capital projects in grid modernization, data centers, renewable energy, electrification, and utility transmission and distribution.

If you bring experience in utility infrastructure, electrical systems, capital project development, and strategic business development, this is an opportunity to help drive growth in the market segments reshaping the future of energy infrastructure.

A Day In The Life

Market Development & Growth

  • Identify, develop, and qualify new business opportunities across priority growth segments including grid modernization, data centers, renewable energy, electrification, utility transmission and distribution, and strategic EPC partnerships.
  • Develop and execute market growth strategies aligned with Systems Control's business objectives.
  • Monitor industry trends, capital spending plans, regulatory developments, and emerging technologies that influence substation investment.
  • Analyze market conditions and competitive activity to identify opportunities for growth and market share expansion.

Customer & Industry Engagement

  • Establish and strengthen relationships with utility executives, engineering leaders, EPC firms, consultants, developers, and key industry stakeholders.
  • Promote Systems Control's Integrated Substation Solutions to prospective customers and strategic partners.
  • Influence project specifications and early-stage planning activities to improve win rates and project positioning.
  • Upstream the voice of the customer to the executive team aid in developing the overall customer growth strategies and pursuit plans.

Strategic Opportunity Management

  • Track major capital projects from concept through award using Salesforce and other business intelligence tools.
  • Coordinate customer engagement strategies for large utility transmission and distribution, renewable energy, data center, electrification, and grid modernization projects.
  • Collaborate with engineering, estimating, operations, and leadership teams to align customer needs with company capabilities.
  • Assist in developing long-term sales forecasts, market assessments, and business planning initiatives.

Industry Leadership

  • Represent Systems Control at industry conferences, trade shows, customer events, and utility associations.
  • Build relationships with industry organizations including EEI, IEEE, NRECA, APPA, DistribuTECH, and regional utility associations.
  • Deliver presentations and thought leadership on industry trends, grid modernization, substation solutions, and energy infrastructure development.
  • Provide market intelligence and customer insights to senior leadership.

Key Performance Measures

  • New opportunity identification and pipeline growth.
  • Market share growth within assigned regions and market segments.
  • Utility, EPC, and consultant engagement effectiveness.
  • Strategic account penetration and expansion.
  • Revenue and booking growth from new customer development activities.
  • Forecast accuracy and pipeline management.
  • Growth of specification influences early-stage project engagement.

What will help you thrive in this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in utility sales, business development, electrical infrastructure, power systems, or related industries.
  • Strong understanding of utility transmission and distribution, substations, renewables, data center power infrastructure, electrification, or grid modernization projects.
  • Demonstrated success developing customer relationships and influencing large capital infrastructure projects.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience utilizing CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and business analytics tools.
  • Ability to travel up to 60+%.
  • Valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with electric utilities, municipal utilities, co-ops, independent power producers, renewable developers, data center customers, EPC firms, or other capital project stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of substation design, utility construction practices, or power delivery infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with data center power infrastructure requirements and market trends.
  • Experience supporting strategic pursuits involving projects exceeding $10M in value.
  • Existing utility and EPC industry relationships.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic Business Development
  • Executive Relationship Management
  • Sales Planning and Execution
  • Market Intelligence and Analysis
  • Commercial Negotiations
  • Customer Focus
  • Influencing and Communication
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making
  • Forecasting and Pipeline Management
  • Initiative and Drive
  • Leadership and Accountability

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

As a Business Development Director- Data Center, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and influencing strategic opportunities with hyperscale, colocation, and mission-critical customers. You will build executive-level relationships, develop early-stage project intelligence, and collaborate across the organization to position Sonepar as a preferred partner in the data center market.

What You'll Do

Develop Strategic Customer Relationships

  • Build and maintain relationships with hyperscale data center operators, large colocation providers, procurement teams, engineering firms, general contractors, and other key influencers.
  • Create and execute account engagement strategies that position Sonepar as a trusted partner within key customer organizations.
  • Develop multi-level relationship maps and strengthen long-term customer partnerships.

Drive Business Growth

  • Identify and influence opportunities early in the project lifecycle.
  • Support business capture strategies through value engineering, specification influence, preferred distributor agreements, and strategic account development.
  • Help drive pipeline growth and support revenue objectives within the data center vertical.

Manage Market Intelligence & Pipeline Development

  • Track and map data center projects from early-stage development through execution.
  • Maintain accurate project and engagement data within CRM systems.
  • Monitor market activity, customer initiatives, and project opportunities to guide business development effort.

Collaborate Across the Organization

  • Serve as a key liaison between customers, leadership teams, and operating companies.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support pursuit strategies and customer requirements.
  • Align business development activities with broader organizational growth objectives.

Represent Sonepar in the Industry

  • Participate in industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities.
  • Stay current on market trends, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities within the data center ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of strategic sales, business development, account management, or related industry experience.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence decision-makers within complex organizations.

description:
Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering multi-disciplinary evidence-based obesity treatment through telemedicine. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, and although historically only about 1% of patients received medical treatment for their disease, the field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth. Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their physician-led care team, which also includes advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.

About the Role:

We are seeking Physicians specialized in Endocrinology and Obesity Medicine to join our innovative, multidisciplinary chronic disease management team. A valid medical license to practice and prescribe legally in any US state is required, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses as needed is required.

This role is designed for an American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) certified Endocrinologist with demonstrated expertise in obesity medicine, comprehensive diabetes management, and a strong interest in working collaboratively with Endocrine Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in providing high-quality patient care.

A critical aspect of this role is ensuring the safe and effective management of patients with complex co-morbidities, including Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), and Cardiovascular conditions. The physician will help enhance the consistency, safety, and effectiveness of patient care across the team, specifically integrating the use of Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs) and insulin pump therapy.

This is a fully remote W-2 position (US-based), with flexible scheduling options: 32 total hours per week, 36 total hours per week, or 40 total hours per week. From the total working hours, 80% will be clinical/patient-facing care, and 20% administrative time.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide direct patient care in a telemedicine clinical setting, focusing on evidence-based treatment for obesity and comprehensive diabetes management, including insulin titration and care of patients who may already be using insulin pumps and/or continuous glucose monitors (CGMs)
  • The role could involve having your own panel of patients, or collaborating with APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes treatment, primarily Type 2 Diabetes. This role could involve APP collaboration and supervision, as needed
  • Review charts and conduct initial and return visits to ensure quality, continuity of care, and appropriate management of CKD/ESRD and CAD/CV conditions
  • Provide advanced treatment planning and medical management support for complex endocrinology cases, escalated concerns, and patients requiring specialized management protocols.
  • Prescribe non-controlled medications, including those for obesity and diabetes, for patients under both direct care and in coordination with APPs
  • Ensure clinical documentation, protocols, and treatment pathways are followed consistently within the team, with a focus on guidelines for managing complex diabetic populations
  • Assist in the professional development of colleagues by fostering clinical growth, offering feedback, and supporting continuing education in both endocrinology and obesity medicine
  • Participate in team-based care initiatives and contribute to a culture of collaboration and high-quality care
  • Attend relevant departmental meetings and contribute to quality improvement efforts within the diabetes and obesity medicine program

About You:

  • Must have an MD or DO degree
  • Required: Valid and current Board certification in Endocrinology by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)
  • Highly Preferred: Certification by the American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM)
  • 2 years of clinical experience and pharmacotherapy (older generation oral and newer injectable medications) in obesity medicine or endocrinology, post residency OR completed an accredited Fellowship program in Endocrinology or Obesity Medicine, in lieu of years of experience
  • Required: Active and unrestricted Medical State License in any US State, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses (IMLC preferred, but not required)
  • Must be currently opted-in with Medicare
  • Demonstrated competency and comfort in managing patients with complex co-morbidities, including CKD, ESRD, and CAD/CV conditions
  • Expertise in advanced diabetes management, including the use of CGMs, insulin pumps, and complex insulin regimens
  • Interest in mentoring, teaching, and collaborating with Endocrine-Specialized APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes, as needed
  • Demonstrated experience working with APPs, medical residents, or trainees in a clinical academic setting
  • Adherence to evidence-based treatments, behavioral interventions, nutrition, and pharmacotherapy for both endocrine disorders and obesity
  • Open to working one of the following W2 roles: 32hrs/week, 36hrs/week or 40hrs/week
  • Committed to delivering patient-centered, culturally competent care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience providing synchronous patient care in a telehealth setting is preferred
  • Bilingual candidates with medical fluency in Spanish are desired, but not required

Form Health’s benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits. Medical, dental, vision: from day 1
  • 401k program

  • Paid parental leave

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
