The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a Manager, Public Affairs Communications to help advance the company's public affairs priorities through strategic communications, thought leadership, stakeholder engagement, and policy-focused storytelling.

Reporting to the Director of Public Affairs Communications, this role will serve as a key communications partner to the Public Policy & Government Affairs, Legal, and Corporate Communications teams. The position will help elevate Lumen's voice on issues that impact the company's business, customers, communities, and the broader digital economy.

This role is ideal for a communications professional who have experience working with the legislative or executive branches of government and translating complex policy topics into compelling, understandable content for external audiences.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute communications strategies that support Lumen's public policy, government affairs, and corporate reputation priorities.
  • Translate complex policy and regulatory issues into clear, compelling communications for policymakers, stakeholders, media, and external audiences.
  • Support integrated communications campaigns around key corporate initiatives, including digital infrastructure, AI, cybersecurity, economic development, and permitting reform.
  • Partner closely with Government Affairs, Legal, and business teams to ensure communications align with company priorities.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to elevate Lumen leaders through speaking engagements, panel discussions, industry events, opinion content, and external thought leadership platforms.
  • Draft talking points, briefing materials, Q&As, presentations, and background documents for executive appearances.
  • Develop executive content strategies that grow visibility among policymakers, industry influencers, third-party organizations, and key stakeholder groups.
  • Develop content that demonstrates Lumen's role in powering the digital economy and enabling economic growth, innovation, security, and connectivity.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify customer stories, case studies, videos, reports, and other assets that reinforce policy objectives.
  • Support public affairs campaigns through articles, blog posts, newsletters, web content, social content, and executive communications.
  • Support relationships with think tanks, trade associations, policy organizations, industry coalitions, and other external stakeholders.
  • Track speaking opportunities, awards programs, partnerships, and sponsorships that support public affairs objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Lumen's visibility and credibility among policy audiences and industry influencers.
  • Work closely with the external communications, social media, creative, and marketing teams to maximize the impact of public affairs initiatives.
  • Ensure public affairs messages are integrated into broader corporate communications campaigns.
  • Track program performance and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, political science or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in public affairs, public policy communications, corporate communications, government relations communications, or related fields, ideally within the telecommunications, technology, cybersecurity, energy, or related industries.
  • Experience engaging with policymakers, trade associations, think tanks, industry coalitions, or other organizations.
  • Familiarity with communications strategies that support advocacy, reputation management, stakeholder engagement, and executive thought leadership.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex policy, regulatory, and technical topics for diverse audiences.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously, navigate ambiguity, and deliver results across competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and take ownership of complex public affairs initiatives, building trusted relationships across stakeholders and advancing workstreams with minimal oversight.

CRM, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high sense of urgency and an inventive approach to work through ambiguity and complex issues   
  • Highly adaptable and able to pivot based on prioritization and needs of the business 
  • Agile and resilient in managing multiple projects with multiple sources of information 
  • A clear, concise, and professional communicator with the ability to present information and demonstrate knowledge to stakeholders at varying levels within the business 
  • Strong work ethic, a high respect for confidentiality and sound professional judgment and initiative
  • Strong accountability and responsibility to meet aggressive deadlines

What we are looking for

  • Experience performing end-to-end recruitment cycle in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a passion for using data to drive decision making
  • Knowledge of recruiting database systems including applicant tracking systems
  • Ability to influence and negotiate

Position Summary

Amerit Fleet Solutions, one of the leading fleet maintenance companies in the U.S., is seeking an experienced, inspired and mission-driven Director of Employee Relations to join our growing team! 

The Employee Relations (ER) team supports the organization by addressing workplace concerns fairly, consistently, and respectfully through strong intake, effective case resolution, and sound employment practices.

The Director, Employee Relations leads Amerit's Employee Relations function, setting the strategy, standards, and operating discipline for how the organization identifies, investigates, and resolves employee relations matters across a multi-site, field-based workforce. This role owns the ER team's highest-risk work, including EEOC and other agency charge response, and oversight of complex and sensitive workplace investigations. The Director serves as the primary connection point to Legal on employee relations matters and partners closely with the Director, People Business Partners and People Business Partners (PBPs) to ensure ER and PBP work in close alignment, with clear escalation discipline, on employee matters across the business.

The ideal candidate combines deep employee relations and labor relations expertise with strong people leadership skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to build scalable, defensible ER practices in a fast-paced, multi-site operational environment.

Compensation: Competitive Pay - Paid weekly, every Friday! Salary Range: $155,000 - $175,000 base depending on experience with bonus potential.

The benefits of belonging – what’s in it for you?

  • Full benefits within 30 days
  • Medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, life insurance, disability insurance
  • 401(k) match program
  • Unlimited vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Commitment to your safety through boot and prescription safety glasses reimbursement
  • Career and learning development with an extensive training program through our Amerit University
  • Employee referral program, up to $500 bonus

  • Employee recognition platform that includes opportunities to redeem points for merchandise
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 24/7 nurse triage line
  • Employee discounts on cell phone service and entertainment tickets
  • Employee resource groups (ERGs) that foster inclusion

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & ER Function Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5, including a Senior Employee Relations Case Manager, Employee Relations Case Managers, and an ER Intake Coordinator.
  • Set caseload standards, quality expectations, and escalation criteria across the ER team; ensure consistent, timely, and well-documented case resolution.
  • Own ER tools, templates, playbooks, and case management systems; drive continuous improvement in intake, investigation, and documentation practices.
  • Build team capability and bench strength through coaching, calibration, and knowledge-sharing across case managers.

Investigation Oversight & Case Management

  • Provide oversight and quality assurance on complex, high-risk, and precedent-setting investigations led by the Senior Case Manager and Case Managers.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for the ER team on the most sensitive matters, including those involving senior leaders, significant legal exposure, or reputational risk.
  • Review and approve findings, recommendations, and documentation on the highest-risk matters to ensure consistency, sound judgment, and defensible outcomes.
  • Partner with the Senior Employee Relations Case Manager to maintain investigation standards, case strategy, and coaching for the broader case manager team.

Legal & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Employee Relations connection to Legal, routing matters appropriately and ensuring timely, well-prepared handoffs on litigation holds, subpoenas, and legal inquiries.

  • Partner with Safety, Compliance, and business leaders on matters requiring coordinated response.

Partnership with People Business Partners

  • Partner closely with the Director, People Business Partners to reinforce role clarity and escalation discipline between the PBP and ER functions.
  • Ensure PBPs are equipped to identify, escalate, and partner on ER issues in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Support leadership coaching on employee issues in alignment with ER guidance, balancing employee experience with risk mitigation and compliance.

Data, Reporting & Risk Management

  • Track and report on ER case volume, trends, cycle time, and outcomes to the AVP, Employee Experience and other senior leaders.
  • Identify systemic themes and risks across cases and recommend policy, training, or process improvements.
  • Own Employee Relations policy content and ensure policies remain current, consistent, and legally compliant across jurisdictions.

Charge Response & Regulatory Matters

title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
excerpt: Company Name ARS-Rescue RooterOverview The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter.
description:
Company Name

ARS-Rescue Rooter

Overview

The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution.

The role is DevOps-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure-as-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards.

The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Azure Infrastructure Engineering & Operations

  • Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on-call.

Hybrid Networking, DNS & Application Delivery

  • Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior.
  • Design name resolution across Azure and on-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding).
  • Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints.
  • Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure-mode design when an edge service or policy fails.
  • Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third-party connectivity.

Migration Execution

  • Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift-and-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post-migration support.
  • Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off-hours production cutovers.
  • Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs).
  • Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads.

Resiliency, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo-redundant storage, and region/availability-zone design against RTO and RPO targets.
  • Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results.

Platform Services Infrastructure

  • Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring.
  • Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift.
  • Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self-hosted agents reaching private endpoints.
  • Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI.

Identity, Security & Governance

  • Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties.
  • Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence.

Observability & Cost Management

  • Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing.
  • Right-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines.

Collaboration & Cross-Training

  • Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Note: Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • 5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on production Azure.
  • Hybrid networking: hands-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior.
  • On-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration support.
  • Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets.
  • Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines.
  • Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy.
  • Independent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Azure issues.
  • Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge

  • Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel.
  • AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-500, AZ-400) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current.
  • AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations.
  • PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi-site hybrid environments.
  • Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting.

Work Details

  • Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone.
  • Regular business hours with scheduled after-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on-call as required; participation in change management (CAB).
  • Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

description:
Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization:

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Role Summary:

The Staff Accountant role at CDP offers a valuable opportunity to build accounting skills through hands-on experience and guidance from an experienced Finance team. With a primary focus on accounts payable and employee expense reporting, the selected candidate will gain exposure to the full accounting cycle, including billing, cash activity, reconciliations, month-end close, and audit support. Working with colleagues across departments, this person will learn how accounting connects to day-to-day business operations and develop broader responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. This role reports sits on the CDP Finance team and reports to the Senior Accountant.

Primary Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable:

  • Own and manage the Accounts Payable inbox and ensure invoices are processed accurately and timely.
  • Create and maintain vendor records, including new CDP employees when applicable, and collect required documentation such as W-9s and ACH/remittance information.
  • Maintain accurate vendor payment methods and remittance contacts, including ACH, credit card, and check information.
  • Maintain the current-year 1099 vendor/contractor listing and support annual 1099 preparation and processing.
  • Enter vendor invoices into Sage Intacct and route invoices to the appropriate CDP reviewer and approver.
  • Monitor Accounts Payable workflows and follow up with reviewers/approvers regarding outstanding invoices or approvals.
  • Communicate with vendors and CDP employees regarding missing invoices, out-of-pocket invoices, payment documentation, and other billing-related questions.
  • Access vendor portals and retrieve recurring or monthly invoices as needed.
  • Maintain a working understanding of general ledger expense accounts and appropriate P&L classifications.
  • Support monthly P&L reviews to identify missing expenses and potential accruals.
  • Maintain a working understanding of prepaid expense accounts and related balance sheet activity.
  • Support the review and reconciliation of prepaid expenses at month-end.
  • Support the monthly out-of-pocket (OOP) expense process.

Expense Reports & Corporate Credit Cards:

  • Support the monthly employee expense report process, including Expensify and corporate credit card activity, and verify that the vendor is populated on each expense when the system supports it.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding in Expensify and corporate credit card systems, including account setup, access changes, and coordination of card activation or cancellation as directed.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reminders to all staff regarding timely expense submission and approval.
  • Follow up with employees and approvers regarding outstanding or incomplete expense reports.
  • Perform the initial review of expense reports for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation. Route reports to the Manager for additional review, particularly during the first year; thereafter, follow review requirements and dollar thresholds established by Finance leadership.
  • Provide basic Expensify support and troubleshooting to employees when appropriate.
  • Assist with monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, including Visa, American Express, and Expensify activity.

Bank Statements and Reconciliation Support:

  • Provide bank statements and supporting documentation for monthly bank reconciliations. The Manager retains responsibility for preparing and reviewing bank reconciliations to maintain segregation of duties.
  • Research bank transactions and provide documentation to the Manager to help resolve reconciling items.
  • Maintain organized and accurate bank statement folders by account, month, and year.
  • Immediately escalate suspicious, unusual, or unidentified bank transactions to Finance leadership.

Other Duties:

  • Support ad hoc Finance and Accounting projects as needed.
  • Maintain organized, current, and accurate files and folders within the internal Finance drive.
  • Assist with expense and financial analysis when appropriate.
  • Support the year-end financial statement audit and related documentation requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, workflows, policies, and internal controls, and assist with documenting approved changes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other CDP departments as needed.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on Finance team needs, business priorities, and the employee’s demonstrated experience and development.

Preferred Qualifications:

Accounts Receivable & Billing:

  • Assist with preparing and issuing client invoices through Sage Intacct accurately and timely, and serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day billing inquiries.
  • Prepare, save, and maintain supporting invoice backup and PDF documentation when applicable.
  • Maintain current station Accounts Receivable contacts and applicable CDP contacts copied on invoices.
  • Maintain and update monthly and quarterly invoice-upload templates.
  • Assist with updating the MSB billing tracker for MSB, PS, and CRM services as needed. The Manager retains responsibility for reconciling the tracker to client agreements to confirm billing completeness and accuracy.
  • Update recurring invoicing information by station and product/service.
  • Add new MSB stations and update assigned Client Services representatives when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate license and email allotment information by station.
  • Monitor billing-related email, respond to routine questions, and collaborate with Station Finance and other internal teams. Escalate discrepancies, agreement questions, and unresolved issues to the Manager.
  • Assist with distributing Accounts Receivable aging statements to stations and supporting follow-up when appropriate.

Month-End Close:

  • Support completion of the monthly Finance close checklist and PS close checklist.
  • Prepare draft journal entries for prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned accounts.
  • Assist with preparing monthly OOP journal entries and station-level allocations.
  • Collaborate with MMT on station breakouts and supporting documentation when needed.
  • Assist with monthly account reconciliations for corporate cards, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned balance sheet accounts; provide supporting documentation for bank reconciliations performed by the Manager.

Systems and Experience:

  • Experience with Sage Intacct, Bank of America CashPro, and Expensify is a plus.

Commitment to Inclusion

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

  • DEI mindset: You embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
  • A Communicator: You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.

Position Overview

Power Your Future with Qualus in our Transmission Line department as a Senior Manager of Engineering. This position is also responsible for implementing best engineering methods, pursuing business development opportunities and maintaining good relationships with internal and external stakeholders. title: Offensive Security Engineer
excerpt: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.
  • Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack
  • Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.
  • Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.
  • Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.


What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation
  • Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.
  • Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.
  • Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).
  • Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.
  • Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.


Nice to have

  • Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.
  • Reverse engineering and exploits development experience
  • Application security experience
  • Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.
  • Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.
  • Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).
  • Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.


Why this role at Nebius

  • Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Desafío Elite: Desarrollador Full Stack Senior | Transforma el Futuro Financiero

Ubicación/Modalidad: 100% Remoto (Talento ubicado en Venezuela o en Ecuador)

¿Listo para construir la próxima generación de sistemas de misión crítica?

En INITIUM, conectamos al mejor talento técnico de la región con los proyectos más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. No somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Si te encuentras en Caracas o Ecuador, te apasiona resolver problemas complejos, diseñar arquitecturas robustas e impactar directamente en el motor financiero de soluciones de gran escala, este desafío es para ti.

Tu Misión

Como Desarrollador Full Stack Senior, no solo escribirás código; serás una pieza clave en el diseño y la evolución de plataformas de alto rendimiento. Tu día a día incluirá:

  • Diseñar y construir APIs REST sólidas y una capa BFF (Backend For Frontend) optimizada para ofrecer la mejor experiencia de usuario.
  • Implementar lógica de negocio compleja, incluyendo el registro de operaciones, covenants y un motor financiero avanzado (NPV, IRR, Duration y stress testing).
  • Desarrollar interfaces modernas y reactivas en la capa Frontend utilizando React 18.
  • Liderar la integración y resiliencia de servicios, desarrollando y manteniendo adaptadores de integración (vía AWS AppFlow) respaldados por patrones de resiliencia como Circuit Breaker, Retry/Backoff y Dead-Letter Queues.
  • Garantizar la máxima calidad, impulsando la automatización con pruebas unitarias e integración continua (CI/CD).

Tu Arsenal Técnico

Imprescindible (Lo que necesitas para triunfar):

  • Experiencia: Más de 5 años de trayectoria como Desarrollador Full Stack en entornos de alta exigencia.
  • Backend: Java 21 y Spring Boot 3 (WebFlux).
  • Frontend: React 18 y TypeScript.
  • Bases de Datos & Mensajería: PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora y arquitecturas event-driven con Kafka / MSK.
  • Integraciones & Cloud: APIs REST / SOAP, integración vía AWS AppFlow y control de versiones con Git.
  • Idioma: Inglés intermedio (lectura, escritura y conversación).
  • Formación: Profesional titulado en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería de Software, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines.
  • Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía, alta capacidad de resolución de problemas, atención rigurosa al detalle en cálculos financieros y excelente comunicación con equipos de BA (Business Analyst) y QA.

Deseable (Suma puntos a tu perfil):

  • Certificaciones AWS (AWS Certified Developer Associate o AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate).
  • Certificación Oracle Certified Professional Java.

¿Cómo mediremos tu impacto?

  • Cumplimiento y eficiencia en las entregas de proyectos.
  • Alineación y ejecución efectiva con el plan estratégico de arquitectura e ingeniería.

Lo que te ofrecemos

En INITIUM apostamos por las personas y creamos las condiciones para que alcances tu máximo potencial:

  • Esquema competitivo: Salario fijo acorde a tu experiencia y mercado.
  • Flexibilidad real: Trabajo 100% Remoto desde Caracas o Ecuador.
  • Cultura de vanguardia: Autonomía, colaboración y dinamismo sin burocracia.
  • Crecimiento constante: Un entorno donde se valora tu iniciativa, se reconoce tu impacto y se invierte en tu evolución profesional y técnica.

"En INITIUM no solo desarrollamos tecnología: creamos un entorno donde las personas pueden evolucionar, aportar valor y dejar huella."

¡Aplica ahora y hablemos!

Si buscas un lugar donde tu código tenga un impacto real, tus ideas sean escuchadas y tu curiosidad sea el motor de tu carrera, queremos conocerte.

Envíanos tu CV o enlace a tu perfil de LinkedIn. ¡Hablemos del futuro que puedes construir con nosotros!

description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, AI/ML, Generative AI)

About Us

Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We’re a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian.

We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world’s largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences.

As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you.

Opportunity!

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, AI, and customer delivery. You’ll partner directly with clients to understand complex business and technical challenges, rapidly design and build solutions, and integrate modern AI capabilities into real-world applications and systems.

This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong application development skills with a customer-focused mindset and enjoys taking solutions from initial discovery and architecture through implementation and deployment.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-ready applications and services.
  • Solid application engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable software solutions.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications and existing technology ecosystems.
  • Strong experience designing and integrating APIs and distributed systems, including third-party services and enterprise platforms.
  • Experience building solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience working with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and modern application development frameworks.
  • Experience with agent orchestration, AI workflows, tool calling, or similar agentic architectures.
  • Strong customer-facing and consulting skills, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Experience with solution architecture, including designing scalable systems and making technical decisions based on customer and business requirements.
  • Ability to work closely with customer stakeholders, product teams, and engineers throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

Bonus points:

  • Experience delivering technical solutions directly within customer environments.
  • Experience designing or implementing RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, and AI observability.
  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience rapidly building prototypes and proofs of concept and evolving them into production-ready solutions.
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms, vector databases, and AI infrastructure.

You’ll Love:

  • Working directly with customers to solve complex, real-world technical challenges.
  • Building and deploying AI-powered solutions that move quickly from concept to production.
  • Combining hands-on engineering with solution architecture and customer collaboration.
  • Working across application engineering, cloud technologies, and modern AI systems.
  • Exploring emerging AI technologies and finding practical ways to apply them to meaningful business problems.

By joining our team, you’ll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other’s strengths and celebrates every success together.

title: Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Security
excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of the role

As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).

What you’ll do

  • Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.
  • Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.
  • Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.
  • Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.
  • Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.
  • Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.
  • Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.
  • Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.
  • Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.
  • Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.
  • Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.
  • Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.
  • Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.
  • Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.

About the team

Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$152,800—$220,000 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Who is BAMKO?

BAMKO is one of the top 10 largest companies in the branded merchandise space and the fastest growing of any of the top 50 companies in the $25 billion dollar industry. Over the last 5 years, BAMKO has won countless awards, including Best Places to Work & Best Client Promotions. With a culture built around the concepts of personal and professional growth, BAMKO puts values into actions. BAMKO has the best and the brightest employees who love a challenge that unlocks their highest potential. Our portfolio of clients have a range of known Fortune 1000 companies. This includes but is not limited to Dunkin’ Donuts, Tesla, Microsoft, Peloton and more! We are a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and innovative company where culture is at our core. We attract and retain high-level talent that continues to outpace the competition. If you are driven, have big brain ideas, are competitive and enjoy working with multiple teams, we want you to be a part of building something special here at BAMKO.

BAMKO is looking for a detail-driven Project Manager to run overseas promotional product and merchandise programs for some of our largest retail, consumer and enterprise clients. You'll be the US point person between our sales team, clients, and our sourcing and production teams in Asia. You'll own each order from RFP and quoting through production, QC, freight and final delivery. We'll hire at the Project Manager or Senior Project Manager level, depending on experience.

What YOU will do:

  • Manage a portfolio of active projects and orders across several major accounts, from five-figure samples to multimillion-dollar programs
  • Work daily with our Asia operations teams and outside brokers on quotes, samples, production timelines and problems as they come up
  • Lead RFP responses: gather specs, collect pricing from factories and brokers, and build quotes that hit margin targets
  • Check art, proofs, Pantone/PMS colors and packaging specs before production so mistakes are caught early
  • Coordinate freight, DDP and drop-ship deliveries, and in-hand dates across multiple distribution centers and warehouses
  • Keep clients and sales reps up to date on status, risks and changes
  • Work with accounting and AP on client billing, vendor payments, POs, and duties and tariff questions
  • Keep project trackers accurate, and close orders out after delivery

Who YOU are:

  • 3–5+ years of project management, production or sourcing experience in promotional products, consumer goods or apparel; Senior level typically [6+] years
  • Experience working with overseas factories or sourcing teams in Asia
  • Strong organization: you can run 30+ live projects without dropping details
  • Clear, confident communication with clients, sales and international teammates
  • Comfort with numbers: costing, margins, freight
  • Working knowledge of imports, tariffs and logistics (a plus)
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel; ERP or order system experience is a plus

Why BAMKO?

The rate of pay offered will be dependent upon the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. In addition, there a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, various paid time off programs, and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

title: Sr. Vice President, Head of System Integrators and Channel Sales
excerpt: The Sr.  Vice President, Head of System Integrators and Channel Sales a senior commercial leader responsible for defining, building, and scaling Sapiens’ global SI and channel ecosystem to drive sustainable revenue growth, market coverage, and execution leverage.
description:
The Sr. Vice President, Head of System Integrators and Channel Sales a senior commercial leader responsible for defining, building, and scaling Sapiens’ global SI and channel ecosystem to drive sustainable revenue growth, market coverage, and execution leverage. This role owns the SI and channel strategy end-to-end – from partner segmentation and value proposition to execution discipline, governance, and measurable outcomes – ensuring channels operate as a system-led growth engine rather than a collection of ad-hoc relationships.

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role partners closely with Sales, Product, Services, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional leadership to build repeatable partner motions that increase pipeline, win rate, and long-term customer value in a complex enterprise SaaS environment.

Job Responsibilities

Channel / SI Strategy & Operating Model:
  • Define and own the global SI & channel strategy, including partner types, coverage models, segmentation, and prioritization.
  • Design a clear channel operating model with rules of engagement, governance, incentives, and success metrics.
  • Establish clarity on where channels lead, where direct sales lead, and where joint motion applies.

Partner Ecosystem Development:
  • Build and scale a focused, tiered partner ecosystem including strategic alliances, systems integrators, regional partners, and technology partners.
  • Recruit, onboard, and enable partners with clear expectations, joint business plans, and performance standards.
  • Drive partner specialization by region, vertical, and solution to increase win rates and delivery success.

Revenue Ownership & Performance Management:
  • Own channel-sourced and channel-influenced pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Establish forecasting discipline, partner scorecards, and KPI dashboards.
  • Optimize partner productivity, deal quality, and repeatability of outcomes.

Partner Enablement & Experience:
  • Build scalable partner onboarding, training, certifications, and sales enablement programs.
  • Enable internal sales teams to consistently and effectively co-sell with partners.
  • Ensure a frictionless partner experience through clear processes and fast decision-making.

Channel Programs & Governance:
  • Design and operate partner programs including tiering, incentives, and deal registration.
  • Establish governance mechanisms that reduce channel conflict and improve transparency.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and RevOps to ensure compliance and clean execution.

Cross-Functional GTM Orchestration:
  • Align with regional sales leadership on territory coverage, account mapping, and partner engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product and Services to ensure partner-sold deals are deliverable and scalable.
  • Work with Marketing on partner-driven demand generation and co-marketing initiatives.

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in SI, Channel Sales, Alliances, or Partner Ecosystems within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global partner programs in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong track record owning revenue outcomes through indirect channels.
  • Executive presence and ability to influence cross-functionally.
  • Proven experience developing and deploying global strategies as it relates to Channel & SI partnerships
  • East Coast candidates highly preferred

description:
Responsibilities Prominence Health is a value-based care organization bridging the gap between affiliated health systems and independent providers, building trust and collaboration between the two. Prominence Health creates value for populations and providers to strengthen integrated partnership, advance market opportunities, and improve outcomes for our patients and members. Founded in 1993, Prominence Health started as a health maintenance organization (HMO) and was acquired by a subsidiary of Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS) in 2014. Prominence Health serves members, physicians, and health systems across Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Accountable Care Organizations, and commercial payer partnerships. Prominence Health is committed to transforming healthcare delivery by improving health outcomes while controlling costs and enhancing the patient experience. Learn more at: Job Summary: The Senior Manager of Product Development is pivotal to guiding our product strategy by orchestrating collaboration with business leaders, technical teams, actuarial stakeholders, and external partners. The role demands expertise in advancing product design based on market analysis, aligning with the company’s strategic goals, ensuring adherence to regulatory timelines for product filings, and staying updated with ever-evolving industry trends. This role calls for development, organization, and facilitation of Prominence Health Plan's commercial and Medicare Advantage products, system and infrastructure improvements, and vendor selection and implementation. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Senior Manager will provide essential support to the organizational business teams in the development, implementation, and compliance of new and renewing commercial and Medicare clients, products, and vendors. Responsibilities encompass three core components of the job: Program Delivery Bid and AEP Project Management Product Analysis Product Insights and Market Intelligence Tracking financial and growth impact of benefit changes CMS/Regulatory Deliverables Regulatory Submissions SNP Model of care management This role will provide crucial support to the organizational business teams in the development, implementation, and compliance of new and renewing commercial and Medicare clients, products, and vendors. Additionally, you will play a vital role in the development and production of required plan documents and the entry of plan filing documents into SERFF, HPMS, and CMS Bid tools. The Senior Manager of Product Development is expected to live at both the tactical layer, as well as the strategic layer. In the tactical layer, this role will work directly with internal and external customers to initiate, plan, execute and manage product development and implementation initiatives to accomplish overall business, client, and vendor objectives. In the strategic layer, the Senior Manager is responsible for working with Sales and our executive team on competitive positioning, growth objectives, and plan optimization. title: Technical Project Manager
excerpt: Productiv Team is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across product and engineering teams.
description:
Productiv Team is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across product and engineering teams. Candidate will provide hands-on delivery leadership, coordinating people, plans, dependencies, risks, and decisions to move initiatives from definition through implementation and release.
The Ideal candidate combines strong project management fundamentals with enough technical fluency to work effectively with software engineering, architecture, quality assurance, DevOps, product, and business stakeholders. This is an execution-focused role requiring independent ownership, sound judgment, proactive communication, and the ability to maintain delivery momentum across multiple teams.

How You’ll Add Value

You will help ensure that strategic technology initiatives are clearly planned, well-coordinated, and delivered predictably. You will connect product priorities with engineering execution, surface issues early, facilitate timely decisions, and provide stakeholders with an accurate view of progress, risks, and outcomes. You will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, technical leads, and business partners while respecting the distinct responsibilities of each role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Project and Delivery Management

  • Lead multiple high-visibility technology initiatives from planning and initiation through execution, implementation, release, and post-implementation review.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, budgets (where applicable), and delivery forecasts.
  • Translate strategic commitments and business objectives into actionable delivery plans aligned with product roadmaps, sprint plans, and release schedules.
  • Coordinate scope definition, requirements, readiness, solution/design reviews, estimates, sequencing, and delivery dependencies.
  • Partner with Product Owners to clarify priorities, manage scope, assess trade-offs, and keep delivery aligned with business value and agreed outcomes.
  • Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify schedule, resource, scope, and quality variances; develop mitigation and recovery plans as needed.

Cross-Team Coordination and Dependency Management

  • Coordinate work across multiple Agile pods and technology teams, ensuring cross-team dependencies, handoffs, and integration points are identified and actively managed.
  • Work with Scrum Masters, who manage pod-level ceremonies and blockers, to address initiative-level risks, issues, and dependencies that span teams.
  • Facilitate collaboration among engineering, architecture, QA, DevOps, product, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve impediments and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Coordinate technical decision-making and escalation paths, ensuring decisions, owners, and due dates are clear and documented.
  • Support release planning with technical leads, including environment readiness, integration sequencing, deployment dependencies, and go/no-go preparation.

Risk, Issue, and Stakeholder Management

  • Own initiative-level risk and issue management, maintaining risk registers, action logs, decision logs, and mitigation plans.
  • Identify emerging delivery concerns early, assess impact and likelihood, recommend options, and drive resolution with accountable owners.
  • Provide concise, accurate, and timely status reporting for leadership and stakeholders, including milestones, accomplishments, upcoming work, dependencies, decisions, and risks.
  • Prepare and facilitate project reviews, steering discussions, stakeholder updates, and escalation meetings.
  • Manage expectations transparently and communicate changes to scope, timeline, priorities, or delivery forecasts.

Quality, Release, and Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, defect triage, readiness reviews, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Partner with QA and engineering leads to ensure test planning quality gates, and release criteria are incorporated into delivery plans.
  • Coordinate implementation activities and post-release follow-up, including issue tracking, operational handoff, and lessons learned.
  • Promote consistent project management practices, lightweight governance, and continuous improvement without adding unnecessary process overhead.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve planning, analysis, documentation, and communication, consistent with organizational policies.

Vendor and Governance Management

  • Coordinate external vendors and consultants, monitor commitments and deliverables, and address delivery concerns in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
  • Track budgets, contracts, resource commitments, and vendor performance where applicable.
  • Ensure project activities account for security, privacy, data governance, compliance, and organizational standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex technology projects or programs involving software development teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, Scrum, iterative planning, and modern software release practices.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across engineering, product, QA, architecture, DevOps, and business functions.
  • Ability to independently own initiatives, establish structure, drive actions to completion, and maintain delivery momentum with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, responsive, and comfortable anticipating challenges and addressing issues before they affect delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear executive updates and facilitate effective meetings and presentations.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with people across roles and levels.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-facilitation skills.
  • Experience with project management tools and documentation, such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday and maintain availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or other relevant project/program management or Agile certifications.
  • Experience with scaled Agile delivery Scrum of Scrums, Kanban, or coordination across multiple Agile pods.
  • Technical familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, databases, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, budgets, contracts, and external delivery partners.
  • Experience planning and coordinating UAT campaigns, enterprise implementations, and production releases.
  • Experience establishing PMO practices, delivery standards, dashboards, and project governance.
  • Familiarity with AI tools that support project planning, reporting, analysis, and documentation.
  • Experience working in mission-driven, nonprofit, sustainability, or green building organizations.

Education


Bachelors degree in Computer Science Information Technology, Project Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Engagement Details

  • Work schedule: Monday–Friday, with availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. The candidate must be available for scheduled project meetings, stakeholder discussions, delivery reviews, and cross-team coordination during ET working hours.
  • Reporting to: Manager, Technology Application Delivery
The candidate is expected to demonstrate consistent availability, respond promptly, communicate proactively, and take ownership of assigned initiatives and deliverables. The successful candidate will independently drive project activities, follow through on commitments, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and decisions.

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

Candidates should have relevant fire protection engineering experience and working knowledge of applicable building, fire, life safety, and NFPA standards. Direct data center experience is preferred but not required for candidates with strong, transferable mission critical experience.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote or hybrid work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Travel to client meetings, project sites, and AECOM offices may be required based on assignment. Travel is typically scheduled in advance.

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work under the supervision and technical direction of a Senior Fire Protection Engineer to deliver assigned fire protection and life safety tasks.
  • Develop fire suppression, fire alarm, and mass notification system designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, narratives, and reports.
  • Perform life safety code analysis, occupancy and construction-type evaluations, means-of-egress calculations, and related code documentation.
  • Support performance-based design, fire and smoke modeling, and egress modeling under senior technical oversight.
  • Evaluate battery, fuel, generator, electrical, and other special hazards and assist in developing fire risk mitigation strategies for mission critical facilities.

  • Coordinate with authorities having jurisdiction and support preparation of code interpretations, permit responses, and alternate-method documentation under senior guidance.
  • Contribute to proposals, fee estimates, staffing plans, technical presentations, and qualifications materials for data center and mission critical pursuits.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable codes, standards, design tools, and emerging fire protection issues affecting data center facilities.
  • Provide technical guidance to entry-level engineers and designers when assigned, while escalating significant technical decisions to the Senior Fire Protection Engineer.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Protection Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited university.
  • Foundational understanding of fire suppression, fire alarm, mass notification, and life safety design documents.
  • Foundational understanding of life safety code analysis and egress analysis.
  • Foundational understanding of fire modeling, smoke modeling, egress modeling, performance-based design, or special-hazard analysis.
  • Knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and commonly applied NFPA standards.
  • Experience using Revit and AutoCAD in a coordinated design environment.
  • Ability to produce clear calculations, drawings, specifications, reports, and technical correspondence under senior review.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, respond to review comments, and elevate risks or technical questions promptly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1 year of professional engineering experience in fire protection and life safety design for building projects, including experience on complex or mission critical facilities.
  • Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction or demonstrated progress toward licensure.
  • Experience developing fire suppression, fire alarm, mass notification, and life safety design documents.
  • Experience performing life safety code analysis and egress analysis.
  • Experience with fire modeling, smoke modeling, egress modeling, performance-based design, or special-hazard analysis.
  • Working knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and commonly applied NFPA standards.
  • Direct experience supporting fire protection design for data centers, colocation facilities, hyperscale campuses, or other related facilities.
  • Mission critical project experience involving high availability, operational continuity, phased construction, or fast-track delivery.
  • Experience evaluating lithium-ion batteries, battery energy storage systems, emergency and standby power systems, fuel storage and distribution, or similar special hazards.
  • Experience supporting permitting and coordination with authorities having jurisdiction.
  • Experience providing construction-phase services and participating in commissioning or integrated systems testing.
  • Graduate of an ABET-accredited Fire Protection Engineering program.
  • Active participation in SFPE, NFPA, or another relevant professional organization.
  • US Citizenship

Solutions Engineer – U.S. Public Sector

About Arango:

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens,, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at,LinkedIn, andG2.

The Mission (About the Role)

We are seeking a highly technical Solutions Engineer to join our U.S. Public Sector organization. This is a high-impact role focused on driving technical adoption across U.S. Public Sector Accounts. The ideal candidate understands that "U.S. Public Sector" isn't just a vertical, it’s a unique ecosystem with complex security requirements, air-gapped environments, and high-stakes requirements. You will serve as the technical authority, translating Arango’s "Silicon Valley" innovation into "Mission-Ready" solutions. Whether you are a transitioning military member (Cyber/Intel), a career GovCon Architect, or a Data Scientist, if you thrive on solving "no-fail" problems, we want you on the team.

Location: Washington, DC / Northern Virginia (NCR) (preferred) but open to other areas of federal concentration localities.

Clearance: Preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Architect Mission Solutions: Craft and deliver technical presentations and architecturally sound demonstrations of the Arango Platform, tailored to specific agency use cases (e.g., Target Intelligence, Fraud/Waste/Abuse, Supply Chain Risk).
  • Lead Technical Evaluations: Drive Proof of Concepts/Technology (PoCs/PoTs) within secure environments, often comparing Arango against legacy NoSQL or relational databases.

What Makes Arango Special?

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.

Working at Arango means:

  • Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
  • Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
  • Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications

If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.
