description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Georgia Center for Opportunity (GCO) is an independent, non-partisan policy research organization that develops solutions leading to social and economic opportunity in the state of Georgia and beyond. Our vision is to make vibrant communities where everyone can achieve their potential.

Our mission is to empower families to flourish across generations. We advance solutions that increase opportunity and create durable pathways to prosperity for Georgia’s families. To achieve our mission, we research ways to help remove barriers to opportunity in each of these pathways, promote our solutions to policymakers and the public, and help effective and innovative social enterprises deliver results in their communities. Our ultimate goal is to see every Georgian who is willing to seize the opportunities presented to them living a life that can be characterized as truly flourishing.

GCO is poised for growth. With an office in Peachtree Corners and programs in Gwinnett County and Columbus, Georgia, GCO is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative environment. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead must be a self-starter, an independent worker, and a team player in this fast-growing organization.

This role reports to the Vice President of Program Strategy & Impact. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality coaching and facilitation across the organization's partner network. This role develops the practice standards, training systems, coaching frameworks, and quality assurance processes that make transformational coaching teachable, repeatable, and effective.

Working closely with internal teams, partners, and volunteers, this position equips facilitators and other volunteers with the knowledge, tools, and confidence needed to deliver an exceptional participant experience. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead also serves as the primary resource for advanced coaching guidance for partner organizations, helping partners navigate complex situations while maintaining fidelity to the program's coaching philosophy.

The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead is responsible for establishing and maintaining program standards for high-quality coaching and facilitation in the classroom, including volunteer competencies, practice indicators, and quality assurance processes. The role supports the observation and assessment of frontline practice, provides targeted feedback and coaching to support classroom performance, and partners with internal team members and partners to address practice gaps and implement improvement plans. The Lead ensures that new frameworks, training, and tools are effectively adopted in the field while balancing program fidelity with appropriate contextual adaptation. This role also coordinates, facilitates, and oversees formal certification processes for the partner's volunteer coaches (Champions) and facilitators.

This role continuously evaluates coaching effectiveness by collecting and reviewing participant and partner feedback, identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating those insights into stronger training and coaching practices.

While most training and consultation can be delivered virtually, this position may require some travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously improve the organization's coaching philosophy, competencies, and practice standards that reinforce best practices.
  • Ensure coaching excellence is accessible, teachable, and repeatable throughout the network.
  • Foster psychologically safe learning environments where volunteers continue developing their skills.
  • Develop clear coaching models that ensure consistent participant experiences across all partner sites.
  • Translate behavioral science and evidence-based coaching practices into simple, practical tools.
  • Design and deliver engaging training for staff, partners, facilitators, and volunteer coaches.
  • Equip partner organizations to confidently deliver high-quality coaching that directly supports participants in the classroom.
  • Serve as the primary coaching consultant for partners facing complex participant or graduate situations.
  • Establish quality standards and observation processes for coaching and facilitation during new partner onboarding.
  • Evaluate participant and partner surveys to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Recommend and implement improvements that strengthen participant outcomes and coaching consistency.
  • Collaborate with program leadership to refine training materials and implementation strategies when needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in education, social work, organizational development, psychology, human services, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Five or more years of experience in coaching, adult learning, workforce development, leadership development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering adult learning programs.
  • Experience coaching professionals or training facilitators.
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to interpret partner and participant feedback provided and translate insights into practical improvements.

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team

The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role

We are looking for a proactive and experienced individual to join as Affirm Bank Treasury Manager. As Affirm Bank is currently in its formation phase, we are actively building out our foundational team. Reporting to the Bank CFO, Bank Treasury is responsible for cash management and operations, funding and liquidity planning, and balance sheet risk management for Affirm Bank. As we continue to scale the Bank and build out the foundational team, the ideal candidate should be able to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced environment with an eagerness to learn and grow.

What you’ll do

  • Support all treasury-related functions with a focus on liquidity and funding risk management, cash management, and periodic funding planning
  • Develop and execute liquidity risk stress testing models, defining stress scenarios, identifying risk exposures, and calibrating underlying model assumptions
  • Develop and maintain the Contingency Funding Plan (CFP), lead CFP simulations and testing, and track action plan timelines for liquidity events
  • Maintain and review Early Warning Indicators (EWIs) and existing risk limits, recommending updates and enhancements to balance sheet risk tolerances
  • Support The Asset Liability Committee (ALCO) reporting and committee presentations under the Bank CFO, benchmarking liquidity and Interest Rate Risk (IRR) profiles against limits
  • Support quarterly Interest Rate Risk (IRR) stress tests and semi-annual back-testing results reviews for ALCO
  • Assist with annual policy and assumption reviews, policy exception documentation, and recordkeeping for Liquidity and IRR policies
  • Guide the enhancement of balance sheet risk management reporting analytics and monitoring for senior leadership, regulators, and internal partners
  • Work cross-functionally with Affirm Treasury, Capital Markets, Bank Engineering, Strategic Finance, and the Bank Controller / Record to Report teams

What we look for

  • 5+ years of treasury or related financial function experience within banking or financial services
  • BA/BS required
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) preferred
  • Broad range of Treasury specific experience with both market facing and risk management exposure at a financial institution and have familiarity with consumer deposits, working capital line, warehouse facilities and other typical financial funding instruments
  • Possess strong analytical quantitative capabilities with statistical modeling knowledge and background
  • Proactive self-starter who is eager to learn with positive attitude

Base Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - USA8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Employees new to Affirm or promoted into a new role, typically begin in the min to mid range.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge

All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

Misumi Americas is seeking a Senior Applications Engineer - CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high-complexity, production-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD&T, and DFM skills,strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer & Program/Production Support

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs.
  • Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions.
  • Some level of support for customers through prototype → production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early.

Manufacturing & DFM Expertise

  • Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC-machined components.
  • Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost.
  • Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling.
  • Support efforts with manufacturing-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time.

Assembly & System-Level Understanding/Support

  • Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including:
    • Part-to-part fit, stack-ups, and tolerance interactions
    • Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly
    • Assembly sequencing and installation considerations
  • Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation.
  • Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework.

Technical Execution

  • Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD&T.
  • Perform CAD work, including:
    • Design updates for manufacturability
    • Parametric 3D Modeling & Visualization
    • Detailed Documentation & Drafting with GD&T
    • Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM
    • Reverse engineering
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams.

Quality & Compliance Awareness

  • Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows.
  • Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition (“quality in, quality out”).

Desired Traits

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply).
  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands-on experience.
  • Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi-axis) and Casting, .
  • Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade-off fluency.
  • Hands-on experience in production-scale manufacturing programs.
  • Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical discussions.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.
  • Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills.
  • SolidWorks CAD proficiency.
  • Willingness to perform hands-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed.
  • Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with Casting, Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP).
  • Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers.
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer-facing content creation, and day-to-day engineering workflows.
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer-facing workflows.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Standard Office & Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations.
  • Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection).
  • Lifting & Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K plan
  • Parental leave programs
  • Paid volunteer days
  • And much, much more!

Salary Range: $175,000 to $180,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

description:
Manager, EMEA Enterprise Support

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the Director, Enterprise Support | Remote, EMEA-based

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Backblaze is growing quickly, with customers that include some of the biggest AI, media, and cloud infrastructure companies in the world. As our EMEA business grows, we are investing in a dedicated, in-region Enterprise Support team, and we need a Manager to build it and lead it. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Support, you will help shape how we support strategic customers in the region, with the speed, depth, and care that enterprise teams expect.

You will hire and develop the team, set the standards, and grow the operation, in close partnership with Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close to customers and escalations, and build the processes and playbooks that let the team scale.

What You Will Own

Build

  • The EMEA team. Define the roles and structure the region needs, then recruit, onboard, and develop a team that scales with the business.
  • Standout enterprise support. Make sure strategic customers get fast, expert, and consistent help, with clear ownership from first contact through resolution.
  • Leadership from the front. Stay close to the work, owning critical escalations and coaching the team through the toughest issues.
  • One global team. Partner with the Director and global support leaders to keep coverage and handoffs seamless across regions and time zones.
  • Partnership across the business. Work hand in hand with TAMs, Solutions Engineers, CSMs, Account Managers, and Engineering so customers feel one coordinated Backblaze.
  • Measurement that matters. Set targets and report on response and resolution times, customer satisfaction, escalations, and team health.
  • Continuous improvement. Spot patterns in customer issues, share them with Product and Engineering, and build knowledge and runbooks that make every case faster.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • You have 7+ years in technical support, enterprise support, or customer operations at a B2B SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years managing teams.
  • You are a builder at heart: you have hired and grown a team, ideally in a new region or function, and you are equally happy handling an escalation or designing the process behind it.
  • You are technical enough to work with engineers and customers on cloud storage, APIs, networking, data migration, and integrations.
  • You have supported strategic or enterprise customers and know how to stay calm, clear, and credible when the stakes are high.
  • You think in SLAs, escalation paths, and customer health, and turn metrics into action.
  • You love bringing people together, and can influence leaders across Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering.
  • You are based in EMEA, with the flexibility to work with colleagues across time zones.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Fluency in an additional European language.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar support tooling.

Why You Will Love It Here

This is a high-impact leadership role at a fast-growing company, with real ownership, executive visibility, and a direct line to the Director of Enterprise Support. You will set the standards, pick the people, and shape a regional team that moves fast and works as one.

The customers are big, the pace is quick, and the opportunity to build is real. If you like being close to the work and seeing your impact show up in customer trust, retention, and growth, you will fit right in.

Come help us build the best enterprise support experience in cloud storage.

description:
Position Summary
The Benefits and Payroll Specialist leads day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs and supports positive, accurate, and compliant employee benefits experience. This role serves as a primary resource for benefit enrollments, employee education, vendor coordination, eligibility, leave administration, data integrity, and benefit reconciliations. This role also owns the execution and quality control of semi-monthly payroll, partnering with HRIS and Finance to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time. The role uses data, audits, and process improvements to strengthen service delivery across the employee lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Benefits Administration:

  • Administer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, retirement and other employee benefit programs, including new-hire enrollment, qualifying life events, terminations and annual open enrollment.
  • Coordinate benefits communications, employee presentations, enrollment support, office hours and educational materials; resolve or appropriately escalate employee questions with confidentiality and care.
  • Partner with benefit brokers, carriers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to resolve eligibility, claims-navigation and enrollment issues and improve the employee experience.
  • Audit eligibility, elections, dependent information, carrier files, vendor feeds and payroll deductions; investigate discrepancies and coordinate timely corrections.
  • Reconcile benefit invoices and enrollment records with HRIS/payroll data, document variances and coordinate resolutions with Finance and vendors.
  • Support leave-of-absence and return-to-work administration, including accurate benefit and payroll treatment, coordination with applicable state paid-leave requirements and escalation of complex cases.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to support the administration and management of employee leaves of absence, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) requests, and American with Disabilities Act (ADA) accommodations, ensuring timely coordination, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance and consistent employee experience.
  • Support domestic and Puerto Rico benefits administration, including applicable election file feeds and coordination with local stakeholders.
  • Conduct periodic audits of 401(k) elections, contributions and changes to confirm accurate payroll treatment; partner with plan administrators on discrepancies.
  • Maintain benefits procedures, calendars and documentation; support required notices, reporting and compliance activities in partnership with HR leadership, brokers and legal advisers.

Payroll Processing & Controls:

  • Execute and oversee end-to-end semi-monthly payroll processing in Dayforce, including pre-payroll validation, payroll runs, review, approval coordination and post-payroll checks.
  • Audit employee pay changes, time and attendance exceptions, benefit deductions, leave impacts, retroactive adjustments, off-cycle payments and other payroll inputs; resolve exceptions before payroll closes.
  • Coordinate payroll corrections, garnishments, tax withholdings and statutory deductions; review payroll reports and partner with Finance on reconciliations and discrepancies.
  • Register and maintain new state payroll tax accounts as business needs require; coordinate payroll tax notices, agency inquiries and issue resolution with internal and external partners.
  • Monitor payroll-related state and federal requirements, including paid-leave payroll configuration, and escalate compliance or system risks promptly.
  • Provide payroll support for Puerto Rico employees and coordinate statutory or processing questions with appropriate specialists.
  • Analytics, Systems & Continuous Improvement
  • Prepare recurring benefits and payroll reports, audit results and actionable metrics on enrollment, deductions, vendor accuracy, service issues and processing trends.
  • Partner with the HRIS Administrator on Dayforce configuration, testing, data integrity, workflows and system changes; clarify ownership of system maintenance versus operational processing.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify enrollment, reduce manual work, improve controls and create standard operating procedures and backup coverage.
  • Assist with HR related projects and performs other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, finance or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in benefits administration and payroll operations, including hands-on payroll processing and reconciliation.
  • Experience administering employee benefit plans, enrollment events, vendor feeds, payroll deductions and benefits-related audits.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll processes, wage and hour requirements, payroll taxes, and benefits compliance; ability to research and escalate specialized issues.
  • Proficiency with HRIS/payroll platforms and Excel-based reporting; Dayforce experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting multi-state and/or Puerto Rico employee populations.
  • Experience with open enrollment implementation, broker/vendor coordination and retirement plan deduction audits.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are strongly preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Employee-centered communication, discretion and responsiveness; strong analytical judgment and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage recurring payroll deadlines while prioritizing benefits service, compliance and process improvement.
  • Cross-functional collaboration, ownership, documentation discipline and proactive problem-solving.

Travel

Limited Travel, scheduled per needs of the business

description:
Who we are:

ShorePoint is a fast-growing, industry recognized and award-winning cybersecurity services firm with a focus on high-profile, high-threat, private and public-sector customers who demand experience and proven security models to protect their data. ShorePoint subscribes to a “work hard, play hard” mentality and celebrates individual and company successes. We are passionate about our mission and going above and beyond to deliver for our customers. We are equally passionate about an environment that supports creativity, accountability, diversity, inclusion and a focus on giving back to our community.

The Perks:

As recognized members of the Cyber Elite, we work together in partnership to defend our nation’s critical infrastructure while building meaningful and exciting career development opportunities in a culture tailored to the individuals technical and professional growth. We are committed to the belief that our team members do their best work when they are happy and well cared for. In support of this philosophy, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including major carriers for health care providers. Highlighted benefits offered: 144 hours of PTO, 11 holidays, 85% of insurance premium covered, 401k, continued education, certifications maintenance and reimbursement and more.

Who we’re looking for:

We are seeking a Threat Hunter to support and enhance our 24/7 Security Operations Center. This role combines advanced threat detection, incident investigation and threat hunting with hands-on development of SIEM use cases, automation and analytics to identify and respond to sophisticated threats, including lateral movement. The ideal Threat Hunter brings strong investigative expertise and a builder mindset to continuously improve detection capabilities and strengthen overall SOC effectiveness. This is a unique opportunity to shape the growth, development and culture of an exciting and fast-growing company in the cybersecurity market.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide first-line SOC support, including alert monitoring, triage, routing, escalation and response across 24x7x365 operations.
  • Monitor, analyze and investigate security events, network traffic and host-based detections, distinguishing malicious activity from false positives.
  • Perform proactive and creative threat hunting and anomaly detection across SIEM and security tools, identifying patterns, lateral movement and emerging threats.
  • Conduct incident investigation, Cyber Threat Assessment and Remediation Analysis, including processing and correlating incident indicators with threat intelligence.
  • Tune and develop SIEM correlation rules and detection logic and rapidly build detection use cases in collaboration with incident response (IR) teams.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and tools (Python, Bash) to automate SOC and IR functions, including Indicator of compromise (IoC) ingestion, log processing and SIEM integrations via APIs.
  • Research, develop and maintain dashboards, visualizations and analytics to support detection, reporting and SOC performance monitoring.
  • Produce, review and maintain documentation and reporting, including cybersecurity briefings, metrics, incident reports and deliverables for stakeholders at all levels, ensuring alignment with editorial standards and government specifications.
  • Support threat intelligence operations, including reviewing and actioning IoCs and translating intelligence into actionable detections.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and stakeholders to support engagements such as Insider Threat, Rule of Engagement (ROE), threat hunting, testing activities and after-action reporting.
  • Support SOC operations processes, including ticket tracking, customer security assessments, ad hoc investigations, tabletop exercises and lessons learned activities.
  • Contribute to continuous SOC improvement by enhancing detection capabilities, processes, communication and overall operational effectiveness; participate in on-call rotation.

What you need to know:

  • Deep understanding of cyber threat TTPs, threat hunting methodologies and application of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Experience supporting 24x7x365 SOC operations, including alert monitoring, triage, analysis, response and review/action of threat intelligence and reported incidents.
  • Ability to manage multiple alerts and tickets in parallel, perform end-to-end triage through resolution and appropriately prioritize response actions including coordination with end-users.
  • Strong experience analyzing and correlating security events across multi-source ecosystem, including endpoint, network, email security tools, SIEM platforms and federal threat intelligence (e.g., CISA).
  • Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise security tools and platforms, including but not limited to FireEye, Elastic, Sourcefire, Malwarebytes, Carbon Black/Bit9, Splunk, Prisma Cloud, Cisco IronPort, Bluecoat, Palo Alto, Cylance and OSSEC.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM or security analytics platforms (e.g., Elastic Stack, Splunk), including log analysis, event correlation and detection support.
  • Experience with malware analysis and understanding of attack vectors involving malware, data exposure, phishing and social engineering techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, performing event timeline analysis and investigating logs across Windows/Linux environments and network security devices.

Must have’s:

  • 5+ years of technical experience.
  • Ability to support working hours: 8:45 AM - 5:15 PM Eastern Time
  • Ability to participate in a rotating SOC on-call; rotation is based on number of team members.
  • Demonstrated proficiencies with one or more toolsets such as Bit9/CarbonBlack, CrowdStrike, FireEye ETP, Elastic Kibana.
  • Solid understanding and experience analyzing security events generated from security tools and devices such as: Carbon Black, CrowdStrike, FireEye, Palo Alto, Cylance and OSSEC.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking skills to break down complex, ambiguous problems into actionable tasks and determine appropriate courses of action.
  • Applicants must currently be a U.S. citizen in compliance with federal contract requirements

Beneficial to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.
  • One or more of the following certifications: GIAC (GCIH, GCFE, GCFA, GREM, GNFA, GCTI, GPEN, GWAPT), CEPT, CASS, CWAPT or CREA.

FGs are also responsible for helping to create financial education content to help participants self-serve on their personal finance journey.

This is a full-time position with shifts from 1:00 to 9:00 p.m. ET, Monday through Friday. There are no weekend requirements.

This position is remote, meaning you can work fully remotely, but there may be occasional opportunities to travel during your employment.

About Your Money Line:

Money is the #1 stressor for American workers—and we’re on a mission to create financial stability and confidence for all. YML is a leading financial wellness benefit pairing AI-powered software with empathetic human coaching to change the financial lives of thousands of households—from teachers to nurses and everyone in between. With YML, employees get help with everyday money challenges, and employers see gains in team wellness, retention, and engagement.

Your Money Line was founded by Peter Dunn (aka Pete the Planner™) and is funded by leading Midwest investors, such as Allos Ventures, First Trust Capital Partners, Elevate Ventures, and CareSource.

What You’ll Do:

As a Financial Guide, you are likely the first voice someone hears on their financial journey. At Your Money Line, you’ll:

  • Translate each participant’s money story into clear and compassionate guidance that aligns with their values and stage of change
  • Offer participant support across channels, including email, phone, chat, and Zoom
  • Facilitate recurring one-on-ones with participants to celebrate progress, unpack habit challenges, and help participants build routines rooted in identity and personal wins
  • Co-create educational content from webinars and short videos to articles and worksheets
  • Escalate questions as necessary to senior members of the financial guide team
  • Participate in ongoing learning via peer coaching, real-time feedback, and industry updates, ever-evolving your financial and counseling fluency

Requirements:

We’re on a mission to partner with commercial trades to deliver technology that enhances technician productivity, improves customer experiences, and drives scalable growth.

You’ll work alongside our forward-thinking Executive Leadership Team to spearhead impactful, transformative solutions.

Why ServiceTrade:

You’ll belong here from the start.

We bring together kind, curious people with diverse perspectives and trust them with meaningful work. You’ll have ownership, clarity, and support to solve real problems, make a visible impact for our customers, and continue growing as your role evolves.

On the Revenue team, you’ll have the opportunity to join a team of strategic thinkers, strong negotiators, deal makers, innovative planners, and creative solution finders of the business world. title: Manager, Financial Reporting & Accounting
excerpt: Overview The Manager, Corporate Accounting & Financial Reporting is a hands-on member of Quarterhill’s Corporate Accounting team, combining technical accounting and external financial reporting with day-to-day corporate accounting and treasury operations.
description:
Overview

The Manager, Corporate Accounting & Financial Reporting is a hands-on member of Quarterhill’s Corporate Accounting team, combining technical accounting and external financial reporting with day-to-day corporate accounting and treasury operations. Reporting to the Director of Finance, Corporate, this role is the preparer of the corporate month-end close and of the quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements and MD&A, executes treasury activities under the Director’s review, and works closely with Accounts Payable and FP&A to give leadership an accurate and timely view of cash.

Quarterhill is a TSX-listed Intelligent Transportation Systems company growing through acquisition, with operations in Canada, the U.S., and Europe. The successful candidate will bring strong IFRS technical depth, public company reporting experience, and an operator’s mindset: someone equally comfortable writing a technical accounting memo, building a cash flow statement that ties, reconciling a bank account, and tightening a close process. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with no direct reports at the outset; the scope is expected to grow as the company scales.

Responsibilities

Corporate Month-End Close

  • Prepare the corporate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, including journal entries, accruals, prepaids, intercompany entries, and balance sheet account reconciliations, for review by the Director of Finance, Corporate.
  • Maintain the corporate close calendar and checklist; coordinate inputs and deadlines with business unit finance teams (Tolling and ITS), Accounts Payable, and FP&A.
  • Prepare intercompany reconciliations and eliminations, and foreign currency revaluation and translation using correct period-end rates (IAS 21).
  • Prepare monthly corporate results and variance analysis to support management reporting.
  • Drive a faster, more predictable close through standardized workpapers, templates, and automation in NetSuite.

Financial Reporting & Consolidation

  • Prepare consolidated quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS, including notes, disclosures, and supporting schedules.
  • Prepare the consolidated statement of cash flows, including working capital movements, non-cash items, and the effect of foreign exchange on cash, fully reconciled to the balance sheet.
  • Own the integrity of the consolidation and reporting workbooks, ensuring every check and tie-out is cleared and every figure is traceable to support before review.
  • Prepare drafts of MD&A, earnings press releases, and other continuous disclosure documents for review.
  • Run the consolidation process across corporate and subsidiary entities, and help onboard newly acquired businesses to Quarterhill’s reporting calendar, chart of accounts, policies, and NetSuite, including purchase price allocation support.
  • Prepare technical accounting position papers independently on complex transactions (business combinations, revenue under IFRS 15, leases under IFRS 16, share-based compensation, debt modifications and covenant matters, and disposals) and maintain accounting policy documentation.
  • Monitor new and amended accounting standards and lead their implementation, including IFRS 18.
  • Support statutory financial statements and income tax provisions for corporate and foreign subsidiaries, coordinating with external tax advisors.

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Execute day-to-day treasury activities under the review and approval of the Director of Finance, Corporate, including daily cash positioning, bank reconciliations, intercompany funding and cash sweeps across Canadian, U.S., and European entities, foreign exchange conversions, and payment run preparation.
  • Operate payment controls, including callback verification of payment instructions, dual authorization, and banking portal access in line with the delegation of authority.
  • Prepare debt-related schedules, including interest calculations and draw and repayment support, and the quarterly covenant compliance calculations and certificates for lenders; track covenant headroom and add-back caps during the quarter and flag potential breaches early.
  • Support cash settlements under transition services agreements with acquired businesses, and maintain the register of surety bonds and letters of credit.
  • Support liquidity, capital resources, and financial risk disclosures (IFRS 7) in the financial statements and MD&A.

Cash Forecasting & Accounts Payable Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A on the weekly cash flow forecast, providing actual cash results, payment timing, debt service, and corporate inflows and outflows, and analyzing forecast-to-actual variances.
  • Work closely with the Accounts Payable team on payment prioritization, vendor issues, accrual completeness, and cut-off, so that the cash forecast and the month-end close reflect the same information.
  • Review corporate cash application and accounts receivable reconciliations to keep the cash forecast and balance sheet accurate.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance, Corporate and the Accounts Payable team to strengthen AP processes and controls, including invoice approval workflows, matching, and vendor master data.

External Audit & Internal Controls

  • Serve as the day-to-day contact for the external auditors on corporate accounting and reporting matters, preparing audit and review support packages and managing requests against agreed timelines.
  • Operate and document key controls over the close, treasury, and financial reporting processes as a first-line control owner, partnering with the Internal Controls team on control design, testing, and remediation.
  • Support disclosure controls and procedures and management’s quarterly and annual certifications (NI 52-109), and readiness for U.S. regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively identify, document, and escalate technical accounting, audit, and control risks to the Director of Finance, Corporate.

Systems & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Help optimize the use of NetSuite, Oracle EPM, financial statement and disclosure management tools (including Anaplan and Workiva), and banking platforms to improve the efficiency of the close, consolidation, and treasury processes.
  • Liaise with business unit finance teams, legal counsel, the transfer agent, and investor relations to support accurate and timely disclosure; prepare financial materials for earnings calls and analyst packages.
  • Support acquisition integration, special projects, and ad hoc analysis as required.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA designation (CPA Canada) required.
  • Minimum 4 years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big Four or national firm strongly preferred) and ideally at least 1 year in industry in a financial reporting, controllership, or treasury role.
  • Public company reporting experience required (TSX, NASDAQ, NYSE, or equivalent), including preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements, and MD&A.
  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS, with a track record of writing technical accounting memos independently; working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting is an asset.
  • Hands-on treasury experience, including cash management, bank reconciliations, payment controls, and debt covenant reporting.
  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation; experience integrating acquired businesses is an asset.
  • Advanced Excel skills; NetSuite experience is an asset, and experience with Oracle EPM, Anaplan, or Workiva is also an asset.

Competencies

  • A hands-on doer who is comfortable preparing the work, not only reviewing it, while looking for ways to make the process better.
  • Exceptional attention to detail: work is tied out and internally consistent before it goes for review.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear auditor-facing memos and executive-facing summaries.
  • Highly organized, with a demonstrated ability to manage competing close, reporting, and treasury deadlines in a fast-paced, acquisitive environment.
  • Collaborative working style, building effective relationships across Finance, FP&A, Accounts Payable, business unit finance teams, and operations, including getting results without direct authority.
  • Self-directed, with sound judgment on when to escalate complex accounting matters.

Benefits

We offera Total Rewards plan designed with you and your family’s health and wellness in mind that includes:

  • Paid days off (i.e.vacation, sick days, bereavement leave)
  • Health and Dental plans
  • Retirement plans

  • Employee referral program

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected.

In een volgende fase draag je bij aan de rationalisatie van de firewallomgeving. Je beoordeelt bestaande policies en rulebases kritisch en helpt verouderde of ongebruikte regels gecontroleerd te verwijderen.

Deze functie vraagt om een ervaren engineer die zelf implementeert en problemen oplost. Een aanpak die uitsluitend op securityarchitectuur of governance gericht is, volstaat niet. Je combineert technische diepgang met inzicht in afhankelijkheden, integraties, beveiliging en onderhoudbaarheid.

Je werkt nauw samen met de product owner infrastructuur. Die bewaakt de prioriteiten en de bredere productkeuzes, terwijl jij instaat voor de technische expertise, risico-inschatting en concrete uitwerking. Documentatie, kennisoverdracht en het formuleren van haalbare verbeteringen blijven doorheen de verschillende trajecten een vast onderdeel van je opdracht.

Resultaatsgebieden

  1. De 802.1X/NAC-oplossing afronden: je werkt de bestaande implementatie met HPE Aruba en ClearPass verder uit, brengt ze in productie en rondt ze operationeel af. Je configureert authenticatie en autorisatie voor endpoints die toegang krijgen tot het bedrijfsnetwerk.
  2. Technische problemen oplossen: je analyseert implementatieproblemen gestructureerd, achterhaalt de oorzaak en werkt oplossingen uit. Je test de oplossingen met aandacht voor integraties, afhankelijkheden en onderhoudbaarheid.
  3. Netwerksegmentatie en -segregatie realiseren: je brengt samen met application owners en andere stakeholders de noodzakelijke netwerkstromen, afhankelijkheden en toegangen in kaart. Je vertaalt de vereisten naar technisch uitvoerbare maatregelen en draagt bij aan de implementatie.
  4. De firewallomgeving rationaliseren: je analyseert firewall policies en rulebases, identificeert verouderde of ongebruikte regels en werkt mee aan de gecontroleerde verwijdering ervan.
  5. Documentatie en kennisoverdracht verzorgen: je legt technische keuzes, configuraties en werkwijzen helder vast. Je draagt de oplossingen en bijbehorende kennis gestructureerd over aan de operationele teams.
  6. Technische afstemming en verbetering opnemen: je stemt keuzes, risico's en afhankelijkheden af met de product owner en met infrastructuur-, security- en applicatieteams. Je beoordeelt bestaande implementaties en werkwijzen kritisch, stelt haalbare verbeteringen voor en vertaalt securityprincipes naar praktisch werkbare oplossingen.

Beoogde resultaten

  • Een operationele, geteste en gedocumenteerde 802.1X/NAC-oplossing, inclusief gestructureerde overdracht aan de operationele teams.
  • Technisch gerealiseerde segmentatiemaatregelen op basis van een duidelijk inzicht in netwerkstromen, afhankelijkheden en noodzakelijke toegangen.
  • Een beter beheersbare firewallomgeving dankzij onderbouwde analyse en gecontroleerde opschoning van policies en rulebases.

Technische achtergrond

Vereisten

  • Ruime ervaring als Security Engineer en Network Engineer, of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
  • Sterke praktische kennis van enterprise-netwerkomgevingen en netwerksecurity.
  • Aantoonbare hands-on ervaring met het implementeren, configureren en troubleshooten van 802.1X en Network Access Control met HPE Aruba en ClearPass.
  • Goede kennis van authenticatie- en autorisatieconcepten binnen netwerkomgevingen.
  • Ervaring met het implementeren en troubleshooten van netwerksecurityoplossingen.
  • Goede kennis van netwerksegmentatie en -segregatie.
  • Ervaring met firewalls en met het beheren en analyseren van firewall policies en rulebases.
  • Vermogen om netwerkstromen en applicatieafhankelijkheden te analyseren en te vertalen naar technische securitymaatregelen.
  • Ervaring met het documenteren van technische oplossingen en het overdragen ervan aan operationele teams.

Pluspunten

  • Ervaring in een complexe IT-omgeving met verschillende technische en niet-technische stakeholders.

Persoonlijke fit en werkhouding

  • Je werkt graag hands-on en analyseert technische problemen op een gestructureerde manier om de oorzaak te achterhalen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en resultaatgericht. Je neemt ownership en volgt werkzaamheden op tot ze geïmplementeerd, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn.
  • Je communiceert helder met technische en niet-technische stakeholders, werkt samen met verschillende teams en deelt actief kennis.

Voorbereiding op het interview

Gebruik daarvoor dezelfde praktijkcase als bij de externe vragen en behandel de volgende onderdelen: beginsituatie, technische aanpak, stakeholders en afhankelijkheden, implementatie en resultaat, overdracht en lessons learned.

Department Overview

The Department of Molecular Microbiology & Immunology comprises a cadre of interactive and interdisciplinary faculty with diverse expertise. Our faculty are active in the scientific community and within OHSU, serving on NIH study sections, as editors for prestigious journals, and as members on university committees and councils. The overall mission of our department involves research and education, while bringing together basic and translational efforts through close collaborations with the Vaccine and Gene Therapy Institute, the Oregon National Primate Research Center, and the VA Portland Health Care System as well as Providence Portland Medical Center.

Function/Duties of Position

This position supports the financial management and post-award administration of the Basic Science Departments under the supervision of the Basic Science Budget Manager. Position actively works with Financial Manager and other OHSU partners (OPAM, CFS, etc.) to resolve questions, issues and/or errors, ensuring adherence to internal and external applicable policies. Additional responsibilities include participation in post-award team meetings, basic science team meetings, development of department policies/procedures, advising and training others on financial matters and special projects as requested by OHSU leadership and faculty.

Post-Award Grant Administration

  • Develop and maintain PI Grant reports for assigned faculty, including providing information for Other Support Pages.
  • Administers reporting and other requirements with grant recipients, reviews plans/agreements, schedules, and budgets.
  • Works with various sub-contract institutions on resolving budgeting and invoicing issues.
  • Processes grant budgets and salary/effort on grants as needed.
  • Prepares regular grant spending forecasts. This requires adjustment of OHSU labor distribution as needed via Oracle Discoverer, grants accounting and Labor Distribution.
  • Analyze all monthly grant income (including foundation funds) and expenses transactions for department.
  • Monitor personnel costs and all other grant spending to ensure adherence to proposed scientific aims and budgets.
  • Process adjustment forms and/or request/supervise processing, as needed.
  • Provide financial analysis, variance analysis, data queries, and reports for grants and subcontracts via Matrix.
  • Ensure compliance with federal and OHSU grant policies, researching faculty questions and providing training when needed.
  • Process grant extensions and carryforwards.
  • Provide monthly reports to PIs on their grant expenditures and forecasts of future spending, anticipating potential shortfalls and proactively work with faculty to mitigate such without compromising the accomplishment of specific aims.
  • Advise CRO, Department Administrator and Department Chair of faculty funding issues.
  • Work with OPAM to prepare set up of new projects, load/adjust budgets, assist in preparation of Final Financial Reports, and grant close-out.

Budget and Fiscal Management for Department

  • Provides input and data for department budget development.
  • Manages recruitment/start-up packages.
  • Tracks commitments and available packages to help plan for faculty recruitments.

Financial Data and Reporting

Other Duties

  • Updates/enters labor distribution for assigned PIs and labs. Serves as the effort coordinator for basic science department members.
  • Regularly communicates with CRO, RAPP, department administrators, and Chair on important financial details, updates and forecasts.
  • Additional responsibilities assigned as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field from an accredited college or university; AND

  • Minimum of 2 years of progressively responsible relevant work experience.

  • Prior Academic Health Center or relevant financial specific experience performing analysis related to operational improvements and business cases.
  • Highly proficient with use of PC, including database and spreadsheet applications.
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills, including complex functions, formulas and formatting. Experience with relational databases. Understanding of financial reporting concepts such as cost accounting and net present value analysis.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks at one time and avoid crisis.
  • Must have excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills: both written and verbal. Able to convey complicated financial information to non-finance individuals.
  • Very high degree of accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team while being collaborative in resolving problems.
  • Must have demonstrated excellent customer service skills both on the phone and in person.
  • Must possess energy and drive to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to use tact and diplomacy to maintain effective working relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completion of OHSU Essentials of Grant Administration certificate.

  • A minimum of 3 years’ academic health center experience with post-award sponsored projects financial analysis, specifically with NIH sponsored projects and multi-center grants (R01, R21, U01, and F-type grants).

  • A minimum of 2 years’ administrative experience with NIH comprehensive center grants (P60) and NIH National Research Service Awards (NRSA, T- and F-type grants), including management of trainees in xTrain.

  • A minimum of 1 year of post-award experience at OHSU.

  • Proficient in utilizing ORACLE, Cognos, IBS, AR, iExpense, and strong excel and accounting expertise.

Additional Details

Please list work experience on resume in months and years.

This position is teleworking but work at OHSU Marquam hill is possible with office or cubicle. Schedule is Monday - Friday, during normal working hours (schedule flexibility is possible within limits), and occasional overtime required, typically due to increased workload deadlines.

Benefits

  • Healthcare for full-time employees covered 100% and 88% for dependents.

  • Substantial Tri-Met and C-Tran discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program.

  • Tuition reimbursement.
  • Employee discounts to local and national businesses.

Position Summary

We are seeking a strategic and experienced Senior IT Security Engineer to lead our Security Operations Center (SOC) and drive our organization's cybersecurity excellence. You will play a critical leadership role in managing complex security incidents, designing vulnerability management strategies, overseeing security compliance frameworks, and mentoring our security team. With 6-8+ years of advanced hands-on security experience, deep expertise in incident response and threat investigation, proficiency with enterprise security platforms (Sophos Intercept X, Windows Defender, Proofpoint, ManageEngine), and a demonstrated track record of building secure infrastructure, you will help establish DataCore as a security leader. If you can think strategically about security architecture, lead incident response investigations, mentor junior analysts, and drive compliance initiatives across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR, we want to hear from you!

Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic & Leadership Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Security Operations Center (SOC) team, mentor junior and mid-level analysts, and establish best practices for incident response and threat detection
  • Design and implement security monitoring strategies, detection engineering capabilities, and alert tuning frameworks across Sophos, Proofpoint, Windows Defender, and ManageEngine
  • Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, runbooks, and playbooks for the organization; ensure alignment with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS2 requirements
  • Conduct security risk assessments and threat modeling; recommend security architecture improvements and infrastructure hardening initiatives
  • Serve as primary liaison with compliance teams; drive audit readiness activities and evidence collection for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulatory compliance programs
  • Evaluate, select, and manage security tools and vendor relationships; conduct cost-benefit analysis and ROI assessments for new security solutions
  • Lead incident response for complex, multi-stage security incidents; perform advanced root cause analysis and develop strategic remediation plans

Operational & Technical Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, detect, analyze, and respond to security incidents and alerts from Sophos Intercept X Advanced, Windows Defender, Proofpoint, and other security platforms with advanced investigation techniques
  • Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments and security scans using ManageEngine; establish prioritization frameworks based on business context and threat landscape
  • Investigate advanced threats, malware incidents, and suspected breaches; perform forensic analysis and produce detailed incident reports with executive summaries
  • Manage email security at scale; develop and enforce email security policies, investigate sophisticated phishing and BEC campaigns, and implement email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  • Perform threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK framework; identify emerging threats and proactive security gaps before they are exploited
  • Collect, analyze, and report security metrics, KPIs, and incident trends to management; design security dashboards and executive-level security briefings
  • Support continuous improvement of security awareness and training programs; assess training effectiveness and adjust content based on threat landscape

Requirements

Essential Skills and Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent professional experience and demonstrated expertise)
  • 6-8+ years of hands-on experience in IT Security, incident response, or security operations.
  • Advanced expertise in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, incident response management, and threat investigation with demonstrated ability to lead complex investigations
  • Expert-level knowledge of operating systems (Windows Server, Linux) including security hardening, OS-level threat detection, and endpoint security architecture
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPN, proxies) and network security architecture; ability to design secure network segmentation
  • Deep understanding of attack vectors, attack chains, and the cyber kill chain; ability to map threats to MITRE ATT&CK framework and develop countermeasures
  • Expert hands-on experience with Sophos Central Intercept X Advanced or similar advanced EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) solutions; demonstrated ability to configure, tune, and leverage advanced EDR capabilities
  • Expert experience with Windows Defender for Endpoint and/or other enterprise antivirus/anti-malware solutions at scale
  • Expert-level knowledge of email security; deep experience with Proofpoint or similar enterprise email security platforms; proficiency in email authentication protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI)
  • Expert-level experience with vulnerability scanning and management tools, preferably ManageEngine; demonstrated ability to design vulnerability management programs, prioritize remediation, and track metrics
  • Advanced expertise in SIEM tools and log analysis; proven ability to design SIEM architectures, develop correlation rules, and build security use cases
  • Demonstrated expertise in compliance frameworks (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2); experience leading compliance assessments and audit preparations
  • Expert-level analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to think strategically about security architecture and long-term security posture
  • Exceptional communication skills; ability to present technical security findings to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal communication
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop junior security analysts; experience building and scaling security teams
  • Leadership experience managing security incidents and coordinating response across multiple teams

Preferred Skills and Certifications

  • Advanced security certifications such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CompTIA Security+ or equivalent foundational certifications
  • Advanced experience with threat intelligence platforms, threat research, and intelligence-driven security operations
  • Advanced scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, Bash) for security automation, SIEM rule development, and workflow optimization
  • Advanced cloud security expertise (Azure, AWS); demonstrated ability to design and secure cloud infrastructure; knowledge of cloud-native threat detection
  • Experience with SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation and Response) platforms and advanced automation of incident response workflows
  • Incident response leadership; experience as incident commander or on incident response teams for critical incidents
  • Security architecture and design expertise; experience building or redesigning security infrastructure
  • Experience with GRC (Governance, Risk, Compliance) platforms and compliance automation
  • Vendor management experience; track record of evaluating, negotiating, and managing security tool contracts
  • Threat hunting expertise and experience with advanced threat hunting methodologies

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
excerpt: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

Experience with security compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar; relevant cybersecurity certifications are a plus.

description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.

  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance
