Teikametrics is transforming the future of eCommerce with our AI-powered Multi-Marketplace Optimization Platform, helping brands maximize sales across Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok. We are an AI-powered retail media company and an award-winning Walmart Connect partner, recognized for our work with Chinese brands. We already serve a strong base of China-based sellers, and we are investing more in China.

About the Role

Chinese brands are some of the fastest-growing sellers on Walmart and Amazon in the US. Many are still underserved: great products and capable in-house teams, but little expert help with upper-funnel advertising, AI-driven shopping and the shift to agentic commerce.

We are looking for one leader to own China growth: the strategy, the pipeline, the brand and the results. At the center is our agency service. Our experts run advertising and growth for leading brands, alongside their in-house teams, powered by our AI platform. You will take it to market and make it the standard for how Chinese brands grow on US marketplaces.

What You'll Own

China growth strategy and results. Set the growth plan for China and own the number. Work directly with the CEO and US leadership, and shape our offer, pricing and product with what you see in the market.

Agency service sales: Win China's leading marketplace brands as agency clients.

  • Lead with a growth audit that shows a brand where it is leaving money on the table, then turn it into an ROI case the owner signs.

  • Sell to founders and owners as well as e-commerce leads, including large sellers running separate Walmart, Amazon and TikTok Shop teams.

  • Position the service alongside the brand's in-house team. We take on what in-house teams struggle to do alone: upper-funnel advertising, AI-driven bidding, listings built for AI shopping assistants, and integration with the brand's own tools.

Growth of the base we already have: Expand current clients into agency service, and bring new brands onto our AI platform with a clear path to upgrade.

Marketing and brand in China: Make us the name Chinese brands think of for marketplace growth: WeChat and Channels content, webinars in Mandarin, invite-only roundtables, events, case studies and partner referrals.

Marketplace partnerships: Work hand in hand with Walmart and Amazon teams in China on referrals, co-hosted sessions and events.

The team: Hire and lead a sales and marketing team as the business scales, and partner with our service team to launch, keep and grow every brand you sign.

Who You Are

Agency experience is a must. You have sold and delivered managed advertising services to Chinese cross-border sellers, at a marketplace ads agency, an Amazon Ads or Walmart Connect partner, or a service provider. Software-only sales is not enough for this role.

  • Hands-on ads management depth: You have run, or led the people who ran, Sponsored Ads, DSP and upper-funnel campaigns on Walmart or Amazon, and you can talk ROAS, incrementality and measurement with a brand owner.

  • A track record of winning and keeping agency clients, including brands with their own in-house ads teams. You know how to make in-house staff see the service as support, not competition.

  • You have owned both sales and marketing, and built pipeline from WeChat, events, partners and marketplace teams, not only from inbound.

  • You have led a team of sellers, marketers or account managers.

  • Fluent Mandarin and professional English, based in or able to work from Shenzhen.

What Can Help You Stand Out

  • Relationships with Walmart or Amazon teams in China.

  • A network among China's leading consumer brands selling on US marketplaces.

  • Experience bringing AI or software to market alongside a service.

You will thrive here if you are a builder who wants to own a business, not just a quota. You are as comfortable with the founder of a fast-growing Shenzhen brand as with US leadership, and you move fast, test, learn and keep raising the bar.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days you know the market: the top Chinese sellers on US marketplaces, who serves them today, and where we win. You have run your first growth audits, signed your first agency clients, and tested the pitch with real brands.

In your first year agency service is a growing, repeatable business in China. China's leading brands see us as their growth partner, Walmart and Amazon see us as a go-to partner for Chinese sellers, and you have built a team around a playbook that works.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of China growth, with a direct line to the CEO and a real say in strategy, offer and product.

  • Competitive base salary plus meaningful upside tied to the growth you drive.

  • An AI platform and marketplace partnerships that give you an edge in every pitch.

  • A company investing in China, with room to build the team and the business your way.

  • Flexible working, with a Shenzhen base.

The job description is representative of typical duties and responsibilities for the position and is not all-inclusive. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with business needs. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. A background check will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment is extended.
The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to: skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes potential opportunities for bonus or commissions, and equity grants. Speak with your recruiter for more information.

WHY TEIKAMETRICS?

At Teikametrics, you’ll experience the excitement of a growth-stage company with the stability of an established market leader. You’ll also have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology that’s transforming the industry, while collaborating with top brands redefining the future of eCommerce. With a remote-first culture we value impact over location and you’ll have the flexibility to work when you’re most productive and effective. Join us on our mission to be the world’s leading Marketplace Optimization Platform, used by every seller and brand owner.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

Teikametrics will never ask you to communicate via WhatsApp, Telegram, or other messaging apps during our hiring process. We do not request payment, financial information, or purchases of equipment during recruitment. All legitimate job openings are posted on our official careers page at , and our recruiters will only contact you through LinkedIn or official company email addresses (@teikametrics.com).
If you're unsure about a communication you've received, please contact us directly at to verify.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. companyName: Vivantify Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 7–11 Years
Openings: 1
Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Specialist – Data Engineering to design and establish scalable Data Lake/Lakehouse architectures for manufacturing and industrial data environments. The role involves building reliable data pipelines, implementing data governance and quality practices, enabling analytics and AI use cases, and assessing the security and compliance of ITAR-controlled data across the data landscape.

Job Description

The position focuses on defining and implementing data lake architecture to support manufacturing analytics, reporting, and applicable AI/ML use cases. The candidate will work with machine, equipment, MES, test, and probe data, ensuring accurate lot-, wafer-, and die-level traceability.

The role also involves evaluating existing data environments, strengthening data quality, lineage, governance, and access controls, and ensuring appropriate handling of ITAR-controlled information. The candidate will collaborate with technical teams and senior stakeholders to document findings, recommend improvements, and deliver scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable Data Lake/Lakehouse architectures across cloud or on-premises environments.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines for manufacturing, machine, equipment, MES, test, and probe data.
  • Establish data quality, governance, lineage, cataloguing, and traceability practices.
  • Develop data processing solutions using SQL, Python, Scala/Java, and Spark.
  • Implement data orchestration, streaming, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation.
  • Assess ITAR-controlled data classification, segregation, access, and security controls.
  • Enable analytics, reporting, and ML/AI use cases within manufacturing data environments.
  • Engage with stakeholders, document assessments, and communicate technical recommendations.

Required Skills

  • Data Engineering: Strong experience in enterprise data engineering, particularly in manufacturing, semiconductor, or industrial environments.
  • Data Lake/Lakehouse: Azure Data Lake, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Parquet-based storage, or equivalent architectures.
  • Programming: SQL and Python or Scala/Java.
  • Distributed Processing: Apache Spark.
  • Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP, or on-premises data platforms.
  • Orchestration & Streaming: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Kafka, or Event Hubs.
  • DevOps: CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Data Governance: Data cataloguing, lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Analytics & BI: Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire.
  • AI/ML: Understanding of ML/AI data pipelines and manufacturing analytics use cases.
  • Security & Compliance: ITAR/EAR export controls, IAM, RBAC/ABAC, encryption, network segmentation, and audit logging.

Mandatory Skills

  • Azure Data Lake
  • Azure DevOps

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of data engineering experience, preferably in manufacturing, semiconductor, or industrial environments. They should possess strong hands-on expertise in data lake architecture, distributed data processing, and cloud data platforms, along with an understanding of manufacturing data traceability, governance, and security compliance. Strong stakeholder management, assessment, and documentation skills are essential.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients.

description:
Job Title: Account Director - Purplemoon

Job Location: Montclair, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Purplemoon, an IQVIA business, the Account Director is more than a project facilitator. As a senior day-to-day leader, they build trusted client relationships, lead integrated agency teams, and ensure work progresses strategically, efficiently, and with a high standard of quality. They develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses, anticipate needs and challenges, bring a clear point of view, and create the clarity, momentum, and confidence needed to keep clients and internal teams moving forward. Successful Account Directors are trusted advisors and leaders who stay closely connected to account activity without being involved in every detail, proactively bring solutions, know when to make decisions versus escalate, and ensure clients feel their business is understood and well managed while providing teams with the direction, context, and support needed to deliver exceptional work.

Responsibilities:

Client Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day partner to clients, building strong relationships across brand and cross-functional teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand strategy, competitive environment, customers, and business objectives
  • Lead client meetings and communications with confidence, ensuring conversations are focused, productive, and action-oriented
  • Anticipate client needs, identify potential issues early, and proactively recommend solutions
  • Provide thoughtful counsel and an agency point of view rather than simply executing client requests
  • Build relationships beyond immediate day-to-day contacts and help strengthen the overall agency-client partnership

Account & Strategic Leadership

  • Maintain a clear understanding of the strategic objectives behind agency assignments and ensure work remains connected to those objectives
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Creative, Medical, Project Management, Digital and other disciplines to develop integrated solutions
  • Translate client needs into clear, actionable direction for internal teams
  • Evaluate work before it reaches the client to ensure it addresses the brief, reflects client expectations, and meets Purplemoon standards
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the work, expand existing assignments, or bring forward new ideas that can help the client's business

Team Leadership

  • Provide clear direction and leadership to the account team while creating opportunities for more junior team members to grow
  • Establish clear roles, expectations, priorities, and next steps across assignments
  • Ensure internal teams have the context and information they need to do their best work
  • Create strong partnerships across disciplines and help resolve issues quickly when teams become misaligned
  • Coach and develop junior account team members, providing regular feedback and increasing their level of ownership over time
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, solutions-oriented team environment

Operational & Financial Management

  • Maintain command of account scope, budgets, timelines, staffing needs, and deliverables
  • Partner with Project Management to ensure work is appropriately planned, resourced, and delivered on time
  • Identify scope changes and financial risks early and address them proactively
  • Participate in the development of scopes of work, estimates, forecasts, and staffing plans
  • Understand account financials and help ensure work is delivered profitably and within agreed-upon scope
  • Maintain visibility across multiple concurrent workstreams and establish priorities when demands compete

Growth & Agency Contribution

  • Look beyond individual assignments to identify opportunities to deepen Purplemoon’s relationship with clients
  • Participate in annual planning, organic growth initiatives, new-business opportunities, and pitches as appropriate
  • Contribute ideas and perspectives that improve how Purplemoon works and serves its clients
  • Help build a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and high standards

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of healthcare/pharmaceutical advertising or communications experience, with significant experience in account management
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing and the healthcare communications environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex accounts, multiple workstreams, and cross-functional agency teams
  • Strong client relationship and presentation skills
  • Ability to think strategically while maintaining command of executional details
  • Experience managing scopes, budgets, timelines, and account financials
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving skills, and ability to operate independently
  • Experience coaching and developing junior team members
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial agency environment where individuals are expected to take ownership and help solve problems beyond the boundaries of their job description

Please Note: You must reside within the country where this role is posted to be eligible for this remote job opportunity.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

Ocean Associates, Inc. (OAI) is seeking a candidate to support to the NOAA’s National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS), Office of Protected Resources (OPR) in Silver Spring MD. Tasks

  • Support the development of NOAA ‘in-house’ capacity for predictive sound field and sound exposure modeling, including the assessment and procurement of existing software, as well as the design, development, and use of new software and tools to support the assessment of acoustic impacts on protected species and their habitat, as well as NOAA’s broader Ocean Noise Strategy goals.
  • Assist by coordinating with the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), as necessary to maximize synergy with their similar in-house model development and work closely with OPR managers and others, as assigned, to ensure the resulting product supports NMFS’ management needs.

  • Familiarity with common anthropogenic sound sources (e.g. airguns, explosives, pile driving),

  • Ability to define project scope, goals, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with both client stakeholders and technical delivery teams
  • Experience developing detailed project plans, timelines, resource allocations, and budgets, including estimation for data and analytics workstreams
  • Expertise in scope, risk, dependency, timeline, and resource management across cross-functional teams of data engineers, analysts, and data scientists
  • Skilled in navigating ambiguity, managing evolving client requirements, and maintaining delivery momentum under pressure
  • Familiarity with change management and data-driven transformation initiatives, including user adoption of new analytics tools and platforms
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong follow-through, and highly effective organizational skills
  • 4+ years of professional services and/or project or program management experience
  • 5+ years overseeing technical delivery or consulting projects, ideally in data or analytics
  • 4+ years of client account management experience
  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

We are actively seeking candidates for full-time, remote work within the US. Atlanta-based applicants will have the opportunity to work in our headquarters in Sandy Springs, GA.

excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

Assignment Length: Approximately 2 Months

The Senior HRIS Analyst is responsible for the development, implementation, and ongoing optimization of HRIS solutions, with a primary focus on enabling scalable, compliant, and efficient HR operations. This role operates with advanced expertise to design, configure, and support system capabilities (including Workday), while influencing processes, standards, and cross-functional integration across the HR ecosystem.

Please Note: This is a temporary position expected to last approximately 2 months.

Key Responsibilities

HRIS Solution Design & Delivery

  • Lead the design, configuration, and enhancement of HRIS functionality to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate business requirements into system solutions, workflows, and reporting models
  • Develop and implement scalable processes that align with enterprise P&W transformation goals
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT to ensure system alignment across functions

Workday (or HRIS) Expertise & Capability Building

  • Serve as a subject matter resource in HRIS platforms, building depth in Workday functionality and best practices
  • Apply advanced knowledge to optimize system usage, improve user experience, and drive adoption
  • Identify and implement process and system improvements based on data, trends, and business needs
  • Support testing, releases, and continuous improvement cycles

Data, Reporting & Insights

  • Design and deliver advanced reporting capabilities across HR systems to support HR and business decision-making
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and integrity across HR systems
  • Develop complex reporting solutions and automation to improve efficiency and insight generation

Problem Solving & Innovation

  • Analyze complex issues involving multiple variables and systems; develop creative and effective solutions
  • Establish new approaches, frameworks, or processes where existing ones do not fully meet needs
  • Exercise judgment in adapting system configurations, business processes, or reporting methodologies

Collaboration & Influence

  • Partner across HR COEs and business stakeholders to align system capabilities with business priorities
  • Communicate complex system concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Influence decisions through data, expertise, and practical recommendations
  • Provide guidance and informal leadership to team members on HRIS practices and standards

Transformation & Change Enablement

  • Support organizational transformation through adoption of new systems, processes, and ways of working
  • Contribute to establishing new standards for HRIS delivery, service models, and operating practices
  • Demonstrate adaptability in evolving environments with shifting priorities and expectations

Success Profile

Knowledge & Application

  • Applies deep HRIS expertise and business acumen to design and deliver complex solutions
  • Understands interdependencies across HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT systems
  • Contributes to development of new processes, standards, and system capabilities

Complexity & Problem Solving

  • Handles complex assignments requiring evaluation of multiple data sources, systems, and business factors
  • Determines appropriate methods and approaches for new or ambiguous challenges
  • Exercises strong judgment in decision-making and solution design

Collaboration & Influence

  • Builds strong partnerships across teams and functions
  • Advises stakeholders on complex system and process decisions
  • Adapts communication style to influence and align across audiences

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of HRIS experience, including Workday administration, configuration, and support.
  • Strong knowledge of HR processes and systems, including HR, Payroll, and Finance integrations.
  • Experience translating business requirements into scalable system solutions and process improvements.
  • Advanced reporting and data analysis skills with a focus on data integrity and governance.
  • Experience supporting system testing, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting HR technology, transformation, and change management initiatives.
  • Workday certification(s) preferred.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 - $130,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

description:
About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

AiDASH is helping electric utilities and infrastructure providers improve reliability, reduce risk, and make smarter decisions for their operations. Our SaaS platform combines satellite data, analytics, and practical insights to support critical day-to-day work like vegetation management and storm preparedness.

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) to drive long-term success for our strategic North American customers. As the primary point of contact for a portfolio of active SaaS accounts, you'll own customer satisfaction, engagement, and retention - ensuring our customers consistently realize value from our platform. You’ll build trusted relationships across all levels, from field managers to executive stakeholders, becoming a go-to partner in their day-to-day operations and long-term planning. You’ll join a high-impact Customer Success team made up of CSMs, Product Consultants, and Project Managers - all committed to delivering measurable outcomes together.

You’ll be joining a high-performing Customer Success team that includes CSMs, Product Consultants, and PMs who work closely together to deliver outcomes. This is a relationship-driven role suited for someone who thrives in high-ownership environments, enjoys supporting real-world operations, and brings strong follow-through to everything they do.

Why AiDASH?

Our customers are on the front lines of the energy transition, climate adaptation, and infrastructure modernization. This role gives you a seat at the table with decision-makers who are responsible for keeping the lights on, managing vegetation risk, and meeting regulatory standards. You’ll join a team that’s collaborative, mission-focused, and committed to delivering outcomes that matter.
We’re also growing fast. This role offers a path to expand your impact - whether deepening relationships in strategic accounts, mentoring others, or helping shape the future of customer experience at AiDASH.
If you care about helping customers succeed and want to work on meaningful infrastructure challenges, we’d love to hear from you!

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own a portfolio of multi-year AiDASH customers, driving deep engagement, strong adoption, and long-term retention
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across field teams, operations, and leadership
  • Lead regular check-ins, training sessions, and strategic planning meetings to keep customers informed, aligned, and empowered
  • Monitor product usage, customer health, and feedback to proactively surface risks and uncover new opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with Product Consultants, Project Managers, Support, and Sales to solve challenges and improve customer outcomes
  • Play a key role in renewals and expansion efforts, working hand-in-hand with Sales to grow customer value and impact

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related post-sales roles within B2B SaaS or infrastructure sectors
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across all levels of the customer organization - from field managers to senior executives
  • Highly organized and dependable, with a proven ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities effectively
  • Quick learner and confident in explaining software platforms and data dashboards to diverse audiences
  • Experience working with utilities, infrastructure operators, or field-heavy industries is a strong plus

What you'll love:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
  • 401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after three months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
  • Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you.
  • Winter Break: From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends!

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We offer a competitive annual pay range of $110,000 to $140,000 for this full-time position, which includes a base salary and bonus based on performance. description:
About the Role:   

The Sr. Project Engineer manages the engineering strategy, design, and standards for a customer (or program), and is viewed as the engineering expert for that program. The Program Engineer’s sphere of influence starts with an RFP or concept and extends through as-built submission to ensure consistency of design and messaging to customers, the internal team, and vendors/subcontractors.

As a Program Engineer, you’ll work closely with Program and Account Managers to understand anticipated work in your program. You’llalso work with each engineering discipline through the different stages of a projectto ensure that strategy, engineering standards, and an excellent customer relationshipismaintained.We’ll appreciate your insightful leadership, communication skills, and thorough knowledge of your customer as you guide engineerswithin your program. 

In this role, you will…

  • Provide input to engineering teams throughout the full lifecycle of a project to ensure correct equipment & spec is incorporated into designs, promote value engineering, and ensure standardization
  • Estimate the engineering effort for bid purposes and contribute to precontract project planning
  • Work with Engineering Leadership to plan the “Program Team” – how many resources, what skills are needed, etc, for future projects
  • Aid in the transition of projects from Pre-contract to Post-contract
  • Attend meetings relevant to the program (internal and external, project and non-project) as required
  • Manage and be knowledgeable in all aspects of the customer spec (conveyor, structural, safety, etc…)
  • Train engineers and other team members on customer requirements, standards, and specifications
  • Travel to job sites and customer offices as needed; travel estimated at 10-15%
  • Act as liaison between DCS and the customer on spec questions and as the escalation point for internal project teams when spec disputes arise
  • Provide input to management in customer strategy discussions
  • Work with customer’s engineering team to understand, improve and implement new designs

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have BS in a technical discipline (ME, EE, other engineering, or equivalent experience)
  • You have 5+ years of experience integrating material handling system solutions and have a thorough knowledge of your customer’s conveyance systems and engineering requirements
  • You’re familiar with the full lifecycle of the design process and the installation/integration process
  • You’re proficient in AutoCAD & and have working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
  • You possess excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, and adapt effectively to various audiences, including internal teams, clients, and management
  • You are assertive and comfortable driving initiatives independently
  • You’re a self-motivated performer who can work with minimal supervision and high-level project guidance

About Us:

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982, and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More Reasons to Join Our Team:

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%
  • Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program
  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year
  • We know how to throw company events
  • We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?

title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Hiawatha, IA
excerpt: Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home.
description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

REMOTE California candidates

Summary of the Role:

​​The Aftermarket MRO Sales Engineer is responsible for driving revenue growth and customer satisfaction in the aerospace aftermarket through the sale of polymer‑based products and solutions, including seals, elastomers, engineered plastics, and consumable components used in maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) applications. This role supports aircraft owner‑operators, MRO facilities, distributors, and broker/resellers, combining strong technical knowledge of polymer materials with commercial expertise to address aftermarket performance, availability, and cost‑of‑ownership requirements. The Aftermarket MRO Sales Engineer serves as the technical and commercial interface between customers and internal engineering, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to develop compliant, interchangeable, and value‑driven polymer solutions. This includes supporting material selection, application suitability, regulatory compliance, and aftermarket substitution strategies to deliver competitive and profitable outcomes across the product lifecycle. ​The Aftermarket MRO Sales Engineer is responsible for building relationships across all levels within existing customers and prospective target accounts to generate new business opportunities.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

​The primary function of the Sales Engineer (SE) position is to promote and sell Trelleborg products and services within an assigned geographic area, market industry, product range or list of customer accounts in order to achieve sales and profit targets.

  • ​​Sales Growth: Achieve Sales Target. Strive for 10%+ year over year growth or agreed sales target.
  • ​Profitability: Achieve Profit Target. Strive for 10%+ year over year growth or agreed profit target.
  • ​Project Focus: Generate and convert projects for key target customers. Manage project cycle and speed.

  • ​Provide market feedback and intelligence for use by Global Aerospace MRO, Aerospace Marketing Department, Segment/Product/Lead/Analyst Group personnel.

  • ​Establish the market sell price and profit margin in collaboration with the Global Aftermarket MRO team utilizing market research, tools, and methods along with the support of the SM and GM.

  • ​Knowledge of aerospace market a plus.

  • ​Familiarity with ISO quality requirements is beneficial

Competencies:

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Excellent people and relationship building skills, including written and verbal
  • Customer driven with a positive, professional, can-do attitude
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to mulit-task with attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong analytical, decision making and problem solving skills
  • Proven proficiency and experience in the use of business operational software (CRM, Oracle JDE, SAP)

Travel:

title: Supply Chain Lead, Indirect
excerpt: About Electra Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be.
description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

As our Supply Chain Lead, Indirect, you'll own sourcing, supplier management, negotiations, and category strategy for Electra's indirect spend - IT, facilities, engineering services, professional services, travel, logistics, and MRO support.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll run your categories independently - from strategy and competitive sourcing through negotiation, contract award, and supplier performance - and make the commercial calls that come with them. As Electra scales toward certification and production, you'll build many of these category strategies from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies across indirect spend categories including Engineering Services, IT Hardware & Software, Facilities, Infrastructure, Professional Services, Travel, Logistics, MRO, and Corporate Services
  • Lead competitive sourcing events including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and contract awards
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business requirements and identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier consolidation
  • Negotiate commercial agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), software licensing agreements, and consulting contracts
  • Establish and manage supplier performance metrics, service-level agreements, and business reviews
  • Evaluate supplier financial stability, operational capability, cybersecurity posture, and business continuity risks
  • Support budget forecasting and spend analysis activities through data-driven sourcing recommendations
  • Drive procurement governance and compliance with company policies, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements
  • Identify and implement cost reduction, value engineering, and efficiency initiatives across indirect spend categories

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years of supply chain management experience in heavy industrial environments
  • 5+ years of directly applicable procurement experience in the aerospace or aircraft industry
  • Demonstrated results in contract negotiations and supplier performance management
  • Advanced analytical and financial modeling capabilities
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives
  • Strong collaboration, organizational, and time management skills
  • Effective communicator across all levels of an organization - internally and externally
  • Ability to author and review statements of work (SOWs), RFIs, RFPs, and supplier commercial and technical proposals
  • Self-motivated and accountable - able to thrive independently or as part of a geographically distributed team
  • US Person (Citizen or Permanent Resident) required

Bonus Points

  • Defense, manufacturing, or high-growth technology industry experience
  • Experience supporting prototype development, aircraft certification, or engineering-intensive environments
  • Professional certification such as CPSM, CPSD, CPM, CSCP, or PMP
  • Experience with ERP, spend analytics, and procurement systems
  • Knowledge of supplier risk management, aerospace regulations, and government contracting environments
  • Experience building category strategies from the ground up in a scaling organization

This range reflects the anticipated hiring range across all eligible locations; actual compensation is determined based on your relevant experience, skills, and geographic location. Total compensation includes performance bonus and comprehensive benefits.

Compensation Range
$110,000—$130,000 USD

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

About LogixHealth:

At LogixHealth we provide expert coding and billing services that allow physicians to focus on providing great clinical care. LogixHealth was founded in the 1990s by physicians to service their own practices and has grown to become the nation’s leading provider of unsurpassed software-enabled revenue cycle management services, offering a complete range of solutions, including coding and claims management and the latest business intelligence reporting dashboards for clients in 40 states.

Since our first day, we have had a clear vision of a better healthcare system and have continually evolved to get there. In addition to providing expert revenue cycle services, we utilize proprietary software to provide valuable financial, clinical, and other data insights that directly improve the quality and efficiency of patient care.

At LogixHealth, we’re committed to Making intelligence matter through our pillars of Physician-Inspired Knowledge, Unrivaled Technology and Impeccable Service.

To learn more about us, visit our website

Location: Remote: AL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, OK, TN, WI, WV

This Role: The Manager, EDI partners with the Senior Manager, 837, to plan, manage, and guide the daily activities of the EDI Department. You will lead the EDI Specialist team, serve as their first line of support, and make sure claims are submitted on time and reports are placed accurately.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and oversee the EDI Specialist team to deliver effective, timely service
  • Ensure daily work is completed, including EDI testing, paper and electronic claim processing, and review and correction of validations
  • Send 837 files and confirm validations are run in Allscripts PM to protect billing integrity
  • Retrieve and monitor insurance carrier reports on a regular basis
  • Retrieve documentation for timely filing requests and import it into TouchChart
  • Perform manual billing for the deductible monitoring program and order special forms
  • Complete electronic carrier setups, new client setups, and ERA/EFT enrollments as needed
  • Manage requests flowing through EDI mailboxes in a timely manner
  • Report monthly claim and statement totals to senior management
  • Maintain audits and key performance indicator metrics with the Senior Manager
  • Analyze current workflows with department managers and leads, and recommend process improvements
  • Manage recruitment, time and attendance approval, ongoing feedback, and annual performance reviews
  • Train and develop staff, create documentation and work standards, and resolve issues within the team
  • Facilitate department meetings and present to senior management as needed
  • Uphold the Code of Conduct, HIPAA Privacy and Security requirements, and all applicable laws and company policies

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each Key Responsibility satisfactorily. The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties.

Required:

  • Two to three years of related experience, including prior supervisory and EDI experience
  • Knowledge of electronic file processing
  • Ability to track and resolve EDI production system problems
  • Ability to oversee and manage staff
  • Proficiency with MS Excel and MS Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to individuals and small groups and to write routine reports and correspondence
  • Ability to work effectively with clients, trading partners, and management

Preferred:

  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare setting
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Benefits at LogixHealth:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental and vision, 401(k), PTO, paid holidays, life and disability insurance.
